dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib la jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlo thos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad skar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhud sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung ka'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khyab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khyab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkha'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las dar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhud dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla blta pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdo/sgrig gsal nga pond/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi bsdo zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dang rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' gos la bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhud chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhud chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab rbe|ga brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'chos bsdu phyog sgrig khang nas/10

dkar chagaza hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'khrul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam dang po/ (1)shis brjod phyag bya dang / dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo nas rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)sprul brgyud rim byon rnams mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan tshul sogs/ (6)rigs rus cho 'brang gi che ba brjod pa/ 514)sku bltams pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin bcas kyi skor/ (31)dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs pa dang paṇa chen rin po cher gtsug phud phul ba bcas kyi skor/ (41)dgung lo brgyad par gling smad zhabs drung gis 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang phul ba bcas kyi skor/ (49)dgung lo dgu par dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa sogs kyi skor/ (55)dgung lo bcu par mngon rtogs rgyan dang mgon po'i bskang bshags thugs 'dzin gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ (59)dgung lo bcu gcig par bsdus grwa'i rigs lam gyi gsan sbyong dbu tshugs pa'i skor/ (65)dgung lo bcu gnyis par dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas dbang lung zhus pa sogs kyi skor/ (69)dgung lo bcu gsum par gzhung chen slob gnyer la thugs bskyed gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ (73)

dkar chagaza hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'khrul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam dang po/ (1)shis brjod phyag bya dang / dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo nas rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)sprul brgyud rim byon rnams mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan tshul sogs/ (6)rigs rus cho 'brang gi che ba brjod pa/ 514)sku bltams pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin bcas kyi skor/ (31)dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs pa dang paṇa chen rin po cher gtsug phud phul ba bcas kyi skor/ (41)dgung lo brgyad par gling smad zhabs drung gis 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang phul ba bcas kyi skor/ (49)dgung lo dgu par dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa sogs kyi skor/ (55)dgung lo bcu par mngon rtogs rgyan dang mgon po'i bskang bshags thugs 'dzin gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ (59)dgung lo bcu gcig par bsdus grwa'i rigs lam gyi gsan sbyong dbu tshugs pa'i skor/ (65)dgung lo bcu gnyis par dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas dbang lung zhus pa sogs kyi skor/ (69)dgung lo bcu gsum par gzhung chen slob gnyer la thugs bskyed gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ (73)

dgung lo bcu bzhi par slob gnyer la mu 'thud thugs gnyer gnang ba dang / skyor mo lung dang dga' ldan la phebs pa bcas kyi skor/ (77)dgung lo bco lnga par yar klungs dang e dwags sogs lho gnas su phebs bskyod kyi skor/ (85)dgung lo bcu drug par dbu ma dang mdzod la thugs gnyer gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ 〈99)dgung lo bcu bdun par ra sgreng du phebs pa dang / lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho mjal gzigs shing phyag dpe pod lnga brgya tsam gyi dkar chag bsgrigs pa bcas kyi skor/ (104)dgung lo bco brgyad par khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel dang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi drung nas zab chos gsan cing / rgyud sde la thugs gnyer gnang ba bcas kyi skor/ (112)dgung lo bcu dgu par pha bong khar 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi drung nas zab chos gsan pa sogs kyi skor/ (115)dgung lo nyi shu par deb sngon dang / rnam nges rin chen sgron me sogs la thugs gnyer dang zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung nas zab chos gsan pa bcas kyi skor/ (120)dgung lo nyer gcig par 'jam dpal zil gnon dang / thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub gnang ba bcas kyi skor/ 5124)dgung lo nyer gnyis par bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa sogs kyi skor/ (130)dgung lo nyer gsum par sman rtsis la thugs gnyer gnang ba sogs kyi skor/ (135)dgung lo nyer bzhi par gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis khams be ri rgyal po bcom ste mdo smad dbang du bsgyur ba sogs kyi skor/ (140)dgung lo nyer lnga par gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis gtsang pa rgyal por dpung 'jug byas pa sogs kyi skor/ (149)2

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)ra༅༅/ /za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'brul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam dang po bzhugs/shis brjod phyag bya dang / dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo nas rtsom par dam bca' ba/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las rgyun chags lnga pa char sprin/༄༅/ /shis pa brjod pa'i sgo dang po/ ring mo nyid nas goms par mdzad pa'i spangs rtogs yon tan rtsal gsum rab rgyas mi 'jigs seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /(2na)nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib tshogs gcan gzan dregs snying lkog mar thon dang lhan cig bdud bzhi sde bcas g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /(2ba)mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan rtag pa'i rang bzhin tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas skyob pa gzhan las khyad par yongs byas bde ldan mgon/ /dran pas mi shig rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba nyer 'dzugs 'dren mchog 'od mtshan stong du 'bar bas 'jig rten gsum du dge legs stsol/ /shis pa brjod pa'i sgo gnyis pa/ phra rab rdul gyi grangs kyis mtsho ni min thub chen rnams kyi mkhyen dpyod phung po'i rang gzugs byu wā ra'i sa 'dzin la/ /rab bkra dbang po'i gzhu ris kyis klubs bcu drug na tshod dar drag 'dab stong lte bar zla ba'i gdan la 'gying bag sku/ /rnam dpyod dpung pas legs —1—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)gsungs la/ 'du tshul ni/ spyir sems can rnams kyi mgon po yin/ /sgos gangs ri'i khrod du rgyal srid skyong / /zhes rje gnya' khri btsan po sogs rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang lo paṇa rnal 'byor pa rab tu byung bas mtshon pa'i sprul pa mchog dman mtha' klas pa rim gyis 'byon par gsungs shing / khyad par bla ma dri ma med pa mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rje dkon mchog 'bangs lung bstan pa dang byin gyis brlabs/ de dag gi skabs mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi gsung las/rje dkon mchog 'bangs 'di bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams 'dul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas des drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgrol ma zag med la/ /mi kho yi btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /ces byung ba ltar dkon mchog 'bangs chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam por skye ba bzhes pa dang de nyid rang gi dbon sras khri srong lde'u btsan dang ral pa can sogs du ma'i srid pa bzung pa ni/ lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ / rigs gsum mgon pos nga bskul ba'i/ /nga la rigs gsum mgon zhes grags/ /kun tu bzang dang sgrib pa sel/ /nga bskul rgyal por bstan gyur (6ba〉na/ /ci ste nga la der mi smra/ /zhes lung bstan gsal bar byung la/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ mes dbon de dag gi rnam 'phrul du gdon mi za ba'i khungs/ glegs bam le'u bcu dgu par/ da hril te sgril na sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul par grags te ral pa can la sogs pa gcig gnyis rigs gzhan gnyis kyi rigs yin la/ phal che ba ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yin la/ mkhan brgyud byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na yin gyi gzhan du ma sems shig /ces pa'i lung rigs kyis grub cing / 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po nyid nas skye ba rim brgyud dang dus mtshudas su byon pa/ kha che dgon pa ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po snying po'i zhabs/ de dag gi rjes su dus mtshungs par byung ba/ 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/—1—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)gsungs la/ 'du tshul ni/ spyir sems can rnams kyi mgon po yin/ /sgos gangs ri'i khrod du rgyal srid skyong / /zhes rje gnya' khri btsan po sogs rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' mang po dang lo paṇa rnal 'byor pa rab tu byung bas mtshon pa'i sprul pa mchog dman mtha' klas pa rim gyis 'byon par gsungs shing / khyad par bla ma dri ma med pa mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rje dkon mchog 'bangs lung bstan pa dang byin gyis brlabs/ de dag gi skabs mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi gsung las/rje dkon mchog 'bangs 'di bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams 'dul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas des drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgrol ma zag med la/ /mi kho yi btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /ces byung ba ltar dkon mchog 'bangs chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam por skye ba bzhes pa dang de nyid rang gi dbon sras khri srong lde'u btsan dang ral pa can sogs du ma'i srid pa bzung pa ni/ lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ / rigs gsum mgon pos nga bskul ba'i/ /nga la rigs gsum mgon zhes grags/ /kun tu bzang dang sgrib pa sel/ /nga bskul rgyal por bstan gyur (6ba〉na/ /ci ste nga la der mi smra/ /zhes lung bstan gsal bar byung la/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ mes dbon de dag gi rnam 'phrul du gdon mi za ba'i khungs/ glegs bam le'u bcu dgu par/ da hril te sgril na sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul par grags te ral pa can la sogs pa gcig gnyis rigs gzhan gnyis kyi rigs yin la/ phal che ba ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yin la/ mkhan brgyud byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na yin gyi gzhan du ma sems shig /ces pa'i lung rigs kyis grub cing / 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po nyid nas skye ba rim brgyud dang dus mtshudas su byon pa/ kha che dgon pa ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po snying po'i zhabs/ de dag gi rjes su dus mtshungs par byung ba/ 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can/—1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nga las cung zad phyi bar lha rje dge ba 'bum sogs byon pa rnams thugs brgyud gcig pa las skye ba rim brgyud kyi 'khrungs rabs min pa rnam thar chos 'byung lo rgyus kyis shes nus/ bal yul du paṇ+ḍita pad+ma badz+ra zhes par 'brungs pa'i skye ba rjes ma ni thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub yin par rang nyid kyis zhal gyis 'ches shing / rje dge 'dun grub gong du bshad pa de dag gi skyes rabs kyi phreng bar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan glegs bam gyi thor bu'i tshoms las/gal te gzhan snang ma dag pas/ /'phel 'grib 'byung ba ltar mthong yang / gar nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes/ /zhun ma'i khye lus sprul pa 'gyed/ /'jig rten thams cad gsal (7na)byed cing / /lha dag bcas pa gsal bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po dang zhun ma'i khye'u ni spyan ras gzigs te/ de'i sprul ba rje dge 'dun grub tu gsal bar bstan cing / dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ /nga khrims ldan mkhan po'i skur ston kyang / /nga thugs rje chen po su yis shes/ /zhes pa'ang the tshom gyi yul du ma gyur cing / pha chos kyi lung bstan chen mo las/chos dge ba bcu yi khyad 'phags pa'i/ /gling phun sum tsho gos pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /sgos nyang shab sa yi lte ba yin/ /sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i 'dabs/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i mdun/ /gnas g.yeng med bsam gtan 'phel pa yi/ /dpal chos kyi thang zhes grags pa 'byung / /zhes pas kyang gnas dang gang zag shin tu ngo 'phrod pa yin/ de'i 'phros las/ nga gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ /rgyud gang la gang phan ston gyur kyang / /mi mkhas par rlom la ci byar yod/ /ces paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang / ri gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba yi/ /thang ser po gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /rtsibs mu khyud stong gis rab brgyan te/ /rje rgyal ba stong gis byin brlabs pa'i/ /gser dri ma med pa'i mchod rten yod/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dga' ba'i tshal/ /nyams bag phebs dga' bar skyong ba'i sa/ /zhes rgyal me tog thang bstan la/ de yang rwa sgreng gi shug pa la shun pa rim pa bdun —8—

phyag rdor pa'i nang ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams snang rnam thar du bkod pa snyan ba sbyo/da kyi lde mig las/snyigs dus mtha' 'khob yul du skyes pa yi/ /snyom las dge slong nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ zhig dgos pa la/ rtsom gzhi yang ja'i sang sde pas bskul ba la brten nas zur chen rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol gyis gnang ba'i byin rlabs phan bde'i snying po can dang 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis bkas bskul ba la brten nas smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs dbang (10na)rgyal rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mthong bas don ldan mchog tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs gnyis tshig sbyor shin la las sgro btags pa'i dam pa zhig gi sprul pa yin nam zhes brjod gzhir byas pa la de'i 'khrungs rabs —/2

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)sogs la bsnyad de bla ma mang po'i rnam thar mthar chags su bkod nas rang nyid tsham tshom med par khas 'che ba 'dra'ang 'ong 'dug pa sngon gsal por dran na ni der zad gzhan du mi'i chos bla ma sdom pa 'jig pa'i rgyu yin pas ya nga bar mthong / bla ma la la'i rnam thar snyan dngags kyi lam nas drangs ches pa dang 'ga' zhig gnag rdzi rgan po'i tshig 'dra ba'i phal rtags can/ rnam pa drang la ngo bo gzhan 'bigs pa srid sgrub kyi mda' lta bu/ rang gi nyes pa thabs kyis gzhan la 'gel ba 'phyon ma'i gtam lta bu/ bag tsha ba'i gnas kho na ngo mtshar gyi gtam du byed pa gzhan gyi blor chud par mi nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i rnam thar lta bu/ mchog dman gang gis mthong yang spro ba skyed pa'i lam yig rtogs brjod sogs bzang ngan 'bring gsum mang po zhig mthong yang / de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i (10ba)par bkab ma byas par rang lo bco lngar slebs pa yan blo la gang gsal dang de'i phyin ja'i sang sde pa/ 'jam dbyangs smon 'gro lo tsā ba/ skyar po ba blo bzang legs ldan/ 'phyos chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ tre bo spos 'dzin pa ngag dbang nam mkha'/ 'dar pa lo chen ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub rnams kyis reg zig tu bkod par gzhi byas/ der mi gsal ba'i kha 'geng dgos pa'i gsar rtsom gyi rigs rnams 'dar lo/ gnas gsar dpon/ tre bo ngag dbang nam mkha'/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa bzhi pos so so nas phyung ba'i lo tshigs shog ril ma/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo stag ru nas blo bzang dngos grub kyis tho yig rigs las btus pa tshor zhib tu dpyad/ gzhan yang snang la ma nges pa'i the tshom pa rgyus can gyi rigs gang 'dug la dogs bcad/'chad nyan dang rtsom pa tshogs gsog 'gangs che ba byas rigs kun dus thog dang gzhan ma rnams tshig nyung zhing brjod bde ba'i khyad kyis lo khongs der byung phyin zla tshes la ma bltos pa'i phyogs mtshungs su bsdebs nas yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs rnams ci rigs su bgyis te yid la gang shar shugs 'byung lhun po'i tshul du bkod pa la/—13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rigs rus cho 'brang gi che ba brjod pa/de yang khri brgyad stong pa las/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rigs chen po dag tu skye (11na)ba ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i cho rigs phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal rigs shing su la chen po lta bu dag dang / bram ze'i rigs shing su la chen po lta bu dag tu skye ba ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i cho rigs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rus phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ rigs gang las sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag byung bar gyur pa ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rus phun sum tshogs pa yin no zhes gsungs pa byang chub sems dpar ma zad so so skye bo la'ang sbyor du rung ste/ lho brag mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje'i rnam thar du chu brgyud gangs la thug pa dang mi brgyud lha nas chad pa zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon chad bod 'dir rigs rus cho 'brang la nan tar gtsigs che bas rigs ni mkhas mdzangs dpa' zhing rtul phod pa bka' btsan la dkyil che ba gzhung bzang la 'grogs bde ba sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshul ci rigs dang ldan pa/ rus ni rigs ma nyams pa'i pha de'i brgyud las byung ba/ cho ni zhang po khungs dang ldan pa/ 'brang ba ni bshad ma thag pa gsum po dang ldan pa'i spyod pa'i 'brang sa 'dzin pa yin na'ang phyis su rigs rus kyang 'chal pa sna tshogs dang 'dzam gling gi rgyan lta bur rlom pa'i chen po'i skye ba (11ba)mang po rigs ngan dang mu to ba la'ang byung ba brten/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sa skya'i gdung rabs tshigs bcad mar/ mi shes gdol ba'i phrug gu phongs —14—

por grags pas a su ra gsang ba'i brag phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rmi ltas khyad par can bdun shar ba bzhin phyag na rdo rje zla ba bdun —15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gyi bar du bsgrubs pas rdo rje sems dpas gsung rab kyi glegs bam pho brang gi yang thog tu char du phab/ tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad du ma zad glegs bam mang po zhig byung bar mngon te po ti rnams rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags nas mchod pa'i tshe/ mdo sde za ma tog rlung gis khyer te bod kyi pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi thog tu babs par bstan pa'i dbu brnyes zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang / rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhis glegs bam rnams kyi brda 'phrod kyang ma 'phrod pa ltar mdzad nas/ slob dpon u pa ra tsa sogs la zhus par brda ma khrol bar dge slong ku ku rā dza gdan drangs des sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i le'u gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u la brten nas zla ba bdun gyi bar du bsgrubs pas/ (12ba)grub ste lung bstan dang mthun par phyag na rdo rje zla ba bdun gyi bar du bsgrubs pas dngos su byon nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs te li tsa bī dri ma med par grags pa la tshig rnams zhus shig pa'i gnang ba thob pa ltar mdzad de tan+t+ra rnams gsungs pas rgyal po 'khor bcas rig 'dzin gyi sa thob/ de'i sras in+d+ra bhū ti zhes 'byor pa'i dbang po/ de la sras mo go ma de sa dang sras sha kra bu ti gnyis byung ba'i sha kras rgyal srid bzung ba'i sras su rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin te de ni phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pas smin grol gyi lam la bkod/thang yig tu/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur sangs rgyas bla ma steḥ gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum lenaḥ zhes dang / kha ba can du gnam ri zhes bya'i brgyudaḥ srong btsan sgam po zhes bya rgyal por skyeḥzhes skye brgyud rnams gsal bar du lung bstan cing / slob dpon chen po la gson sreg mdzad pa ni che ba 'byin pa ste ston pa drug dang lhas byin legs skar sogs sangs rgyas nyid kyi sprul par gsungs pa dang 'dra/ de'i sras dharma rā dza/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho/ lha lcam mnā ra ba ste mched gsum byung ba'i dang po'i sras/ dharma pā la/ shākya de wa/ ma hā de wa gsum byung / de'ang gdung rabs yig tshang rnying pa tshor dharma pā la rang gis rgya gar nas bod du byon pa dang pe gar gnas pa'i sgom grwa'ang za hor gyi yul du yod pa 'dra mo zhig bris 'dug cing / bla ma sog bzlog pa'i rnying ma'i —16—

ma zad glegs bam mang po zhig byung bar mngon te po ti rnams rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags nas mchod pa'i tshe/ mdo sde za ma tog rlung gis khyer te bod kyi pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi thog tu babs par bstan pa'i dbu brnyes zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang / rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhis glegs bam rnams kyi brda 'phrod kyang ma 'phrod pa ltar mdzad nas/ slob dpon u pa ra tsa sogs la zhus par brda ma khrol bar dge slong ku ku rā dza gdan drangs des sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i le'u gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa' zhal mthong gi le'u la brten nas zla ba bdun gyi bar du bsgrubs pas/ (12ba)grub ste lung bstan dang mthun par phyag na rdo rje zla ba bdun gyi bar du bsgrubs pas dngos su byon nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs te li tsa bī dri ma med par grags pa la tshig rnams zhus shig pa'i gnang ba thob pa ltar mdzad de tan+t+ra rnams gsungs pas rgyal po 'khor bcas rig 'dzin gyi sa thob/ de'i sras in+d+ra bhū ti zhes 'byor pa'i dbang po/ de la sras mo go ma de sa dang sras sha kra bu ti gnyis byung ba'i sha kras rgyal srid bzung ba'i sras su rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin te de ni phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pas smin grol gyi lam la bkod/thang yig tu/ ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur sangs rgyas bla ma steḥ gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum lenaḥ zhes dang / kha ba can du gnam ri zhes bya'i brgyudaḥ srong btsan sgam po zhes bya rgyal por skyeḥzhes skye brgyud rnams gsal bar du lung bstan cing / slob dpon chen po la gson sreg mdzad pa ni che ba 'byin pa ste ston pa drug dang lhas byin legs skar sogs sangs rgyas nyid kyi sprul par gsungs pa dang 'dra/ de'i sras dharma rā dza/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho/ lha lcam mnā ra ba ste mched gsum byung ba'i dang po'i sras/ dharma pā la/ shākya de wa/ ma hā de wa gsum byung / de'ang gdung rabs yig tshang rnying pa tshor dharma pā la rang gis rgya gar nas bod du byon pa dang pe gar gnas pa'i sgom grwa'ang za hor gyi yul du yod pa 'dra mo zhig bris 'dug cing / bla ma sog bzlog pa'i rnying ma'i —16—

g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ zhal brnyan bse 'bag /chibs shel gyi seng ge gsum —18—

brgyud dang 'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ hor bkra shis 'bum gyi sras hor gzhen nu bzang po dang bkras bsam pa gnyis byung ba'i sku mched gnyis gas bod shing sgo can rnams la bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa gong ma sde srid phag mo gru pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la thug /gcen gyis spyan snga grags pa rgyal mtshan —20

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pas thugs dad lhag (16ba)par zhabrungs te mchod yon du gyur nas bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang 'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ nges par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches zhus dag gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur 'phyong rgyas su gdan drangs/ gcung gsum gyi spyan snga bsod nams grags pa dang gong ma chos rgyal chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la thug nas rjes su bzung / khyad par nang so dkon mchog rin chen gyis 'phying pa stag rtse'i rdzong gsar rgyag mdzad/ deng sang mi thog bdun brgyad tsam song 'dug kyang g.yas 'gyel g.yon dpyongs kyi rigs med pa'i lcags phur ltar sra ba'i las rjes gtsang ba'i dper 'os/ 'phags chen dpal ldan grags pa dpon slob la bstod nas chos thog bteg ste byon par bzhugs gnas dang phogs tsha ba'i mthun rkyen gnang bar brten 'phags sde dar bas ga smi ra'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms chen po'i bstan pa spel/ drung dpal 'byor bzang po dang nang so dkon mchog rin chen gnyis kyi jo mor drung dpon she ba'i sras mo dpal 'dzom skyid bsus/ sras nyag phra bar byung ba la ri bo dga' ldan gyi gdan sa gsum pa zha lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan zhes 'jam dpal gshin rje dngos su grub pa'i mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug chen po des gshed dmar gyi sgo nas rigs bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas sras hor rdo rje tshe brtan pa 'brungs/ pha rol gyi dmag byung bar 'od zer can ma'i phyag mtshan khab la brten pa'i las tshogs kyis dgra rnams stong 'ur du bros pa dang rdzong la chu med par/ (17na)dbyangs 'char gyi bum brgyad 'khor lo'i sgo nas lu ma bton pa sogs bka' drin shin tu che bas rje zha lu ba dag zhing du gshegs pa'i nyer bzhi mchod pa'i thebs su dga' ldan dos skyel du grags pa yang star chags su mdzad/ yab drung chen dpal 'byor bzang po bka' gdams dang dge lugs la thugs gus pa'i dgongs bzhed dang sras kyang rje zha lu bas srid 'bebs mdzad pa'i bka' drin sogs la brten/ hor rdo rje tshe brtan rnam rgyal skyed pa dpal bzang pos ri bo bde chen gyi chos sde btab phyogs der zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/—22

su gnang / sku 'bring ba dpa' zhing rtul phod pa srid sgrub la 'gran nus pa/chung ba gtsug lag gnyis ldan gyi bstan bcos la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa zhig go /mched gsum gyi jo mor sngon bal yul du gong dkar zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa rtse'i khri thog tu gdan 'dren pa'i ched du bde gzar bslang ba'i zhabs drung gong ma chen po ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan kwa na ding tā'i gu shri chen hwa wang 'an rgyal bzang du phebs dgos byung bar/ 'phyong rgyas su gnang ba'i bka' shog la 'on gyi shing chu (18ba 'di lus la mi 'phrod pas nged brag khar yong chog pa'i do dam gyis gsung ba'i bslab ston phebs/ gong ma'i zhabs 'degs su lha sras rgyal po'i rnam sprul 'bri gung zur pa chos —24

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyang yar klungs su phebs/ che gnyan thams cad sgo bstun gyis gong ma chen po pho brang sne'u sdong rtser phebs chog pa'i do dam gyi gtso bo'ang mdzad/ de'i tshe rje 'bri gung pa sgar thog tu gdan drangs te sngags rnying ma'i zab chos mang du gsan/ de nas bzung ste mchod yon 'brel chags par byung / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs bla chen mang por chos 'brel gsan/ ga rma 'phrin las gnyis pa dpal snang lo tsā bar snyan dngags gsan pas dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tshor grags/ gtso bo ni gsang sngags rnying ma bla rdzogs thugs gsum la nyams len gnang bas slob dpon chen po pad+mas rjes su bzung ngo / /gcung ni rgyal srid la snying po med par mkhyen nas rab tu byung ste nang gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzad/ zhabs drung hor bsod nams pa'i jo mor skyid shod sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan zhes lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa de'i lcam sring tshe dbang rgyal mo byon par sras hor tshe dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal/ tshe dbang bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ ga me ngag dbang grags pa gsum 'khrungs/ gcen rang srid skyong ba la 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngang tshul dang gzhan sde 'joms pa la rā ma ṇa dang mtshungs par grags/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i rnam sprul 'phrang 'go gter ston shes rab 'od zer yongs 'dzin du bsten/ sngags (19na)rnying ma'i rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyang yar klungs su phebs/ che gnyan thams cad sgo bstun gyis gong ma chen po pho brang sne'u sdong rtser phebs chog pa'i do dam gyi gtso bo'ang mdzad/ de'i tshe rje 'bri gung pa sgar thog tu gdan drangs te sngags rnying ma'i zab chos mang du gsan/ de nas bzung ste mchod yon 'brel chags par byung / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs bla chen mang por chos 'brel gsan/ ga rma 'phrin las gnyis pa dpal snang lo tsā bar snyan dngags gsan pas dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tshor grags/ gtso bo ni gsang sngags rnying ma bla rdzogs thugs gsum la nyams len gnang bas slob dpon chen po pad+mas rjes su bzung ngo / /gcung ni rgyal srid la snying po med par mkhyen nas rab tu byung ste nang gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzad/ zhabs drung hor bsod nams pa'i jo mor skyid shod sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan zhes lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa de'i lcam sring tshe dbang rgyal mo byon par sras hor tshe dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal/ tshe dbang bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ ga me ngag dbang grags pa gsum 'khrungs/ gcen rang srid skyong ba la 'jam dpal dbyangs rgyal phun tshogs la zab chos ci rigs gsan/ dga' ldan nas shad chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mkhas grags can de gdan drangs ri po bde chen ser khyim pa lta bur song ba'i nyams gsos gnang zhing dbu blar bzhes/ 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar po dang mchod yon du gyur/ sman khrog bzhes pa sman chen dang nor ba'i rkyen gyis sku tshe'i bar chad du song /sku 'bring ba lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen spyan yangs shing khyad par mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan pa la gus pa che/ dzo gi gaṅgā gi ris mahā rā dza la bar chad chen po 'dug pas sku tshes spel ba'i thabs yod ces bde skyid gling du sku mtshams la bsnyad nas mgul dar gyis bcings te bkrongs pas dmangs rnams 'khas drung a tsa ra zhes gleng / chung ba rtsis kyi gtsug lag la mkhas shing 'jig rten 'tsho gtsigs la mi bltos pa'i 'bad med du bzhed pa rnams lhun gyis grub ces (19ba)gleng /mched rnams la bod rgyal po'i gdung du grags pa lha mda' smad pa'i brgyud pa sa skyong lha rgya ri ba mi dbang byams pa rab brtan gyi sras mo lha lcam kun grub rgyal mo byon par sras lcam sring lnga tsam byung ba'i bgres pa dpal ngag gi dbang po bsod nams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan za hor gyi rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi sku'i rnam sprul du lung gis zin/ yab mes kyi chos gsang sngags rnying ma la gtso bor thugs mos che bas chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ 'bri gung zhabs drung nā ro pa bkra shis phun tshogs/ chos sdings rig 'dzin dbang chen lhun grub sogs rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten smin grol gdams pas thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang / ka dag lhun grub kyi rnal 'byor dang bla ma zhi drag bka' brgyad tshe bdag rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub la gtso bor mdzad/ sde dgu khyab 'jug zhing skyong sogs chos srung bran du 'khol/ gzhan la dbang gnang ba dang gtor bzlog gi tshe dkar chas su bsgyur nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad/ sde pa bkra shis rtse bas mtshon mi bsrun pa 'gar las sbyor gnang ba rnams rtags mngon du gyur pa sha stag byung / rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter chos gtso bor gyur pa'i gter kha ris med kyi glegs bam brgyad cur nye ba bzhengs nas rang nyid kyis thos bsam mdzad cing gzhan dag de la sbyar bas sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa zhig yin —26

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)cing dge lugs kyis mtshon pa'i grub mtha' gzhan la'ang spyi snyoms par skya ser mtha' dag mthun snang du grub bo/ /gcung dmag dpon lha'i dbang phyug ni snyan dngags (20na)dang rtsis sogs gtsug lag gi yon tan la mkhyen pa yangs shing rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bsnyems chas dang dmag dpung gi kha lo sgyur ba la rnam dpyod che bar grags kyang ha cang gar zhen ches pa'i ri bo bde chen pa dang mchod sku thon sdo/gas mi legs/byi glang bde gzar chen mo'i skabs skyi ru nas dang gsol dpon rab brtan can gyi bka' gros thog tu btang na sku rab pa rtsa stongs su 'gro zhing gtsang dpung gan pa la 'da' mi nus nges par yar stod dge tshal ba'i mgo brtan pa'i gnang sgo zhal phyir 'chus kyis ma khyogs par brten rang srid mtha' dag dmigs med du rgyas 'debs kyi rtsa ba lta bur song zhes gzur gnas rnams gleng / 'di lo 'brum nad yod gshis sgar thog nas sku 'brum bsnyun pa'i rkyen gyis gshegs sam zhes mdzes btsal nas dril bsgrags kyang / don gtsang skur bka' gros thog rje dom po che pas srog 'bul byas nas sne'u sdong gong ma/ lha pa dang 'phyong rgyas kyi zhabs drung tshor sbyor ngan zhus pa don la gnas/ mched gnyis kyi jo mor thu mi sa stoṭa'i gdung 'dzin yar rgyab dpon chen gyi lcam mtshan yongs grags dpon sa bdag smyon mar grags pa khab tu bzhes par sras hor bdud 'dul rab brtan lcam sring rnams zuXgrangs/de'i dus sde srid gtsang pa'i mtshan don dbus gtsang phal cher la khyab pa'i skabs yin pas mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa sa skyong phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis da lta nged rang la bu mo 'os pa zhig mi 'dug pas sna dkar rtse'i lcam la 'di ga nas pha ming byas te jo mor gtong gsung ba sogs gzigs phyogs legs pa'i phebs sgo dang don phyag thog tu bkal ba'i rdzong bda' gnang / nged kyi ma'i rigs ni 'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs (20ba)su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa na gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya dang zung du 'brel ba lha sa gro khud sna bo gdong zhes par su thu a —27—

gi sku tshe'i smad la hor khrims byung nas rgya'i mi chen ar mgon/ do shu a nu gan/ su thu a skyid rnams kyis mi brtsis dud grangs su bcad/—28

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)de'i sras dge bsnyen yon bdag kun dga' bde skyid kyis rje btsun sa paṇa gyi zhabs la thug pa'i gus shing zhabs tog che bar grags/ des yon bdag 'bum skyed jo mor bsus par sras ma byung zhing yum gyi bu mo mkha' 'gro'i rtags mtshan can zhig g.yog tu bsten nas shing 'thu bar btang sar gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du mi nag po mig gsum yod pa zhig gis dga' mgur spyod pa'i snang ba byung bas lus la bde ba chen po'i nyams shar zhing ring por ma lon par sbrum dang ldan par gyur kyang gzhan la smra ma nus/ zla ba dgu tsam song ba na nyin zhig shing 'thu sa nas dus la log ma byung bas yon bdag ma 'bum skyid kyis lta bar phyin pas grod pa zhig la bya se mo zhig gab 'dug pas grod pa blangs pa gshags pa'i nang na mi las 'das pa lha'i bu 'dra ba zhig 'dug par rang re la bu med pas dngos grub tu go ste gsos pas skyed shin tu che bar byung / nar son nas chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i zhabs 'bring du phul bas 'phags pa rin po che tshogs la 'byon res/ skya bo/ mjal sna/ gzimasagayog rdzogs mtshams lcags skas 'og tu zhabs dbang rgyun mar zhus pas thengs gcig dka' las (21ba)a gag glen pa zhig 'dug gsungs nas zhabs mgo thog tu nan cher bzhag pas ag glen du grags zer/ lugs gcig la lha khang chen mo'i rgya mthongs kyi ka brgyad ma bzos dus 'phags pa rin po che dgyes nas ka ba 'di rnams la dri ba byas na ang lags zhes lan 'debs pa tsam byung 'dug gsungs pas/ ming ang lan rdo rje dpal du thogs zhes kyang grags/ don du gshin rje pu tra'i sras yin pas legs ldan nag po'i rigs su gtogs/ 'bri gung pas stod hor gyi dmag ke rdol bdun tsam khrid yong bar gong ma se chen gyis thi mur bho khas 'go byas pa'i hor dmag btang ba dang khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag dpon chen yang lan gyis khrid nas g.yul sprad pas stod hor gyi dpung bcom/ 'bri gung sgom pa dpon po tshong 'dus la ṇa 'bur mar khrims la gtugs/ stod hor gyi rgyal bu rin chen gong du khrid nas khrims la thogs/ dpa' rtags su 'phags pa rin po ches thug chen khams gsum zil gnon/ khrims rnga khams gsum dbang sdud/ g.yab dar myur mgyogs pho nya/ rdo —29

bar gong ma se chen gyis thi mur bho khas 'go byas pa'i hor dmag btang ba dang khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag dpon chen yang lan gyis khrid nas g.yul sprad pas stod hor gyi dpung bcom/ 'bri gung sgom pa dpon po tshong 'dus la ṇa 'bur mar khrims la gtugs/ stod hor gyi rgyal bu rin chen gong du khrid nas khrims la thogs/ dpa' rtags su 'phags pa rin po ches thug chen khams gsum zil gnon/ khrims rnga khams gsum dbang sdud/ g.yab dar myur mgyogs pho nya/ rdo —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rje dgra dpung 'joms byed/ sku 'bag 'jigs byed dpa' bos thog drangs pa'i dngos po'i gnang sbyin dang rgyal bu thi mur bho khas ral gri li tsa shel khog tu grags pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu gnang / bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal rgya nag sman yul nas gdan drangs jo mo bdun tsam bsu ba'i do dam mdzad de 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung rgyud chad med du byon pa'i thabs kyis sa skya pa la zhabs tog shin tu che/ rgyal bu dpon chen dmag dang bcas pas byar dwags kong gsum/ e gnyal lo gsum/ kong bca' de'u la bcas lho brag ya gsum mnga' 'og tu bcug /mon la dkar po la bcas lho brgyud thams (22na15da dpung shed kyis bcad/ lam bar gnyal smad kyi sa char dmag ston gtong ba'i thab chen skas tshad 'dzugs dgos pa zhig brtsigs/ brag la ang lan gyis 'dir slebs zer ba'i yi ge brkos pa da dung yod zer/ 'bri gung gling log gtong bar shar dwags la sgam po'i bar dmag gis phyin/ g.yu 'dzam gling 'od gsal srang nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa sgam po nas blangs te gdan sar phul/ sngar bod du gru shan med pa la rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pa bkug nas gsar du bzos/sa hor mchod yon gyis yar 'brog khri skor rta sga 'bab sar 'ja' sa dang bcas gnang / sngon gyi yig tshang khungs btsun las/ /stag 'jam yar 'phrog khri skor steng / /bya rog tshang gi rtags mgo ni//nyi shu rtsa brgyad de dang ni/ /zhes pa ltar shar rgyal po'i lung dang lag rtags 'dzin pa chen po rim par byon pa'i gdung las mi'i dbang po kun dga' grags pa zhes lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa chas kyis mdzes shing sgrigs kyis che ba ya rabs bzang po'i spyod tshul dang ldan pa de'i sras mo khri lcam kun dga' lha mdzes de nyid gtsang sde srid nas 'byon dgos pa'i bslab ston byung bar brten/ sna dkar rtse'i zhal ngo rnams gtso bor gdan sa gong 'og dang gong dkar chos sde de 'og bo dong pa dang thugs 'brel che na'ang / rje btsun grol mchog sde dpon phal cher gyi dbu blar gyur cing /rtag brtan sprul sku de rje grol mchog gi sku skye yin pa'i grags pa la brten rtag brtan du brtag pa zhu —30

/ sngon gyi yig tshang khungs btsun las/ /stag 'jam yar 'brog khri skor steng / /bya rog tshang gi rtags mgo ni//nyi shu rtsa brgyad de dang ni/ /zhes pa ltar shar rgyal po'i lung dang lag rtags 'dzin rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)ba gnang bas byon pa 'gab tshul dang srid yong ba'i rten 'brel du gra lnga'i thang kha zhig kyang bskur bar mdzad/ me 'brug lo khri lcam dpon g.yog 'phyong rgyas su phebs/sku bltams pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin bcas kyi skor/dmar (22ba)ser can zhes pa me sbrul hor zla dgu pa'i tshes dang dus zhib tu brtsis na nyin zhag re'i tho rengs de dus bcu gnyis kyi mthar 'ong yang 'jig rten dmangs rnams tshes snga ma'i tho rengs la phyi ma'i yin par ngos 'dzin pa'i dbang gis nyer gsum gyi tho rengs zhes grags rung rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug g.yu lo nas kyis zhib tu gzigs par grub pa'i rgyal phur 'phrod nges yin gsung ba nas don du nyer gsum gyi skya rengs dang po btang ba'i nam langs yos/ dbyangs lha/res gza' phur bu/ zla skar rgyal/ 'phrod chen mdung / sbyor chen grub bya/ rten 'brel rga shi /byi ba'i nyi ma la nged btsas pa yin 'dug rung rang bzhin brjod tsam las gza' skar de dag gi 'bras bu bshad tshod bzhin yong du re ba'i rlom pa ni min te dus der skyes pa'i khyi rgan rgya bo'ang ji snyed yod pas so/ /tshes snga ma'i chu tshod ma rdzogs na zin phung gi thog tu song 'dra ba dus 'gyur sogs 'bras bshad dang yang mthun pa 'dra/ de lta bu'i rigs rus cho 'brang dang ldan pa las rtol dang ya ru sogasal bsnyad nas rtogs brjod du ngom ngom byed pa tsho'i gral du sdod mi dgos par snang / de'ang ri bo bde chen gyi rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rgyun gyi mchod gnas la bcar bzhugs yin pa khong gis reg zig gi shog dril bris 'dug par mngal du 'jug par nye ba'i tshe dkon gnyer yin zer ba'i btsun pa zhig gis thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal po'i sku li ma zhig khyer byung ba ci yin dris pas lha sa'i rang byon lnga ldan yin gleng ba dang btsa' bar nye ba'i tshe mnal lam du skar khung zhig la phebs par brtsams pa sku lus mtho bas dka' tshegs su gyur pa na bud med rgyan cha mchor mo zhig gis phyag —31—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)ba gnang bas byon pa 'gab tshul dang srid yong ba'i rten 'brel du gra lnga'i thang kha zhig kyang bskur bar mdzad/ me 'brug lo khri lcam dpon g.yog 'phyong rgyas su phebs/sku bltams pa dang yang srid ngos 'dzin bcas kyi skor/dmar (22ba)ser can zhes pa me sbrul hor zla dgu pa'i tshes dang dus zhib tu brtsis na nyin zhag re'i tho rengs de dus bcu gnyis kyi mthar 'ong yang 'jig rten dmangs rnams tshes snga ma'i tho rengs la phyi ma'i yin par ngos 'dzin pa'i dbang gis nyer gsum gyi tho rengs zhes grags rung rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug g.yu lo nas kyis zhib tu gzigs par grub pa'i rgyal phur 'phrod nges yin gsung ba nas don du nyer gsum gyi skya rengs dang po btang ba'i nam langs yos/ dbyangs lha/res gza' phur bu/ zla skar rgyal/ 'phrod chen mdung / sbyor chen grub bya/ rten 'brel rga shi /byi ba'i nyi ma la nged btsas pa yin 'dug rung rang bzhin brjod tsam las gza' skar de dag gi 'bras bu bshad tshod bzhin yong du re ba'i rlom pa ni min te dus der skyes pa'i khyi rgan rgya bo'ang ji snyed yod pas so/ /tshes snga ma'i chu tshod ma rdzogs na zin phung gi thog tu song 'dra ba dus 'gyur sogs 'bras bshad dang yang mthun pa 'dra/ de lta bu'i rigs rus cho 'brang dang ldan pa las rtol dang ya ru sogasal bsnyad nas rtogs brjod du ngom ngom byed pa tsho'i gral du sdod mi dgos par snang / de'ang ri bo bde chen gyi rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rgyun gyi mchod gnas la bcar bzhugs yin pa khong gis reg zig gi shog dril bris 'dug par mngal du 'jug par nye ba'i tshe dkon gnyer yin zer ba'i btsun pa zhig gis thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal po'i sku li ma zhig khyer byung ba ci yin dris pas lha sa'i rang byon lnga ldan yin gleng ba dang btsa' bar nye ba'i tshe mnal lam du skar khung zhig la phebs par brtsams pa sku lus mtho bas dka' tshegs su gyur pa na bud med rgyan cha mchor mo zhig gis phyag —31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nas 'then te thogs med (23na)du byon ba'i snang ba byung / dngos su yang klu khang du sngar med pa'i me tog gi rigs gsar pa skyes pa dang gzims chung gi rtser 'ja' zug pa/ srol med pa'i zhol pa mang pos rdzong la skor ba byed pa/ nam mkha' sprin med las char babs pa sogs byung zer ba rang gi mngon sum du ma gyur pas yid brtan dka' zhing gal te byung du zin kyang dus mtshungs par phyogs der gang zag khyad par can sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa gshegs pa dang bltams pa/ lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dang ma 'grig pa'i nges pa yang med dam snyam/ rtag brtan sprul sku de la gsung rab nas bshad pa'i mngon shes yod yod mi 'dra'ang 'byung po'i mngon shes phra mo bsgrubs pa'i lung bstan skabs re bden bden 'dra yong gin yod tshod 'dug pa'i 'khrul gzhi la brten zhang po phyogs thugs mos pas ched gnyer gyis mi sna mngags pa'i rgyu mtshan du rgyal bu zhig byung bas ming dang rim gro sogs legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhu ba gnang 'dug par mdzes lam spam me ba'i gsung zhig las 'phyong rgyas su dus log 'byung rgyu shes bya lkog gyur ba'i lan ni gang yang ma byung bar gda'/ming kun dga' mi 'gyur stobs rgyal dbang gi rgyal por 'dogs pa mdzad/ gtsang sde srid nas rgyal bu 'grungs pa'i legs bya'i dga' ston la mi ched gnyer gnang ba'i lugs legs kyi thugs brtse bzang po bstod pa'i nang rtags phyir gsal gyi nyams ci yang shar/ byang pa rig 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal mtsho skyes bzhad pa'i dbang pos bar chad mi 'byung ba'i srung ba dang byin rlabs mdzad/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam sprul byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sprul lo'i mjug (23ba)mdo khams nas phebs pa dang 'grig pa'i tshe dbang lcags sdong ma brgya rtsa dang nyang lugs drag dmar gyi dbang brgya tshar gnang 'dug pa dran pa'i yul du ma gyur kyang byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs nyams kyis nad gdon gyi 'tshe ba dkon zhing bsnyen sgrub ci yang ma song ba'i byis pa'i dus gzhan la srung mdud dang mchil ma btab pa'i chu byin pa zhal ngo gong ma bsnyen sgrub song ba'i rigs las nus pa che ba tsam byung zhes gleng /—32

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dbang zhu ba'i dus tsog pur bsdad par nye 'khor ba zhig gis tsho 'dzin phyir brtan dgos pa 'dra zhes zhus par bdag po rin po ches 'di gzhan la brten dgos pa zhig min zhes bsngags brjod dang dgyes tshor chen po mdzad 'dug /mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi srung 'khor dang rim gro rkyen bzlog mang du gnang / sa rta'i zla ba gsum gnyis brtsegs kyi snga phyi tshor yang byang pa rig 'dzin chen pos sgo gsum bar chad las bsgral ba'i byin rlabs mang du mdzad/rang lo gsum lon pa sa lug lor dus 'gyur 'byung ba'i rtsa ba ni 'phrang 'go gter ston bzhugs skabs rgyal bu zhal ras kyi phyed la sha lpags med pa'i dam sri'i sprul pa zhig byung ba gter ston rin po ches 'di gsos na mi nor srid sde thams cad myur bar brlag gsungs nas nag po sum sgril gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas zhag bdun gyi thog ngo gsar de phyir log /mnan pa tshad ldan skabs su ma babs pas gzims chung bde ldan du rtsig pa glo 'bur ba byas pa'i nang du mnan pa'i tshul gyis bcug dam sri mi ldang ba'i 'khor lo sogs rten 'brel mang du mdzad de bcas ma zhig bar du skyon mi yong zhes lung bstan pa dpon sa bdag spyon mas glo 'bur 'di lag ru 'gog ces bshig pas dam sri langs pa yin la/ spyir 'phyong rgyas par me tog phog pa'i lha skal (24na)lta bu ni gsang sngags rnying ma/ gnas skabs su bka' drin che ba ni gdan rabs bka' brgyud/ spyan snga zhwa dmar ba/ ri bo dga' ldan pa gsum yin pas gar 'brug gi dgos don che ba med kyang dus 'gyur 'byung ba'i 'phral rkyen ni 'jig rten phal ba rnams la mi la'i mgur 'bum dang bya bral gyi rigs myug myug mangs na rten 'brel gyis chas ka srab tu 'gro zhes rnam rtog byed/ sde dpon zhal mar gzigs la thug tshe 'brug phyogs la dga' ba zhig yod 'dug pas 'phral du 'brug lugs dang 'brel zab che/ zhabs drung dmar dpon bkar lugs la thugs zhen pa'i rgyun gyis nang so bsam grub dang khyams stod pa sogs drung 'khor gar zhen pa mang bas zhabs drung de nyid kyang thugs tshom zin pa'i bla ma zhwa nag gser mdongs dang grogs po shar phyogs rgyal po la 'chol zhes sde pa sku rab pa dang skyid sdug gcig —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa mdzad par gtsang sde srid kyi thugs la re dogs kyi kun rtog mang po shar te shin tu ma mnyes pa'i dgongs pa'i 'dzin stangs gzhan du gzhol ba ni rang phyogs dpon g.yog gi gnang sgo log pa'i skyon kho na las sde pa gtsang par ra 'khang brdung rgyu ni mi 'dug /de'i rtsa ba yar rgyab tu khrims phog nas 'khyar ba'i 'phags sde ba'i gra pa rjes su sde pa'i nang zan la song ba mkhyen rab dpal bzang las dbang gis blon por gyur pa gzhan du blo 'byogs pa'i ram 'degs drung yig sa skyong / byang gling sangs rgyas/ sa lte ba/ sngon mo ba sogs drung 'khor dang nang zan kha shas kyis byas pa rig nyams kyis rtser rdzong btsan pa khog tu zhugs dus de ring nang cha rul pa 'don rgyu yin zhes gsungs par drung nas kyis gser zho gang dang kha btags shig (24ba)phul te da lam rten 'brel mi legs pas slar gnang chog zhus nas bskol zer don ngan gros bshams par brten zhabs drung de nyid sham po gangs skor la phebs su bcug pa'i 'phags sde pa rnams kyang rul lam zer gang ltar bslus thabs kyis rdzong zug po nas la rtsis sprad/ khri lcam gyis dbu gnang nged kha shas tho rengs phyi zur la bde skyid gling du spos pa'i lam du chus gang ba'i bum pa khur pa dang nam sangs la zug po nas mjal bar 'ongs pa'i zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod thogs pa dang phrad pa g.yul rgyal rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar lam rtags legs par snang /zhol gyi srang mdor 'gro ba'i dus skye bo mang pos sgron me spar te smre sngags kyi ku co dang bcas nas phud gtor ba nged kyi gdong la 'thor ba rnams phal cher bzung zer ba legs nyes ni dpyad par dka'/ sngar spel nag rin lhun pa'i dgra shar ri bo bde chen pas phyag mdzod dngos grub bsad par sde pas dgon pa dmag gis bskor ba'i tsha 'jun gnang ba 'khon du bzung ste rdzong shor ba'i nang bar rgyal gling lding tshos rtse nas 'jag khyad 'then pas dgon pa'i gra pa 'ga' res dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byas zer/ sde pa lhas byin/ sgom bu ba sogs dpon zhen pa kha shas kyis rdzong la 'tshang ba'i gros btab pa nang so a 'dzom pa can gyis bshol bas 'jam chags su gyur/ rdzong pa rnams gshogs ma —34

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa mdzad par gtsang sde srid kyi thugs la re dogs kyi kun rtog mang po shar te shin tu ma mnyes pa'i dgongs pa'i 'dzin stangs gzhan ba sogs drung 'khor dang nang zan kha shas kyis byas pa rig nyams kyis rtser rdzong btsan pa khog tu zhugs dus de ring nang cha rul pa 'don rgyu yin zhes gsungs par drung nas kyis gser zho gang dang kha btags shig (24ba)phul te da lam rten 'brel mi legs pas slar gnang chog zhus nas bskol zer don ngan gros bshams par brten zhabs drung de nyid sham po gangs skor la phebs su bcug pa'i 'phags sde pa phyag bris su bstsal/nyi ma kha shas kyi bar jo bo chen po'i lam yig lha khang ma'i lung zhig gnang byung / ching gis gnam gyi gdung las bstan pa'i sbyin bdag lha btsun chung ba phrad par byon zhing zhag gcig pu nga bla ma'i sku (30bslobs su sdod pa yin zhes de gar gzims/ dpon slob rin po che ni sku tshags ma bshig par snyes ma log gis bzhugs song / nged ni lo gzhen pas rgyun du gang byed ltar nyal/ rdo rje brag zhabs drung dbon rin po che gzhan don du gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten 'byor/ dpon slob rin po che lha sar thegs/ rgyun gyi zla bo dang dge rgyan sbrags par grogs po nang pa'i dge slong ngag dbang chos rgyal zhal ngos 'bod par mdzad pa khong pa sna ring zhing rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa sogs nas bag phebs par byung / ma ma yang zhag bcu skor zhig gi bar lcang srung khang du bzhag nyin star 43

nams rab brtan la rang gi g.yog ris su gtogs pa rkang mthil gyi rde'u dpral bar 'phar snyam pa'i chags sdang gi gnod pa ci 'khyol dang lhag tu gtsang pa'i lung gan pa la man la mi rgyug pa zhig ma byung na bod du bsdad gzhan 'dra zhes zhal nas kyang 'don zhing don du yang phyag thog la bkal ba'i sog po log na rdzong gzhis rnams bskyur te 'byon rtsis dang zhe phugs (31na)su dge phyogs dang gtsang pa lugs legs byung na khong rang gis shogs mi thon de gnyis lugs ma legs na slar yang sog dmag 'dren thub snyam pa'i nged tshos sog yul du phyin na gtsang pa dang 'gras 'gro ba gzhir bcas kyis bde skyid phung la re ba'i rnam pas/ lha btsun la da lam sog yul du gdan 'dren thub na gtso cher dpon po kho lo che mnyes pa dang de nas sog po tsho ོ drug la ngo so r+sā po yong zhes ga bslab byas pa bstad pa bzang bas ma dgongs par bden par bzung ste lha btsun dang gu ru hung tha'i ji sku mched gnyis kyis mtsho khar 'phral du yong dgos tshul nan shin tu che ba byung bar zhal ngo dang dka' bcu ba gnyis kyis rgyu mtshan phul kyang mchod yon nang nyams kyis 'jun stangs ma gtogs don ma mthong / rang ngos ni sa thag ring ba dang na tshod phras pa sogs nas 'chi bar 'gro rgyu'i nyams tsam shar te rgyu mtshan byung res kyis mchi ma dbang med du shor kyang tha'i ji gnyis kyis zhal ngo dang dka' bcu bas bzod pa yin zhes bden par ma bzung /dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches bka' nan che bar phebs nas sog po 'di bla mar 'jog che —44—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)bas shogs che ba yong rigs su 'dug kyang sde pa a dpal gyi zhu dbang du song bas ma tha'i ji tshor bslab ston med pa'i da cha dpon po rnams nan ches pa'i gshis bar khams brgyud de phebs na 'o mi brgyal ba yong / rgyal me tog thang bar nged rang yang gdan 'dren la 'gro phebs pa rgyal sde dgon zhar la rtsis bzhes gnang ba'i bzhed pa zhal ngos mkhyen te dgongs phyogs lon pa'i shin tu mi dgyes pa byung 'dug /zhi ba'i sgo nas ma phyin na dpung shed (31ba)kyis khyer ba'i mdangs shig byung bar brten dka' bcu bas bde chen rtser phyin/ sgang chen nas la e ri sgor phyin chog pa'i rgyu mtshan mol ba bzhin gtsang du bang chen btang ba don smin gyis do dam la pho ra snang pa bstan 'dzin rdzong bda' gnang 'dug /gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa bar skabs su 'thor ba zhal ngos btsun khral sum cu tsam dang bcas btsugs pa'i slob dpon du hor zla lnga pa'i nyer bzhi la bzang grong rab 'byams pa bskos de'i sang nub 'bras spungs nas bteg pa'i ri sgor gsang thabs kyis 'bros dgos byung ba nam langs la snye thang bkra shis sgang du 'byor zhal snga nas kyis las ka 'di 'dra byed don chung ba 'dug ces gleng rim gyis gzhung ko byas te rong chad dkar du slebs/ drung 'tsho dbon po'i sman khang spyil bur gnas tshang byas te zhag gnyis tsam bsdad cing chad dkar rdzong nas gzhis lan mdzad/ sde pa dmag dpon pa ngag gi dbang phyug dang blon chen gsol dpon rab brtan gnyis kyis thog drangs skya ser gyis bsu ba dang bcas e ri sgo chos rdzong du 'byor dpon blon thams cad nas rnyed bkur gya nom pa dang khyad par dpon sa a ne drung pa pad dkar chos nyid bzang mo gnyen gdung che bas bza' btung gos kyis thog drangs byis pa brid pa'i rta dang seng ge'i gzugs brnyan shing la bzos pa sogs sgo du ma nas bdag rkyen mdzad/ mchod yon gnyis ga'i dgongs gzhir gtsang sde srid thugs dogasachung phyir sku tshab cig zhus par lding dpon nam mkha' 'brug gnang / kho rang zhal ngo dang thugs kha shin tu 'gre ba'i nang bzan lta bu byas bsdad song yang bla ma dung (32na)dkar pa sogs kyis khong dpon slob gtsang par kha gtad pa'i skyon gyis nam mkha' 'brug gis btson rdzi byas yi ge 'bru gcig 45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyis dgongs ja bu ram gyi gzhis len gyis thog ster cha bzabs/ gtsang chung gling khar sde pa bying pas dmar spro bshams shing ras chung phug gi bla ma 'dzam gling yongs grags kyang ngos phrad la 'ongs/sde pa skyid shod pa dang sgo mang slob dpon byang pa gnyis kyis 'bri phag gi thog tu bde gzar bslang ba'i rkyen gyis gtsang dpung bye ri stag rtse'i bar bteg pa'i dmag gyes pa dang thug dmag mi 'brum nad pa mang po dang (33ba)phrad pa'i skabs dag gis lam ri khug tshor 'byol bzhin pa nas gra phyi nang gi mda' brgyud 'gar rtsar gnas tshang byas skabs dgong mo snga ma 'brong zhol du 'og khang lta bur sdod dgos byung bas 'di 'dra'i gnas tshang dga' ba zhes skyid snang tshor bar byed/ dol mdar lhun grub lha rtse'i rdzong dpon spel ba don grub rdo rjes gung tshigs kyi dro bstabs/ 'bri'u sna'i gru don bya la brgyud de lding dpon rgya yags pa'i nang du gnas tshang bgyis pas gang yod kyi gzhis len bzabs/ chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su slebs/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan las thog gi skabs nas 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa dang 'grig /tshe rta 'jam dkar sgrol dkar gsum gyi rjes gnang zhus/ sgo mang slob dpon gung ru sangs rgyas bkra shis pa sogs gzhan 'byor phun tshogs la phrag dog pa mang pos gling smad par chos 'brel zhu ba mi 'os zhes gshe na'ang / rtogs pa'i yon rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dper song /de nas bzung zhag bzhi bcu tsam gyi bar ser mo ba rnams kyis tshogs chen du gdan gung gnyis kur mang ja nyis skol sum skol kha btags sman tse ja dngul gyis mtshon pa'i 'gyed gtang thub pa gtso bor 'don pa'i tshogs dbur bsngo ba chad dogs pa'i nyes dmigs che yang dpon slob thams cad ltogs las ma tshugs pa'i che ba stong 'bul nas chung ba brgya 'bul du byas te len par chag med phyin/ snying nas gtan bde bsgrub pa'i rigs la rang nyid 'ching byed las dgos pa mi 'dug kyang dar kha 'khyar sbrel ba'i brgya 'bul la zhwa gyon pa dang nas phad tshwa rdig gi 'bul bar shel rgyan (37ba)sprad nas brgya shogs stong 'gugs kyi sgar skor mkhan rnams mthong tshe 'dod yon 'bad med du blangs chog pa 'di sngon sbyin pa btang ba'i rnam smin yin par 'dug /'di dang 'grul res phal che ba gzhan dag la'ang gtsang sde srid du gsar slebs kyi phud du ming btags pa'i gos dar gyi 'bul ba mdzad song / zhabs drung byams pa de mkhyen pa che zhing mchog dman bar gsum dang 'grogs lugs mkhas pas nyi ma gnangs chag gis phebs te lo tshod dang bstun pa'i gsung gleng zhib par mdzad pas shin tu 'dris pa byung / 'grul pa rnams kyis gdan drangs pa'i bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che phebs/ chu khyi lo na phras pa'i mjal lugs kyi tha snyad che ba med pa 'di skabs zhal ngos skor yang kha yar zhus par 'gos dan dka' ba'i mthar mnyam phyag gi zhal bzhes gnang yang don du phyag lan mi gnang ba'i bka' gros nang nas zhal ngor bya byung ba'i de ring nged kyis mdzub mo ker na phyag ma 'bul bskum na phul gsung bkyog mo'i sgo 'khor mdun du bzhengs nas 'dug par mig zur gyis bcos pas phyag mdzub ker byung ba de nyin ldem mjal 'dra ba'i mdzes lam chung tsam byung tshod du 'dug sang nyin phebs sgor bslab tshigs bzhes nas phyag 'bul bsam pa yin rung da cha nang so'i drung gi thugs dang bstun gsung ba'i zhal dan ltar gnang / zhabs drung byams pa dang mjal 'dzom mdzad par khong dpon slob rnams ni phyis su dge lugs pa phal cher gyis 'dud pa'i g.yag —54—

dge slong thugs bsam dag cing rgyun du 'grogs pa'i zla bo'i dper 'os pa yin kyang thos bsam gyi rgya gtugs pa'i yon tan 'gangs chen 'jags rigs min 'dug /tha na dgos la mi dgos kyi chos spyod rgyug chung ba 'dra bslabs pas sgom 'gags te smon lam gal che tsho 'dzin du ma bcug pas byams smon dang thog mtha' pa gnyis lha sa smon lam du 'gro rtag pa'i zhal phyi 'brangs pa zin zhing bzang spyod ni de dmar spro'i gzhis len sna tshogs byung / dka' bcu ba gtsang la 'gro skabs shig zhabs drung de nyid la sku chas kyi mthun rkyen ma nyungs tsam zhal ngos bskur song ba sgang chen pa ma chen brgyud sde phyogs kyi mi mang bsten bskyil mdzad na khyed rang dpon slob la mi phan zhing gzhung du dgongs tshom 'phros yong sogs mgu zhe khrel gyi 'phros pa btang 'dug /de dag gis snga phyir yang lug dres pa sogs sngagasang rnying ma'i bla ma mang po zhig zhal mthun pa'i sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa 'di rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi dbon brgyud yin pas nged rang rnams mjal thub na legs pa'i mol bsdur dang sde srid du dgongs pa zhus par thugs dogs ngan pa'i 'brol cha ma byung skad/ za dam pas ra mo che smon lam gtong ma nyan par brten gtsang nas phod dkar ba mi snar yongs pa'i khra mas bcad mtshams byas/ dgun lho 'grul 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku dpon slob dang byang phyogs nas ching gis gnam gyi gdung las gur dkar po'i bdag —57—

phyogs kyi mi mang bsten bskyil mdzad na khyed rang dpon slob la mi phan zhing gzhung du dgongs tshom 'phros yong sogs mgu zhe khrel gyi 'phros pa btang 'dug /de dag gis snga phyir yang lug dres pa sogs sngag ba'i rnying ma'i bla ma mang po zhig zhal mthun pa'i sde pa 'phyong rgyas pa 'di rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi dbon brgyud yin pas nged rang rnams mjal thub na legs pa'i mol bsdur dang sde rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bor 'dug (42ba)pa'i cho 'phrul du go /stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor phar gdung 'bul kyang bzabs par mdzad song /gling smad zhabs drung nas mngon rtogs rgyan 'dzin rgyu gnang byung ba blo 'jug pa rang ma byung bas dge slong gis rting bskul byas kyang blo ka re gnyis las ma bzung bar brten shin tu 'gor ba byung / la la'i brjod rigs kyis 'khrul ba'i zhal ngo'i thugs la mgon po zhal 'di bkra mi shis pa lta bur mngon nas bkag cha che bar 'dug rung rang chos skyong 'di la lhag par mos pa zhig byung bas rtse lugs kyi mngon rtogs spyan 'dren bskang bstod rnams tshang ba'i shog bu nyi shu yod pa/ der ma 'dus pa'i bstod pa'i rigs sogs lhan thabs shog bu bcu skor bcas pa lkog la 'dzin dgos byung bas myur po ma thub rung zhag nyi shu tsam la gtsang mar 'dril/ de'i skad cha gzims khang gong du gnyal pa sku skyes tshor bas 'phyong rgyas zhal dbon spyin dpal la da lo bya rog 'di rnams sder 'dzings byed pa'i shin tu 'tshub pa 'dug pa khong gis mgon po zhal gyi bskang gso bzung bas lan labs pa zhal ngos gsan nas/ lha 'di 'tshub po yin zer bas mi 'gab bsam pa shar rung thugs 'dzin grub rjes dus gtor mdzod gsung ba ltar yar ngo mar ngo'i brgyad gtor kyang btang / de mus smad lugs rnam sras ser chen dang beg tse'i bskang ba gnyis kyang bzung ba'i nyer dgu'i skabs chag lhag par mos pa zhig byung bas rtse lugs kyi mngon rtogs spyan 'dren bskang bstod rnams tshang ba'i shog bu nyi shu yod pa/ der ma 'dus pa'i bstod pa'i rigs sogs lhan thabs shog bu bcu skor bcas pa lkog la 'dzin dgos byung bas myur po ma thub rung zhag nyi shu tsam la gtsang mar 'dril/ de'i skad cha gzims khang gong du gnyal pa sku skyes tshor bas 'phyong rgyas zhal dbon spyin dpal la da lo bya rog 'di rnams sder 'dzings byed pa'i shin tu 'tshub pa 'dug pa khong gis mgon po zhal gyi bskang gso bzung bas lan labs pa zhal ngos gsan nas/ lha 'di 'tshub po yin zer bas mi 'gab bsam pa shar rung sta zur gyi thad du bram gzugs zhabs g.yon skyil krung lta bu la g.yas pa'i mthil gdan la bstad pa'i bus mo la phyag g.yas rkang dung dang bcas brten (43ba)g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na thod pa 'dzin dgos 'dug pas dpag tshad rgyang grags kyis mi mtshon pa'i thag ring po zhig snang ngo / /rje bsod nams rgya mtshor mnal lam du lung bstan byung ba'i 'bras spungs phyi skor nub kyi zhal bram gzugs rang byon de mjal bar phyin te gtor bsngo bskang pa byas/ nyin gcig gzims —63—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khang gong du ja mgron la phyin skabs bzhugs gral de gar bkra shis kha btags 'dom 'khor mar mdud pa zhus nas bde mchog chu skor gyi nang so nor bur g.yogs song ba de nyin rang bshig nas kong po'i tshong pa mang po 'dug par dwags can dang 'phreng ser gyi rin la sprad pa dka' bcu ba dang gsol dpon nor rgyan pa gnyis kyis labs par dge slong gis dad mos cung zad tsam yang med par (44na tsher dug ces lan btab song / rwa chen rdo rje grags kyi pur dngos su bzhugs pa'i 'jigs byed kyis gtsos mgon po phyag drug pa las gshin bcas pa'i mgon khang dang steng gi blos slong rnams mjal zhing snyan dar phul/ kha sing be ge na skabs gnyis bsrung bar zhum bu mang po blangs pa'i mu 'thud bzhin gso yin yod par zhal dpon gyi rgya ri khyer bar bsnyad pa'i nang so nor bus thams cad brdungs shing sre po zhig yod pa de la gri mes kyang bzos pa sogs dbang byung na rtswa 'phred la mi za ba'i bya skad dang po rgyag gin yod/ ja pa dang lhan du tsha ba'i 'grul pa ga rta me chen slebs pa'i bzang ja/ rgun 'brum/ sbrang rtsi sogs ster cha mang du byung / 'di phan chad bying nad ye ma sangs pa'i/zan la rta g.yag bya khyi'i gzugs 'gros sna tshogs bzos pa mtshan mo snod du bcug nyin mo zhal ba'i khar bkram nas rtse/ srubs dbar rnams la dge slong gis bskul lcag mdzad nas mdo sde mdzangs blun dang drin lan bsabs pa bklags pas las dge sdig gi lo rgyus tshor 'jigs snang yang cung zad yong ba la rgyun du bya lam rjes med du 'gro ba de dred po chos rgyus mkhan zhig yong ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dgun stod zhag bcu skor gyi ring tsha rting kha nas nam phyed bar mi chad pa'i rlung dmar shin tu che bas 'grul pa la la 'gril zhing nang du'ang glo skar sogs tshad ma gcod dgos pa'i sngon ma grags shig byung song ba lo shas dbus gtsang du ltas mi legs pa 'dra byung ma song rung rje pha bong kha pa'i lung bstan chen mor bdud seng ge'i mgo can gyis gtsos pa yod tshul gsungs pa'i 'byung po'i cho (44ba)'phrul gyi sngon 'gror go /—64
