rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)dgung 'o1 bcu gcig par bsdus grwa'i rigs lam gyi gsan sbyong dbu tshugs pa'i skor/me yos kyi lo gsar grub nas dga' ldan khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel smon lam chen mo'i gral dbu dang de zin bstun 'bras spungs su phebs/ khri rin po che/ zhal ngo / dka' bcu ba gsum nged mtshan nyid byed 'jug pa'i bka' gros kyi sgo dod/ rang ngos nas mtshan nyid la shes 'dod ye med/ sngags phyogs kyi rgyud sde du ma'i rgyud dang bskyed rdzogs cho ga lag len las rab 'byams 'dra la thos bsam byed rgyu byung na snyam pa dung nge ba yod kyang rang dbang med pas bka' bstun zhu ba'i lugs byas/ gling smad zhabs drung nas mtshan nyid 'gangs che ba'i bsngags brjod mang po gnang yang sngags phyogs shig med na mtshan nyid 'di 'dras 'phral gyi kha bshad las phugs gar yang phyin pa zhig med 'dra snyam pa sha stag byung / gang ltar hor zla dang po'i nyer gsum gyi gza' skar legs pa'i nyin dbu btsugs rtsi bzhag 'dzin rogs dge slong dang byang ngos nas gnyis kyis byas/ thog mar tshig bkra legs khyad kyis gang zag yin na lha ma yin pa bud zer na/ ston pa shākya thub pa chos can zhes sogs kyi khyab rkang gcig dang phyi dro gang zag yin na mi ma yin pa bud zer na/ longs sku chos can yod pa'i khyab rkang gcig gnang byung ba 'dzin dka' ba ma byung / bsam mno btang bas lha yin na 'dod khams pa'i lha ma yin pa bud zer na/ gzugs khams pa'i lha chos can sogs kyis kyang gshogs pa 'dug snyam pas mtshon te rtags gsal khyab gsum gyi 'bros 'ded kha yar blo la shar byung ba gling smad zhabs drung la zhu bar phyin pas/ phyag thugs (45na〉kar thal mo sbyar te khyed sngon paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i skabs nas shes bya 'di la sbyangs pa zhig yin pas de tsam re'ang re de ring gi de tshig bkra legs legs yin sang nas kha dog dkar dmar gtong rtsis yin —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()kyang khyed la de 'dra dgos pa'i rigs su mi 'dug pas mtshan mtshon nas gtong gsung rim pa bzhin du gnang byung bzhag brgyad tsam song ba'i tshe/ don spyod nus pa'i ldog pa dang yin khyab mnyam yin na mtshan nyid ma yin pa bud zer ba'i chos thun gnang ba shin tu 'dzin dka' bar tsha ba dka' bcu bas rogs byas te nam phyed la thug thug bar bskyar ldab mang bas sdug khyud de ba zhig la zin/ tshoms nas mgon khang pa rnams kyis gnas tshul ma shes shing bskyar sbyang byas pa tshor bas de 'dra'i thugs rus che ba zhes mgu mgu byed 'dug pa blo sbyong don 'dun mar/ gtso bo gnyis kyis dbang po gzung gsung ba shin tu bden par snang mngon shes med pa 'di mtshang che bsam pa shar/ sang nas bzung rtsis bzhag rnams sngar lugs ltar zin/ khri rin po ches gnam gang gi 'o brgyal de la bltas na mtshan nyid kyi thugs gnyer mi yong ba 'dra bsam pa byung yang da cha de 'dra'i dogs pa mi dgos pa 'dug phebs pa las nub gcig po'i skyag re med des byi ba la glang chen gyi dpe'i paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi bsngags brjod sogs ni 'bug 'bug mi gsung ngo / /brtan pa ma thob pa'i bsam pa 'gyur bar tshegs mi 'dug pas mtshan nyid kyi chos thun gcig gnyis bzung mtshams sngar gyi blo 'gyur ba'i rtog ge'i rig pa la a 'thas te po ti lnga dang (45ba)zur bkol rnams la zhib tu sbyangs te rab 'byams smra ba'i ston pa zhig byed snyam pa byung /'di nas bzung dge slong yang 'phral gyi rogs las spros pa'i dpe cha'i bskul ma'i khur phogs/ rang lo bcu gcig las mi 'gro rung rgan dang khyad par med pa'i dbang por rang khrims kyis rtsis bzhag la shin tu brtson par byas/ bla chen gyi gral du tshud pa la sngar gyi 'bul chen rnams bzang yang rgya gar kha spu can dang bod kyi cha pa chos seng gi lugs ltar na bshad ma thag pa rnams 'gangs che'am snyam/zla gcig tsam gyi bar rigs lung tshad ldan byed ma shes pas chos 'khor gling pa'i bar shar ba kha shas bos pa'i bgro gleng byed par rtog pa zhib tu bcug /zla ba phyed gnyis tsam nas rtags bsal sbrel thub pa'i rigs lung byed shes pa byung / zla chos gnyis kyi ring mtshan mtshon rdzas ldog /ldog pa ngos —66

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)'dzin/ spyi bye brag rnams kyi rtsi bzhag ma brjed par bskyar/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor mnal lam du mgon po zhal gyis bskul te rang gzhan tshang mas mi'i 'bru tshad du ngos 'dzin rung gnang sgo long pa (48ba)zhig la rang tshugs 'dzin rgyu med pa'i chos grar phyin na chos dang gzhas rar phyin na gzhas kyi dpe kho na'i thugs tsho ma zin par khri rin po cher da cha sa lam gyi rnam gzhag sogs gzhung bshad ma gtogs mtshan nyid pa'i rig pa sa li si li gnang mi dgos tshul zhus pa ltar ston chos nas se ra byes pa'i phar phyin gyi spyi don khob shag cig gnang byung ba ma 'dod kyang bzu nga /zur chos la zhal ngos ma mkhyen pa byas ra ba stod pa'i rtags rigs rtsi bzhag ring nges shes pa chos thun gnyis re bzung / zla chos la rtags rigs rdzogs shing phar phyin gyi spyi don chos 'khor gyi 'gor slebs/ dka' bcu ba gtsang nas 'khor ba'i skad cha dris byung bar rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas dpon slob gnyis lhan du bzhugs thog gegs sangs/ston chos gnyis pa nas zhal ngo phar phyin la dgyes pa 'dug pas dgongs khrid dang bcas se ra byes pa'i phar phyin gyi thal 'phreng gi chos thun re dang rang ngos bsdus tshad sbrel 'dod che bas ra ba stod pa'i rnam 'grel gyi le'u dang po nas chos thun gnyis re chag med du bzung / bkra shis rgya mtsho 'dzin she gnyis ka 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig 'dug kyang gsol dpon nor rgyan pa sogs kyis bslad pa'i dgos pa'i mchod rten nag po dang mi dgos brag la sku dkar gsol ba'i dpe kho nas yi ge brda dag rtsom pa sogs yon tan rnam grangs mang po byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 'gal zla mi mthun (49na)phyogs shig 'dug pas rogs su mi 'gyur bar nges nas kho rang gi chu babs su bzhag /lcang —71— —

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)'gro dgos 'dug ces rgyud stod smad kyi snyung gzhi 'du ba 'khrugs pa las kyang che bar gda'/ dgun chos la bcu gnyis pa nyis brtsegs yod pa dang bcas skabs dang po dang le'u dang po'i 'phros rnams bzung / e nas dpon sa a ne drung zhabs skor la phebs par gzhis len dang dngos po'i skyes gang legs khri/la/dgung lo bcu gsum par gzhung chen slob gnyer la thugs bskyed gnang ba sogs kyi skor/sa sbrul gyi lo gsar grub rjes zla ba dang po'i nang du nyang bran grong smad pa'i sger gzhis su mgron la phyin zhag gcig bsdad gzhis len dang ster sbyin bzabs/ de nas se rar slebs dpyid chos dang po la phar phyin gyi skabs gnyis pa dang rnam 'grel ra ba stod bla brang gi dpe g.yor dgos stabs le'u bar ma gnyis ma byung bas le'u bzhi pa'i rtsi bzhag gnang / chos 'khor gling (50na)pa dpon slob rnams kyang chos thog la byon/ bla brang khag gsum dang khams tshan mi tshan gyi ja mgron la 'gro dgos ma gtogos rigs lung 'ba' zhig byas/ chab mdo'i gnas po yab khra sogs bar khams nas 'grul pa mang tsam 'byor bas rdo gcal chen mor dge 'dun tshogs chen gyi dbus su ja rta khrab mdzos gtsos pa'i brgya 'bul bteg par bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/cha khar rgyal pos gzhung bzhig pa'i gshis byang lam ma bde bar tā 'on dar khan chos rje dang brag nyi dbon chu gnyis rgya'i gzhung bgrod dar rtse mdo nas bar khams brgyud 'byor/ tā 'on chosarjes tshogs chen du bos brgya 'bul dang 'bras spungs gser thog gi thebs la gser zho stong dang ja khor drug ma stong phul/ brag nyi dbon chung gis kyang ster sbyin phran bu byas/ gsar 'grul 'dra la rjes gnang dgos pa byung bar lha gcig gi rigs 'gre thams cad la bsgyur chog pa'i sla po zhig mdzad —73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ () mkhan yong gin 'dug pa bzhin khri rin po ches bslab ston gnang ba ltar rigs gsum mgon po mi g.yo ba sgrol ma sogs kha shas kyi rjes gnang 'dra'ang byas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug tu gling smad zhabs drung gsang sngags mkhar du thegs/ nged rnams 'bras spungs su log dka' bcu bas 'jam dbyangs legs chos pas mdzad pa'i phar phyin gyi skabs gnyis pa'i dpe zhig gtad nas gzung zer yang grub mtha' mi mthun 'dug pas 'then pa'i de tshab blo bzang chos grags dang lhan du ra ba stod pa'i blo skor rnams dpe thog nas tshang bar bzung / chos 'khor gling pa'i bar shar ba rnams rigs (50ba)lung la re mos su yod bar ma zad ra ba stod pa'i chos mtshams byung res kyi jo phrug sogs re mang yong gin yod pa dang rigs lung smar bar byung / rgyal gnyer pa zur pa nang so chab mdo rje drung rin po che'i phyag g.yog yin gshis kho pa 'das rjes gzims khang gong du bzhugs rtsis kyis sku chas rnams rgyal du bsgril te phebs pa thugs dang bstun na dgon par phan pa zhig yong rgyur 'dug rung zhal ngos tsha ba dka' bcu ba btang ba'i nang so'i shul la sgrom mda' ba dang hab thob lta bu'i bgo bsha' brgyab pa'i rje drung gnas nas phyung bas ma legs tsam byung song sgom mda' ba dang dka' bcu bar las sbyor yang mdzad skad/zhal ngo glang thabs kyis shin tu mnyel ba'i nyin chen byung rung drung 'tsho sgar grong pas sbyongs phul bas 'phrod na'ang sku 'dar nas tsho mi zin pa zhig 'dug par bdag la bka' bsgo byab khrus tshe dbang rnams kyis gsung ba byas 'phral stabs 'grig pa'i zhi bas nged rang rjes su 'dzin pa'i dus la bab par 'dug ces thugs mos sngar bas che che 'dra dang dka' bcu ba yang rgyal du song ba dang bcas glo bur ba zhig byung dogs pa'i sbubs 'thums pa de sangs pas blo bde gsung / sbyongs de 'phrod drags pas sku gzugs thang ba'i tshad cig byung bas tshang ma yid bde bar gyur rung dge bskos chos dbang sogs drung 'khor dbang yod 'ga' res mi gces 'di la rtab 'gros su bshal gtong nyes che zer nyes pa dkri la khad kyang byung song / gsang phu dbyar chos grol bstun khri rin po che 'bras spungs —74

shin tu phan gnang zhing bzhad kyin 'dug pa rtogs pas bdag grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i rtags chen por snang / khri rin po che phebs par zla gcig gi bar phar phyin gyi skabs gsum pa dang rnam 'grel gyi le'u bzhi pa'i 'phros rnams zhus/ chos gling gra tshang stod lung gram du chos dbar la byon pas blo bzang chos grags dang bkra shis rgya mtsho gnyis kyi thog /khar kha blo bzang dpal 'byor dang sgo spe ba chos grags rgya mtsho gnyis bskyil/ sgo spe ba shes rab rtul ba'i khar sgom chen pa 'dra ba'i sbubs bzang / khar kha ba yon tan che zhing nyams 'char ba zla bo dga' ba'i tshad cig byung /zla ba shog bu mda' tshad ma bzhi bcu tsam zhig gnang nas/ tshur 'khor bstun rgyugs gtsang sing 'phrod na rje btsun tsong kha pa'i gser sku legs po 'di rgyal la 'a rtsa phebs par dge 'phel du dbyar mthong dang sbrags zhag bcu bzhi bsdad pa'i ring bzung (51ba)ba'i tshur phebs 'phral rgyung phul bas gser sku'ang dgyes bzhin pas gnang / zhal snga nas rong tshad pas 'dul ba gra tshang gi rigs gra dang chos ston gnyis la bos/ ston chos kyi ring phar phyin gyi skabs bzhi pa dang lnga pa gnyis 'dril ba 'gab gsungs nas rtsibazhag kyang ring tsam byung zhing rnam 'grel gyi le'u gsum pa'i phyed tsam song /dga' ldan du thegs gdong 'dul ba zhig 'dzin 'dod yod zhus pas skyed tshal ba'i yig cha las —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()btus pa'i gzhi stod yan gyi spyi ma thal shog bu lnga bcu tsam zin bris su btab nas gnang / bgro gleng byed rogs phal cher chos 'khor gling par song bas byes pa'i grub mtha' dang phyogs log cig yong gin 'dug pas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i phar phyin thal 'phreng steng gi dgos med kyi tshig ro mang tsam mchis pa phud pa'i rags rim dang 'dul ba'i zin bris rnams ston gyi ring bzung / ja pa dang mnyam du sprul sku ngag dbang dpon slob byon tshogs chen du bos te/ spob rtse brgya'i ster sbyin mdzad/ bar khams pa'i bdog pa la gcig tu che zhes kun gyis ha las par brtsi/ brjed gsos byas pa'i khong dpon slob la tshe dbang phyag drug pa rigs gsum mgon po rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ rig pa dngas khyad nas srod dang tho rengs rab gsal gyi khang du bsdad pa'i dpe cha bshar sbyang byas pa sprul sku ngag dbang gi 'grul zla la gung ru rab 'byams pa ḍo ma bi 'dug pas tshor te gra pa slob gnyer ba 'dra zer dga' dga' byed/ gsol dpon nor rgyan par bsing gsogs re nyal khar skyol byas pa ltar bskyal byung rung mi rnams kyi rtsar thugs (52na)rus 'di 'dra 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs dam la mdzad na byed nyams spro zer ba labs 'dug /gangs can gyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag pha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod du rje zhal snga nas kyis re rdzog gsung ba ltar phyin/ zhag gcig gnas 'brel byas gzhis len bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ rigs gsum mgon po rang byon sogs gnas kyi khyad par ngo mtshar can rnams la gsung bshad kyis 'byam klas/ drung 'tsho sog gor gyi spyil bur gsol ja bzhes sar sngon chog dar chog gi gsung bshad gnang gin 'dug pa la mkhas pa zhig yod pa 'dra bsam pa las ma byung / de dus zhal snga nas khe gsum pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid pa ston bzang gi rigs la shes 'dod 'gro/ gzhan su la'ang mos pa chung zhing rnga sgram sgrom dril bu sil sil/ smin ma gzengasamatho/ lus gnad srong ba/ sgom thag can sogs gang yang zag zog tu mngon pa'i skyon gyis mkhas grub chen po 'di 'dra dang mjal yang ha cang mos pa ma byung / de skabs nas zhabs pad bsten na ris med kyi grub mtha' kun la rgya mtsho las chu bcu ba lta bu zhig yong rgyur 'dug rung mtshan nyid pa'i nga —76

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()btus pa'i gzhi stod yan gyi spyi ma thal shog bu lnga bcu tsam zin bris su btab nas gnang / bgro gleng byed rogs phal cher chos 'khor gling par song bas byes pa'i grub mtha' dang phyogs log cig yong gin 'dug pas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i phar phyin thal 'phreng steng gi dgos med kyi tshig ro mang tsam mchis pa phud pa'i rags rim dang 'dul ba'i zin bris rnams ston gyi ring bzung / ja pa dang mnyam du sprul sku ngag dbang dpon slob byon tshogs chen du bos te/ spob rtse brgya'i ster sbyin mdzad/ bar khams pa'i bdog pa la gcig tu che zhes kun gyis ha las par brtsi/ brjed gsos byas pa'i khong dpon slob la tshe dbang phyag drug pa rigs gsum mgon po rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ rig pa dngas khyad nas srod dang tho rengs rab gsal gyi khang du bsdad pa'i dpe cha bshar sbyang byas pa sprul sku ngag dbang gi 'grul zla la gung ru rab 'byams pa ḍo ma bi 'dug pas tshor te gra pa slob gnyer ba 'dra zer dga' dga' byed/ gsol dpon nor rgyan par bsing gsogs re nyal khar skyol byas pa ltar bskyal byung rung mi rnams kyi rtsar thugs (52na)rus 'di 'dra 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs dam la mdzad na byed nyams spro zer ba labs 'dug /gangs can gyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag pha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod du rje zhal snga nas kyis sgo/ga gsung ba ltar phyin/ zhag gcig gnas 'brel byas gzhis len bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ rigs gsum mgon po rang byon sogs gnas kyi khyad par ngo mtshar can rnams la gsung bshad kyis 'byam klas/ drung 'tsho sog gor gyi spyil bur gsol ja bzhes sar sngon chog dar chog gi gsung bshad gnang gin 'dug pa la mkhas pa zhig yod pa 'dra bsam pa las ma byung / de dus zhal snga nas khe gsum pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid pa ston bzang gi rigs la shes 'dod 'gro/ g.yin su la'ang mos pa chung zhing rnga sgram sgrom dril bu sil sil/ smin ma gzengasamatho/ lus gnad srong ba/ sgom thag can sogs gang yang zag zog tu mngon pa'i skyon gyis mkhas grub chen po 'di 'dra dang mjal yang ha cang mos pa ma byung / de skabs nas zhabs pad bsten na ris med kyi grub mtha' kun la rgya mtsho las chu bcu ba lta bu zhig yong rgyur 'dug rung mtshan nyid pa'i nga —76

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)rgyal de chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyur snang ngo / /dgun chos grol ba'i dga' ldan nas rje bla ma 'bras spungs su phebs/ phar phyin gyi spyi don dang khyung phrug byams pa bkra shis kyi dbu ma'i thal 'phreng gi dbu btsugs/ rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa'i phyag dpe ma byung bas zur chos la mngon pa mdzod kyi rtsi bzhag cig zhus par paṇa chen dang las chen dngos grub pa'i yig cha 'di gnyis chu thub po rang mi 'dug gnang ba'i chos 'khor (52bskon po'i paṇa chen gzhung lugs 'bum phrag brgya ba dngos grub dpal 'bar gyi yig cha'i steng nas bsdus te lung rig gnyis ka yod pa zhig stsal/dgung lo bcu bzhi par slob gnyer la mu 'thud thugs gnyer gnang ba dang / skyor mo lung dang dga' ldan la phebs pa bcas kyi skor/lcags rta'i lo gsar grub bstun gling smad zhabs drung smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs/ de'i bar 'jam dbyangs stag lung brag pa'i gsung rgyun gyi gtan tshigs tshul gsum pa'i lung 'gal gyi skor gyi legs bshad zur pa 'dra dang blo gsal gling pa dam chos dpal gyis mdzad pa'i drang nges rnam 'byed kyi sems tsam pa rdzogs pa'i bar rnams bzung dpyid chos gsum po'i ring 'jug pa'i thal ldog nas bdag 'gog bar gyi thal 'phreng mdzod kyi gnas bzhi pa man yongs rdzogs/ phar phyin gyi skabs dang po'i mjug man bzhi pa'i phyed lhag tsam yan gyi spyi don rnams bzung / 'di skabs nas blo kha mtho ba'i lugs byas/ chos 'khor gling pa dang ra ba stod pa'i bar shar ba rnams su ma zad dka' rab 'byams rgan pa rnams dang blo gsal gling nas byams gling rab 'byams pa sprel rgan/dga' ba gdong rtse mo rab 'byams pa/ sgo mang nas rtse chen rab 'byams pa/ bsam snang rab 'byams —77

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 15)khor mar byas chog pa cung mi 'dra 'dug rung / sgo mang byang pa chos grags rnam rgyal gyi thugs la yun thungs pas po ti'i 'gro tshod de tsam min po che dang zhal ngo sogs dpon slob rnams 'dzom pa'i thog tā 'on chos rjes sog po thams cad cha khar rgyal pos dbang du bsdus song bas gdan 'dren byung na phebs pa 'gab/ gnang lugs kyang 'di 'dra dgos kyi gshom ra zhu 'dug par dal 'byor lan cig thob pa stong log tu btang nas ci byed snyam pa byung / de dus sngon byon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rnam thar la yid spro zhing da dung rgya gar du chos rnam 'grel nas gzhung che ba re blangs/ nged rang yang chos 'khor gyi bshad pa byed khur gyis de ga 'dzin par ma zad zla bo'i skyor rogs dang bcas re res deb la lugs kyis langs nas bshad pa byed pa ltar gyi skyor sbyang byas par drung 'khor 'dras mthong bas gra pa rnams tshogs langs gling bsre byed pa bla ma'i ang nyan yin mod rang re la de 'dras ci byed gleng / dbon po dam chos kyis rtsed mor bsnyad pa'i dngos su'ang gling bsre zhig thub na 'dul ba gra tshang gi bla ma yong shas khas zer/ zhal ngos yi ge slobs gsung bar drung yig ngag dbang dge legs kyis spang leb khar dpe bris nas nyin gcig gnyis shig sbyangs pas dpe char gnod po byung bas rang la dgos dus ni yig mkhan zhig rnyed yong / mi'i yig mkhan byas nas mi tshe 'byid pa mi 'char bla ma de gsung rab la e mkhas zer ba las yi ge la e (54ba)mkhas zer ba mi yong snyam bskyur btang / tshogs langs byed pa zhal ngo'i thugs la 'thad rgyu rang mi 'dug pa'i khar rigs gra'i gdong la sgo mang slob dpon gung ru glo bor du grongs pa'i sgo mang phyogs kyi tshogs langs pa rnams bshol pas chos 'khor gyi phyi rgol ba yang thabs chag nas stabs ma 'grig /chos 'khor gling gi bar shar ba kha shas la dung rgya gling bslabs song ba'i khrod du bkra shis rgya mtsho'ang dang jangs kyis song ba dpe cha ma nus pa yin 'dra bas ba lha snal 'debs ma byas/chos sde chen po skyor lung pa spyi sos yong dgos tshul ltar hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin gling smad zhabs drung phebs pa dang phyogs mthun du phyin/ gdong dkar zhol du rdzong dpon skyong nga bas bzhes spro bshams lam zhor mkhar grong nas kyis dkar spro drangs/ chos de ba dang shun drung 'khor rnams kyis rta bsu/ gra dmangs kyi ser sbreng / skya ser gyi khrom shin tu che ba dang bcas de nub chos ster slebs/ spyi sger tshang mas rnyed bkur bzabs pa'i zhag bzhi po'i ring nyin ltar gyi dmar spro gnyis dang dkar spro bdun brgyad tsam re byung ba nam langs sa rub lta bur phyin/ mi yong gong 'bras —80

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)spungs su khri rin po che'i phebs sgor skyor mo lung du spyi chos shig gnang dgos yong ba bka' gdams glegs bam nas chos thun gcig gnang rgyu'i bshad pa hrug tsam zhig nged kyis 'bul phebs byung yang ṭīk+ka lugs de ma gtogs 'bol bshad blo la 'char mdog kha po ma byung bas dgongs pa zhus/ ma nas kyang gzhon dus yong mdog kha mo'i ma btab skyes de min yang rgan du song tshe pho rog gi phrug gu 'dra ru mi 'gro tsam byung / dgon pa'i phyi rol gyi (55na)sa khri'i steng nas khye'u gsal ba'i 'khrungs rabs shog bu lnga tsam zhig lung gi tshul du klog /klog pa'i sngon 'gror gling smad zhabs drung rin po ches bzhugs khri'i steng nas bzhedas te phyag dang bcas dpe cha zhal phye lag tu gtod pa gnang ba ya nga ba byung zhing la las rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi yang srid thugs kyis dran 'dra zhes kyang gleng skad/'go mjug tshor bla ma dung dkar bas ma ṇi bskul ba'i rta snyan po mang po byed 'dug cing bla mas zhal ngo la skyor mo lung pa dang skyor lung pa tshor zhal ngos mgron brda byung ba'i 'phrul gyis 'byor ba khrom pa'i ya bor shin tu mkho ba'i rjes su 'phros kyang yang yang mdzad song /chos 'chad pa'i skabs me tog gi char pa ja phor gyi kha rgya tsam pa babs pa khrom pa kun gyis mthong ba bka' gdams glegs bam 'gangs che ba'i byin rlabs su mngon/ tshur lam tsher gseb dgon pa'i mdor rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa dpon slob kyis gzhis len bstabs/khong gis bzhugs gral la lugs gnyis dang 'brel pa'i smra ba'i sgo phye song bar gsol dpon dang dam chos sogs drung 'bor mang pos bla ma zer na 'di 'dra yong ba yin zhes khri rin po pa khrug tsam zhig nged kyis 'bul phebs byung yang ṭīk+ka lugs de ma gtogs 'bol bshad blo la 'char mdog kha po ma byung bas dgongs pa zhus/ ma nas kyang gzhon dus yong mdog kha mo'i ma btab skyes de /klog pa'i sngon 'gror gling smad zhabs drung rin po ches bzhugs khri'i steng nas bzhedas te phyag dang bcas dpe cha zhal phye lag tu gtod pa gnang ba ya nga ba byung zhing la las rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi yang srid thugs kyis dran 'dra zhes kyang gleng skad/'go mjug tshor bla ma dung dkar bas ma ṇi bskul ba'i rta snyan po mang po byed 'dug cing bla mas zhal ngo la skyor mo lung pa dang skyor lung pa tshor zhal ngos mgron brda byung ba'i 'phrul gyis 'byor ba khrom pa'i ya bor shin tu mkho ba'i rjes su 'phros kyang yang yang mdzad song /chos 'chad pa'i skabs me tog gi char pa ja phor gyi rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mig pho brang du bzhugs/ smon lam chung ba'i gral dbur khri rin po che phebs/ ra sa 'phrul snang du gsung chos smon lam nyi ma gnyis kyi bar khri rin po ches gnang / nyi ma gsum par bdag gis lad mo gshod pa'i lugs byas/ bstan 'bar ma dang bde ba can chad dogs zla bo mtha' dag sems tshad che/ dbon po dam chos gnas tshang gi gzhis srung la bzhag pa lta bar ni yong ma thub sa gcig tu sdod mi tshugs pa tsam gyi blo 'khor ba'i ngang nas tshogs grol byung ba dang nub kyi spag rar yongs nas mgron gnyer rgya yags par dris par chad lhag med pa legs po byung byas 'dug pas bkyig thag bkrol ba tsam gyi nyams shar zer/ nyi ma bzhi pa nas bzung rje bla ma dang nged dpon slob gnyis chos gra smon lam nyi ma re mos lta bur spel mar gnang / dgongs star jo mjal la phyin kyang kha bshad las sems rgyud ma dul ba'i nyams kyis nad med pa tshe ring ba dpe cha smar ba sogs gnas skabs kyi smon lam las rgya chen 'debs pa ma shar/ dung skyong rgyal mor gsol mchod lnga drug cig phul/ yon tan gyi thugs khur bzhes mkhan rnams ni bshad pa la rtog pa 'dug /phal che ba bde pa can gyi smon lam chad ma chad zer rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshun la mkhas pa'i rje stag lung brag pas kyang bde ba can chig rkya mi pher dbu (58ba)mdzad kyi rigs rnams chos spyod smon lam chu rgyug rgyug yong bas snyigs dus kyi mi'i snang tshul la nges pa ci yod/ spus srang drung 'tsho bas rgya'i gdugs legs po zhig zhal ngor phul rje gong ma'i skabs gsung chos smon lam tshor dbu gdugs dang rgya gling sgrigs mar gnang gin yod pas stabs bde 'di 'dra mi 'gab zhus snang yang dgongs par ma bab/ ba so sprul ba'i skus gra skor mdzad pa'i nyin dpon slob dang zhal ngo gnyis bka' gros gnang ba'i bdag rkyen du 'gro ba 'dug ces dgongs mo'i smon lam zin 'phral bzhugs khri gnyis nub phyogs su kha sgyur/ slob dpon rnams dang gra dmangs tshogs thog sprul pa'i skus dam bca' mdzad/gling smad zhabs drung nas bdag la bgro gleng gnang ba 'gab kyang ra ba stod pa'i mig ltos kyis sun 'byin dang tshag khrad sogs med pa'i 'jam tong nge ba zhig mdzod gsung ba de 'dra byas na mi —86

/gzhan ma lo snga ma mang por sku rtsed la gzhogs drung pa'i khyed rang thugs gnyer yag po mdzod bla ma rang zhig mdzad pa yin no/ sde pa dmar po'i rigs la dgos pa med byed na sde pa sngon po rang dga' gsung bar sde pa dmar po su la zer zhus pas khyed bla chen gyi rigs 'di sde pa dmar po rang yin mod gnang ba 'phral nyams 'char du 'dug kyang gzur gnas shig gis brtags tshe thabs kyi sgo nas chos ba rdzogs byang du bsdos/ mtshan nyid kyi skabs dbang rjes gnang cho ga bskang gso yig rtsis kyis mtshon pa'i yon tan gzhan bslab pa/'jig rten gyi rnam g.yeng sgrob sgrob byed pa mtha' dag slob gnyer gyi gegs kho na byed pas e phyogs la 'gro (60na)ba'i grabs yul gyis dpe cha rigs lung tshang ma btang snyoms su lus/ sngar nas las tshan sogs stob chen byed srol snang ba'i steng gsol dpon rab brtan bteg chos lung na khar 'byor/de lo than pa shin tu che bas zhal ngos char 'bebs gyis gsung ba gdams ngag ni mtshan nyid —88—

pa'i nang rten kun bzang rtse brgyud rje nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i phyag tu 'byor pa bla dwags la rdo rje phur par grags shing mtshan dngos pad phur khams gsum rnam rgyal du 'bod pa de chu 'gram du gdan drangs nas sku khrus gsol bas de nub char dba' thon tsam zhig babs/rgod dkar la brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gzhi dgon rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal du slebs/ zhal snga nas rgya chen pas zhag gnyis sdod dgos tshul byung ba dang sgar pa mang po sha nad kyis na ba 'dom pa'i bcag mal mi byed ka med la gzhi byes thugs rtse mthun/ gra tshang gis gzhis len dang ster cha bzabs gyis pod chung dam phrug dmar po 'byar ba zhig khyer te 'di gur zhal gyi be'u bum yin rje yon tan rgya (60ba)mtshos bdag la skor cig tshags kyis slar tshur dgos pa yod gnang byung bsad 'bul ba yin zer gtad byung / po ti de dkon mod ma shes par 'bras spungs su bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi gzungs bzhugs gnang skabs dpe cha dbye 'byed kyi khrod du bskyal ba chos tshan rnams gtor nas mchod rten so so'i gzungs bzhugs la song bar snang / phyis su byas tshe tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos/ mus srad pa ni dkar chag khrigs chags can/ gsungs pa'i rdzong pod yin 'dug pa nor med dang nyams med kyi dper song / sde pa brag kha bas tshes gcig pa btang nas brag khar yong dgos tshul byung bar zhal len gnang song yang sang mi bskyar ma 'ongs pa'i khong rang bsam yas mdo sde'i thugs brel gyis bzhugs long mi yong 'dug /zhabs tog byed mi rkang tshugs 'jog zer bar zhal ngo ma mnyes pa'i rdzong la ma phyin par rgya gar shar gling zer ba der mnga' ris gra tshang bla gnyer rnams kyis bzhes spro dang ja zhus byas ljangs 'phrang 'gor yar klungs sna mo shag pa 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i bu 'bring po'i gtsug phud blangs pa'i dga' ston du rta rags gang yod —89

gtad byung / po ti de dkon mod ma shes par 'bras spungs su bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi gzungs bzhugs gnang skabs dpe cha dbye 'byed kyi khrod du bskyal ba chos tshan rnams gtor nas mchod rten so so'i gzungs bzhugs la song bar snang / phyis su byas tshe tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos/ mus srad pa ni dkar chag khrigs chags can/ gsungs pa'i rdzong pod yin 'dug pa nor med dang nyams med kyi dper song / sde pa brag kha bas tshes gcig pa btang nas brag khar yong dgos tshul byung bar zhal len gnang song yang sang mi bskyar ma 'ongs pa'i khong rang bsam yas mdo sde'i thugs brel gyis bzhugs long mi yong 'dug /zhabs tog byed mi rkang tshugs 'jog zer bar zhal ngo ma mnyes pa'i rdzong la ma phyin par rgya gar shar gling zer ba der mnga' ris gra tshang bla gnyer rnams kyis bzhes spro dang ja zhus byas ljangs 'phrang 'gor yar klungs sna mo shag pa 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i bu 'bring po'i gtsug phud blangs pa'i dga' ston du rta rags gang yod —89

rnams g.yu pad kong rna sogs bod lugs kyi rgyan bkod bzabs gshom dang bcas snga dus kyi sde srid (61na)khungs btsun pa'i sgrigs srol bzang po bag dro ba zhig 'dug /phyogs de'i dgon pa rnams kyi ser mdzad/ rang la byings dang mthun pa'i kun slong gi 'ching ba dam po zhig yod pas zhabs drung de skar rnying la mos pa'i gsha' ma rang min pa 'dug snyam dag snang ma byung / zhi ba lhas/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na/ /bdag lta ngan pas smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i don de ma go ba'i skyon du gda'/ chad dkar chos sde spyi sos gzhis len dang bdog pa'i skyes bzang ba bag dro nyams kyis rdzong nas tsha khad gcig tsam gyi sar thabs bsur 'byor/ dwags po gra tshang pa dang e dgon bdun gyis (61ba)gtsos pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyis seng sbreng / skye bo'i khrom khri phrag gis bsus te ltag rdzong gsar brgyab bkra shis mthong smon gyi dwags po gra tshang gi 'du khang steng du sdod sa byas/—90

khrod du phyin na snyam pa'i gdan khar sdod mi tshugs pa tsam byung / zhag gsum bzhi nas dwags po gra tshang rgyal dbyar chos la bzhud pa'i rigs lung byed mkhan med par khu sem me byung (62na)bas mig bshad/ nya stongs brgyad gsum la gzims chung du dpon blon rnams dang rdo gcal du khrom la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phab/smyung gnas ras pas bsnyen gnas nyi ma shar nas byas pa'i mig ltos kyis dus la mi rta khrab khro zangs mar btsod gos snam sogs brgya 'bul tshar du dngar bar bsngo ba dang khrom khri phrag brgal bar tshe dbang —9/—

byung 'dug pa e phyogs 'di rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas bzung dad mos shin tu che bas bla ma de nyid dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa'i shugs kyis rdo la ring bsrel byung bar (62ba)gda'/lam zhor du glog dgon par dro bstab der bsam yas pa dang gcig par grags pa'i rgyal po zhig 'dug par snyan dar phul/ sgrol dkar gyi bka' bab mnyam med sgre pa'i gzims phug mjal/zhal ngo dang bla ma dung dkar ba gnyis kyi stabs dang bstun pa las mtshan nyid pa rgan po'i nyams kyis gnas skor la dag snang shin tu chung / ri sgor slebs bstun rgya ri gzhung nas zhag nyi shu skor rgyun gyi rnyed bkur dang rdzong du bos pa'i 'dod pa ltar gtor rgyag cig byas/ rgyal mtshan skor pa'i go ma bzabs mchor du bshams 'dug /nged rang chung ngu nas yul 'khyar ba'i mi la gnyen sred kyi bed mi 'dug kyang a ne drung pa tshur phan thogs drags pa'i gal che ba yod pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba legs pa zhig phul/ rong chad dkar du zhag bcu bsdad nar ma dus ston bdog skyes bzang bar mdzad/zhabs drung la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ phyag drug pa'i rjes —92

chos 'khor rgyal du slebs/ gnyer pa dge 'dun chos grags —93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shogs che ba'i drag zhan tshang mar rgyun gyi rnyed bkur bzang bas dmangs ma rnams mgu'ang zhal ngo ma mnyes pa'i chung bcad mdzad par gnyer pas 'di 'dra'i zog rnying mi yong ston mgyogs po slebs yong zhes 'brog rtags kyi zhu ba phul/ dbyar chos dang thug pas bag dro zhing gra tshang khag dang phyug po rnams kyis sne len rgyas par byung / ri mthil gyi mgon khang rnams mjal zhing gtor gso byas/ gling smad zhabs drung ra ba stod pa'i rgyun gyis dus bzang chos spyod la mnyes pa'i stabs kyis chos 'khor gling pa'i chos thog skabs 'phral 'phral yong gin yod pa'i bag chags kyis byams khang du mnga' dgas gnyis kyi dus bzang chos spyod ci rigs par phyin/ lar mtshan nyid pa'i dus 'dir bla chen gyi bzang rdzu/ mi chen gyi sgrigs ma/ sgom chen gyi sbubs sdir/ sngags pa'i brtul zhugs/ bla chung gi mi chos sogs re dogs gang yang mi dgos/ dge 'dun spyi khrims dang ma 'gal zhing dpe cha rigs lung nus phyin rnam grangs mang po'i g.yeng ba'i rdo zhwa dang so phag gi khres po ni med/ snang ba gdong gtad kyi nyams 'char/ 'phral blo bde/ phugs zhe gtsang / chos spyod kyi gdangs dang thal skad kyi sgra thos tshe snying khong sde pa dpon g.yog bod chas 'chor la pho nyams kyang ma shor ba'i rang lugs ma —95

'bul mi nus zhal ngo la gra skor gyi skor bskyar nas zhus par gra skor ngam ring rang 'gab/ des na sde pa gtsang pa dang yang mjal 'dzom shar yong / gtsang pa'i gral 'phros pa smon 'gro nas sogs dang gsung 'phros mdzad dgos yong bas mtshan nyid gcig bus mi 'thus/ sngags/ rig gnas/ lo rgyus sogs tshang ma nas mkhyen dgos zhes mi 'dod gdam nga'i tshes grangs dus tshod byung bas gtam mgo mthong (69bsom gyis lus ngo shes pa'i dpe bzhin ha go snyam mdo phyogs kyi 'khri ba bod bcad/ de snga dge slong gi zla bor byang ngos chos mdzad —102

'gro gtsang pa la brtan nas 'bud dgos gnang ba zhal ngo'i thugs la babs na'ang gtsang sog gnyis ka la bltos mi dgos pa'i rang grol zhig e yong dgongs/ star sdong nas/ zhal dpon sbyin dpal/ sras po rab rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgu tshan gsum dang bcas chos dpal gyi thad 'di nad ma theg pas lcags po ri'i bka' khri'i don bzhin lha sa tshur gnang dgos/ dpon slob tsho'i zhabs tog dang phyag g.yog chos dpal las lhag pa zhu zhus par sku mdun sman thang nas dang rab 'byams pa tshogs gsog pas nang so a bar 'di skyag drags par gtsang pa dpon blon bkrol zin pa yin shas kha bas gtod pa rang jo bo dang chos gtam gnyis ka bzang tshul gyi snyan sgron phul ba dgongs par ma babs pa'i khar phyags phyi rnams kyi zhu dbang du song ba'i dge skyon zhib cha rab 'byams pa chos khog sogs nang mi 'gas star sdong nas can la bya btang ba ltar don ma mthong pa'i gzhis rtser gtugs pas sku mdun khang drag nas dkyel ches pa'i zla ba gnyis tsam gyi ring zhu khras gtsos tshig sna blangs shing sel 'jug gi ched du zhu khra bsnol nas gtad kyang (71ba)'di lo zhal ngo la dpon blon rnams dgyes pa zhig byung song bas don smin te rdo rje lags kyis mi sna byas pa'i lha sa'i rtsis sprod rnams lo gsar gdong la phal cher grub/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du gling smad zhabs drung phebs 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa yongs rdzogs la ljags bshad gnang zhing dka' gnad rnams la dogs gcod zhus/ de zhor bka' gdams glegs bam la spyi chos byed lugs kyi sgroms dang gnad 'gag tsho 'grol ba gnang /dgung lo bcu bdun par ra sgreng du phebs pa dang / lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho mjal gzigs shing phyag dpe pod lnga brgya tsam gyi dkar chag bsgrigs pa bcas kyi skor/ chu mo bya'i lo gsar grub nas smon lam dus thog tu 'dzugs rtsis la sa skya zhabs drung mthu stobs dbang phyug bstan pa gso chog sogs bod 'bangs bde thabs kyi sku rim tshugs pa ma zin pas 'gyangs/ lha sa rtsis blangs thog sa skya pas rab gnas mdzad pa 'di rten 'brel legs pa byung zhes —104

sogs chos bka' kha shas zhus/ thog mar zhal ngo'i bslab ston dang bstun pa las mos pa che ba med kyang nye bar brtags tshe bla ma de nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba'i mdzad pa dang gsung 'phros gang la bltas kyang dad pa mi 'gro ba'i rang dbang mi 'dug /bslab ston dang phebs sgo mtha' dag chos la bskul ba kho nar snang bas sngon chad thos bsam byas rgyu'i lugs rnams kyang snang shas kyi mkhas 'dod grags 'dod kho nar song ba'i rang rgyud tha rgod ltar rengs pa 'di nas bzung thar pa sgrub pa'i chos shig byed dgos rgyu yin 'dug snyam pa'i blo sna cung zad nang du khugs pa'ang rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin no/ /mtshan nyid pa byed skabs dus gtor gtor bsngo kha ton chag pa rnams kyang bslab ston bzhin gsos/hor zla gsum pa'i brgyad gtor sngar srol ltar byas/ rnam rgyal zhal snga nas rgya chen pa zhal ngo'i dgongs par ma babs pas bde yangs slob dpon la bskos/ rdo ljangs rtsis len la na kha can chos mdzad btang / gra tshang yang phyir 'byon bcug /gra tshang tshugs nas thor ma myong zhes pa'i kha pho la ma mnyes pa'am ci ltar yang 'di lo yong sgo bkar rgyar bcu phogs ja thug ye ma gnang yang gra pa rnams kyis lho rgyud lho byang gnyis gar spyi bsod brgyab pa'i sngar kyis byon/ bye ri stag rtse nas gtsang sde srid lcam gyis ja 'dren byung / de skabs rta 'tshub mdzes kha khyer can gyi ris la dga' bas zhal ngo'i chibs pa khu bya zer ba hor rta 'tshub po zhig 'dug pa der zhen pas la mo'i khrom gseb tu bskyur ba a bar mjug dkar —106—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)gyis 'dzin thub pa ma gtogs dgos med kyi brdab bcag yong grabs byung ba'ang sgro zhwa ba'i skyon kho nar snang ngo / /mal gro'i sde dgon rnams kyis sngar lugs bzhin bsnyen bkur/ mkhar skya ba skya ser tshor bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rin chen gling du bka' gdams glegs bam gyi chos thun gcig bshad/lo snga ma shangs khong nga bas hor smad ta'i dmag khrid pa dang khal kha drug cu skor zhig 'bri gung du jag la phyin pa phrad pa'i mtshan brdungs kyis bsad pas hor rnams sog dmag la 'jigs shing gtsang sde srid kyis kyang bslab ston byung bar brten hor gyis 'bod mi byung ba ltar 'od zer gyang nas phyir log klungs shod gyen brgyud lam du phag mo ba'i ja 'dren btang bka' gdams kyi chu 'go byang rwa sgreng du slebs/ dgon 'og tu gnas tshang byas/ sa ga zla ba'i rten dgram chen mo dang thug par rten 'brel 'grig /jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gdung rten dngul gdugs ma/ dbu yon ma che chung sogs rten rnams mjal zhing bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i smon lam rgya chen btab/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhugs khrir phyin te dkon mchog 'bangs kyi 'khrungs rabs nas chos mthun gsum bshad 'ja' sprin dang me tog gi char 'dug ces dge slong mang po nam mkha' la mdzub tshugs byed zhal ngo (72ba)sog khrod du mdun chings la byon/ sgam po sprul sku nor bu rgyan pa gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ nged kyis hung rgya bzo shes kyin med pas gdung brgyud rin chen gyi yig lan khri rin po che dang drung yig a khu bka' bgros nas bzos song ba gyong po zhig byung tshod nas yig 'grul bcad song /zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nas stag lung du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs byung yang rgyal du 'gro ba'i khyad kyis slebs mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan phul/ ja 'dren la nang so 'bras pa rdzong bda' gnang byung zhing phar 'bul 'bul byed par nub gling dbon po btang / hor gyis sog po la rta brgya/ gnag phyugs lnga brgya lug stong sprad pa'i mdun ma grub nas hor dpon blon gyis yong dgos tshul ltar 'bri gung brgyud nyang po'i phu smam du dpon tshang gi ru bar phyin 'bri gung —107

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 15)gyis 'dzin thub pa ma gtogs dgos med kyi brdab bcag yong grabs byung ba'ang sgro zhwa ba'i skyon kho nar snang ngo / /mal gro'i sde dgon rnams kyis sngar lugs bzhin bsnyen bkur/ mkhar skya ba skya ser tshor bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rin chen gling du bka' gdams glegs bam gyi chos thun gcig bshad/lo snga ma shangs khong nga bas hor smad ta'i dmag khrid pa dang khal kha drug cu skor zhig 'bri gung du jag la phyin pa phrad pa'i mtshan brdungs kyis bsad pas hor rnams sog dmag la 'jigs shing gtsang sde srid kyis kyang bslab ston byung bar brten hor gyis 'bod mi byung ba ltar 'od zer gyang nas phyir log klungs shod gyen brgyud lam du phag mo ba'i ja 'dren btang bka' gdams kyi chu 'go byang rwa sgreng du slebs/ dgon 'og tu gnas tshang byas/ sa ga zla ba'i rten dgram chen mo dang thug par rten 'brel 'grig /jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ gdung rten dngul gdugs ma/ dbu yon ma che chung sogs rten rnams mjal zhing bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i smon lam rgya chen btab/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhugs khrir phyin te dkon mchog 'bangs kyi 'khrungs rabs nas chos mthun gsum bshad 'ja' sprin dang me tog gi char 'dug ces dge slong mang po nam mkha' la mdzub tshugs byed zhal ngo (72ba)sog khrod du mdun chings la byon/ sgam po sprul sku nor bu rgyan pa gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ nged kyis hung rgya bzo shes kyin med pas gdung brgyud rin chen gyi yig lan khri rin po che dang drung yig a khu bka' bgros nas bzos song ba gyong po zhig byung tshod nas yig 'grul bcad song /zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nas stag lung du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs byung yang rgyal du 'gro ba'i khyad kyis slebs mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan phul/ ja 'dren la nang so 'bras pa rdzong bda' gnang byung zhing phar 'bul 'bul byed par nub gling dbon po btang / hor gyis sog po la rta brgya/ gnag phyugs lnga brgya lug stong sprad pa'i mdun ma grub nas hor dpon blon gyis yong dgos tshul ltar 'bri gung brgyud nyang po'i phu smam du dpon tshang gi ru bar phyin 'bri gung —107

gyi rjes gnang byed khar glo bur du 'tshub dang ser drag cig byung ba sngar nas rgyal dang 'khon 'gras ches pas chos skyong gi 'tshub yin zhes zhal ngo gsung / de skabs mtshan nyid pa'i mjug gi rdzing bu rnyog can la dam tshig gtsang ba'i dngos grub dang ma gtsang ba'i bar chad kyi gzugs brnyan gnyis ka yong don mi 'dug pas cham pa tsam yang ma byung / blon po thod dkar dang go (73na)na'i ban+de phul bas dwags po gra tshang gi slob dpon chos rgyal bkra shis kyis thog drangs mkhas rlom rnams kyang mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur mdzad gra tshang khag dang phyug po mang pos mgron la bos/ ri khrod chen mor pa'i mdor rta bskol ba'i ja bzhes sar thal mo sbyar te dus kyi 'khor lo'i dka' gnas la dri ba zhus song bar la babs mar gtam ma 'dri zer ba yin pas mkhas pa chen po nyid kyis gsungs shig pa'i lan rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgung lo bco brgyad par khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel dang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi drung nas zab chos gsan cing /rgyud sde la thugs gnyer gnang ba bcas kyi skor/shing khyi'i lo gsar grub nas smon lam che chung gnyis ga'i gral dbur phyin smon lam chung bar zhabs tog deb bshar mar song bas bla ma gzhan chud kyin med/ smon lam chen mor 'di nas bzung lcags sprul gyi bar nged rang 'gro res kyi gzims khang gong sprul sku'ang chag med du byon/ ra mo che'i gos sku'i nyin gung tshigs grol bstun rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa phebs pa dang gsung gleng zhib par byung / gang la dri ba zhus kyang gsung rgyu med pa mi 'dug smon lam grol nas 'bras spungs su slebs/gling smad zhabs drung dkon mchog chos 'phel phebs/ zla gcig tsam dpon slob thams cad sos dal du bzhugs (75ba)zhal ngos chos 'khor gling par 'jigs byed dang bskang gso skor 'dzugs rtsis mdzad song ba gling smad zhabs drung gis mi 'gab tshul dang rgyud pa zhal snga nas bzang grong par kyang de mtshungs kyi zhu yig phul/ zhal snga nas dkar po bas gtsos ba'i gra pa slob gnyer sha stag byed mi rnams kyang ma 'dod 'dug rung / bkras rgyam pas mtshon pa'i pher rgya can mang pos zhal ngo'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun te ram bteg go gsar ma'i a krad kyi dpe bzhin bskang gso rnams btsugs pa'i chos ra'i gong 'og mtha' dag spyan gsum dang mche ba gtsigs pa sogs kyi bshar sbyang gis khengs song /gling smad zhabs drung gsang phu dbyar chos la phebs/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhabs pad bsnyen nas yi dam chos skyong zung 'brel gang yang rung ba'i nyams len bstar lugs kyi phyogs 'go tsam yang med par lo gzhon skyon gyis mun nag 'dom par gzhal ba'i mgon khang lcang lo can du mtshams dam po zhig byed rtsis byas pa rten 'dogs kyi g.yag cig dgos 'dra zhes zla bo —112

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)rnams zer yang mtha' 'dre'i kha rlang gis stod smad kun tu phyugs nad sngar ma grags byung ba dang bcas ma rnyed/ zhal ngos ser rtsi sbug tu thab chung bsgrigs pa'i rang dbang 'du po zhig gi zhal bkod mdzad rung nyams len 'di byed med par mtshams la gnas kyang tshugs/ lhag tu sos bya gdong gi tshad pa dang mdo'i thab me 'dom pas rig pa nyog cing dge bshes dge dar ba dang gsol dpon nor rgyan pa can zla bo las su ma rungs shing khyad par spyan 'dren gyi bdug spos la bsnyad pa'i mtshams nang du bsangs btang ba lta bu'i sdod mi tshugs par bde ba can du gsang dgos (76na)pa sogs rkyen du mas zhe gsog dang bcas mkhas pa gtsang nag pa'i dam bcar song / 'di tsam du ma zad dge dar ba phyi nang mi mtshungs pa'i kha phyi lta dang grod pa nang lta'i byed sgos sems rgyud mang du bsreg cing rje chos dbyings rang grol la'ang nyer mkho'i lag 'thogs kyi chos 'dra zhu bzhin du dam tshig gi srung sdom gang yang mi byed/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse'i chos sde 'jig par nye ba'i rtsa ba lta bu yin yang mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang dang lung kha shas nan gyis zhus pa'i dam sel gyis sku tshe'i gegs su song bar mngon zhing mi tsho'i sar nga de 'dra zhu 'dod med kyang dpon slob rang gis gnang byung sogs 'dra min kun 'dus labs skad/zhag lnga drug nas dge slong dang lhan du rab gsal du don nas bsdad pad+ma bka' thang mi la'i rnam mgur sogs rnam thar mang po klog /bde yangs su zhal ba byed mi'i 'u lag gis gzhas 'then pa nyan zhing kha yengs mig yengs kyi ngang la zla gcig tsam song / zla ba lnga pa nyis brtsegs kyi snga ma'i nang du gsang phu nas khri rin po che phebs/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam gyi rtsi bzhag gnang ba tshang bar bzung / sgo mang slob dpon rgya yags pas rigs gra'i tshogs dbur bos pa ltar phyin/zla ba bdun pa'i nang du dga' ldan khang gsar gyi zhig gsos grub pa'i gzhis skar shog gsung ba nas dpon slob lhan rgyas su 'byor/ gzhis ka spro zhing mdun du lha sa dang g.yas g.yon rgyab —113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byung bar drung 'tsho sgar pa grong pa lha rje mkhas shing dpyad lag tu 'gel ba'i nyams myong che la tshod things pas gtar kha brgyab pa shin tu 'phrod pa'i gdong bzlog tu gyur/hor zla gsum pa'i nang du pha bong khar phyin zab chos mang du zhus/ gnas skabs kyi las tshogs 'dra la dga' tshor che ba byas pas phebs sgor sngags rnying ma'i chos mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig nyams su bzhes na rdzogs chen gyi khog phug dgos/ kho bo'i bla ma nyi zla sangs rgyas de 'phrin las bzhi la gtso bor mi mdzad/ ka dag lhun grub kyi sgo nas grol lam brnyes pa yin zhes lo rgyus mang po dang bcas rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i klong gsal gyi dbang lung rags rim ngo sprod mdor bsdus dang bcas pa bstsal/ dbang rjes gnang gi phyag len khrid kyi rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)yod/ gtsang stod rgyal po'i mnga' thang gung la reg pa 'di 'drar zhal ngo la dpon po ci la yong chos rje pha bong kha ba mi'i ngo 'dzin mkhas tshul gyi zur za gnang phyis su bsams na mngon mkhyen kho nar gda'/ gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la dbang gi las tshogs la bsngags brjod gsung ba lo mjug la ar sa lang sogs ma rung pa 'ong ba dbang du sdus shig gyi bsnyen bkur bzabs (78ba)'bras spungs su 'byor nas zhal ngo dpon g.yog chab tshan dang sbrags rgyal la phebs/ tshogs chen la zhag bco lnga skor gyi bar rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs ma bu bsdebs tshig bcad lhug mtha' dag la bshad pa zhib par phul/ thugs rjes g.yin grol ba'i yon tan rang nyid la med pa'i steng gsan pa po rnams kyang rtog shes nga rgyal ba'i skyon gyis 'ja' sprin dang me tog gi char ni rmi lam du'ang ma byung / sa skya bdag chen mthu stobs pa lha sar sog bzlog la phebs/ gtor rgyag sbyin sreg 'cham dbyangs sogs rnam dpyod dod pa'i sgra skad bzhag /gtor bzlog zin 'phral rlung 'tshub lha sa nas langs sgo la phyogs su song bar sor zhen skyid zhen byed mkhan mang pos sdug bsngal chen po byas zer/sog po ni zla ba bzhi'i thog gtos che ba byung bas sog 'gugs mdzad pa 'dra mor song / byang ngos nas bdag chen rin po che'i sku zhabs su ja zhus la btang tshur yang mgron gnyer de gnang byung /dbyar gyi ring zur chen chos dbyings rang grol phebs/ bdag gis zla ba lnga pa dang drug pa gnyis kyi ring 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi shrī ring 'bum phrag gcig gi bsnyen mtshams shig byas/ dpon slob kyis dus dgra'i dbang po'i sku brnyan phyag bris su bstar zhing mtshams 'og tu gegs sel bogs 'don gyi bslab ston dang dmigs skor sogs chos 'brel phran bu zhus/ mtshams grol bstun nyer mkho'i phyag bzhes mang po dmard du gnang / zho ston gdong la bsnyen mtshams zin pas yang dgon shag skor ba rnams kyi 'cham sna mang po'i ltad mo byung / ta zhing chos rjes 'dul ba gra tshang gi rigs —117—

gyis zhal ngor skyel bar btang ba ltar sdong mgron gnyer la ngag ma bskur nas dge 'phel du byung / sog po 'phral du lha sar yongs na thugs dbang ma 'dus dogs pas thang ma phyed bar sku mtshams dngos zhugs/ zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar du 'phen pa btang bas sngags ring 'bum phrag gcig song / sngar bod du sog po byung ba la gtos che/ zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa dang khong rang pha bu rnams kyi gros la dang mi sna gtong res kyis 'brel —118—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)brang gi chab srid gong 'phel gyi rten 'brel yin zer/ sngar jung gir rgyal mos rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dngul sku bzhengs pa'i kha lud la nor bu dga' 'khyil byung ba'ang sog yul du bstan pa rgyas pa'i dpe dang bcas zhal ngor zhus/ cha khar rgyal po'i dmag la rgya nang du 'gos pa'i 'grum nag mtsho khar byung ba sog po g.yon ru'i phyogs nas gtsang phyogs su mched rung dbus su sa gtsang skabs yin pas smon lam che chung la phyin pa'i slar 'bras spungs su slebs/gtsang gi dpung chen (81na)yang gnam mtsho le gung dang khad nyer 'byor/ sde srid dpon blon nas spe ser ba rdzong bda' mdzad pa'i sgar pa yab sras/ stag lung zhabs drung / 'brug pa sprul sku/ nged rnams mdun chings lab par sog khrod du 'byon dgos pa'i bka' shog ngag ma nan cher 'dug kyang sgar stag rnams sku dbang btsan pas 'brum pa'i stabs kyis sog khrod du shar mar phebs ma song de mthun 'di ga nas kyang 'phan yul tsam du 'gro bar thag bcad de nyang bran lab la brgyud rtsis kyis sbyar rar zhag gcig bsdad pas pha bong kha nas rje de nyid kyis gnas tshang gi ming sgra dang bcas sog bod gnyis mar la mar sbyar ba ltar gzhung 'grig yong sogs bslab ston bsgyur bar dka' bcu ba gnang byung ba lung bstan du 'dug cing lha khang bar phyin lam du za dam gnyer pas thab bsu bteg pa'i mi chos kyi sne len dang phar yang mang 'gyed gya nom pa btang / phyag mdzod khag rnams gtsang sog gi dmag sar thengs gnyis tsam byon pa'i snga ma ni sog pos don char sne len tsam yang ma byas 'dug /de ga mu mthud na bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal srid la chags 'jig las 'os mi snang bas sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi brtul zhugs dang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gar 'chams kyis shogs ma thon rung rnying ma ba'i sngags rgan rnams kyis sde brgyad bran du bkol ba'i mthus tha'i ji glo bur du smyo 'bog gi snyun gyis btab/ sde khrod tshor thog 'byug gi 'jigs pa'ang kha shas byung 'dug pas skor res bar ma'i dus lab sne blangs pa'i bar chings byung bar brten bod dmag rnams bkyigs thag bkrol ba bzhin gyes/ 'phan (81ba〉rtsal lha khang du sdod ring deb ther sngon po la zhib tu bltas/ rnam nges rin chen sgron —121—

gnyer pa don grub tshe ring byung / thon gdong khrom la lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs nas chos thun zhig bshad/ sang nyin rag mar slebs mdung na khar khrom la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang byas/ tshur skor du 'brum pa mched drag pas zhal ngo'i bslab ston dang bstun zhag bcu skor las sdod pa ma shar de bar bka' chos kha shas nos/ 'das ma 'ong gi gsung gleng bslab ston kyang 'phel bar byung / khyad mtsho sngon chad ming mi gsal ba zhig 'dug pa ji bzhin rtogs par dka' yang 'gom gshin rje me'i spu grir dogs kyang nye bar dpyad tshe dpal mgon ma ning gi mtsho yin 'dra bsam pa shar/ slar lha thog steng gi mtsho rnams mjal bas phyag drug pa'i bla mtsho'i rgyab nas gangs chen po nyil/ gur gyi mtsho'i 'gram gangs dang g.ya' 'dres pa zhig nas chu rka'i tshod tsam pa ja sbyor gcig gi bar rdol ba sogs ring por mi thogs par rgya dbus kyi gser zam tshugs pa'i rtags su mngon/ de las spros pa'i mtsho mjal ni rab 'byams pa bkras rgyam pa dang dbon po mtsho smad pa sogs mtsho dang gnas la skur zhus byed kyin 'dug pa dang nam zhod 'dom pa gnyis gas lan 'dra bas gsal ba ma byung / gnas mjal ba yang dam tshig gtsang ba gal che bar mchis/ o rod nas gu shri dpon pos rang 'dod ma 'khris pa'i bstan pa kho na'i don du g.yul bshams pa'i dmag rogs pā thur khung tha'i jis mdzad pa'i (84ba)o rod kyi dmag khri lhag tsam glang lo zla ba dang po'i nang du 'byor nas chog thu dpon po khri dmag gsum du nye ba zhabs drung la spyan 'bebs zhus 'dug par rdzong btsan gnam gyi ka ba dgra lag tu shor tshul yod snang bar phebs sgor bsngo zhus la mtshon cha byung ba gcog pa dang nang phyogs nas 'bru drangs te srog gcod mi mdzad pa legs por mngon rung mang po gsod pa'i don du sbyin pa gtong ba'i dpe bzhin rdzong btsan po thugs la mkhar bas (86na)sog po kha drang ba'i ched du las dkar rnam smin gnag pas rjes su yi rang dka'/ deng sang rang phyogs rnams sog dmag gis bde gzar che ba zhig yong snyer re mdzad kyang rgyal ba tsong kha ba'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la mi phan dga' ldan pho brang pa lha sa sa gtsos sde bdag chen po gzhan smon pa'i yul yin pas nya ra mdzad —128—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 15)mkhyen pa dga' phebs pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung lta bu bsams kyin dad pa'i sos su gda'/dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dga' ldan khang gsar du bzhugs gdan 'jags/ zla ba bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa'i ring tsha rting kha nas dgongs ja'i bar rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum po ti bdun tsam/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum/ mar mi'i rnam mgur/ bu ston rin po che'i bde mchog gi chos 'byung sogs lung mang po dang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bco lnga tsam/ gzhan yang rjes gnang kha shas stsal/ nyi ma thung zhing ljags lung dang bcas dbang sgrub so sor skye bo tsho'i blo dang 'tsham pa gnang rgyu byung ma song rung skyes bu dam pa bskal pa'ang skad cig mar bsgyur thub pas cung zad tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad dam snyam ljags lung gi skabs shig spyan cung zhig mnyel bar sku 'khrugs dogs 'dug pas nyin gcig gnyis shig 'phrod bsten gnang pa legs pa 'dra zhus par dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa byas na dga' mo yong 'gro zhes chos mtshams 'jog pa ma gnang yang myur du gdangs song zhing de bzhin du lha 'dre mo rtsis pa gang la'ang thugs snang ye mi gnang bas mtshon pa'i tshe ring na dga'o rnam dkar gyis sogs gsung mgur (86ba)gyi don phyag thog tu khel ba tshur mthong gi 'gro ba rnams kyi blo'i yul du mi chud par gda'/zla ba bcu gnyis pa tshes nas lha sa skor la 'brum pa phran bu mched pas bdag gis chos lung bkra shis snang du phyin/ zla los dang dang po'i ring grong smad nas kyis zla bo byas te le'u tho bcas/ dbu mdzad don grub bkra shis pa can bskang gso ba bzhi dang bcas pas stag lo lo gsar gyi srid gsum bdag mo'i mchod pa ma chag par btang / hor zla gnyis par dga' ldan khang gsar du 'byor/—129—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgung lo nyer gnyis par bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes pa sogs skor/zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar gyi 'phrod bzang bar jo bo rin po che spang gcal steng du yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgya mtshan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ gling smad zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa zhal snga nas rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa/ 'bras spungs 'dul ba slob dpon ta zhing pa thub bstan rnam rgyal/ blo gsal gling slob dpon pho khang pa 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ rgyal pa slob dpon sgying thang ba chos phun tshogs/ sngags pa slob dpon se chen pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ sgo mang slob dpon bsam sgang pa blo bzang ngag dbang / shag skor slob dpon snang rtse ba pad+ma chos 'phel/bde yangs slob dpon ge ra/ se ra stod pa slob dpon kun bu ba/ smad pa slob dpon gung ru ba dgus kha skong ba mdzad de yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs/ gling smad zhabs drung gis lhung mthun byin brlabs nas bzung ming rnying pa'i steng du ngag gi dbang phyug ces gsar du sbyor ba gnang / paṇa chen rin po che lho kha brgyud gtsang (87na)du chibs kha bsgyur snye thang nor bu sgang tshun zhal ngos chibs skyel la phebs/ rgyal po'i 'bul ba dngul tshan ches pa'i phud la rten bzheng zhig byed rtsis yin pa'i bslab ston zhu ba mdzad par rgyal me tog thang gnas bzang yang ha cang lung gyog tu song ba'i ngom che ba mi yong 'dug pas ser 'bras lha sa gang 'os su 'gab tshul thugs nang dag pa'i phebs sgo lhug stsol du gnang / des thugs dogs 'phros pa'i rgyal byams pa'i rgyab yol kyang rim 'gyangs su lus/ dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs kyis pha bong khar rje de nyid kyi dngul gdung bzhengs pa'i shis brjod la phyin/ de nub dngul gdung rin po che'i sku mdun du bsdad de bum nang du dbu thod hril po bzhugs 'dug par smon lam nan tan du btab/ nang par dge slong rnams la tshe —130

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)tshegs che ba ma byung / deng sang ni ma bslabs na mkhyen zhid bslabs na thugs su mi chud pa mang bar gda'/ kho bo'i yon tan phran tshegs rnams bslabs nas shes pa sha stag yin no/ /ston gling smad zhabs drung rin po che phebs 'grel pa bzhi sbrags yongs su rdzogs pa dka' gnad kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa zhus/ dpon slob rin po ches dbu gnas co ne chos rje/ ta zhing chos rje/gnyal ba chos rje sogs kha shas la gung tshigs grol nas zhag nyi shu'i bar la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti lnga'i lung rdzogs par phul/ co ba chos rjes sa paṇa gyi zhun thigs 'jam dbyangs seng bzhen ma khyad mtshar de byin/ bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa byang khyad kyi ta zhing chos rje bsnyen rdzogs bskyar sgrub kyi mkhan po byas/ de nas kong po rab 'byams pas gtsos sgrub mi kha yar byung / ri bo dga' ldan gyi phyag len de'ang shes na 'gab 'dra snyam gling smad zhabs drung gis mkhan slob sbrags pa gnang / bdag gis gsang ston byas te dka' bcu dga' gdong pa sogs kha yar gyis bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa phyag len zhib drags pas sgrub gra bzhi lnga tsam la gung tshigs grol nas skar ma khra chem chem gyi bar 'gor gyin 'dug /sngar khas len tsam byas par 'khris te bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos nged 'bod par me rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho/ ja'i sang me (89na)de'i chi/ ja'i sang gu shri/ ā chin che chen/ bo dong gu yeng / sder gel che chen rnams kyis gtsos mi sum brgya skor rdzong bda' mdzad pa 'byor/ston mjug 'bras spungs su phyin 'dzin she bzang ba la shes 'dod yod pas rje zur chen la dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang dang bsnyen sgrub kyi phyag khrid zhus pa'i stabs 'di skabs zhag bdun gyi bar bsnyen mtshams byas par thun thams cad la rtog pa gzhan du 'phros pa'i dmigs pa tshad ldan ye ma byung zhing de dang mtshungs par dngos nyams lta zhog rmi lam bzang ba zhig kyang bshad rgyu med/ phyis su rin spungs zhabs drung lugs kyi tshigs bcad byed na nyin rer glo ka bco lnga tsam dang snar thang pa dang dpal khang pa ltar byed na glo ka nyi shu skor re rtsom thub/ 'char sgo yangs pa'i skabs —133—

bslabs nas shes pa sha stag yin no/ /ston gling smad zhabs drung rin po che phebs 'grel pa bzhi sbrags yongs su rdzogs pa dka' gnad kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa zhus/ dpon slob rin po ches dbu gnas co ne chos rjes sa paṇa gyi zhun thigs 'jam dbyangs seng bzhon ma khyad mtshar de byin/ bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa byang khyad kyi ta zhing chos rje bsnyen rdzogs bskyar sgrub kyi mkhan po byas/ de nas kong po rab 'byams pas gtsos sgrub mi kha yar byung / ri bo dga' ldan gyi phyag len de'ang shes na 'gab 'dra snyam gling smad zhabs drung gis mkhan slob sbrags pa gnang / bdag gis gsang ston byas te dka' bcu dga' gdong pa sogs kha yar gyis bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa phyag len zhi kha drags pas sgrub gra bzhi lnga tsam la gung tshigs grol nas skar ma khra chem chem gyi bar 'gor gyin 'dug /sngar khas len tsam byas par 'khris te bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos nged 'bod par me rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho/ ja'i sang me (89na)de'i chi/ ja'i sang gu shri/ ā chin che chen/ bo dong gu yeng / sder gel che chen rnams kyis gtsos mi sum brgya skor rdzong bda' mdzad pa 'byor/ston mjug 'bras spungs su phyin 'dzin she bzang ba la shes 'dod yod pas rje zur chen la dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang dang bsnyen sgrub kyi phyag khrid zhus pa'i stabs 'di skabs zhag bdun gyi bar bsnyen mtshams byas par thun thams cad la rtog pa gzhan du 'phros pa'i dmigs pa tshad ldan ye ma byung zhing de dang mtshungs par dngos nyams lta zhog rmi lam bzang ba zhig kyang bshad rgyu med/ phyis su rin spungs zhabs drung lugs kyi tshigs bcad byed na nyin rer glo ka bco lnga tsam dang snar thang pa dang dpal khang pa ltar byed na glo ka nyi shu skor re rtsom thub/ 'char sgo yangs pa'i skabs —133—

na ni gzung chog par snang /dbyangs can ma dang sgrol dkar gyi bstod pa zhig brtsams kyang phyis kyi tsho dang bsdur na rtsom pa po mi gcig pa 'dra ba yod/ gling smad zhabs drung sku zhabs su rim lnga gsal sgron gyi ljags lung dang (89ba)gsung bshad mdor bsdus shig zhus/ rab 'byams pa don yod rgyal mtshan sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs rgya lhag tsam bsgrubs/ rgyal po'i 'bod mi byung tshul gyi bslab ston zhu bar zhal ngos gzhis ka rtser byon/ khang drag pa ma chen yod pa phan dang mi 'dra ba'i dpon blon rnams la btsa' brgyab nas khyed rang dge lugs pa tshor khebs gang che gyis gsung ba las dgra gnyen gang gi'ang tha snyad med pa'i zom thom zhig gsungs 'dug par zhal ngo thugs 'khang che ba zhugs par gda'/ me rgan dka' bcu can la bdag rkyen dang 'dod chos gang legs ngos bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por skor zhig yong mi thub tshul gyi rgyu mtshan dang bcas brdzangs/ 'grul sdebs 'dir co ne chos rje dang sngags pa slob dpon se chen pa sogs log mi mang bar byung / sde pa skyid shod pa'i don skor la zhal ngo yongs rdzogs bod du bsgril/ re res gtsang du drung 'khor mdzad pa'i blo 'bebs na 'phan yul mkhar rtse yong zer pa'i rdo sbrags byung ba gram bu rab 'byams pa'i bsam par zhal ngos mda' tshod rgyud 'dzin du go nas skyid shod par don ga la yong sde pa gtsang pa dga' ldan phro brang du bzhugs 'dug ces gleng skad/ khri rin po ches dgung skag cig skor gnang ba ltar brtsis ba'i 'go brjod dang bcas phul 31 smad du dga' ldan la phebs/—134

grags pa'i bstan bcos zhig gi mdzad byang gi tshig la 'khrul ba yin zhes paṇa chen rin po che dang gling smad zhabs drung phebs sgo gnang 'dug pas mi 'gab gsung bar brten yongs grags shig bsgrigs par kho pa ma 'dod pa'i shog ril la dbyugs skor byed 'dug /gong dkar chos sde'i par ma'i steng nas ka lā pa'i rtsa ba 'phreng gsum re snga dro'i ring bzung / de las mang ba bzung yang (92na)mi zin cing zin kyang mi byang la/ gso rig cig kyang slob 'dod yod pas bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud kyi rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud gnyis bzung / byang ngos nas g.yin phan chi dang se chen chos rjes gtsos 'grul pa gtos che ba 'byor/ zhal bcu skor gyi bar tshogs chen du mang 'gyed kyi rnyed bkur che zhing bsngo ba la phyin par dngul srang stong phrag lnga drug dang gos dar stong phrag gnyis gsum sogs bdog pa gya nom pa'i rnyed pa blangs/ nyer gsum la gsar 'grul rnams kyis bos pa'i se ra theg chen gling du phyin/ tshogs su zang zing gi bdog pa rgya cher bstab cing yar 'brog tu byon/ ngan bslabs 'dra byung tshod nas du ri yal gtsang du dmag la 'gro/ chos sde gsar par 'chi sa byed zer ba sogs dge bstan chu la bskur ba'i grabs byed par se chen chos rjer zhi drag gnyis ga'i sgo nas labs pas bzhol thub rung dmag gi kha lud lta bu rgya mar brgyab pa'i rdab gsig che rab byung song / khri lcam de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs su mang 'gyed gdung chog /gdan sa gong 'og 'bri stag /sgar pa/ bkra shis lhun po sogs su bsngo rten —139

thob kyang bsnyen sgrub ci'ang byed ma myong da lta rig gnas kyi slob gnyer 'dra dang 'dom pas mi thub zhus par/ 'jigs byed kyi skor de legs po yin 'dug rung rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i dus gnang bar phar yang nus pa che mdog kha mo byung rung tshur bla ma rnams spyan bye ma thag lta bur me tog 'thor/ grwa sa gnyis yul don/ bsod nams grags par khrims lugs phog pa'i 'phrod nyams shig ma byung bas dpal ldan dmag zor ma dang zhal gang rigs nas e yong gsung bar de gnyis kyi gdams pa lta zhog rjes gnang blo kha rdzogs pa tsam yang zhu ma myong tshul glengs pas/ des na rma khar phan na khyi tshil gyi dpe bzhin rnying ma rang nas mdzod gsung /sngar drag las shes 'dod yod skabs ni byed ma bcug 'di skabs dgos dus rdo rje dang mi dgos rdo 'jong gi dpe'i mi byed dbang med cig byung dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di thob thob 'dra ba la zhib tu dpyad na bshes gnyen bsten pa thos bsam sgom sogs gang la'ang 'gal rkyen mang zhing mthun rkyen nyung bas mi khom pa'i rten gyi bzhugs gral du chud par snang ngo / /de nas dpe cha bslab sbyangs byed 'phro rnams lings kyis bskyur/ gshin rje me'i spu gri'i las byang bsdus pa zhig brtsams/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa la brjed gsos kyi dogs gcod zhus nas 'bras spungs su dga' stag rtse rtsis sprod zer ba ltar chu mig kha ba dar rgyas btang zhing bang rim a bo mthong dgas kyang rogs byas pa'i 'bab kha btsan pa byung 'dug /gzhis ka gong dkar mtshur phu drug pas gzu gnang ba'i babs shing lha bya'i dmag rnams kyang gtsang du bteg sgar pas kur lugs rang 'jags kyi tham ka dgos gsung ba dge lugs nas phar lha(ra ba rnams len rtsis 'dug pas mi 'gab 'dra snyam ma brgyab par mchod yon la zhus pa'i sras po rab brtan btang ste bsgyur sbyangs dang sbrags te rgyob gsung ba bzhin smin 'grub byas kyang de rjes zho kha bas rgyal la lag brgyag byas song gshis tham khar cha bzhag yong mi yong rgyal ba'i dbang po mi dgos sems can gyi dbang po zhig gis kyang dgongs pas chod dgos pa 'dug rung thel tsher brtsi 'jog ma byung zhes ma ṇi 'dren 'dren mdzad par gda'/kong po gar srid kyis dmag lho byang gnyis ka nas bteg zho kha bas rgyal me tog thang la lag brgyag byas/ gtsug lag khang 'tshor bar nye ba na dpon po dam chos kyis mgon po ko gtums ma brdabs pas phyugs ma rta tsham ngams can de tshos bzung nas bsdad na du ru gis bgrod mi thub 'dug kyang lo rting ma sog po'i gdong du e dang 'ol dgar yongs nas thal ba rlung khyer du song bar chosasrung sde brgyad rnams chad btsan par go /hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la sgor 'tshangs mdzad 'dug kyang rgyag cha gzan drags pa'i 'gro khyab che ba rang ma byung zer/ bkra shis chos sde ba tshos mthu byas zhes dge bshes dge srid kyis dmag lho byang gnyis ka nas bteg zho kha bas rgyal me tog thang la lag brgyag byas/ gtsug lag khang 'tshor bar nye ba na dpon po dam chos kyis mgon po ko gtums ma brdabs pas phyugs ma rta dmag tu 'khrul nas stong 'ur byas 'dug pa ni chos skyong gi nus mthur mngon/ so so'i kha gnon du o rod g.yon ru'i dmag brgya skor gnyer ba don grub tshe ring dang chos rdze rtse mo bas khrid nas e ri sgo dang bar bzung gi dmag nang so dngos grub kyis sna drangs nas phyin pas (104ba)re zhig yul du log snang / kur srid kyi dmag rnams la las sbyor kha yar byas/ kong po tsho rang yul btsan po dpung tsham ngams can de tshos bzung nas bsdad na du ru gis bgrod mi thub 'dug kyang lo rting ma sog po'i gdong du e dang 'ol dgar yongs nas thal ba rlung khyer du song bar chosasrung sde brgyad rnams chad btsan par go /hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga la sgor 'tshangs mdzad 'dug kyang rgyag cha gzan drags pa'i 'gro khyab che ba rang ma byung zer/ bkra shis chos sde ba tshos mthu byas zhes dge bshes dge dar bas dpon slob zhabs drung gi snyan la phul ba sogs ri bsgul mtsho skyoms —156

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)kyi 'phyong rgyas nas mchod gzhis la bsdam ra'i bkod pa byed dgos pa'i rang dbang 'du po zhig ma byung bas dpal ri bas mnan pa brgyab pa thon pa'i gnyer pa sbrel bos tshur bskur ba mched na byed gtad kyi rgyur song dogs gzhan gyis ma mthong ba'i ngos rdzong sdod la de ga'i bslab ston byas/ sa skya zhabs drung mthu stobs pas sngar so go bzlog mdzad par bsnyad sger don snying nad kyis byams pa gling lnga mchod pa tshos thugs sun phyung bar zhabs drung dang bsam yas chos skyong gnyis ga'i bka' shog byung ba ltar bzhugs mi bde ba'i nyes dmigs las 1snal ba'i 'khas 'degs zhus/dbyar mtshams khang du gnas rnying rgyal pos cho 'phrul 'dra brtsams byung ba ar gtad byas pas gdug rtsub rnams rang zhir song / gtsang dpon blon nas stag lung zhabs drung / paṇa chen rin po che/rgyal tshab drung pa gsum la bar par phebs dgos pa'i phyag tham yang yang gnang zhing nged 'phyong rgyas phyogs kyi mi gnod 'drer 'dzin pa'i gtel (105na)por bzung phyir 'bud mdzad par mngon shes med pa ni nyams dga' bsam pa shar/ se chen o pa shi phyir 'gro skabs khal kha o rod kyi gzhung bde thabs dgos pa'i lha sde mi sde tshor yi ge sgroms che ba zhig bskur/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang nged kyis slob dpon byas te sems dpa' chen po dang pad+ma sku skyes gtsos pa'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nyis brgya lhag tsam gung tshigs grol nas nyin mtshams kyi gong la grub pa gnang /a bo mthong dga' sgrogs khang du me mdas gron pa'i bsngo rten 'byor zhing bsngo smon byas/ gtsang pa dpon blon babs gtod pa 'dra e yong gi nyer len dang bcas rgyal po mchod yon gnyis kyi zhu 'bul ltar dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dgun smad 'u yug gling dkar du chibs kha bsgyur/ gung snang chos rje mdzes pa dpal dang gra tshang slob dpon pa gnyis kyis bskul ba'i 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi dbang chog cig bris/ jus ring gyi sgrub pa yang yang btsugs pa'i 'phro ma chad pa'i ngos zur rdo rje 'chang la zab chos kyang mang tsam zhus/ dus rim zor las gtsang gi bde gzar la dmigs phug pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du phyin/—157—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gnam gang gi srod yol tsam gyi tshe brag sna chos rje dang dge bshes dge dar ba sogs 'ga' zhig gis thos par dgon gsham nas bud med kyi skad 'dra ba'i nga ro drag po lhang lhang sgrog pa lan gnyis gsum byung 'dug pa cho 'phrul zhig yin pa 'dra zhing / lo sngon ma'i dpyid ka gtsang gi span du skya btsun gnyis kyi rjes la rde'u khyer nus pa'i rlung nag gi gseb nas bud med nag mo ral pa rting par slebs pa'i mi ro mang po khur te dre'u la bzhen pa zhig yul mi 'gas mthong bas a ba las la dris pa na sde srid gtsang pa'i bla khyer zhes labs kyang gleng ma nus rjes su rim gyis mched pa'i gtam dang yul mi rdor bsam la'ang rgyus snang bar dpags na don gcig par mngon/dgung lo nyer drug par gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bod yongs kyi srid dbang phyag tu phul pa sogs skor/chu rta'i lo gsar gyi dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bskang ba dang bzhugs gral dkyus bzhin btang / bar skabs su smon lam chung ba'i gral dbur gzims khang gong sprul pa'i sku 'byon gyin (105ba)yod kyang dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches zhal ngor smon lam la bla ma mang por bzhugs khri rgyag pa 'di skabs su babs po mi 'dug /khong dpon slob kyi bka' shog dmar po de ta zhing chos rje lta bus mtsho kha bar du phyin pa yar slebs nas thel dmar brgyab pa dang khyad ci yod sogs phebs sgo byung 'dug pa'i rkyen gyis gtsang nas star sdong pa ched gnyer gyis btang ba'i khyed rang dpon slob bzhugs gdan kha gang ma tsam mdzad na ma gtogs bzhugs khri mi yong tshul gsungs par brten smon lam la phebs mi dgos pa'i khrol cha dgos tshul mdzad byung ba thugs mtsher ba bden par 'dugade'i stabs kyis smon lam che chung gnyis ka'i gral dbur 'gro dgos pa shar/ 'grul pa mang bas 'dod yon longs spyod nan tan che ba'i bag dro ba byung / khyad par khal kha rdo rje rgyal po'i mi snas gos chen khyad —158—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)'phags kyi gur tsan dan dkar pos shing cha byas pa zhig kha byang du bstan te phub/ der bos nas gzhis len dang ster sbyin bcas sog yul du yong dgos pa'i snyan gsan phab/ stong 'khor ba la sprul sku gsum 'dug pa'i 'or dus stong 'khor bas thog drangs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nyis brgya skor bsgrubs/sprul pa'i sku'i mtshan ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs lhun grub tu btags/ smon lam grol nas 'bras spungs su slebs/ o rod g.yon ru me rgan da'i chin gyi dge rtsar dpon mos de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngul sku bskrun par gzungs bzhugs phul zhing rab gnas dang no mon khan gyis zhabs drung byams pa'i dgongs rdzogs su dngul gdung gi rgyu cha sprad byung bar bzheng rogs kyi do dam gang legs byas/hor zla gnyis (106na)pa'i nyer lnga la chos sde gsar par 'tshang kha gtong rgyu yin pas dmigs phug gi sku rim gyis gsung bar chos sde chen po phan tshun du ja tshul thog mdo sgrub/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyis gshin rje'i sgrub pa dang 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor zor 'phangs pa'i nub btso lan gnyis tsam rgyugs/ bdag gis gshin rje bshor sang nyi ma khros pa'i sgrub pa byas/se chen no mon khan dang g.yon ru'i dpon mos gtsos pa'i gsar 'grul log mi rnams la 'dod chos dang rdzong ba sogs blo'i re ba yongs su bkang /zla ba gsum pa'i nang du bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu bod shing sgo can rnams chud pa'i gnas tshul 'byor ba bzhin yi dam chos srung rnams la legs so'i tshigs bcad kyi snyan dar dang bcas gtang rag rgyas pa phul zhing ser 'bras lha sa sogs nas dar 'phyar yang gzab rgyas bstar/ dbyar thog gi ring mtshams shig byed bsam yang star sdong mgron gnyer lam nas sgrog pa'i rgyal po'i dgongs bstad thun mong ma yin par 'dug pas cis kyang gtsang la phebs na 'gab gdan 'dren la ma gcig tha'i ji dang skyid shod tha'i ji mtsho skyes pa gnyis 'byon rgyu yin 'dug /da lam chibs rags nyung bsdus las rgyas rgyas mi dgos pa'i ngag ma dang bcas byung / bde gzar gyi mjug tu song ba dang khyad par sku rim gyi las sbyor mang po byed dgos byung ba'i dam nyams tshogs pa'i gseb tu —159

skyes pa gnyis 'byon rgyu yin 'dug /da lam chibs rags nyung bsdus las rgyas rgyas mi dgos pa'i ngag ma dang bcas byung / bde gzar gyi mjug tu song ba dang khyad par sku rim gyi las sbyor mang po byed rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'gro dgos der shin tu ya nga ba'i ma 'dod pa byung rung rang dbang ma thob pa'i gshis/ zur kun mkhyen chen pos dam sel la dmigs pa'i bsrung (106ba)ba zab pa gnang ste brgyad gtor ma chag tsam zhig byas pa'i hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig la 'bras spungs nas bteg /phyi nang thams cad kyisad lam rten 'brel khyad kyis rgyas rgyas dgos rgyu yin 'dug zer yang zhal ngo'i dgongs gzhi ma things pas ma bde/ stod lung nang du chu lam sdings gsum sogs kyis sne len byung zhing shu gu la brgyab 'u yug gling dkar du slebs/ shangs kyi phu brgyud zab bu mjal na snyam yang rgyal mo che bas gtsos sog po gtod che ba'i gshis rang dbang ma 'dus/ rgyus yod 'dras pha gi'i thad na zab bu yod zer bar gsol 'debs smon lam byas/ de'i thad kyi mkha' 'ja' sprin zhig byung ba skyon chen po thugs dgyes pa yin nam khrel ba yin ni ma shes/ thob rgyal gyi mda' bde chen du slebs nyin gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos dbu gnang / zhal ngo / gu shri bla ma/ g.yu dka' bcu/ er te ni da'i chin/ skyid shod zhabs drung ma chen sogs skya ser gyi bsu ba gtos che ba 'byor/ rgyal po dang thog mar mjal skabs 'phags pa rin po che'i ma na ho'i phyag dril dang gsol can mar gad las grub pa sog po bod 'gyel du grags pa'i nor sna bod khri skor bcu gsum dang g.yas bzhag g.yon bzhag yin zer ba sne'u sdong rtse brgyud rin spungs par byung ba'i khyad can de ster bar mdzad/ gdan sa 'og nas rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po ches ja 'dren rgyas par gnang /sa skya rab 'byams pas lcam nor bu la gdung brgyud 'khrungs pa'i stabs phebs ma thub ces gnyen tshan gyi sgrub byed mang po'i byed snang bar ta zhing chos rjes khyed dpon slob thog tshang (107na)mar sku nyes mi tshe 'byid rgyu yin 'dug ces ha la shags kyang byas song / sang ri zhing gi gru don gser mdog can gyi mdar tshogs pa'i ser sbreng dang span du mkhan slob rnams phrad par byung zhing mkhan po a 'dus de tshad ma bod du dar tshul gyi gleng mo mang po mdzad 'dug /mkhan lcags 'dam pa byon pa'i khong gi bla ma jo nang sprul sku de 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku skye yin pas 'bras spungs phyogs la dag —160

gnang / zhal ngo / gu shri bla ma/ g.yu dka' bcu/ er te ni da'i chin/ skyid shod zhabs drung ma chen sogs skya ser gyi bsu ba gtos che ba 'byor/ rgyal po dang thog mar mjal skabs 'phags pa rin po che'i ma na ho'i phyag dril dang gsol can mar gad las grub pa sog po bod 'gyel du grags pa'i nor sna bod khri skor bcu gsum dang g.yas bzhag g.yon bzhag yin zer ba sne'u sdong rtse brgyud rin spungs par byung ba'i khyad can de ster bar mdzad/ gdan sa 'og nas rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po ches ja 'dren rgyas par gnang /sa skya rab 'byams pas lcam nor bu la gdung brgyud 'khrungs pa'i stabs phebs ma thub ces gnyen tshan gyi sgrub byed mang po'i byed snang bar ta zhing chos rjes khyed dpon slob thog tshang (107na)mar sku nyes mi tshe 'byid rgyu yin 'dug ces ha la shags kyang byas song / sang ri lcags 'dam pa byon pa'i khong gi bla ma jo nang sprul sku de 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku skye yin pas 'bras spungs phyogs la dag —160

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)snang che bas mjal bar yong tshul ze dgur mngon chung gi sgo nas mdzad pa'i g.yo can drang por smra mkhan zhig snang / sang gnas rnying zhabs drung bkra shis lhun po'i slob dpon dang bla brang gi phyag mdzod lhun grub gling pa sogs bod pa dang ji nong se chen hung tha'i ji gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i sog po'i rta pa drug brgya skor bsu bar 'byor zhing nyer lnga la chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun por ser sbreng dang bcas slebs/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po dang mjal zhing spyi bla brang so so nas gzhis len dang shangs len phar tshur gzab par bstar/ rtse tshogs mkhan po zur pa khang dmar ba mchod yon gyi dgongs phog la brten gling gseb tu me bcad chu bcad lta bus nyam thag pa 'dug par phan thog dgos tshul gyi saṃ ṭa btang byung ba ltar nyes dmigs las grol ba'i rogs dan byas/ sog po dang gtsang gi skya ser rnam grangs shin tu mang ba phrad par 'ongs pa'i nam langs sa rub bar mtshams med pa lta bu rnam par g.yengs/ sne'u sdong rtse nas sha khas drung rin po che phebs byung ba/ dpal phag mo grub kha ba can 'dir bla dpon zung du 'jug pa'i yul shin tu gnyan rung deng sang bstan pa ming gi (107ba)lhag ma tsam du gyur pas kun gyis brnyas bcos na'ang / rang ngos nas gnas dus ma bltas pa'i bkur bzos che ba phul/ zhal ngos kyang de dang cha mthun pa mdzad song / gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita smon 'gro ba chen mo rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa byon byung bar mdo sngags tha snyad gang la dris kyang mi mkhyen bya ba mi 'dug pas grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas pa 'di 'dra snyam mos pa 'phel/gzhis ka rtser sdod ring sku mdun gdan drangs nas bslab sbyangs shig byas na bsams kyang bsam thog tu ma khel/ rtser phyin pa'i thog mar tshoms chen du bod sog grangs med tshogs pa'i bzhugs gral gyi tshe/ gong ma se chen gyis
