rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)snang che bas mjal bar yong tshul ze dgur mngon chung gi sgo nas mdzad pa'i g.yo can drang por smra mkhan zhig snang / sang gnas rnying zhabs drung bkra shis lhun po'i slob dpon dang bla brang gi phyag mdzod lhun grub gling pa sogs bod pa dang ji nong se chen dung tha'i ji gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i sog po'i rta pa drug brgya skor bsu bar 'byor zhing nyer lnga la chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun por ser sbreng dang bcas slebs/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po dang mjal zhing spyi bla brang so so nas gzhis len dang shangs len phar tshur gzab par bstar/ rtse tshogs mkhan po zur pa khang dmar ba mchod yon gyi dgongs phog la brten gling gseb tu me bcad chu bcad lta bus nyam thag pa 'dug par phan thog dgos tshul gyi saṃ ṭa btang byung ba ltar nyes dmigs las grol ba'i rogs dan byas/ sog po dang gtsang gi skya ser rnam grangs shin tu mang ba phrad par 'ongs pa'i nam langs sa rub bar mtshams med pa lta bu rnam par g.yengs/ sne'u sdong rtse nas zhabs drung rin po che phebs byung ba/ dpal phag mo grub kha ba can 'dir bla dpon zung du 'jug pa'i yul shin tu gnyan rung deng sang bstan pa ming gi (107ba)lhag ma tsam du gyur pas kun gyis brnyas bcos na'ang / rang ngos nas gnas dus ma bltas pa'i bkur bzos che ba phul/ zhal ngos kyang de dang cha mthun pa mdzad song / gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita smon 'gro ba chen mo rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa byon byung bar mdo sngags tha snyad gang la dris kyang mi mkhyen bya ba mi 'dug pas grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas pa 'di 'dra snyam mos pa 'phel/gzhis ka rtser sdod ring sku mdun gdan drangs nas bslab sbyangs shig byas na bsams kyang bsam thog tu ma khel/ rtser phyin pa'i thog mar tshoms chen du bod sog grangs med tshogs pa'i bzhugs gral gyi tshe/ gong ma se chen gyis 'phags pa rin po cher 'bul chen gsum du mdzad pa'i phyi ma ma skyes dgra'i rten skal rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'phel gdung rgyal mkhar rtser bzhugs pa'i grags pa can de/ yongs grags 'phags pa rin po ches ye shes pa dngos su bcug pa'i khrus long ma ṇi ma'am lugs gcig la mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi thugs gsal me long chos dbang rin po che'i gter —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()byon/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal bkod ma'i rigs ldan yol ba khyad mtshar gyis sna drangs/ nang rten/ ja sku/ lim/ rgya nag mas mtsho ni pa'i rten mchod mang po dang gzhis/bsam grub rtses thog drangs bod khri skor bcu gsum yongs su rdzogs pa 'bul ba yin zhes dril bsgrags/'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos gtsang rong gi bde gzar bar nas lab gter bsnyad pa'i pa rnam rdzong g.yar po bdag bzung gi skabs sde dpon gyi go sa 'dra ba byung zhes ngom ngom mdzad pa khong la dpal ldan sa skya pa dang (108na sko srid phag mo gru pa'i mnga' thang dang mtshungs pa 'di 'dra 'bad med du gzhan gyis ster mkhan byung na khron pa'i sbal ba'i dpe ltar thugs gas nas gshegs dogs kyang dgos rigs su 'dug /skye ba gzhan du rang gis phar phan btags pa'i drin lan gzhal dgos bzhin yin na zor cung zad yang / de min rgyal po'i thugs rtse bstad lugs la dpags na 'di snang gi gegs sel dang rting ma'i yar 'dren yong ba'i gdeng gang yang med pas drin lan bskal bar yang gzhal dka' ba'i khur lci bar gda'/ 'di rigs dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs su ni ga la 'gro 'on te bod 'dir mgo chings shig yod na dus kyang bde zhing / sa gar rnying gsum sogs grub mtha' gzhan rnams dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su rgyas mi 'debs par phan nam snyam pa byung / chos sde chen po der sku gsung thugs rten dang mdo sngags gso rig sgra snyan gyi 'chad nyan 'dzugs sa'i dri gtsang khang kun rar bcas pas mtshon pa'i dge stobs de brgyad stong pa nas bshad pa'i bdud las su song 'dug kyang mdzad pa la dpags nas sde srid de chos rgyal zhig yin pa 'dra bsam pa shar/ nged rang gis las sbyor mangs pa'i stabs kyis ngos mjal dang rgyu 'grul byed ma nus/ de 'dra'i dogs pa ma dgos na dbus phyogs nas gsol skal rten thub dang bcas pa'i bslu zhabs su ma song tsam zhig thub par 'dug /drung 'khor tshor drag chas rnams gtor na mi 'thus shing bsnyems chas kyi rigs la 'jug mi yong bas sa ris kyi zhu rten la phul chog tshul gnang song / 'di lo nas bzung rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad (108ba)gling par rten mchod spyi rdzas rim gyis sprad pa lo bco brgyad phan —162

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)gcig /maṇ+ḍal rgyan gsum/ man rgyan nyer gcig 'byar ba'i mthon thi'i snyan dar gong pa/ dmar 'bal/ bod dmar/ sgro rkang / (110na〉ga rkang sogs khrab legs rmog bcas dgu/ dkyus ma bcu gcig /sog khrab rmog bcas gsum/ zangs khrab rgya bzo ma gcig /sag thag cha 'grig so gcig /dwags dong gser shog dkar thag gsa' mjug tshang ba drug /gri gos 'dzab ma de mtshungs/ snyan dar khyon bsdoms nyis brgya bcu gsum lhag bcas song / rgya ri zhabs drung blo bzang mthu stobs chos rgyal gshegs pa'i gsang khog nas mgyogs bsngo zhig byung bar smon lam yang dag byas/ rang phyogs kyi dgon pa dang sa ris phar shor ba rnams ni tshur len dgos pa gzhir bcas de phyin bstan don la rgyar mi btub pa dang tshur rgol gyi zhabs 'dren ma byung phyin grub mtha' mtha' dag rang 'jags su bzhag na rang gzhan tshang mar slebs che tshul chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i rnam thar dper drangs nas mchod yon gnyis gar zhug pas rgyal po'i thugs kur thal mo sbyar te dbu khug khug mdzad 'dug /sde pa'i dgongs par bab ma bab ni ma shes/ slar bkra shis lhun por yongs tshogs chen du bka' gdams glegs bam pha chos thun gcig la gzab bshad byas pas sngags gra'i slob dpon shes rin par grags pa'i dge bshes chen po de ched bstad kyis byon te bshad pa la mgu ba'i legs so byed 'dug/gzhan bde gzar gyi mjug tu song bas nom pa dang sa cha'i ang nyan ma gtogs chos kyi bgros bgros chen po mi gda'/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i rab gnas la paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor lo'i gtso bor bzhengs pa'i gral du nged gra tshang dang bcas (110ba)'bod pa gnang / sngags gra slob dpon pa rgyab gral ba rnams dang 'phros pa las zhal 'don ye mi mdzad 'dug /dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang bdag gis slob dpon byas nas gu shri bla mas gtsos pa'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kha yar bsgrubs/ g.yeng ba'i dbang gis yong gdong bka' bsgo'i byin rlabs tsam las gsung chos ni zhu long ma byung / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos —165—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzheng ba gnang ba'i rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po'i dngul skus thog drangs bdog pa'i skyes bzang bar bstsal/ nyer lnga la bkra sa lhun po nas bteg zha lu ri sbug dbu mdzad rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis gtsos zha lu ri mthil gyi ja 'dren zhig byung dpon slob rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor phul/ phur pa gra tshang dang ma ṇi sgrub sde'i ser sbreng gis bsus pa rnam du 'byor zhing klu sdings su zhag gnyis bsdad/'di skabs gar lugs phyogs ni bde gzar slong ba'i bka' gros grub pa'i nyams sa stsol sel 'bul mjal tsam las zhu don gyi rigs mi byed 'dug /de phyin gzhan phyogs rnams sngar 'jags ma byung dogs pa dang rang phyogs rnams gsar pa 'byung re'i zhu don pa dbyar gyi grog tshang rdol ba lta bu snang / de skabs rnying lugs dgon chen nad mi theg pa'i rigs ma gtogs dmangs ma rnams ni spyi lung gsang ba'i gal mdor/ lo dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang dbu rur 'tshog: ces pa lo dgu'i bar dbus par ma zad gtsang pa rnams kyang zhu don la dbus su 'tshog pa dang / snang rtse nas kyi gsang ba'i lung bstan du/ bstan pa dbus gtsang yongs la bcu bar byed (111na༄sa chu bcu ba lta bu'i don ma 'brol bar lo grangs la zhabrul ba'i de bar zhu don byed ring mi chog pa'i dbang du btang nas yong mi nyung ba byung / mon du bla khag lnga dang 'brug pa thug pa'i dmag bskul la lha ba'i gdung brgyud sku gzhen pa byon/ de nyin mchod yon rnams rdzong du bzhugs gral la phebs pa dang 'grig nged la rgyu mtshan rnams gsung ba sde par gnas tshul 'di bzhin yin 'dug pas deng sang dpung snon zhig mdzad na dka' tshegs med 'phros zhus par khrel dgod dang bcas gtsang pas sdug po btang nas dmag mi byed ka med byung de 'dra'i blo rgya med gsung yang me chung ring du ma bsad pas sor dang 'dom gyi dper song zhing gtsang dus lho 'brug gi bu gte gnad che ba rdzong go rnams su yod pa glod bkrol mdzad pa'ang snying rje rgas pa zhe sdang gi rgyu byas/ snar thang phur pa ba'i mchod gzhis bye spe bde 'byor byang par shor 'dug pa khong tsho'i ral mo'i che sa des gra tshang la 'cham dbyangs bslabs pa'i 'dris yod gshis chos gzhis rnying pa lhogs na dang de min tshab cig dgos tshul zhus par zla —166

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)phogs gsum las gnang ma nyan pas 'thor dgos byung song / 'gro don gling pa dang thar pa ba sogs ni gtsang pa'i sku zhabs gra tshang ba yin par khyad med rung rang 'jags las 'pho 'gyur ma byung gshis phur pa ba chos mkhas drag pa zhig la rngan pa ma thebs ba'i skyon du snang / gra tshang gcig gi sa ris tsam gyi phan pa'ang sgrub par mi nus pa'i rjes su yi rang shar/ klu sdings kyi khang pa de ga rma pa'i gzims chung yin zer 'gangs che bar byed kyang dpe cha lta mkhan gyi sdod sar mi 'dug /nyin mo bzhu mar spar ma dgos tsam las shin tu 'thibs pas nyin mtshan kun tu gnyid log gam yang na dud 'gro 'jog pa'i 'os su gda' bar zhag gnyis las ma 'gor bas btson nas thon pa lta bu'i dga' tshor byung /rim gyis rgyal mkhar rtser slebs/ gra tshang rnams kyis ser sbreng dang gar sogs rgyas par bstar/dpal 'khor bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten chen mo mjal/ bdag po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags de skyon chen po'i lung bstan dang mthun pa'i chos rgyal zla med pa'i phyag rjes che snyam pa'i dag snang shar/ deng dus kyi bla ma rnams kyis de tsam rmi lam du'ang mdzad dogs ga la dgos/dge lugs gra tshang bdun gyis dkar spro dang rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)bod thams cad 'dres pa'i ra ma lug de 'dra rang la shes 'dod kyang mi 'gro/ lhag tu 'gol sdod kyis thos bsam skyong rgyu byung na snyam pa dur re ba yod pas phebs lan du/ sa phag 'bri stag sogs go babs de bzhin mi mdzad ka med du 'dug /nged rang dpon slob rabs chad so nam pa'i rigs la de 'dra par bkab mi dgos rang ngos nas lus sems gnyis gas mi nus nges pas thel gtong sogs mi byed zhus/ drang srong srin po ri dang thag nye sar byung yang mjal ba'i skal ba dang ma ldan/ lam zhen du gling smad zhabs drung gis gsang phur yong dgos tshul gnang ba ltar phyin/ zhing sgang zhig tu chos 'chad rnams dang lhan du bsu ba la phebs 'dug /bdag gis sngar lugs bzhin phyag dang mjal dar rtse sprod/ mchod yon gnyis kyis phyag dbang zhu ba gnang ba gzhir bcas kyang ta zhing chos rje sogs la las gsang phu ba rnams la ston pa'i ched du sgrib g.yogs gang yang med sa 'dir bsgrigs nas 'byung po gnang zhes skur zhus kyang byed (113na)de nub gsang phur bsdad sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma dang rngog lo'i gdung rten gyi gtsos pa'i rten rnams zhib par mjal/ chos skyong la snyan shal phul/gling smad nas gzhis len gya nom pa gnang / gung tshigs la gzhis ka sne'ur 'byor zhag gnyis bsdad lam zhor du rgyal khang gnyan po der snyan dar dang gser skyems phul bse 'bag de shin tu legs par 'dug /nyer lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'dus tshogs kyi bsu ba dang bcas slebs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la ser theg chen gling / rgyud stod pa/ rmi ru ba sogs kyi ser sbreng dang bro gzhas kyi rtsed sna mang pos mdun bsus klu phug gling khar phyin te sgar byas nas zhag bco lnga tsam bsdad/ 'bras spungs sngags pa gnyal gung snang chos rje 'jam dbyangs sprul sku'i yongs 'dzin du 'byon rgyu dang thu shi ye thu rgyal po se chen rgyal po gnyis kyi mi sna sogs phal cher dang se chen rgyal po'i bla mchod du sku 'bum chos rje bkra shis don grub brdzangs shing 'jam dbyangs sprul sku'i tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin yig bsrings/ rin po che kun bzang rtse pa'i zhal ngo tha ma de lugs gnyis ga'i mdzad pa legs rgyu mi 'dug rung zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi khyad nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya —/69

nus nges pas thel gtong sogs mi byed zhus/ drang srong srin po ri dang thag nye sar byung yang mjal ba'i skal ba dang ma ldan/ lam zhen du gling smad zhabs drung gis gsang phur yong dgos tshul gnang ba ltar phyin/ zhing sgang zhig tu chos 'chad rnams dang lhan du bsu ba la phebs 'dug /bdag gis sngar lugs bzhin phyag dang mjal dar rtse sprod/ mchod yon gnyis kyis phyag dbang zhu ba gnang ba gzhir bcas kyang ta zhing chos rje sogs la las gsang phu ba rnams la ston pa'i ched du sgrib g.yogs gang yang med sa 'dir bsgrigs nas 'byung po gnang zhes skur zhus kyang byed (113na)de nub gsang phur bsdad sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma dang rngog lo'i gdung rten gyi gtsos pa'i rten rnams zhib par mjal/ chos skyong la snyan shal phul/gling smad nas gzhis len gya nom pa gnang / gung tshigs la gzhis ka sne'ur 'byor zhag gnyis bsdad lam zhor du rgyal khang gnyan po der snyan dar dang gser skyems phul bse 'bag de shin tu legs par 'dug /nyer lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'dus tshogs kyi bsu ba dang bcas slebs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la ser theg chen gling / rgyud stod pa/ rmi ru ba sogs kyi ser sbreng dang bro gzhas kyi rtsed sna mang pos mdun bsus klu phug gling khar phyin te sgar byas nas zhag bco lnga tsam bsdad/ 'bras spungs sngags pa gnyal gung snang chos rje 'jam dbyangs sprul sku'i yongs 'dzin du 'byon rgyu dang thu shi ye thu rgyal po se chen rgyal po gnyis kyi mi sna sogs phal cher dang se chen rgyal po'i bla mchod du sku 'bum chos rje bkra shis don grub brdzangs shing 'jam dbyangs sprul sku'i tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin yig bsrings/ rin po che kun bzang rtse pa'i zhal ngo tha ma de lugs gnyis ga'i mdzad pa legs rgyu mi 'dug rung zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi khyad nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya —/69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mtsho'i dgongs bstad la gong rgyag gi bdag rkyen yong la re'i byon byung yang mjal dar slog tsam yang byung ma song bas mi drin can gyi ngang tshul bsam mkhan dkon par snang / mchod yon thun mong nas ser gsog chen mo zhig mdzad/ dga' ldan gyi khri rin po che ljangs rams pas dbu gnang rtse shar gnyis dang bcas pa phebs/ bzhugs gral gyi (113ba/sar khri rin po ches rgyal po la bstan pa bzung ba'i bsngags brjod cung zad dang shar pa zur bzhugs dbon por grags pas dbugs dbyung rgya cher mdzad/ jo shāka mjal bar phyin nyin lha sa ba rnams kyis tshes bcu'i 'cham/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po btsun mo sras blon po rnams kyi bkod pa/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ snye thang bkra shis sgang pas ru 'dren sde bzhi'i 'cham/ gzhan yang rtsed sna'i rigs shin tu mang ba byung / ru 'dren gyi 'chub lhongs kyis ser bas dkar por btang yang 'ong khar ma shor zhing dkar por song ba rten 'brel legs pa 'dra/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan por er te ni chos rje bskos/ zur kun mkhyen chen pos kha'u'i rdo la zhal gyi sku brnyan thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag bris/ brag sna chos rjes dang btsun dpal gyi rgyal mo'i dbu thod/ mkhan po'i shing sku/ chos dbang gi tshems rnams byin/ tshes bcu drug la 'bras spungs su bteg /'di lo gzhis ka rtser bsdad pa dang phrad mi sna tshogs kyi dam sel la brten glo nad 'dra ba la 'phrod bsten gang yang mi len pa zhig gis zla ba gnyis tsam mnar/ la la zas ngan yin nam zer na'ang bdun pa nyis brtsegs kyi hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyal kha tshun na bzhin pa la sang zhogs tsher ma bton pa bzhin mi 'dug pa ci yin ni cha ma things ya mtshan pa zhig tu mngon gzhis ka rtser grong smad nas dgos pa bkra shis 'das pa'i so dang skra la sbyang ba bsregs pa'i thal ba gser la sbyangs te btags grol dang ngan song sbyong ba'i gzungs mang du bris shing su tsā 'ang btab/ rgya ri zhabs drung khri pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang lha (114na)ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi khri 'don thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms par nged yong e thub kyi thang len byung ba ma thub pas gzims khang —170

tan can tsam ga la yod kyang / gser dang ra gan mi nor ba zhig gda'/ lugs gnyis rta kyi bslab bya dgos zer ba ltar brtsams/ tha'i jis —175

pa'i rna cha can la gtang rag snyan dar zhal yig dang bcas phul/gling smad zhabs drung rin po che gsang phu nas phebs/ se ra gzims khang gi thog tu zhabs 'chag skabs gzigs rtog gnang ba'i rnying ma'i lung bstan 'dra la yod zer ba bden mi bden ji ltar yang dmar lcags gnyis sbrel ba'i btsan rdzong shin tu rgya che ba zhig byung na ser 'bras gnyis dang zung du 'brel ba'i 'phral phugs su brtan brling che zhing thugs rje chen po'i gnas yin pas ma ṇi sgrub sde zhig tshugs na mchod yon gnyis kyi sku'i sdig sbyong la legs tshul phebs par sog po yod ring ni skyon mi yong de min rdzong la 'khra ba'i tsam byas/ sde pa thugs brel ma chod pas—177

rtse shel dkar lha rtse gsum skyid shod khu dbon la gtod rtsis yin gsungs par yang na dbus gtsang gi khrims bdag gtad nas rang gu yangs pa zhig 'gab phyed ka de 'dra mdzad don med dam zhus kyang ma gsan par phyag tu bkal bas rgyal po thugs ma dgyes par rang yul du ldog rtsis mdzad par rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen po'i bstan pa la dgongs nas bzhugs dgos mol ba de kho na ltar mdzad song / rgyal po 'di nyid snying stobs che zhing thugs bsam dang dad pa brtan drags pa ma gtogs khyi'i sbar mor yos blug pa 'dra ba zhig yong grabs byung / me shor gyi zhig gsos grub dbyar stod 'bras spungs su slebs dwags po sku rab gnas gzhir sgrom mda' dgon gsar bas sa bon byas dga' ldan rab brtan btsugs pa'i mkhan por sgrom mda' (119na)chos rje mthu stobs dpal 'byor bskos khong pa lugs gnyis nas rnal 'byor che bas 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs rab byung snang /glegs bam rnams la dkar chag gsar bsgrigs dang yig bskur deb gnyis kyi 'go brjod/rgyal po'i thugs dam du rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bstod pa rnams brtsams nged sog yul du 'gro mi 'gro'i brjod rigs la brten zur kun mkhyen chen pos phyag bris gnang byung ba'i de lan phul/ gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa'i bskang gsos 'chad nyan la gnod po byung song bas zhal snga nas dang nged gros mthun gyis gtor 'bul tsam khyed par thag bcad de bla mas gra rgan tshor 'phros pa btang ba'i lan lag shad tshig rtsub mang po byas labs par brten bla ma sang byung ba gdan khar sdod long med par mchi ma mang du bton te ngas shogs mi thon 'dug drung 'khor zhig bka' bkod bsgyur bar gnang na e 'gab kyi 'char byung rung la bzhag /sde pas thugs khur bzhes pa'i gu shri bla ma'i dngul gdung la gzungs bzhugs phul zhing rab tu gnas/ dbu mdzad mdo sngags gling pa/ snang rtse ba/ nam mkha' phun tshogs/ blo bzang don grub/ blo bzang yon tan/ byams pa blo bzang / blo bzang rab brtan —178

bas 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs rab byung snang /glegs bam rnams la dkar chag gsar bsgrigs dang yig bskur deb gnyis kyi 'go brjod/rgyal po'i thugs dam du rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bstod pa rnams brtsams nged sog yul du 'gro mi 'gro'i brjod rigs la brten zur kun mkhyen chen pos phyag bris gnang byung ba'i de lan phul/ gra tshang chos 'khor gling pa'i bskang gsos 'chad nyan la gnod po byung song bas zhal snga nas dang nged gros mthun gyis gtor 'bul tsam khyed par thag bcad de bla mas gra rgan tshor 'phros pa btang ba'i lan lag shad tshig rtsub mang po byas labs par brten bla ma sang byung ba gdan khar sdod long med par mchi ma mang du bton te ngas shogs mi thon 'dug drung 'khor zhig bka' bkod bsgyur bar gnang na e 'gab kyi 'char byung rung la bzhag /sde pas thugs khur bzhes pa'i gu shri bla ma'i dngul gdung la gzungs bzhugs phul zhing rab tu gnas/ dbu mdzad mdo sngags gling pa/ snang rtse ba/ nam mkha' phun tshogs/ blo bzang don grub/ blo bzang yon tan/ byams pa blo bzang / blo bzang rab brtan —178

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)rnams gong dkar du 'cham bslab par btang / phur sgrub 'dzugs rtsis kyis lcags khang ma'i las byang zhig gsar bsgrigs byas/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstod pa snyan dngags dang 'brel khul kyang brtsams/ khar kha rab 'byams pa blo bzang dpal 'byor dang rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legasaganyis la lo chen gyi bshad sbyar gzhung don gsal (119ba)ba'i steng nas ming le rkang pa drug pa yan gyi ri mo zhib par khrid cing de mus byang 'grul 'dra'i brel bas g.yengs pa dang kho rang gnyis kyang ri mo yongs rdzogs song ba'i ming tsam 'dod 'dug pas kun bshad man gyi brda chad dang dbyings sgrub byed lugs rags pa tsam bslabs pa'i sa bzang pa'i sgra ṭīka steng nas rdzogs pa zhig song ba byas/da la'i kun ci rgyal mo glo bur du bsnyun par lha sar phyin pa'i gegs sel gyi rim gro dang rjes gnang thor bu byas pas phan skyed che bar byung / paṇa chen sku mched kyi gter lung thog tu babs pa'i lo sngon ma gnyis la sad mo che bstud pa'i skya pham par 'byung ba'i bcud nyams gso ba'i bum gter sbas/ston sad bsrungs byas pa'ang kha ma skyengs tsam byung / rgyal po dang rgyal mo che bas mtsho khar yong dgos tshul nan chags par zur kun mkhyen brgyud rig 'dzin yol mo bar 'gro dgos yong mi yong gi brtag pa zhus pa'i lan du da lta'i sog po 'dis don la gdan mi 'drongs lo shas song mtshams 'di tsho dang cha lugs mi gcig pa shar phyogs nas gdan 'dren yong phebs pa 'char yang rgyun ring mi 'gor ba yar ldog gsungs pa'i phyag bris ma byung ba rjes su nges pa rnyed/rgyal pos rgyal rabs yig tshang zhib pa zhig dgos gsungs pa ltar deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs su grags pa brtsams/ de skabs rtsom gsar ba'i nyams kyis bcad lhug thams cad la snyan ngag mang bas mchog dman kun gyis go bde ba zhig ma byung zhing sog skad du bsgyur ba la'ang ji bzhin mi 'gyur ba 'dug zer/ 'cham dbyangs bslab mi rnams dang lhan du dkon gnyer dpon dge steng bla ma byung (120nasgo bong pa rtse lugs kyi phyag len mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod gtsang ba 'dug /stag lung zhabs drung gis bar pa gnang ba'i drung pa rgyal tshab pa dpon slob mchod yon la —179

gtsang ba 'dug /stag lung zhabs drung gis bar pa gnang ba'i drung pa rgyal tshab pa dpon slob mchod yon la —179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bab 'bul bar phebs pa'i dus skar khrod du byung ba'i 'brum nag cig gtsang nas dbus su mched/dben sa sprul sku dang thor god da'i chin gyis gtsos pa'i 'grul pa mang ba 'byor/ thor god da'i chin gyis thog mar mjal dar la rta sga ma brgya tham pa byung / 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po yin na mjal dar la'ang 'di 'dra byung zhes zhal pho shog logs gcig tsam yong yang kha thag ring dogs ma bris/ dben sa sprul sku dang da'i chin gnyis kyis lha sar bos pa'i khri 'bul 'gangs che ba bstar bar bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/ stag lung zhabs drung phebs 'dug pa dang mjal lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng zhib par byung / 'bras spungs su 'ongs te gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad la 'jam dpal dmar po'i sgrub pa zhig btsugs dgon klung tshor 'brum pas chad lhag che tsam snang bas 'dzem cha'i lugs kyis 'ol dga' phyogs su bteg /mal gro gung dkar du slebs thog stag lung zhabs drung ma chen gyi sku zhabs nas ja 'dren la dbu ma lo tsā ba gnang byung ba khong smon 'gro paṇa chen gyi zhal slob tu song bas sdeb sbyor la shin tu mkhas pa 'dug pas brit+ta/ dzā ti/ ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dogs gcod byas skabs sa gzhong ma byung bar saṃ ṭa la bkod nas khrid/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dus kyi grang ngad che bas nged dpon slob gnyis ga'i lag pa bza' mi 'dus pa byung yang dka' ba khyad du gsod ring chog (120ba)par gda'/ rdzing phyir zhag gnyis dang 'ol dga' rdzong du zhag bcu skor bsdad nas mchod yon phyogs mthun par chos 'khor rgyal la bteg pa kha ba che drags pas bod sog thams cad sbyong ba zhig byung / lhun grub dga' tshal gyi chos khrung steng du bdun gcig gi ring mtshams dam par byas shing phur pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas lha chen zur phud lnga par gsol mchod 'phrin las bcol bar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / rgyal mthil du slebs bstun dwags phyogs kyi skya ser shin tu mang ba dang phrad/ gzhi byes kyi khrom la rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang byas/ lho brag phyag rdor ba'i shangs mtshal las grub pa'i snyan brgyud glegs bam rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos byams pa'i gzungs bzhugs la 'bul ba gnang —/80

nas khrid/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i dus kyi grang ngad che bas nged dpon slob gnyis ga'i lag pa bza' mi 'dus pa byung yang dka' ba khyad du gsod ring chog (120ba)par gda'/ rdzing phyir zhag gnyis dang 'ol dga' rdzong du zhag bcu skor bsdad nas mchod yon phyogs mthun par chos 'khor rgyal la bteg pa kha ba che drags pas bod sog thams cad sbyong ba zhig byung / lhun grub dga' tshal gyi chos khrung steng du bdun gcig gi ring mtshams dam par byas shing phur pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas lha chen zur phud lnga par gsol mchod 'phrin las bcol bar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang byung / brgyud glegs bam rje dge 'dun rgya mtshos byams pa'i gzungs bzhugs la 'bul ba gnang —/80

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)rgyu or pa blo gsal bshes gnyen gyi rku thabs la brten 'khyar ba bam ring a mas byin byung ba rnyed pa'i mchog tu gyur/ dka' bcu ngo mtshar ba so gos rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sum cu tsam bsgrubs/ mgon khang rnams la gtor gsos spyan gzigs phul zhing bskang gso byas/ byams chen dang ri mthil gyi mgon khang tshor zhal yig dang bcas pa'i snyan dar phul/ rgyal po dpon g.yog nyung bsdus la gnam lcags ral gyis gtsos pa'i nang rten gyi mjal kha btang /kong por skyar langs byung ba'i sde pas nang so nor bu dang star sdong nas dmag dpon sbrel por rdzong bda' mdzad kyang don du dpon g.yog las sbrel po byed dgos ma byung ba'i khar star sdong mgron gnyer chu ma 'phrod pa'i skyid shod du log dgos shar ba bar chad mi 'jug pa'i gson bsngo zhu mi (121na)slebs shing bsrung ba dang dam rdzas sogs kyang bzabs nas bskur/ nged kyis 'ol dga' rtser bsdad cing mchod yon skyid shod du phebs/dgung lo nyer brgyad par phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi rnam thar mdzad pa sogs kyi skor/shing sprel gyi lo gsar dus 'dod don yi ger bkod pa'i snyan dar phul/ gnyags ban nang ra ba ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros bas pa'i 'grel ba mchog dga'i steng nas dbyangs 'char dang nag rtsis kyis gzhud mang du sbyangs/ zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung lan dang gling smad zhabs drung smon lam tshogs dbur phebs par zhu yig /sku mdun smon 'gro lo tsā ba ma chen la sras po skabs sbyar la slob dpon du 'bod dgos 'dug par dka' gnad la mtha' gcod kyi bslab dgos tshul dang sras por yang de dang dbyibs mtshungs pa/ er te ni hung tha'i jis sku 'bum mchod stong dngul gyis —181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gtums par legs so'i yig lan rnams rgyan gyis spras pa bskur/ rin chen sgang gi sku 'dra rin po che'i mchod khang sgo rgyan du snyan ngag gis brgyan pa'i bstod pa brtsams/ se chen dbon pos bskul nas gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas bsdus gnyis ka thon pa zhig bris kyang tshig mang la don nyungs pas dag yig smra rgyan gyi sku mched cig byung 'dug /'ol dga' tshes bcu pa rnams kyis phur pa'i 'cham rgyas par byas/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya skor bsgrubs/ dbon drung zhi ba bzang po la tshe dbang sogs chos 'brel 'dod bstun bshad/ dben sa sku skye bkra shis lhun por slo bur du grongs pa'i thor god da'i chin can 'brum par 'dzem stabs 'dam du slebs/ rgyal mo che chung dang da'i chin sogs rang yul du log rings (121ba)bar sde pas dbyar 'ong gseb la mi gnod pa'i khyad kyis 'phan yul nas brdzangs na 'gab 'dug pas za dam du shog gnang ba ltar mal gro brgyud lam du 'degs gdong rgyal du dpal ldan dmag zor mar 'dod don gsol ba'i snyan dar 'bul mi mngags/ja'i sang sde pa 'ol dgar bad smug gis ma bde ba dpon tshang byang ngos pas sbyongs 'bebs ma nus pa'i skyon la brten 'od zer gyang nas lod du song bas zhag gsum tsam bcag mal dang rjes gnang bsrung ba rim gro gang zab byas pas bde skyid che zhing 'phrod bsten mjug skyong la dpon tshang nang so dar rgyas dang bsrung 'khor bar brag sna chos rje bcas rin chen gling du bzhag /nged rnams thang skya lcags zam kha nas byang khar don po to shar sogs bka' gdams kyi gnas mang po mjal 'dod kyang rang dbang ma 'dus/ a mes kyi bstan srung gtso bo yin pas zing pa stag mgo'i khyab 'jug gi dam shing la snyan dar spyan gzigs 'bul mi btang zhing 'phrin las bcol/ za dam gyi dgon rdzong rnams bkod pas khyad du thon pa'i legs kyang gtsang khang gi thub chen de mthong ba tsam gyis skrag tshom tshom mgon khang de shin tu 'jam zhing gtor ma rnams kyang bse dang 'jim pa la bzos pa'i phyag rgya ba rgan po'i nang rtags phyir shar zhig snang / dben sa sprul sku'i tshab mar kre pa rje drung zer ba'i tshe blos btang gi ri khrod par rlom pa la khong gi gra rigs mnga' thang thams cad mig 'og tu bcug pa zhig —182—

tshom mgon khang de shin tu 'jam zhing gtor ma rnams kyang bse dang 'jim pa la bzos pa'i phyag rgya ba rgan po'i nang rtags phyir shar zhig snang / dben sa sprul sku'i tshab mar kre pa rje drung zer ba'i tshe blos btang gi ri khrod par rlom pa la khong gi gra rigs mnga' thang thams cad mig 'og tu bcug pa zhig —182—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)'dug pa gra pa rnams dang ma 'cham par phyir ldog gos shar song / chos rje bco brgyad pa khu dbon dang sngags phyogs kyi gleng mo mang du byung ba dbang khrid lung gsum la (122na)gsan rgya che ba'i tshad cig tu snang / skyid shod tha'i ji sku mched nas gzhis rtse sogs bzung ba rgyal po'i dgongs par ma babs pa mkhyen pas tshur rtsis sprod mdzad/ gzhis rtse rdzong dpon la nye gnas stag lung pa'i rnam thar ma khyongs dogs nang so nor bu btang song / 'di nas bzung phal cher gyis sde srid dang sde pa zhes 'bod cing kho rang yang sde pa dang rus gcig gi gcung po yin pa'i nyams tsam byed pa 'dug /sog po rnams skyid shod du phebs bstun rdzong bda' gnang dgos zhus par brten za dam nas thon pa'i lam zhor srung ma rang bzhin gyi 'du gnas dpal ldan rtse mjal bar 'dod kyang stabs ma 'grig /skam la brgyud 'bras spungs su 'byor/ gzhis ka rtse'i rin chen rgyan cha gtor dus kyi sha ba skya ring gi g.yu rnams kun ci rgyal mos jo bo shākya mu ni'i dbu rgyan la sbyar ba sogs jo bo rnam gnyis kyi dbu rgyan zhig gsos dang jo 'drar dbu rgyan gsar du bzos pa'i kha yig brtsams/ rgyal mo che chung dang da'i chin gyis gtsos pa rnams la gang 'dod kyi chos 'brel dang dngos po'i rdzong ba bzabs/ sngags khang du bskang gso btsugs thog chos skyong rnams la 'phrin bcol bris pa'i snyan shal phul/chu rta kong dmag gis rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang mes bsregs par 'gyangs med du zhig gsos grub pa'i 'du khang gi ldebs bris la dbu mdzad 'brong rtse blo bzang dang 'bras spungs dgos nor gnyis kyis gtsos bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ do dam dpon tshang tsha rong ba/ stag ru ba nor bu/ gtsang pa gser sdings nas rnams kyis byas pa'i gtso bor rgyal ba tsong kha pa 'khor dag pa (122bskom brgyad kyis bskor ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs snga phyi/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug /nag po skor gsum/ beng phyag /thugs kyi rgyal po/ seng g.yabs la bka' gdams lha bzhi rnams bris/ lo pa chos rjes rdzing phyi'i byams par snam sbyar phul ba'i smon lam dang dge bshes dge dar bas bskur ba'i bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam bris/ khyab bdag —183—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 15)'dug pa gra pa rnams dang ma 'cham par phyir ldog gos shar song / chos rje bco brgyad pa khu dbon dang sngags phyogs kyi gleng mo mang du byung ba dbang khrid lung gsum la (122na)gsan rgya che ba'i tshad cig tu snang / skyid shod tha'i ji sku mched nas gzhis rtse sogs bzung ba rgyal po'i dgongs par ma babs pa mkhyen pas tshur rtsis sprod mdzad/ gzhis rtse rdzong dpon la nye gnas stag lung pa'i rnam thar ma khyongs dogs nang so nor bu btang song / 'di nas bzung phal cher gyis sde srid dang sde pa zhes 'bod cing kho rang yang sde pa dang rus gcig gi gcung po yin pa'i nyams tsam byed pa 'dug /sog po rnams skyid shod du phebs bstun rdzong bda' gnang dgos zhus par brten za dam nas thon pa'i lam zhor srung ma rang bzhin gyi 'du gnas dpal ldan rtse mjal bar 'dod kyang stabs ma 'grig /skam la brgyud 'bras spungs su 'byor/ gzhis ka rtse'i rin chen rgyan cha gtor dus kyi sha ba skya ring gi g.yu rnams kun ci rgyal mos jo bo shākya mu ni'i dbu rgyan la sbyar ba sogs jo bo rnam gnyis kyi dbu rgyan zhig gsos dang jo 'drar dbu rgyan gsar du bzos pa'i kha yig brtsams/ rgyal mo che chung dang da'i chin gyis gtsos pa rnams la gang 'dod kyi chos 'brel dang dngos po'i rdzong ba bzabs/ sngags khang du bskang gso btsugs thog chos skyong rnams la 'phrin bcol bris pa'i snyan shal phul/chu rta kong dmag gis rdzing phyi'i gtsug lag khang mes bsregs par 'gyangs med du zhig gsos grub pa'i 'du khang gi ldebs bris la dbu mdzad 'brong rtse blo bzang dang 'bras spungs dgos nor gnyis kyis gtsos bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ do dam dpon tshang tsha rong ba/ stag ru ba nor bu/ gtsang pa gser sdings nas rnams kyis byas pa'i gtso bor rgyal ba tsong kha pa 'khor dag pa (122bskom brgyad kyis bskor ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs snga phyi/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug /nag po skor gsum/ beng phyag /thugs kyi rgyal po/ seng g.yabs la bka' gdams lha bzhi rnams bris/ lo pa chos rjes rdzing phyi'i byams par snam sbyar phul ba'i smon lam dang dge bshes dge dar bas bskur ba'i bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam bris/ khyab bdag —183—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()chos dbyings rang grol gyis snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i phyag bris byung ba de lan phul/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa la rje bla ma nas 'jam dbyangs stag lung brag pa'i bar du bshad rgyun nyams pa med pa gling smad zhabs drung la mnga' zhing dus thog der lam rim la de las mkhas pa med par nges pa rnyed de gsang sngags mkhar nas gdan drangs/ lam rim chen mo'i spyod pa spyi bslab yan la zhib bshad/zhi lhag la don bsdu/ lam rim chung ba'i zhi lhag la zhib bshad dang de phyin la ljags lung gnang zhing gsung bshad rnams la rgyugs 'bul kyang zhus/ lar snam bu 'dom re tsam rnyed pa la dka' tshegs mi 'dug kyang paṇa zhwa ser po sne ring tshad kyis lam rim/ sa zhu 'byor tshad kyis lam 'bras/ skyon paṇa zhu dmar zing tshad kyis rdzogs chen sgom zhwa bus 'byud yod tshad kyis phyag chen 'chad ga la shes/chos 'di shes pa zhig la gtugs pa gnad che bar snang / gzhan yang rim lnga gsal sgron/ drang nges rnam 'byed/ thar lam gsal byed/ snying po rgyan rnams kyi dka' gnas mang por dogs gcod zhus/zla ba bdun pa'i gnam gang gi tsha rting khar nyi ma gza' (123na)'dzin 'ong ba'i lha sa'i rdo ring la bi warta dang bcas yi ge sbyar/bod 'bangs kyi legs byas mthu dman pas rigs 'dzin yol mo pa chen po lung bstan bzhin gter bzhes pa'i shegs byed kyi mthu zangs mdog dpal rir zhing khams 'phos pa'i dgongs rdzogs su bram ze mchog sred kyi thugs dam rten mgon po phur zhabs mas thog drangs pa dang gdung chog ser tshogs kyi dgos cha yang mi srun sgyu 'phrul dra bas mnga' bdag phyag mdzod byed dkar gyur bar slob dpon chen po'i sku dang bka' brgyad gra tshar gyi zhu rten byung ba ltar 'dod pa'i re ba bkang /dpon slob rin po ches gsang sngags mkhar du rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i gos sku gsar bzhengs gnang bar smon lam zhig rtsoms phebs pa la de 'phral du saṃ ṭar bris nas spyan 'bebs zhus pas sngar dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa'i thugs rtsom skabs dka' las chen po yong ba 'dra rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho de dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i thogs med du mdzad pa yod 'dug pas de 'dra zhig byung na snyam —184

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)pa yid la ngur ngur shar yang da cha re ba bzhin byung zhes dgyes dgyes gnang / paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang las chen dngos grub pa'i mdzod gnyis po legs rgyu mi 'dug pas yig cha 'bri dgos pa'i bslab ston phebs/ drang srong chu lha'i bus nyal 'gro thams cad bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i zhag bdun gyi ring dan 'bag gling khar nad sel sman gyi dga' ston la sgar byas nas bsdad/ 'di lo nas bzung chu zhugs la phyin res kyi grong smad nas bzhes sprod gzab rgyas bstar/ ra ba stod par dol brgyad gra'i mchod gzhis dang gsang phu spyi sor zul phu'i dbyar (123ba)chos phyi mas mtshon bstan rgyun la phan pa'i sde par bka' 'phros gnang / khal kha phyogs dus 'jam pa 'dug rung o rod du gzhung don la 'dul ba bla ma ngag dbang chos 'phel rdzong bda' byas/ bod kyi bde thabs su gtsang 'gram lha khang zhig gsos dang gnas 'dzin sgrol ma nas lta bus byas na yong tshul sde par zhus pa thugs la babs pa'i phyag tu bkal/ dben sa dgon pas go chod pas lha khang 'di med kyang yong zhu mkhan byung gsung ba mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang de thog ma nas dben sa'i thad der brtsigs na yong rgyur chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por mngon mkhyen med pa'i skyon yin pa 'dra/lug sprel gyi mtshams su chos 'khor gling zhal snga nas dkar po ba 'brum nad kyis grongs pas 'chad nyan du mnga' ris gra tshang slob dpon gnyal pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las bskos/ khong pa 'dzin she yangs pas paṇa chen gyi yig cha rnams gtong rtsis 'dug rung / sde pas dpe cha rnams dam 'byar gyis mnan pa'i se ra byes pa'i lugs thong gsungs par gra dmangs rnams bla ma byes pa'i rtsa grar song bas byas so snyam pa'i log rtog gis lugs mi legs pa chen po yong grabs byung / zhal snga nas mdzad bstad pas gnyer pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos grags sbran nas phar phyin gyi yig cha rtsom dgos tshul byung ba ltar gling smad zhabs drung sku zhabs su mdzod kyi sngon du phar phyin 'bri ba'i dgos don 'di bzhin byung tshul snyan 'bul zhu bar btang / 'di lo phar phyin gyi ṭīk+ka thal 'phreng zung 'brel gyi skabs gsum pa yan bris/ drung rams pa bsod nams chos bzang zhes dom bsnyag tu grags pas —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()grangs dga' ston lo lo bzhin bstar/ bzhugs gral zur gsos ster cha sogs bdag rkyen deb 'khod bzhin byas/ sne'u sdong zhabs drung rin po ches bka' shog tshigs bcad gnang 'dug par de mtshungs kyi zhu lan dang gong dkar nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos chab shog byung ba'i lan shes pa brjod pa'i tshig tu spel/ smon lam che chung gnyis la 'grul pa'i stabs kyis 'dod yon shin tu che yang rnam g.yeng gis khyer ba'i chos gra smon lam gra skor ni smar rgyu ma byung / jo shāka /thugs rje chen po/rje btsun tsong kha pa/ dung skyong rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dpon slob gling smad zhabs drung gis dbu mdzad drag zhan mang pos da cha sde dpon lugs kyi rdzong gzhis kyi lte ba tsam zhig med na phugs bag drang zhing 'phral du rten 'brel kyang mi legs par 'dug /gzhis ka gong dkar yang ser 'bras sogs dang thag ring ba'i stabs po ta lar ar po gnang dgos tshul zhus pa ltar mchod yon gnyis sga'i dgongs pa bstad pa'i sa 'dul la yong dgos tshul byung ba bzhin hor zla gsum pa'i nyer lnga la po tā lar phyin/ dan 'bag rin chen sgang du slebs pa dang byang phyogs nas 'brug gi sgra chen po dang bcas char sa spang thub pa'i rdul mi ldang ba babs de nas bzung (126na)ma slebs bar rlung chen po rgyun mi chad pa byung ba ni rlung gi gur khang lta bu'i tshul du 'dug pas srid gsum bdag mo dgyes pa'i ltas yin nam snyam/ skabs re shar nub gnyis ka nas rlung 'tshubs te khol bur 'khrug pa ni sde brgyad kyi lhongs su snang / nyer drug la grabs yul rnams byas/ zur kun mkhyen chen pos bsangs rngan sogs sde brgyad cha mnyam pa zhogs ltar gyis gnang /bla mkhyen nang ra bas spom gtas mtshon pa'i rtsis skar nag gi gto chog rnams legs par bstar/sngon skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du lha 'dre rnams dam la btags pas bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang gegs med du grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi che ba dang bod 'dir slob dpon chen po dang sgrub pa bka' brgyad spyi bye brag rnams byin rlabs kyi tshad kha che bas byang gter phur pa lha nag gi dkyil 'a shegar zhal phye ste sgrub pa btsugs/nyer brgyad kyi nyin zur kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyis phyag dar te lto 'phye'i thig rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin 'debs pa gnang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dung rgyal ba tsong kha pas dga' ldan skor lam nas gdan drangs pa/ dpal dī paṃ ka ra'i chos dung / rje btsun sa paṇa gyi chos dung rnams kyi sgra phyogs kun tu bsgrags/nyer dgu'i dmag dpon tha skar gyi 'grub sbyor thog pho brang lte ba yong sa'i sa yul du mkhyen brtse chen mo'i phyag bzo'i phur cha yongs rdzogs gdan drangs/ dkon gnyer dbon dge steng bla mas 'cham —189

rnams kyis mdzad/ shangs su dga' ldan chos 'khor btsugs nas 'chad nyan la khar kha rab 'byams pa blo bzang dpal 'byor bskos/ tshogs chen la zhag nyi shu skor gyi bar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i skyes bu chung ngu'i phyed yan tsam la bshad lung shin tu zhib pa phul/sku mdun smon 'gro nas sku gzhen pa 'gyangs med du 'byon (128na)rtsis kyi 'phrin lan khung rgya mthun rkyen gyi lam yig bsrings/ 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi khyams ra'i zhig gsos kyi thebs gtsang gi chos sde chen po'i shing cha sogs da la'i kun ci rgyal mos phul bar brten nang ka ba brgya sgo khang ka ba brgyad kyis jo shāka gi zhabs tog dang mnyan yod mchod pa'i dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar dmigs pa legs par 'grub/ bsam yas su gtsang dus kyi mchod 'bul rgyun 'dug la gong 'phel gyi tshul du mchod 'bul ba lngas mchod pa sna lnga drug cu re/ dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po cher gsar 'dzugs kyi mchod pa sna lnga lnga bcu tham pa 'bul bar nyang rong gra tshang gi gra pa lnga sde res skor gyis gtan 'jags su byas kyang bsam yas kyi de grangs tshang phyag tu ma khel ba'i 'phros shig snang / bde chen chos 'khor nas ba so'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga chung ngu'i rten dang bcas pa'i yig lan snyan ngag dang rje btsun mi la lta bu'i grags pa don ldan gyi grub chen dka' bcu bag dro ngag dbang lhun grub la ched du bsngags pa'i 'phrin yig tshig bcad bskur/ e pa dpon yig chos nor bu dang ngag dbang dpal 'byor gnyisakyis glegs bam mang du bzhengs shing ngag dbang dpal 'byor da lta'i bar du yi ge 'bri bar rkang tshugs su bsdad/dbyar ston gyi ring gra tshang la dkon gnyer dpon dge steng bla mas phur pa dang rdo rje brag pa'i sku mdun kun bzang dbang pos tshe bdag gi gdangs dbyangs yongs rdzogs dang kha shas la gtor bzo'i phyag len khrid/ dkon gnyer dpon pos bskul ba'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ rong pa sku mdun gyi ngor gsol 'debs smon lam/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos grags kyi 'dod pa bzhin chos gling —192

zhabs tog dang mnyan yod mchod pa'i dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar dmigs pa legs par 'grub/ bsam yas su gtsang dus kyi mchod 'bul rgyun 'dug la gong 'phel gyi tshul du mchod 'bul ba lngas mchod pa sna lnga drug cu re/ dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po cher gsar 'dzugs kyi mchod pa sna lnga lnga bcu tham pa 'bul bar nyang rong gra tshang gi gra pa lnga sde res skor gyis gtan 'jags su byas kyang bsam yas kyi de grangs tshang phyag tu ma khel ba'i 'phros shig snang / bde chen chos 'khor nas ba so'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga chung ngu'i rten dang bcas pa'i yig lan snyan ngag dang rje btsun mi la lta bu'i grags pa don ldan gyi grub chen dka' bcu bag dro ngag dbang lhun grub la ched du bsngags pa'i 'phrin yig tshig bcad bskur/ e pa dpon yig chos nor bu dang ngag dbang dpal 'byor gnyisakyis glegs bam mang du nges dang sgra ka lā pa yongs rdzogs 'gro yin yod tshod du gda'/'brug pa rang gi pha chos tsho ni yod pa gzhir bcas shing phyag rgya ba'i bzang rdzu'i sbubs ni shin tu che/snyan grags la dpags (134na)pa'i mkhas pa rang ni dka' ba 'dug /dge bshes dge dar ba sngar nas rim gror dgos pa'i lag len rnams khral chos tsam las do gal chung zhing lo snga ma'i nang du 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i tshe bum zhig bzheng bcug pa bum pa la sna tshogs rdo rje brgyab pa 'di 'dra chos rje sku skyes ri mor thon pa sor bzhag gi bris pa ngas mar dang zan la ga nas thon sogs sgyur sbyang che ba byed 'dug par gnyen po bsten pa dang yul ngan spong pa'i dper bsams ya bo ma byas/'di'i skabs sde pas yol rin chen gling gi bla ma'i 'os shig e yod 'dri bar gra tshang la rgyal mo chung bas phul ba'i bla bre ka gling bzhi tsam khebs pa gnyis kyang sbubs zos byas pa sogs gang ci nas nye bar 'khod pa ya mi mtshan par mngon te khong pa 'os su phul/ mchod dpon la blo bzang lung rigs gra tshang gi dkon gnyer thems zin lag pa bde bar 'dug pa bskos pas phyag len rnams bkod pa dang mthun pa byung / sngar ras bris la brten pa'i phur sgrub bsdus tsam zhig las med pas gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gyis rtsa 'cham dang bris thig sogs pho brang yas mas kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin khrid par rnying ma rang skad kyi sgrub chen gzhung bsrangs pa'i chog khrigs brtsams pa btsugs shing nged rang nas kyang bris thig sbyong bdar byas/ rta nag sgrol ma phug pa rin spungs par phyogs 'phul gyis gtsang dus sku rim la 'jug med pas mngon spyod skor la do ma gal ba'i mtha' ma chod rung / sde pas sku rim pa bcol bar brten chos rje ma chen phyag len 'dra 'khrid par byung bar 'joms byed nyi zla nag po/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'jam dpal skor sogs dbang lung lag len kha yar phul/ khong pas brtan bzhugs(134ba)—201—

gling bzhi tsam khebs pa gnyis kyang sbubs zos byas pa sogs gang ci nas nye bar 'khod pa ya mi mtshan par mngon te khong pa 'os su phul/ mchod dpon la blo bzang lung rigs gra tshang gi dkon gnyer thems zin lag pa bde bar 'dug pa bskos pas phyag len rnams bkod pa dang mthun pa byung / sngar ras bris la brten pa'i phur sgrub bsdus tsam zhig las med pas gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gyis rtsa 'cham dang bris thig sogs pho brang yas mas kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin khrid par rnying ma rang skad kyi sgrub chen gzhung bsrangs pa'i chog khrigs brtsams pa btsugs shing nged rang nas kyang bris thig sbyong bdar byas/ rta nag sgrol ma phug pa rin spungs par phyogs 'phul gyis gtsang dus sku rim la 'jug med pas mngon spyod skor la do ma gal ba'i mtha' ma chod rung / sde pas sku rim pa bcol bar brten chos rje ma chen phyag len 'dra 'khrid par byung bar 'joms byed nyi zla nag po/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'jam dpal skor sogs dbang lung lag len kha yar phul/ khong pas brtan bzhugs(134ba)—201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tshigs bcad cig kyang brtsams/ gsol 'debs dgos tshul byung ba'ang bris/ rin po che khra tshang pa phrad par byon/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i tshems shig ster sbyin mdzad/ gnam lcags rdzas rgod kyi sgrub pa dang yang gsang las bzhi'i bsnyen mtshams shin tu dam pa zla lhag cig bcad/ sne'u gdong rtse zhabs drung ma chen/ stag lung zhabs drung kun spangs pa/ sku 'bum chos rje don grub rgya mtsho/smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta yab sras gnyis rnams kyi gsung shog gi lan rgyan gyis spras pa/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis bskul ba'i mchod yon gnyis kyi brtan bzhugs/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa nas 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel bar gyi lam rim bshad brgyud kyi brgyud 'debs/mkhan po thu mir ka 'phreng gi bstod pa rnams brtsams/ byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sprul sku gang du 'byon pa'i ri klung dgon grong gi dbyibs yol mo sprul pa'i skus phyag bris su mdzad de lung bstan pa dang mthun par sku skye mon mkhar rnam sras gling du byung / ngos 'dzin grub nas zla ba drug pa'i nang du phebs par tshes bcu dgu la gtsug phud blangs/ mtshan blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sder gsol/ lcags sdong ma'i tshe dbang dang le'u bdun ma bsam pa lhun grub mdun bskyed dang bcas pa cha tshang gi lung phul/ blo bzang zhes pa rab 'byams pa lnga ba sogs gra rigs 'ga'i blor ma babs 'dug par kun bzang byas na yong rgyur gzhan sems ma shes pa'i skyon du mchis/hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du sne'u gdong rtse nas (135na)zhabs drung rin po che yab sras lhan rgyas su phebs/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che'i gtsug phud blangs/ mtshan blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lhar gsol skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa/tshe dbang dang mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang phul/ dar rgyas chos sdings pa rig 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel bzhed pa dang sbyar/ ngam ring mkhan po lo chen byon/ jo bo chen po'i zhun thigs las grub ba'i tshe dpag med dang 'od dpag med kyi sku ster ba —202

po'i zhun thigs las grub ba'i tshe dpag med dang 'od dpag med kyi sku ster ba —202

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)mdzad/ 'on kyang jo bo chen po gdung nag tu song ba'i lo rgyus mang bas the tshom gyi gzhir snang / smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi tar shab gdong sna dang ngam ring lo chen la se mkhar chung ba'i sgrub gnas de dang 'brel ba'i sa ris 'os 'gab sde par zhus pa'i sbyor 'jags byas/ rtse zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che/ slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje gnyis dang / bsam yas gnod sbyin chen po'i gsung lan spyan gzigs bcas pa phul/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i smon lam/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pas zhabs drung gdung brgyud/ lo pa chos rjes nged rang / rab 'byams pa ngag dbang don grub kyis dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dang phyogs mthun du ngos kyi ming sgra thon pa/ rong po dka' bcu chos rjes kirti sku skye'i brtan bzhugs/ bla chen sku skyes rmog lcog pa'i skye srid myur 'byon gyi smon lam bskul ba rnams bris/ zla ba dgu ba'i nang du byang rtse zhal snga nas mnga' ris pa ngag dbang (135ba)rdo rje dbu mdzad/ smad rgyud dpon slob nyi shu skor/ sgo mang dang blo gsal gling gi slob dpon/ rnam rgyal gra tshang gi don du gnyer ba 'ga' zhig dang bcas par zhabrul 'khor khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi steng nas 'jigs byed kyi 'phrin las bzhi'i phyag len dpe klog dang bstun mchod dpon pas thig dang re'u mig bcad pa dka' bcu dom ras ma go bar kho rang tshos drug cu bar rtsibs 'don ma shes pa'i gru gsum 'drad ma shud byed par 'di 'dra yong zhes mkhas nyams kyang byed par snang mkhas grub rje'i las gsum rnam gzhag dang bstun pa'i mgon po'i gtor chen gtso 'khor gyi gtor ma'i bzo dbyibs dang 'khor lo'i phyag len rnams zhib par khrid cing de dag gi yig cha'i lung yang phul/ 'dul ba slob dpon zur pa rong tshad pas tshigs su bos nas chos rje don grub rin chen pa'i phyag ḍi dang rgya sbug khyad can zhig gis gtsos pa'i dngos po bstar/ se chen chos rje rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa khal khar bro 'tshal ba'i rim gror shes rab bla ma 'byor ba phyir log skabs gong ma rgyal por zhu yig rten sbrags phul/so ga gnas chung chos rgyal gyi sku khog nang so dgos nor 'das pa'i khog gsar rnams la phebs —203—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dgung lo so gcig par lha rtse dga' ldan 'og min gling dang / yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse btab cing / dbu ma theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings mdzad pa bcas kyi skor/lo 'jug dus rim dang me phag gi lo gsar rgyas par byas shing snyan dar 'dod gsol dang bcas pa phul/ 'phros gtam pa cha ma 'grig par glang bu nas la dri ba sgroms gang che'i bshad pas gral 'phros pa'i sa stong bgags/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas la drug cu pa'i lag len khrid/ smon lam du 'gro ba'i lam zhor la skyid shod zhabs drung gis bkra shis mthong smon du bos te skyed bu kha dro'i gzhis len dang tshan grangs bzabs/ ta 'on du ri yal dbon pos brgya 'bul byas/ chos gra smon lam 'phel bar byung / jo shāka /dung skyong rgyal mo/ gnas chung chos rgyal khog tu zhugs pa rnams la tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan dar phul zhing skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti bzang por de mtshungs kyi snyan shal 'bul rgyu bskur/ rgya ri dpon blon nas tshogs chen du mar 'gyed dang bdog pa rgyas par bskrun/ rgya ri ba/ skyid shod ba/ de mo sprul sku/ chos rje tre bo sogs skya ser mang po la gung tshigs kyi bzhugs gral dang mchod dbyangs gra skor bar dgongs ja bu ram sngar 'byud bzhin btang / de thog drung 'tsho ba dpon por gso ba rig pa la brten pa'i 'phros gtam shin tu 'phel bar byung rgya ri dpon blon la tshe rta/pad+ma gling pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang / phyag drug (137na)pa'i rjes gnang / zhabs drung la sger du dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang phul zhing rdzong ba gzab par byas/ chos rje 'od 'bar gyis bskul nas rgya ri zhabs drung gi brtan bzhugs/ rtsed thang las chen mtshan sgrogs pa'i 'dod sbyar bzhin gra skor gyi bca' tshe/ dge slong nam mkha' lha dbang gi kha tan du phyag drug pa'i bstod pa dang bslab bya/ lha pa dbon —205—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()blon gyis phar phyin/ mdzod/ rgyal rabs gsum par du brko ba'i thugs rtsis 'dug pa'i par byang tshigasabacad par yig pa gnyis kyi kha tan smon lam/ me rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtshos byams pa gdan 'dren gyi shing rta 'khor lo ngo mtshar ba bzos pa'i smon lam/ da la'i bā thur dang tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi nyams len du seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs rnams bris/'brug pa sprul sku dbu che rnams dang bcas phebs gtsug phud blangs mtshan blo bzang mi pham dbang po nges don grub pa'i shing rta bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i sder gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bsgrubs bzhugs gral la gral 'phros pa par bkab cig med pas nged rang gis sa stong dgog pa'i 'phros gleng mang tsam byas mthar blo gsal gling slob dpon dam chos rnam rgyal dang chos 'khor gling slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'phrin las gnyis rigs lung la bslangs/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /sgrol dkar/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang dang bla chas chibs chas kyis gtsos pa'i shangs len rgyas par phul/ de mtshungs bde chen chos 'khor/ drin las pa/ lcog gra pas mtshon bla khag mang dag la'ang mjal dar slog 'tshems med (137ba)du byin/ zi na nang sos gtsos mdo smad kyi gsar 'grul 'ga' zhig 'byor bar 'dod chos ci rigs byas/ lam zhor du po tā la'i rdzong gi lte ba lam tsam thebs 'dug par ltad mor shog gsung ba bzhin phyin/ 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan shal phul/ gung gi dro bstab nas 'bras spungs su slebs/ zangs ri dpon sa yum sras/ gling stod chos rje/rong tshang chos rje sogs la nang mjal dang dpon sa yum sras la tshe rta phul/ gling stod rtan smon lam/ me rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtshos byams pa gdan 'dren gyi shing rta 'khor lo ngo mtshar ba bzos pa'i smon lam/ da la'i bā thur dang tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyi nyams len du seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs rnams bris/'brug pa sprul sku dbu che rnams dang bcas phebs gtsug phud blangs mtshan blo bzang mi pham dbang po nges don grub pa'i shing rta bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i sder gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bsgrubs bzhugs gral la gral 'phros pa par bkab cig med pas nged rang gis sa stong dgog pa'i 'phros gleng mang tsam byas mthar blo gsal gling slob dpon dam chos rnam rgyal dang chos 'khor gling slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'phrin las gnyis rigs lung la bslangs/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /sgrol dkar/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang dang bla chas chibs chas kyis gtsos pa'i shangs len rgyas par phul/ de mtshungs bde chen chos 'khor/ drin las pa/ lcog gra pas mtshon bla khag mang dag la'ang mjal dar slog 'tshems med (137ba)du byin/ zi na nang sos gtsos mdo smad rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()pa blo gros rnam rgyal rdzong bda'i sta gon gyi rnam 'joms sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig dang bsnyen (140na)rdzogs 'dod sbyar byas/de mo sprul sku dang mnga' ris grub chen snying stobs rgya mtsho can la 'dod chos kyi lung kha yar bklags/ khams pa sngags 'chang gis bskur ba'i rgyal po byes chas kyi ngag bsgrigs/ a khu drung yig gi kha tan tu gtor ma brgya rtsa tshigs bcad ma/ don gnyer can 'dras bskul ba'i gsang ba'i rnam thar bri ba'i sa bon dgos tshul gyi paṇa chen rin po cher zhu 'phrin/ gong ra lo tsā ba'i snyan ngag gi yig lan/ bsam yas dang tshangs pa chen por spyan gzigs phul ba'i 'phrin gsol rnams spel/ brag sna chos rjes gong ra ba'i lag gi dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo par ma zhig khur 'dug pa khang brtsegs sogs yul bkod 'dra rung ba la chu babs nas mu khyud kyi rked pa rnams bcad 'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i mtshan nyid ci yang mi 'dug pas zog chos su mngon/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa drug pas ngam ring lha chen gyi thugs ka nas bton zer ba'i stong skad can de yin 'dra'o/ phal cher la mtshams byas khog snyan ngag me long gi 'grel pa zla ba bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa nyis brtsegs kyi snga ma'i ring rdzogs par brtsams nas smon 'gro paṇa chen yab sras la gzigs 'bul du btang bar legs so'i snyan ngag gi 'phrin lan rgyas par byung ba bstan bcos kyi mjug tu par la brkos yod/ gling smad dbon pos yong dgos tshul byung ba ltar gsang phur phyin zhag gnyis bsdad/ dpon slob de nyid kyi dngul gdung gsar bzhengs la me tog gtor shis pa brjod cing dngul gdung dang bse khrab pa'i snyan dar la zhal byang bkod/zla ba bcu (140ba〉na nyis pa'i 'gor zur thams cad mkhyen par zab chos ci rigs zhus/ sto khal kha nas zhabs drung byams pa'i sprul sku'i mi sna/ rgyal byed chos rje/ no mon ta ra can 'grul pa kha yar 'byor cing mang 'gyed dang ster sbyin byung /—210

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)dgung lo so gnyis par dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse dang / dol gsung rab gling btab cing pho brang po ta la'i ldebs bris gsar bzhengs bcas kyi skor/dus rim gyi phur sgrub zor las/ sa byi'i lo gsar dmag zor ma'i bskang ba rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon la sngar rgyun bzhin phyin pa'i snyan shal/ sne'u gdong rtse nas lo gsar gyi bka' shog tshigs bcad ma 'dug pa'i lan phul/ lha sa smon lam gyi gral dbu byas pa'i chos gra smon lam chag med dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya skor bsgrubs shing / nya stong brgyad gsum la bsnyen gnas ma tshor sdom pa phab/ jo shāka gis gtsos pa'i mchod khang rags rim la 'dod don gsol ba'i snyan shal sgron/ zha lu ri sbug dbu mdzad rin chen bsod nams mchog grub zhabs skor du byon 'dug pa bka' brgyad sbug tu gung gi dro'i thog rgyud sde rnams las brtsams pa'i gsung 'phros zhib tu byung bas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nges pa rnyed/ 'grul pa rnams lugs gnyis kyis re ba bskang ba'i rdzong bda' byas/ byams pa sprul sku dang er ti ni khung tha'i ji la rgyan gyis spras pa'i yi ge bsrings/ 'di lo dbus dpung rnams kyis spu nag khar tsha lam gyis slebs sar phyin/ gtsang dpung gis hung ral khar skor rgyag tsha grul bas da cha zla gcig tshun la jus 'gro tshul sa gro rtse bkras bzhis sde par zhus 'dug kyang sde pa nor bu sdod ma nus par 'ur zhogs kyis bros pas sgar chas dang go cha phal cher yang shor ba'i phag ring dkyil sgar la lcog bu zhig 'bubs dgos (141na)pa sogs skad cha bshad thebs med pa mang po gleng 'dug/de'i skyon gyis dbus dpung rnams kyang tshur bsdog par dka' tshegs shin tu che bas drung che 'or gsum yang 'khang lang tsha bar snang / lo sngon ma'i brgyad gtor gyi rten 'brel legs pa dang mtshungs par ston mjug yar klungs bkra shis rtse ba'i dge ba'i gral dbur zha lu nas gnas gsar dbon —211—

shal /de nga bcas brgyad gtor grub rjes rgyud pa zhal snga nas dam chos rnam rgyal la phyag drug pa dang chos rgyal gyi rjes gnang dang sang sing bla ma kun dga' don ldan sogs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang phul zhing mi bzang rnams la tshe mgon gyi rjes gnang byas/ sde pa 'dam bsam grub sde chen gyi mkhar las kyi zhal bkod la thegs skabs ar po la brten pa'i bar chad mi gleng rgyas pa bla ma tsho dang go log pa zhig 'dug /'di lo dbyar bdag byed dgos tshul byung ba bzhin dbyar gnas la bsdad cing slob dpon rnams kyis kyang (143na)dbyar zhal gyis bzhes/blo gsal gling zhal snga nas 'bur ltag pas dbyar zla ba gsum rang byed dgos gsung bar gzhan rnams ha las pa'i de 'dra yin na dbyar gnas mi byed ces phyi 'then brgyab byung / don la blo gsal gling pa bden pa 'dug kyang dmangs dang bstun dkyus kyi phyag len phyed po de ga byas/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ dpal mar me mdzad/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa rnams la gsol 'debs snyan ngag nas drangs pa re bris/ chos rje dbon rin po che phebs/ thig le bcu drug gi yig rnying dang bka' gdams pha chos nasachos thun gsum bzhi zhig /rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i nye brgyud kyi tshe dbang / sha ba ri lugs kyi zhal gyi las tshogs gang thob kyi lung phul/ snyan brgyud slob bshad kyi skor gyis mtshon pa'i dam pa'i chos—214

stobs chen bzhi'i bzhugs gral du ni chud par mi gda'/ rdo rje brag nas rig 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches/ blon po bka' thang las/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nyid: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las lnga: 'phrul lnga bsgyur ba'i stobs su 'gyur 'dra min zhig dang ma nor na gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don mdzad byang ming 'dul skyong gnam sa'i bdag za hor chab las 'bebs pa 'byung : zhes pa nyang chos dbang paṇa chen dbang po'i sde yan yongs grags dang bar skabs su gtsang sde srid rkarma bstan skyong dbang po la yang srid kyi grags pa che ba 'dra min dang (146ba)dngos bstan de nged la ngos 'dzin pa snang yang smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas 'don zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas gter zhig dgos rgyur chu stag bsam yas su 'gro gdong gnas chung chos rgyal gyis da lam las mkhan gyis gter thon zer byung na rten 'brel gyi sgor gnod pa yod pas ma 'don zhes mchod dpon par nan gyis gsungs 'dug pa rta mgrin gling ras kha byang zhig rnyed pa'i 'byas byung yang do gal ma byas pas de 'dra'i re ba gang la yod/ gal te las 'phro sad pa zhig yin kyang skye ba brgyud dgos rgyu nas da lam dog 'tshang mi zhu/mnga' ris grub chen snying stobs rgya mtshos/ glegs bam pha chos kyi lung bstan du/ de'i dus kyi skye ba de/ me'i son las rus byas pa'i lugs yin chos gang byas ngar che lhag por drag po'i bsnyen pa la bsngags/ bdud sde dang sdig can gyis mi bzod pa'i rigs yin des rtsod pa dang phas tshus zer mang 'o na'ang rang pham par mi nus zhes par ngos 'dzin pa lo khams 'grig pa tsam las gzhan ma'i —219—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tig bstad ci yod/ shing yos dum bu gnas pa rnams kyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung skabs/ rab 'byamasachos rje'i rin chen rgya mtshos/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ston pa'i gsung rab sa steng du/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /yi ge ma zhes ga'o zhe nu zhes/ /zhes pa yin tshul gyi rgyu mtshan mdzad pa blo'i skad dod mi lha dang sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis bu lha dang ma ti sogs 'jog pa 'dug mod/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i mtshan (147na 'a blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes pas the mi tshom par snang / 'on kyang rang rang gi dag snang mdzad par rjes su yi rang ngo / /dgung lo so gsum par rgya nag tu phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba dang / sto brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling btab pa bcas kyi skor/lo mjug gi dus rim dang sa glang gi lo gsar thog mchod sprin snyan shal spros nas smon lam chen mor phyin pa'i sngar 'khyud bzhin byas/ gtsang khang byang gi lcog 'og ka bzhi mar sde pas zhal bkod mdzad de rten mchod rgya mi chung tsam gyi mchod khang gsar du bsgrigs 'dug /tshes gsum la pho brang chen po po ta lar slebs/ gong gi gser yig pa rnams la tshe rta/ mgon po/ lo ma rgyan ma/ 'od zer can ma sogs rjes gnang kha yar dang 'dod chos kyi lung 'ga' zhig byas/ gong gi bka' ma bzlog par yong ba'i khas len zhus/ rgya nag yul gru ches pas 'brum pa dang tshad pa'i nad kyi dogs pa yong 'dug pas yun ring mi 'thogs par dgos pa'i zhib cha'i rgyu mtshan 'bul bar zhu yig rten sbrags dang bcas dka' bcu shes rab rgyal mtshan dang de'i lo stor hor bkra shis btang mi sna rnams dang lhan du 'gro mi gsar 'grul tshor lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas re ba bskang /—220

nyin lnga tsam bstud pa bstan 'dzin chos rgyal la sku dog cher yod pa rim gros bzlog par snang /zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du gnas rnying zhabs drung dang se ra byes (149na)pa'i slob dpon pas gtsos pa'i gra pa kha shas/ rta nag sgrol ma nas sku mched/ gra tshang gi gra pa rags bsdus sogs la pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang bzhi rta pad kyi lung dang bcas pa/ se ra byes smad kyi gra pa sum brgya skor la rgyal ba tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i bstod chen bzhi sogs chos spyod kha shas dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi lung / de rnams kyi thog gso rig slob gra dang rmi ru ba rnams la sman bla sprul sku dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang byas/ gnas rnying zhabs drung dpon slob nyung bsdus la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa dang mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang nye brgyud rnams phul/ gra tshang gis yun du gnas pa'i tshan grangs dang bcas rten 'byung bsgrigs/ bla ma sgrol ma nas/ sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad bzhi la rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i rdzogs chen klong gsal gyi dbang lung dang ka dag gi nyams 'khrid zhag nyi shu'i bar smin rgyas su phab/ phyogs 'dus kyi rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu skor bsgrubs/ tshes bco lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyin pa'i 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ring por gnas pa'i bden tshig gi smon lam mdzad cing chos rgyal chen po'ang khog tu zhugs nas phebs/ zhar la gso sbyong byas te po tā lar nyin skor du slebs/ tshes bcu dgu la se ra theg chen gling tshogs chen gyis po tā la'i tshoms chen du bdog pa dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel —223—

gra pa kha shas/ rta nag sgrol ma nas sku mched/ gra tshang gi gra pa rags bsdus sogs la pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang bzhi rta pad kyi lung dang bcas pa/ se ra byes smad kyi gra pa sum brgya skor la rgyal ba tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i bstod chen bzhi sogs chos spyod kha shas dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi lung / de rnams kyi thog gso rig slob gra dang rmi ru ba rnams la sman bla sprul sku dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang byas/ gnas rnying zhabs drung dpon slob nyung bsdus la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa dang mgon po snying zhugs kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang nye brgyud rnams phul/ gra tshang gis yun du gnas pa'i tshan grangs dang bcas rten 'byung bsgrigs/ bla ma sgrol ma nas/ sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad bzhi la rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i rdzogs chen klong gsal gyi dbang lung dang ka dag gi nyams 'khrid zhag nyi shu'i bar smin rgyas su phab/ phyogs 'dus kyi rab byung bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu skor bsgrubs/ tshes bco lnga la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyin pa'i 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis ring por gnas pa'i bden tshig gi smon lam mdzad cing chos rgyal chen po'ang khog tu zhugs nas phebs/ zhar la gso sbyong byas te po tā lar nyin skor du slebs/ tshes bcu dgu la se ra theg chen gling tshogs chen gyis po tā la'i tshoms chen du bdog pa dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel —223—

bdag bstod/ lha sa'i tshes bcu pa rnams kyi 'dod pa bzhin le'u bdun brgyud 'debs mjug tu ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dang bcas pa rnams brtsams/ de mo sprul sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan bar khams su 'byon gdong chos nyan pa sum cu skor la nyang lugs drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang / ras chud lugs kyi rta mgrin/rigs gsum mgon po/ sme brtsegs/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i tshe dbang nye brgyud dang thang stong rgyal po'i 'chi (150na)med dpal ster sogs rjes gnang kha shas dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti dang po/ las chen kun rgyal ba'i bka' gdams chos 'byung phyed nag gam bshan pa mig dmar gyi dbang lung / gshin rje khro chu'i dbang lung / bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi srog dbang /—224—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dregs pa nyi shu'i lung phyag 'khrid kyis mtshon pa'i 'dod chos mang du byas/ gzungs gzhugs 'bul tshul gyi yig cha zhig dgos gsungs pa'ang brtsams/ chos rje brag sna ba can chos zhu gzhi ba rnams la bka' gdams chos 'byung gi 'phro rdzogs par byas/ chos rje dpon dar ba/ grub chen bag dro ngag dbang lhun grub/ byang ngos nas sku gzhon pa/ rgya yags dge slong / mchod dpon/ dbu mdzad rnams la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams 'khrid slob bshad lugs kyi snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi dang ldan pa zla gcig la nye bar phab/ grub chen bag dro la mnal ltas kyang legs pa byung snang /zla ba bdun pa'i nang du me'i spu gri dang bshor sang nyi ma khros kyi sgrub pa btsugs skabs mtshams khang thog tu bya rog 'dzings nas kha yar bsad pa'i 'tshub ltas sna tshogs byung / se ra rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas la drug cu pa'i phyag len khrid/ byes pa slob dpon 'phrin las bsam grub kyis gsol 'debs dgos tshul byung ba brtsams (150ba)rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas gzungs gzhugs 'bul tshul zhib tu sbyangs nas rdzing phyir gtsang gi chos sde chen po'i dngul gdung gsar bsgrigs mdzad song bar gzungs 'bul la brdzangs/ pha bong khar rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi 'bur sku zhig mi snang bas sprul sku ba rnams kyis sngags sku dang lhan du bzhengs/ bstan pa spyi dang sgrub sde 'phel zhing rgyas pa/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'dod gsol dmigs phug ste dpal ldan bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i smon lam chos srungs la gnyer gtad kyi phyag len gang zhib kyi lus lag dar nas phul/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug nas byang chub shing gi nags khrod du zla ba brgyad par spyan drangs/ dkar chag zhig kyang brtsams zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma la sngags gsar rnying gi zab chos mang du zhus/ khyad par pu tra'i rjes gnang gi dus ser chol dang drag po dbu dgu pa'i dbang la 'tshi che ba byung / sngar 'bras spungs spyi sos rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang dgos gsungs byung ba mtshan nyid kyi gra sar dbang gi bed kyang chung de las rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung rab kyis mtshon pa'i rlung gi rigs mkho ba 'dra gleng rung 'phreng ba dgos pa'i bskul —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ma yang yang byung ba nas/ sngar dbang ji lta ba zhig ma thob pas 'phreng ba dang zur bka'i dbang mang tsam gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan gsan 'bul bar sde pas sman grong spel ba tshe dbang dar rgyal yar klungs bkra shis rtser rdzong bda' mdzad/zla ba bcu pa'i 'gor rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po phebs/ rang byon 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang (151na)phyug gi gtsug lag khang du spyi bka' dang zur bka' bsdoms pa'i dbang drug cu skor dang gsung ngag slob bshad kyi nyams 'khrid shin tu rgyas pa bcas zla ba gsum gyi rnam g.yeng gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i smin rgyas su zhus/ snang gsum skabs srid pa'i bde ba la skyug log pa'i thar pa zhig ma bsgrubs na gang gis kyang mi phan pa 'dug snyam pas zas kyi dang kha'ang 'gags pa dang rgyud gsum gyi tshe snang ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i ban bun gyis bdag 'dzin mngon gyur ba non pa'i rgyun de ga skyong rgyu byung na chos pa dga' mo zhig yong tshod du snang yang rjes su dgun gyi na bun ltar yal nas bya lam rjes med du song / paṇa chen smon 'gro ba rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng 'dzin de gtsug lag bye ba'i yon tan gyi phung po dang bcas rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing du gshegs par sras kyis bsngo rten gnas tshul zhib cha skyel mi mngags par skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'phrin lan bdog pa'i skyes bsrings/ gsung chos stabs rdo rje slob dpon du 'gro ma thub pas gra tshang gis dus rim 'bras spungs su btang / rme —226

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)dgung lo so bzhi par lam rim dang sngags rim sogs kyi 'khrid lung stsal tshul dang / ra sgreng gi gtsug lag khang la nyams gso gnang ba bcas kyi skor/lcags stag gi lo gsar po ta lar byas nas smon lam chen mor phyin/ 'di lo lho byang gi 'grul pa nyung bas longs spyod mi che'ang chos gra smon lam gra skor rnams 'phel ba byung / jo shāka sogs la phan bde spel ba'i smon tshig gi snyan dar phul/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs drug cu tsam bsgrubs/ bla ma lha rtse ba'i sku skyer gu ru yon tan gter mdzod kyi dbang dang las gshin phyir sgrub kyi rjes gnang bskur/lo snga (151ba)ma rgyal mo chung ba'i phyi rten la dngul gdung bzhengs pa klu rgyal steng du bzhugs par 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgo nas rab gnas 'bring po byas/ smon lam grol bstun 'bras spungs su slebs/zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du rgyal po mchod yon gyi sku rim la mdzod dbus ma nas byon pa'i 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga 'khrugs sdebs su bkod de btang bas rten 'brel gyi ltas legs pa byung /cha gan no mon khan gyis gtsos gsar 'grul kha shas 'byor/ no mon khan gyis thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag sbug hor chol gyis gtsos bdog pa'i skyes mang du byin/ gsar 'grul la chos dang zang zing gi phan pa bsgrubs/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skur nyang lugs drag po'i dbang rdo rje sbyi blugs dang byang gter nas nyer mkho kha shas kyi lung phul/ pad+ma gling pa'i gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje skor chen bshag pa dang sbrags byon byung ba'i gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i thun ru rin spungs pa'i nang rten chos mdzad rgyal po don grub nas brgyud pa de ster sbyin mdzad/ 'di'i cha de lha lung gra tshang pas phyis su sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs la phul 'dug pa skam thun dang rlon thun gyi snod du mngon/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug yig rnying gi lung phul/ khong snga 'gyur gyi mkhas grub chen po —227

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dgung lo so bzhi par lam rim dang sngags rim sogs kyi 'khrid lung stsal tshul dang / ra sgreng gi gtsug lag khang la nyams gso gnang ba bcas kyi skor/lcags stag gi lo gsar po ta lar byas nas smon lam chen mor phyin/ 'di lo lho byang gi 'grul pa nyung bas longs spyod mi che'ang chos gra smon lam gra skor rnams 'phel ba byung / jo shāka sogs la phan bde spel ba'i smon tshig gi snyan dar phul/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs drug cu tsam bsgrubs/ bla ma lha rtse ba'i sku skyer gu ru yon tan gter mdzod kyi dbang dang las gshin phyir sgrub kyi rjes gnang bskur/lo snga (151ba)ma rgyal mo chung ba'i phyi rten la dngul gdung bzhengs pa klu rgyal steng du bzhugs par 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgo nas rab gnas 'bring po byas/ smon lam grol bstun 'bras spungs su slebs/zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du rgyal po mchod yon gyi sku rim la mdzod dbus ma nas byon pa'i 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga 'khrugs sdebs su bkod de btang bas rten 'brel gyi ltas legs pa byung /cha gan no mon khan gyis gtsos gsar 'grul kha shas 'byor/ no mon khan gyis thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag sbug hor chol gyis gtsos bdog pa'i skyes mang du byin/ gsar 'grul la chos dang zang zing gi phan pa bsgrubs/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skur nyang lugs drag po'i dbang rdo rje sbyi blugs dang byang gter nas nyer mkho kha shas kyi lung phul/ pad+ma gling pa'i gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje skor chen bshag pa dang sbrags byon byung ba'i gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i thun ru rin spungs pa'i nang rten chos mdzad rgyal po don grub nas brgyud pa de ster sbyin mdzad/ 'di'i cha de lha lung gra tshang pas phyis su sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs la phul 'dug pa skam thun dang rlon thun gyi snod du mngon/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug yig rnying gi lung phul/ khong snga 'gyur gyi mkhas grub chen po —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()la mi dge ba'i bshes kyis dben bcos pa'i skyo ma snga btsan zhig 'dug par rje zur pa'i bde 'dus kyi dbang lung gi brgyud par rig 'dzin chen po dgos nges snang rtse bas sbas pa da lam 'bri gung du 'byon tshe dogs pa chod yong tshul mol bas zhabs drung dang mjal ba nas bzung thugs nges (152na)rnyed pa'i gong ra ba'i rdzun phugs rdib par snang / thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku dge bsnyen du bsgrubs shing mtshan bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjer btags/ ga rma gu ru'i gtor bzlog gi sgrub pa la mtshams shin tu dam par bcad zla ba gsum pa'i brgyad gtor e waṃ pho brang du grags pa gsar pa der byas/gong dkar chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis dbang chas mchod chas gsar bzo'i bkod pa mang du mdzad cing lcags yos dang shing lug tshor gar 'cham gyi chas kyi bzo bkod dang de mthun deb ther bsgrigs pa sogs byas pa dngos gtsang zhing las rjes che ba zhig yin/ gong du dka' bcu shes rab pa rdzong bda' zhus pa yar log pa dang lhan du nom chi bla ma/ ta 'on nor bu dbon po/ do no'i khi ya gsum gyis gtso me pa'i gser yig pa gtos che ba 'grul sdebs mang ba dang bcas 'byor/ slar yang pho brang du yong dgos pa'i bka' shog dngos po gnangs che ba'i gnang sbyin rnams sprad/ 'grul pa rnams kyi mang 'gyed zhag bcu sbrel dang de bar ster cha khor yug tu blangs/ 'bras spungs bde yangs gra tshang la tshad ma'i 'chad nyan ra ba stod pa'i lugs ltar btsugs pa'i slob dpon du rmi ru dka' bcu pa phun tsho gos chos ldan bskos/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mdos bskang sngar rgyun bzhin btang / byang rwa sgreng gi gtsug lag khang khyams chen dang bcas pa gog nyams che bar zhig gsos sngar las rgyas pa sde pas thugs khur bzhes nas bsgrubs/zla ba drug pa'i nang du gong gi mi sna tsho dang lhan du se chen dbon po blo bzang chos 'phel rdzong bda' byas pa'i zhu yig rten sbrags phul/ cha gan no mon khan la (152ba)rjes gnang dang dngos po'i rdzong ba'i 'brel ba sogs la nyin gsum bzhi tsam ma gtogs zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas brgyad pa snga ma'i chu zhugs kyi bar dpe mtshams kyi ngos paṇa chen thar pa rtse pas mdzad pa'i 'phreng ba'i mngon —228

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()la mi dge ba'i bshes kyis dben bcos pa'i skyo ma snga btsan zhig 'dug par rje zur pa'i bde 'dus kyi dbang lung gi brgyud par rig 'dzin chen po dgos nges snang rtse bas sbas pa da lam 'bri gung du 'byon tshe dogs pa chod yong tshul mol bas zhabs drung dang mjal ba nas bzung thugs nges (152na)rnyed pa'i gong ra ba'i rdzun phugs rdib par snang / thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku dge bsnyen du bsgrubs shing mtshan bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjer btags/ ga rma gu ru'i gtor bzlog gi sgrub pa la mtshams shin tu dam par bcad zla ba gsum pa'i brgyad gtor e waṃ pho brang du grags pa gsar pa der byas/gong dkar chos rje dkon gnyer dpon pa dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis dbang chas mchod chas gsar bzo'i bkod pa mang du mdzad cing lcags yos dang shing lug tshor gar 'cham gyi chas kyi bzo bkod dang de mthun deb ther bsgrigs pa sogs byas pa dngos gtsang zhing las rjes che ba zhig yin/ gong du dka' bcu shes rab pa rdzong bda' zhus pa yar log pa dang lhan du nom chi bla ma/ ta 'on nor bu dbon po/ do no'i khi ya gsum gyis gtso me pa'i gser yig pa gtos che ba 'grul sdebs mang ba dang bcas 'byor/ slar yang pho brang du yong dgos pa'i bka' shog dngos po gnangs che ba'i gnang sbyin rnams sprad/ 'grul pa rnams kyi mang 'gyed zhag bcu sbrel dang de bar ster cha khor yug tu blangs/ 'bras spungs bde yangs gra tshang la tshad ma'i 'chad nyan ra ba stod pa'i lugs ltar btsugs pa'i slob dpon du rmi ru dka' bcu pa phun tsho gos chos ldan bskos/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mdos bskang sngar rgyun bzhin btang / byang rwa sgreng gi gtsug lag khang khyams chen dang bcas pa gog nyams che bar zhig gsos sngar las rgyas pa sde pas thugs khur bzhes nas bsgrubs/zla ba drug pa'i nang du gong gi mi sna tsho dang lhan du se chen dbon po blo bzang chos 'phel rdzong bda' byas pa'i zhu yig rten sbrags phul/ cha gan no mon khan la (152ba)rjes gnang dang dngos po'i rdzong ba'i 'brel ba sogs la nyin gsum bzhi tsam ma gtogs zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas brgyad pa snga ma'i chu zhugs kyi bar dpe mtshams kyi ngos paṇa chen thar pa rtse pas mdzad pa'i 'phreng ba'i mngon —228

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dkyil blor chud par byas/ 'bri gung zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa 'dul ba'i bstan bcos shig thugs rtsom gnang bzhed pas mdo rtsa'i dpe dag pa g.yar po dgos tshul phebs lan du snyan tshig nas drangs pa'i zhu 'phrin glegs bam dang bcas te phul/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po smon 'gro paṇa chen phebs pa'i zla gcig skor bzhugs/ li ma/ ya rtse/ rgya nag gsar rnying gi rten gyi dpyad don gyi ngo sprod zhib tu zhus/ e ri sgor zhal ngo bkra shis pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i bsngo rten skyel mi byung bar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ du ri yal khon jin 'byor ba'i gos dar gser dngul ja ras sa gdan rta snga mo'i stong 'bul bteg /gzhan gyi byad kha'i rnam pas khams nan tar ma bde 'dug pas rjes gnang gdon 'grol byab khrus byas pas phan ngo cung zad byung / dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las can rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kha shas bsgrubs/ gnas rnying zhabs drung gangs can mkhan po la rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum nang gi ni gu chos drug gis 'khrid kyi lung thugs dang sbyar/hor zla brgyad pa rjes ma'i nang du ya ma 'gram 'grig gi rnam pas bro 'tshal ba rim bde'i skabs khyab bdag bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po bka' chos rnams grub pa'i gung thang nas phebs/ rje btsun rdo rings pas mdzad pa'i mgon po'i gsang 'khrid dang / tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i phyi 'khrid nang 'khrid kyi rgyun 'byer sogs bka' chos thor (153na)bu dang / dkyil chog du ma'i phyag len dang phyag rgya 'ching tshul gyi phyag 'khrid dogs gcod zhus/ ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe chog gi rten 'brel zhig kyang gnang nas yar klungs su phebs/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang du tshogs chen la rje btsun myong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum khrod nas rje 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam thar/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gsang bdag la zhus pa'i gsang tshig /gsan yig stod cha/ lam rim che chung / sngags rim chen mo/ gsung 'bum thor bu nā ro chos drug gi 'khrid yig /bsre 'pho'i ga dmasang ga rim lnga bsdus pa/bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba/ rdor bzlas/ mngon par byang chub pa/ bdag byin rlabs/ dgongs pa bla na med pa rnams kyi zin bris/ sprin bral ba'i man ngag /kye rdor sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma'i dkyil —229

nang du tshogs chen la rje btsun myong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum khrod nas rje 'jam dpal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam thar/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gsang bdag la zhus pa'i gsang tshig /gsan yig stod cha/ lam rim che chung / sngags rim chen mo/ gsung 'bum thor bu nā ro chos drug gi 'khrid yig /bsre 'pho'i ga dmasang ga rim lnga bsdus pa/bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba/
