rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'khor/ brtag gnyis gsum gyi zin bris/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu nyid kyi don bshad pa/ 'pho ṭīka /sbyor drug tshigs4da dang de'i don bshad pa/ 'dir gnyis su med pa zhes sogs kyi dus 'khor gyi zin bris nyung ngu dang mngon rtogs/ dbang / sbyor drug /bsdusargyud/ nang le rnams kyi zin bris/ bsam gtan phyi ma las bzlas brjod rnal 'byor gyi che ba/ 'chi zhag dang tshe lhag bshad pa/ grub chen brgyad kyi bzhugs tshul rnams kyi lung phul/ gdan sa gong nasalo rting mar gdung brgyud rin po che khri 'don gnang bzhed kyi bka' shog phebs lan rgyan gyis spras pa phul/ smon 'gro paṇa chen dbang rgyal rdo rje 'khor ba'i tshul la nges par 'byung ba'i gsung 'phrin snyan tshig bstsal bar yab kyi rnam thar 'khyongs pa'i rigs chos gnyis ka 'dzin (153ba)pa legs phyogs don rgyan gyi rgyud las drangs pa gsol/ khal kha g.yas ru'i stong 'khor sprul sku'i 'phrin lan tshigs su bcad pa zhig bsrings/ bod 'bangs bde thabs su rdzong mgo so sor tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad bzhes kyi chog bsgrigs dgos tshul ltar rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi las byang bklags chog ma bkod/'on kyang rat+na'i gtsang la phan pa'i zhal chems las/ dge bshes thams cad phyogs cha'i bdud kyis zin: chos dang chos pa gzhan la smod pa dang : khyad par bdud kyis byin rlabs dge bshes 'gas pad+ma nga yi chos la chos log zer sbas yul gter chos smod dang ya ga sgrog: ces pa'i don thog tu babs lta bus bsgyur kha zhig byung ba'i phyag tu khel ma song /zla ba bcu par dam sel gyi rnam pas srung ma'i 'khru ldog gis nye 'khor ba kha shas gnyan tshad kyis na zhing / nged kyang gag rims kyis btab par lha rje byang ngos pa sku mched gnyis kyis bsad dbyung gi 'phrod bsnyen dang nad g.yog ja'i sang sde pa dang byang ngos nas sku gzhen pa gnyis yin zhing sde pa thugs khur bzhes nas rim gro rgyas par byas pas zhag bcu skor nas bde bar byung / rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba'i bka' 'bum rnams dpon skyon can e pa'i dpon yig gsum gyis bris pa'i tshe 'khrungs rabs brgyud 'debs smon lam bcas pa dang rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi —230

'bangs bde thabs su rdzong mgo so sor tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad bzhes kyi chog bsgrigs dgos tshul ltar rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi las byang bklags chog ma bkod/'on kyang rat+na'i gtsang la phan pa'i tshe 'khrungs rabs brgyud 'debs smon lam bcas pa dang rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi —230

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)gsol 'debs brtsams/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du zur rdo rje 'chang la dbang chos mang du zhus/tshes bcu bzhi la blo la thol byung du shar ba bzhin rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjer bstod pa gsol 'debs brtsams/ gdan sa gong du khri 'don zhal dkar gyi tshan grangs legs so brjod pa'i yab sras gnyis gar snyan (154na)tshig rgyan gyis spud pa'i zhu 'phrin 'bul bar 'ol dga' 'bri lung pa btang /zla ba bcu gnyis par khal kha thu shi ye thu rgyal po'i sras 'jam dbyangs sprul sku dang o rod nas do go long tshe ring sogs hrūl pa mang ba 'byor/ khong pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku skye'i dbang du btang ba'i tshogs chen gyi ser sbreng dang rta bsu'i bdag rkyen cher mdzad/ zhag bcu skor gyi bar mang 'gyed kyis 'brel zhing de mtshungs bsngo rten gyi ster cha'ang mang du byung / sde pas lho 'brug la las sbyor zhig byed dgos gsung yang byas zin rjes nyes che ba 'dra mo re yong gin yod pas lkugs pa'i sngo tshod kyi dper bsam pa'i da lta rdo rje 'phreng ba'i bslab sbyang rang bcas long med tshul zhus pas gung thang du phebs sgo gnang ba'i zur khyab bdag chen pos 'brug byed kyi rlung 'khor phag rir 'dzugs pa gnang song ba de nas zla ba bzhi tsam na zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal chu tshan khar gza' nad dam rtsi dug gang yin kha mi mthun pa'i snyun gyis btab zhal dbugs ma chad tsam zhig 'do le la bteg nas spu nag tu khyer 'phral gshegs pa'i rtags myur du thon song bar rje bla ma dang 'khor lo'i do dam la 'gro mi ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis la legs so brda mtshon tsam mdzad skad/ 'di lo dus rim sngar 'khyud bzhin thugs la ma bzhed pa'i phyag drug pa'i gtor rgyag gyis gsung ba gtor chen tshad ldan 'phral du ga la 〈gas kyang dkyus 'gre zhig byas/—231—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)gsol 'debs brtsams/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du zur rdo rje 'chang la dbang chos mang du zhus/tshes bcu bzhi la blo la thol byung du shar ba bzhin rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rjer bstod pa gsol 'debs brtsams/ gdan sa gong du khri 'don zhal dkar gyi tshan grangs legs so brjod pa'i yab sras gnyis gar snyan (154na)tshig rgyan gyis spud pa'i zhu 'phrin 'bul bar 'ol dga' 'bri lung pa btang /zla ba bcu gnyis par khal kha thu shi ye thu rgyal po'i sras 'jam dbyangs sprul sku dang o rod nas do go long tshe ring sogs hrūl pa mang ba 'byor/ khong pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku skye'i dbang du btang ba'i tshogs chen gyi ser sbreng dang rta bsu'i bdag rkyen cher mdzad/ zhag bcu skor gyi bar mang 'gyed kyis 'brel zhing de mtshungs bsngo rten gyi ster cha'ang mang du byung / sde pas lho 'brug la las sbyor zhig byed dgos gsung yang byas zin rjes nyes che ba 'dra mo re yong gin yod pas lkugs pa'i sngo tshod kyi dper bsam pa'i da lta rdo rje 'phreng ba'i bslab sbyang rang bcas long med tshul zhus pas gung thang du phebs sgo gnang ba'i zur khyab bdag chen pos 'khrug byed kyi rlung 'khor phag rir 'dzugs pa gnang song ba de nas zla ba bzhi tsam na zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal chu tshan khar gza' nad dam rtsi dug gang yin kha mi mthun pa'i snyun gyis btab zhal dbugs ma chad tsam zhig 'do le la bteg nas spu nag tu khyer 'phral gshegs pa'i rtags myur du thon song bar rje bla ma dang 'khor lo'i do dam la 'gro mi ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis la legs so brda mtshon tsam mdzad skad/ 'di lo dus rim sngar 'khyud bzhin thugs la ma bzhed pa'i phyag drug pa'i gtor rgyag gyis gsung ba gtor chen tshad ldan 'phral du ga la tshugs kyang dkyus 'gre zhig byas/—231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgung lo so lnga par/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du gsung rab par du brkos pa dang / chu shul gsang sngags byang chub gling btab pa/lho gnas su phebs pa bcas kyi skor/lcags yos lo gsar grub nas smon lam chen mo 4 phyin/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/ gnyal gung (154bskong mdzes pa chos rje/ dka' bcu chos 'byor/ do go long rnams kyis gos dar gser dngul ja ras kyi stong 'bul bstar/ smon lam grol nas chos rje dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs kyis pha bong khar mgron la bos/ khong pa dge bshes mi che'ang bla ma la gus shing rjes su gdan sa bzung ste ri khrod kyi 'dzin stong ma bor ba'i chos dang mthun pas nye gnas kyi dper 'os/ mar lam grong smad dang che gsum pa gnyis kyis ster sbyin dang dkar spro bshams/ lha sar zhag shas bsdad nas dka' bcu chos 'byor dang do go long sogs la rjes gnang ci rigs byas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i 'gor 'bras spungs su slebs pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin sla chos su su ma song bar nyams su bstar/ pad+ma sku skye'i 'dod skong tsam du byang chub bar rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam dang / tre bo hor tshang chos rjes bskul ba'i dmag zor ma'i brgyud 'debs bris/ sprul sku tor dar can mi grangs bcu drug gi do dam rgyal rtse dga' bas byas pa'i lho brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling gi gtsang khang du thub chen/ mchog zung / nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung /bla ma lha khang du jo 'brom yab sras dang rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ mgon khang du nag pho skor gsum dmag zor ma rnams bzhengs pa'i gzungs 'bul la rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang / nag zla'i tshes gsum la gnas chung chos skyong chen pos rang nyid kyi sku zhal bkod mdzad pa zhig bskur te 'di dang 'brel ba'i gsol mchod bris (155na)gsungs par thang kha'i lha —232

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgung lo so lnga par/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du gsung rab par du brkos pa dang / chu shul gsang sngags byang chub gling btab pa/lho gnas su phebs pa bcas kyi skor/lcags yos lo gsar grub nas smon lam chen mo 4 phyin/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/ gnyal gung (154bskong mdzes pa chos rje/ dka' bcu chos 'byor/ do go long rnams kyis gos dar gser dngul ja ras kyi stong 'bul bstar/ smon lam grol nas chos rje dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs kyis pha bong khar mgron la bos/ khong pa dge bshes mi che'ang bla ma la gus shing rjes su gdan sa bzung ste ri khrod kyi 'dzin stong ma bor ba'i chos dang mthun pas nye gnas kyi dper 'os/ mar lam grong smad dang che gsum pa gnyis kyis ster sbyin dang dkar spro bshams/ lha sar zhag shas bsdad nas dka' bcu chos 'byor dang do go long sogs la rjes gnang ci rigs byas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i 'gor 'bras spungs su slebs pa'i gsang 'dus 'jam dpal rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin sla chos su su ma song bar nyams su bstar/ pad+ma sku skye'i 'dod skong tsam du byang chub bar rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam dang / tre bo hor tshang chos rjes bskul ba'i dmag zor ma'i brgyud 'debs bris/ sprul sku hor dar can mi grangs bcu drug gi do dam rgyal rtse dga' bas byas pa'i lho brag dga' ldan don gnyis gling gi gtsang khang du thub chen/ mchog zung / nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung /bla ma lha khang du jo 'brom yab sras dang rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ mgon khang du nag pho skor gsum dmag zor ma rnams bzhengs pa'i gzungs 'bul la rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang / nag zla'i tshes gsum la gnas chung chos skyong chen pos rang nyid kyi sku zhal bkod mdzad pa zhig bskur te 'di dang 'brel ba'i gsol mchod bris (155na)gsungs par thang kha'i lha —232

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)mgron gyi bla ma bsgyur ba'i gsar du bris pa dang bstun nas brtsams ngos sku brnyan dang gsol mchod gnyis ka lcog tu phul/ brel ba'i stabs kyis nyer gsum la brgyad gtor btang /zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du dpe cha'i brjed gsos ngos phyag len gyi mtha' gcod byas pa'i 'phreng ba dang da chu ṇa ā tsārla'i kṛ ya sa muñtsa zung du 'jug pa la dal por byed na zla ba gcig /'bring la zhag bco brgyad/ rtsol khyad che na zhag bcu bzhir grub pa tshad ldan mkhas pa'i phyag len du snang ba'i 'bring po'i dbang du byas/ gnas rnying zhabs drung khri pa/ gzims khang gong sprul sku/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/gling stod zhabs drung / rwa sgreng mkhan po/ se 'bras kyi slob dpon rnams kyis thog drangs dge 'dun rags bsdus stong du nye ba/ khal kha bā thur hung tha'i ji sogs dpon po rnams kyis gtsos pa'i brgya skor tsam dbang gral byas pa'i 'du khang khengs pa la hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la sta gon dang brgyad la gsang 'dus 'jam rdor nas btsugs pa'i nyer lnga la dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bar phyag len phra mo tshun yang sla chos su ma song ba'i bstan rgyun la phan pa phul/ dge 'phel ri khrod pa dka' bcu ba dom ras 'phreng ba'i rgya gzhung shes na 'di gas chog ces dkyil thang ka ba'i legs la bkram bum pa zhig bshams/ zhabs drung rin po ches dbang chog gi ljags lung gnang ba'i bum dbang bskur tshig byung dus bum chu re gnang ba de gas dbang lung gnyi ga'i go bcad 'dug /rkarma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang bo dong ba'i bla ma mang pos dkyil 'khor bshams ma thag tu sgrub mchod gang yang med par dbang bskur ba/ rtag brtan sprul skus mngon snang ba de 'dra'i rigs tsho rdo rje 'chang dang dgongs pa mnyam pa'i khyad can zhig las 'os ci yod/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ des na nyan thos theg pa ni/ khub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang / /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la/ /gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo / /zhes pa'i dgongs don thog tu bab pa ni min las che/ blo dman bdag gis so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon zhig gis so so skye bo'i pa'i sku (158na)sha gzugs sku skye gsum la 'khrul med kyi gter ston zhig po gling pas lho brag mkhar chu nas gdan drangs pa'i drag dmar la dbang gsum yod pa'i che ba ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten te rgyas pa dang sgrub skor las tshogasayongs rdzogs kyi lung phul/ thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor du gra tshang gsar du btsugs pa'i slob dpon 'os pa zhig dgos rgyur 'dug rung sde par thugs rgyus med pas rgyal mtshan legs pa rtab 'gros su gnang /mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar por dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling btsugs pa'i slob dpon du ba de dka' bcu ba shes rab bzang po btang / kong ngo rdzogs chen pa kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis 'bras gzhongs gnas sgo phye nas lha ri rin chen spungs par dag snang gi zab chos mang du byung ba bod 'bangs bde thabs kyi rim gro mdzad par byon te gung thang du rje bla mar chos bka' rnams rdzogs par phul/ dpon slob lhan du rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi sgrub pa zhig kyang mdzad/ 'bras spungs su ngos byon gyis yun du gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing 'ja' shing 'ja' shel ya mtshan can sogs 'bras gshongs kyi sa sna rdo shing du ma byin/phar rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter gsar gyi tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gsang yig gi lung phul/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i brtan bzhugs shig 'dug pa de mkha' 'gros dag snang du gsungs tshul byung yang gter ma min pa'i nges pa mi snang gang ltar gra tshang du btsugs/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i gcung sgam smyon sprul skur rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang (158ba)'dus dmar 'khrid kyi lung phul/ brgyud 'debs dgos tshulu ltar brtsams pa lung las nyams khrid kyi brgyud pa ni min/zla ba bdun pa nas bzung zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi bar zur rdo rje 'chang gi drung du mdo sngags kyi chos mang du nos shing khyad par lha brag gter byon gyi rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar dang dgongs pa zangs thal gyi nyams 'khrid nan tan du zhus pas 'di ga'i mus bskyangs na 'ja' lus —237—

pas rgyal mtshan legs pa rtab 'gros su gnang /mnga' ris khyung rdzong dkar por dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling btsugs pa'i slob dpon du ba de dka' bcu ba shes rab bzang po btang / kong ngo rdzogs chen pa kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis 'bras gshongs gnas sgo phye nas lha ri rin chen spungs par dag snang gi zab chos mang du byung ba bod 'bangs bde thabs kyi rim gro mdzad par byon te gung thang du rje bla mar chos bka' rnams rdzogs par phul/ dpon slob lhan du rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi sgrub pa zhig kyang mdzad/ 'bras spungs su ngos byon gyis yun du gnas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing 'ja' shing 'ja' shel ya mtshan can sogs 'bras gshongs kyi sa sna rdo shing du ma byin/phar rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter gsar gyi tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gsang yig gi lung phul/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i brtan bzhugs shig 'dug pa de mkha' 'gros dag snang du gsungs tshul byung yang gter ma min pa'i nges pa mi snang gang ltar gra tshang du btsugs/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i gcung sgam smyon sprul skur rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang (158ba)'dus dmar 'khrid kyi lung phul/ brgyud 'debs dgos tshul ltar brtsams pa lung las nyams khrid kyi brgyud pa ni min/zla ba bdun pa nas bzung zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi bar zur rdo rje 'chang gi drung du mdo sngags kyi chos mang du nos shing khyad par lha brag gter byon gyi rdzogs pa chen po rang byung rang shar dang dgongs pa zangs thal gyi nyams 'khrid nan tan du zhus pas 'di ga'i mus bskyangs na 'ja' lus —237—

nag la myur du thon dgos pa'i bka' shog dang bka' ngag skyel bar se chen dbon po dang (159na)bo ro tshe ring gnyis snga mgyogs su 'byor/ sngar grags yul lam tsam yod kyang 'di nas bzung sde pas stod rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ yonayang dag bzabs shing 'bras bu gling pas spoms 'bul byas/ dka' bcu byams chos pas bzang rdzas gtsos pa'i ster cha dpangs bstod du bstar/ mnyam med gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa'i thugs dam rten thub pa gser gling mas gtsos pa'i rten rnams mjal/ thang po che khri skor gyi dus khu pa tshos thub pa gser gling ma'i 'dra cog cig bzos pa de phyi la bten ngo bo sbas se ba byas par brten drung chen rin po cher bab rten la 'dra cog phul bas thog ma nas zhabrul gzhi yod zer ba dang de ga yang phyis sgar pas brjes par gleng ba ji ltar na'ang mjal nyams spro ba zhig snang / bsam gtan gling 'di dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod (164ba)nams rgyal mtshan dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan khu dbon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas yin pas dpal kun bzang rtse pa yab sras rnams thugs gtsig nan tar che bas ched gnyer du mjal bar phyin/ yar klungs par bla ma dam pa zhal gzigs byung ba'i gzims khang de byin shin tu chags/ chosarje bla ma'i sku 'dra tshul khrims ma dang na bza' sogs nang rten rnams mjal nas smon lam btab/srung ma rnams la snyan dar phul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ sna mo shag grub chen pas sna chas rgyal pho brang pa'i spyil por bos/ las 'phro gling gu ru rat+na 'gro 'dul dang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku zhig 'dug pa 'dam btang byung bas rat+na 'gro 'dul khyer/zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches dbu gnang tshogs mkhan chen gyis thog drangs skya ser gyi rta bsu dang rtse tshogos/ ri bo chos gling / bkra shis cho me sde/ ban tshang pa/ ras chung phug pa so gos ser sbreng shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas pho brang 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sne'u sdong rtser 'byor/ de nub lnga mchod chen mo dang 'grig yas mas thams cad gling me skar tshogs ltar bkra bas rten 'brel legs pa byung /tshoms chen bzhugs gral du no mon e rjen dang bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gnyis la khri zhal sprod dang bcas bod sog gi tshogs che bar rin po che sman lung pa dang paṇa bstar/ mnyam med gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa'i thugs dam rten thub pa gser gling mas gtsos pa'i rten rnams mjal/ thang po che khri skor gyi dus khu pa tshos thub pa gser gling ma'i 'dra cog cig bzos pa de phyi la bten ngo bo sbas se ba byas par brten drung chen rin po cher bab rten la 'dra cog phul bas thog ma nas zhabrul gzhi yod zer ba dang de ga yang phyis sgar pas brjes par gleng ba ji gyis brlabs pa'i srung ma rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas yin pas dpal kun bzang rtse pa yab sras rnams thugs gtsig nan tar che bas ched gnyer du mjal bar phyin/ yar klungs par bla ma dam pa zhal gzigs byung ba'i gzims khang de byin shin tu chags/ chosarje bla ma'i sku 'dra tshul khrims ma dang na bza' sogs nang rten rnams mjal nas smon lam btab/srung ma rnams la snyan dar phul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ sna mo shag grub chen pas chos rgyal pho brang pa'i spyil por bos/ las 'phro gling gu ru rat+na 'gro 'dul dang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku zhig 'dug pa 'dam btang byung bas rat+na 'gro 'dul khyer/zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches dbu gnang tshogs mkhan chen gyis thog drangs skya ser gyi rta bsu dang rtse tshogos/ ri bo chos gling / bkra shis chos sde/ ban tshang pa/ ras chung phug pa so gos ser sbreng shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas pho brang 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sne'u sdong rtser 'byor/ de nub lnga mchod chen mo dang 'grig yas mas thams cad gling me skar tshogs ltar bkra bas rten 'brel legs pa byung /tshoms chen bzhugs gral du no mon e rjen dang bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gnyis la khri zhal sprod dang bcas bod sog gi tshogs che bar rin po che sman lung pa dang paṇa chen smon 'gro lo tsā ba gnyis kyis 'bel gtam shin tu rgyas pa mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung du mdzes pa'i dper song gzhis len dang —246

shon bro pa sogs rtsed sna mtha' klas pa dang bcas sa skyong mtsho skyes rdo rje dpon g.yog gis mdun bsus te bsam yas pho brang 'og tu 'byor/sang nyin spyan gzigs mchode pa'i bye brag rgyas pa bstar nas dbu rtse rigs gsum/ mkhan po rin po che'i dbu thod/ g.yu'i thub pas mtshon pa'i nang rten rnams mjal zhing yan lag bdun pa dang smon lam rgyas par byas/ bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po sku khog tu khyed kyis sa skya bdag chen la phyag 'then byed kyin yong 'dug pa da lam yang dgos gsungs par chos skyong gis sdug 'dres phyag 'then byas pa dga' na byas chog ces kha btags khrag gis sbags pa bsnams rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dang lha rtse sku skye dpon slob rnams rta bsu la phebs/ sne'u lcang gseb tu sgar byas zhag gnyis bsdad/'brug pa sprul pa'i skus rab byung sgrub dgos tshul byung ba mkhan slob sgrags rgyu'i rtsis 'dra zhig 'dug rung slob dpon lha rtse sprul sku rang gis mdzad pa 'gab ces mol/ slob dpon mdzad skabs mchil lham 'bul rtsis mi 'dug pa 'bud dgos zhes bskul ba rtsod pa btang ba 'dra zhig la song bas rjes su bde chen chos 'khor ba dang lcog gra ba sogs bya gral la'ang chab len lham 'bud dge lugs pa'i lad mo gshod par snang / chos sde chen po'i bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas tshes bzhi la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su slebs/ bdun phyed gnyis kyi bar dge sbyor gyi bcad rgya shin tu dam pas mtshams bcad/'di lo g.yeng bas sgrub khag rnams 'dzugs ma thub kyang dus rim gyis rdo rje slob dpon la sngar rgyun ltar phyin pa zor bkra legs/ sngar brag sna chos rje gong ra lo tsā bar chos zhur 'dengs song skabs kha dal du snang rtse nas (171na)dmag bzlog nyer lnga de zhus na yong glengs pa bdag la dgos rgyur go bas dpe cha dang bcas do gal chen po dang lo tsā ba la mjal na bdag rkyen yong sogs 'char kyang bstan tshod du gda'/ zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma de phyogs la'ang dag snang mdzad gshis dpe de gung thang du phul ba dar sdings rig 'dzin byon pa dang 'grig gsan pas nged kyis de phyogs brgyud zhus par go ba'i zhal snga nas dar rgyas chos sdings par shin tu gnag pa zhig byung song / slar mol mchis kyi skabs snang rtse ba'i gter chos mi dgos de nas brgyud pa'ang zhu yin med pa'i gnas tshul la brten sdang sems kyi tsha ngad de zhi bar snang / gong ra lo tsā ba snang rtse sde pa'i rgyun gyi dge lugs 'di bdud lta bur mngon pa zhig yod tshod nas 'di phyogs su yong bar spro ba med 'dra rung mdzes lam gyi mjal 'dod yod tshul brjod pa chos rje brag sna bas bden par bzung ste yang yang bskul ba'i dbang gis gnam gang gi dgong ja'i lo gsar gyi gtor ma byin rlabs byed khar slebs byung ja sbyor sbrel gyi ring gleng mo 'os 'tsham byas pas khengs pa rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dang lha rtse sku skye dpon slob rnams rta bsu la phebs/ sne'u lcang gseb tu sgar byas zhag gnyis bsdad/'brug pa sprul pa'i skus rab byung sgrub dgos tshul byung ba mkhan slob sgrags rgyu'i rtsis 'dra zhig 'dug rung slob dpon lha rtse sprul sku rang gis mdzad pa 'gab ces mol/ slob dpon mdzad skabs mchil lham 'bul rtsis mi 'dug pa 'bud dgos zhes bskul ba rtsod pa btang ba 'dra zhig la song bas rjes su bde chen chos 'khor ba dang lcog gra ba sogs bya gral la'ang chab len lham 'bud dge lugs pa'i lad mo gshod par snang / chos sde chen po'i bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas tshes bzhi la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su slebs/ bdun phyed gnyis kyi bar dge sbyor gyi bcad rgya shin tu dam pas mtshams bcad/'di lo g.yeng bas sgrub khag rnams 'dzugs ma thub kyang dus rim gyis rdo rje slob dpon la sngar rgyun ltar phyin pa zor bkra legs/ sngar brag sna chos rje gong ra lo tsā bar chos zhur 'dengs song skabs kha dal du snang rtse nas (171na)dmag bzlog nyer lnga de zhus na yong glengs pa bdag la dgos rgyur go bas dpe cha dang bcas do gal chen po dang lo tsā ba la mjal na bdag rkyen yong sogs 'char kyang bstan tshod du gda'/ zur 'jam dbyangs bla ma de phyogs la'ang dag snang mdzad gshis dpe de gung thang du phul ba dar sdings rig 'dzin byon pa dang 'grig gsan pas nged kyis de phyogs brgyud zhus par go ba'i zhal snga nas dar rgyas chos sdings par shin tu gnag pa zhig byung song / slar mol mchis kyi skabs snang rtse ba'i gter chos mi dgos de nas brgyud pa'ang zhu yin med pa'i gnas tshul la brten sdang sems kyi tsha ngad de zhi bar snang / gong rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nas ngan mi byed zer ba'i lo rgyus bka' gdams glegs bam na 'dug pa'i zla bor mchis/dgung lo so drug par rgya nag tu phebs lam bod sog gi gdul byar zab chos dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang zhing gong ma dang mjal 'dzoms sogs kyi skor/chu 'brug gnam lo tshes pa'i chos skyong mchod pa dang lo gsar gyi dga' ston dkyus ltar btang / 'di lo nas bzung lo drug gi li tho nang (171ba)ra chos mdzad kyis bzos/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho la gung ru chos 'byung sogs mi gus pa'i thugs zhe gsog mkhan mang bar brten dbus su log phebs 'dod med 'dug pas glang lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du stag lo'i dus kyi smon lam 'phar ma 'dzugs pa gnang ba yar phebs rgyu mi yong ba'i rten 'brel slog pa lta bur go ba'i nged kyis zhag brgyad tsam gyi ring smon lam gyi tshogs dbu byas/ 'di lo 'grul pa gtos che ba 'byor bas khal kha no mon e jen skyid shod kyis sde pa chos rje'i sku skyes thog drangs cho khur o pa shi 'khor bcas sogs mang dag gis stong 'bul brgya 'bul sngags pa se chen chos rje no mon khan gyis dngul srang khri tsam/ gos dar stong phrag lhag bcas/ 'phyong rgyas paṇ+ḍita sa gser zho khrir nye bas gtso me rgya sog gi dngos po dngom che ba bstar zhing dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ mchod mjal skabasasmon lam nan tan btab cing dung skyong dbang mor gsol mchod spyan gzigs phul bas 'phrin las rgyas par bcol/ smon lam 'phro chen du bzhag ste mjug skyong dga' ldan khri rin po che chu bzang pas gnang / bdag gis po ta lar gung tshigs byas nas 'bras spungs su log/sa rta'i bde gzar skabs thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung gi sgo rgyan thon pa'i gra lnga can gyis khyer ba'i zhig gsos la 'phyong rgyas paṇ+ḍi tas gser g.yu las grub pa'i —256

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()nas ngan mi byed zer ba'i lo rgyus bka' gdams glegs bam na 'dug pa'i zla bor mchis/dgung lo so drug par rgya nag tu phebs lam bod sog gi gdul byar zab chos dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du gnang zhing gong ma dang mjal 'dzoms sogs kyi skor/chu 'brug gnam lo tshes pa'i chos skyong mchod pa dang lo gsar gyi dga' ston dkyus ltar btang / 'di lo nas bzung lo drug gi li tho nang (171ba)ra chos mdzad kyis bzos/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho la gung ru chos 'byung sogs mi gus pa'i thugs zhe gsog mkhan mang bar brten dbus su log phebs 'dod med 'dug pas glang lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du stag lo'i dus kyi smon lam 'phar ma 'dzugs pa gnang ba yar phebs rgyu mi yong ba'i rten 'brel slog pa lta bur go ba'i nged kyis zhag brgyad tsam gyi ring smon lam gyi tshogs dbu byas/ 'di lo 'grul pa gtos che ba 'byor bas khal kha no mon e jen skyid shod kyis sde pa chos rje'i sku skyes thog drangs cho khur o pa shi 'khor bcas sogs mang dag gis stong 'bul brgya 'bul sngags pa se chen chos rje no mon khan gyis dngul srang khri tsam/ gos dar stong phrag lhag bcas/ 'phyong rgyas paṇ+ḍita sa gser zho khrir nye bas gtso me rgya sog gi dngos po dngom che ba bstar zhing dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ mchod mjal skabasasmon lam nan tan btab cing dung skyong dbang mor gsol mchod spyan gzigs phul bas 'phrin las rgyas par bcol/ smon lam 'phro chen du bzhag ste mjug skyong dga' ldan khri rin po che chu bzang pas gnang / bdag gis po ta lar gung tshigs byas nas 'bras spungs su log/sa rta'i bde gzar skabs thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dngul gdung gi sgo rgyan thon pa'i gra lnga can gyis khyer ba'i zhig gsos la 'phyong rgyas paṇ+ḍi tas gser g.yu las grub pa'i —256

mjal thub pa'i ngo tsha bag yod dang ldan pa byas song / 'dod khams dbang mo'i dus kyi mdos ma rdzo dang brgyad gtor snga bsnur du bto / 'di nasad lta'i bar e pa dpon yig ngag dbang tshe ring gis yi ge 'dri bar rkang tshugs su bsdad/zla ba gnyis pa nas bzung ma thon bar la rdzong ba dang phrad par dbus gtsang stod smad kyi drag zhan 'bring gsum shin tu mang ba chad med lta bu byung / 'brug pa sprul sku bde chen chos 'khor ba dang bcas pa byon/ bde chen chos 'khor bas sprul pa'i sku mdo phyogs kyi gsan sbyong gnang dgos 'dug par sngar yang slob dpon sa lugs pa bos pa las 'brug nang gi dge bshes kyis rang rkya pher ba zhig ma byung / da lam dge lugs phyogs nas zhu dgos 'dug tshul byung ba ltar chos 'khor gling pa'i gra rigs gnyal pa rab 'byams pa sku yon 'bul bar brdzangs/ rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po che khri thog pa phebs par ldang bsu mjal dar sogs bkur gzos gang che phul/ lugs gnyis rka'i gsung 'phros ha cang mi smar ba'i spam me ba zhig snang / dngos po tshur len dang phar 'bul gang legs byas/pha bong kha'i bla ma dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i gdan sar myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i drung rams pa dpal 'byor rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dpon slob lnga la 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang phul/ chos rjes bskul ba ltar brgyud 'debs/rdo rje brag sngags rams pa dang dge slong don grub rgyal mtshan gyi bskul ba'i bstod pa rnams brtsams/de'ang bod 'dir 'byor pa yod pa (173ba)rgyu mtshan du byas te khungs dang 'brel ba'i sgrigs bcad bdar med pa'i gang dran lag 'gel gyi che tshugs yin khul la yid brtan ga la yod/ srid dang 'brel ba'i chen po'i las tshan khungs btsun chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i dus su byung ba ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sa skya'i gdung rabs kha rgyan las/ zhar las byung ba phyi nang las tshan ni/ /gsol gzims mchod gsum mjal yig mdzod pa gsum/ /thab 'dren gdan gsum skya rta mdzo khyi bzhi/ /chen po la 'os las tshan bcu gsum ste/ /'di rnams chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i ring la dar ba yin/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs te las tshan bsgrigasabakod skya rags gra sgrig 'chor mas lugs kyis hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor thog phyogs gtsang khyad kyis lci bde ri zur bud mtshams bar phyin nas dan 'bag gling khar sgar gral bsgrigs sar slebs/ der ser theg chen gling pa/ rgyud stod smad/ lha sa dang grong gseb pa'i khrom shin tu che bar bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel dang byin rlabs byas/ dgon pa nas lta mkhan rnams kyis lci bde bud mtshams rta rags ma mthong ba ring por ma thogs par tshur log pa 'dra ba'i rten 'brel legs po byung zhes gleng / yar lam gnas chud lcog tu cho tre skyong chen po sku phebs zhus nas lkog gyur gyi lung bstan zhib par gsungs/sne'u stong zhabs drung rin po ches sngar chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'ang rgyal ba thog jugs pas 'dam bar skyel ma zhus pa dang (174na)dbyibs 'dra ba'i rten 'brel du de bar cis kyang 'gro zhesachibs kha sgyur 'dug /tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin gling stod smad kyi chos rje gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i se 'bras gsang gsum gyi slob dpon chos 'chad/ gra rigs sde dpon khag sogs kyi skyel ma dang bcas chos sde chen —259

slob dpon sogs kha shas 'dam bar du yod/ sa skyong rgya ri bas bod la myur du yong ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam zhig dgos gsung ba de 'phral du phul/ sang skyor mo lung du gzims khang gong sprul pa'i skus gung gi dro bstabs/ skyor lung spyi sos bdog pa bstar/tshal por slebs rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus sku gsung thugs rten dang pad+ma rā ga'i rta chas kyis gtsos pa'i ster sbyin gya nom pa mdzad/ chu lam sdings gsum yang zur gyis mtshon pa'i kur dge'i chos sde so so nas bsnyen bkur/ zhang ston sgar pa sku mdun lhun grub bi ri'i bla ma dang mag par song bas rgyal po yab sras rnams mi dgyes pa'i gzigs phyogs log pa 'dug par 'jigs pa las bskyabs shing bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrubs mtshan ngag dbang tshul khrims grags par btags/ ngor mkhan chen shes rab 'byung gnas dang gleng mo zhib tu byung ba gsan (174ba)rgya sogs sku yon che gras su 'dug /rab gdong du rgya ri dpon blon la sgrol dkar dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel phul/bde chen yangs pa can pa rnams kyis ser sbreng gis mdun bsus/ spyan sngas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i spungs sku rgya nag ma zhig byin nas 'di yangs pa can gyi rten gyi gtso bo lta bu yin pas phyi 'khyar med pa dgos tshul gsungs/nyer gsum gyi nyin na dkar mor sgar phab/ bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po mkhan slob rnams phebs pa'i gnang skyes phar 'bul sogs rgyas pa dang zhag drug gi ring gang ci'i gsung gleng bslab ston zhib mol du phebs/ blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo'i ljags lung zhig zhus pa phyed tsam bstsal ba'i lhag ma rgya nag nas yar phebs dus 'bul ba'i rten 'brel byed ces 'phro 'jog pa gnang ba yun ring mi 'gor ba ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i mngon par mkhyen par go /'on kyang ljags —260

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)lung gi los zhu ma thub pas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen por rting sor tshang ba zhig nyan/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma'i dbang brgya rtsa zhig phul/ bkra shis lhun po'i slob dpon rnams la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang du ri yal gyi no bo mkha' 'gro tho yon la dbu ma'i lta 'khrid kyi lung / ngo sprod la zhib cha bcas dgos tshul bzhin bshad/ dka' chen tshogs gsog pas gzhen rta pher po'i rta sngon po legs pa zhig byin/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang po chos rje 'ug pa lung pa ma chen gyis rgya nag nas myur du ldog dgos tshul gyi snyan ngag gi lam du drangs pa'i (175na tsher phrin yig byung ba de lan bi warta/ rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug gnyags ban nang ra ba dang bde chen yangs pa can spyan snga ga rma nyi ma sogs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rnams bris/nyer dgu la bteg pa'i mthong smon du bsdad/ sang bshes gnyen phu chung par 'brom ston pasazla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang zhal dngos su bstan zhing mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis phu chung par thig le bcu drug gnang ba'i tsā sgye mor gung tshigs byas/ mchod rten byin rlabs can der bskor ba gsol 'debs smon lam btab/ gan ta la'i nang khongs dri za'i rgyal po'i pho brang gangs kyi ri bo'i mdun du gnyan chen po'i gsol mchod gter gzhung lhad med gra tshang gi tshogs su btsugs pa'i de nub gangs chen po babs pa lha chen dgyes pa'i mtshan mar go /zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis la bsam grub bde chen du slebs dpon mo shes rab sgrol mas bskul ba'i smon lam bris/ sne'u sdong zhabs drung rin po ches dbu gnang / gzims khang gong sprul sku/ lha rin po che/ rgya ri/ skyid shod pa/ser 'bras kyis slob dpon dang bcas pa'i skyel thung mdzad mi phal cher phyir thegs/ 'bri gung zhabs drung rin po che khri pa phebs pa'i sngar mal gror mjal dus kyi 'phro mus las brtsams pa'i gsung gleng shin tu 'phel/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub dgung lo bcu bzhi pa zhig phebs byung ba khri 'don ma grub 'dug pa'i stabs bkur gzos sgam 'brug rnams dang cha 'dra —261—

mkhan slob rnams la yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung / skyid shod sku skyer tshe mgon/ da la'i bā thur gyi dpon mor tshe dbang rnams byas/ gra tshang la stag zhen/ zhing skyong / khyab 'jug /tsi dmar ba sogs kyi gsol ga'i lung phul/ gzhan ma'i brel ba cher ma byung bas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sngar me khyir brtsams par bzo skyor dang zhus dag btang /thang lha la rten 'dzugs gsol mchod rgyas par phul ba dang dus mtshungs par thang lha'i gangs kyi sked par 'ja' tshon gyis 'khyud pa dang nyi ma shar pa'i bkra rtags legs/ gsol mchod nyung ngu zhig brtsams shing zhal byang btab pa'i dar tshon sna lnga bstar/ mchod dpon dang bcar sdod kyi zla bo nyisasbrags khyad nas blo bzang lung rigs kyis bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs pa'i las tshan gyi babs dang bcas blo bzang mthu stobs btags pa ming don mthun pa'i rten 'brel du song / rgyal po sku khams gzhi med du gdangs pa'i gtam snyan 'byor/ nye skor du hor sog 'brog pa'i rigs mang ba'i phrad mi rnams la so so'i 'dod sbyar byas/ grong smad a sug la 'byung po'i gdon gyis sems mi bde ba che ba zhig glo bur du byung 'dug par sngags dang bsrung bcos kha yar byas pas zla phyed tsam la gzhi med du song /nyer gcig la bsam grub bde chen nas bteg /sems dpa' chen po'i sprul sku gro ma lung gi chu tshan gyi nus pa gtar kha byas pa dang mnyam tshul byung bar brten der phyin te zhag (176na)gsum bsdad kyang kha ba ches pas 'phral sdod nyams ma spro yang dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dgyes pa'i mtshan mar byed 'dug shis legs par mngon/ dud 'gro sogs la gnod tshabs che ba der dmigasate bsangs mchod cig phul bas nam mkha' bsngal myong ba rmongs pa'i rang mtshang gsal bar bstan/ skyon rin po che'i sgrub gnas su grags pa'i sa phug cig mchis pa the'u rang sgrub sa 'dra ba zhig las byin —262

mtha' dmag gi kha gnon du bzhengs pa phyis su lung stong bdag med kyi nyams nas phal cher zhig 'dug rung bod 'bangs bde ba'i tshigs bcad dang bcas dar lcog cig btsugs/ rgya rgan du 'byor thog skyid nang sor grags pa'i sog ban rwa sgreng gi ri khrod pa 'khor ba la zhe chad kyi snying rus can des nged la sbyar ba'i bla ma rgyang 'bod cig dgos zer yang rang la yon tan med par ham pa byed pa rtsed rgyal phyir 'byon gdong phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du phul/ 'bab rong du slebs thog bar khams nas rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug zhing khams 'phos pa'i thugs bur du rdol ba sbyar ra a bo ngag dbang sogs mang pos mthong 'dug pa legs pa'i mtshan ma zhig yin 'dra snyam der mda' dar ljang gu 'phrin bcol gyi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa btsugs/ gnam gang gi nyin glang ling la khar gra tshang la rgyal gsol ring ba tsa ri zhing skyong tse'u dmar po'i gsol mchod rnams btsugs skabs snyan dar zhal yig can phul/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin sho mong 'dzom rar 'byor/ da la'i bā dur cung zhig bro 'tshal bar tshe dbang dang mgon po'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel phul bas sang nyin nas bde ba byung zer/—263—

gsal 'debs kyi rten skyel mi 'byor pa ltar dgongs pa rdzogs byed kyi smon lam byas/ sems dpa' sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs sku gzugs gcong gis nan tar zinakyang thugs sna shin tu ring bas rgya nag 'byor/ da la'i bā dur cung zhig bro 'tshal bar tshe dbang dang mgon po'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel phul bas sang nyin nas bde ba byung zer/—263—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()khrom sa steng du hor tsha bar ta'i dpon dmi bsod nams kyis gzhis len rgyas pa dang rta brgya tsam gyis gtsos pa'i ster sbyin byung /tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i dbang zhig bskur/'bab (177na)rong du sdod mi'i ri khrod pa 'ga' 'dug par ma ṇi'i bzlas lung byas/ chu nag khar o rod g.yon ru a kha'i cho khur rang yul la 'degs par mngon du phyogs pa dang 'dzom pa'i der sog lugs kyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstabs/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po er te ni'i gzhi ma rnams 'dug pa'i 'phrad mi mang ba byung / dpon mo shes rab sgrol mar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phab/gra tshang gnyis kyis byes lam du mkho ba'i bca' yig mdor bsdus dgos tshul byung ba ltar sprad/ chos 'khor gling pa rnams kyis gnas chung chos rgyal gyi mchod 'phrin ja mchod lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba'ang bris/ hor a mdo ba rnams kha zhu gting 'khyags su ma song ba'i sngar gyi sbyin bdag rnga ma nag po'i tshos can gyi stabs mtsho mo ra ba bkra shis sum mdor sde tshang ma dril 'dug / der bu dmar/ i big /skya ba ri/ btsan rgod dar/ dbang rgyal/ mgon tshe rnams kyis gtsos pas rta dngos gtsang nyisabargya drug cu tsam bdog pa bstar/ tshes dgu'i nyin lha ngar sgang du sa khri brtsigs pa'i steng nas hor a mdo ba'i khrom stong phrag gsum lhag par lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang rgyas par bskur/ de skabs nam mkha' dwangs shing rlung bser bu tsam yang med pa la 'ja' sprin byung ba kho pa rnams dam tshig gtsang ba'i rten 'brel du mngon/ hor smad pa lha rgyal dar gyis mdzo mo be'u dang bcas pa brgya/ mdzo pho nyi shu rnams byin/ sde pas tho nang ltar sgar gral bsgrigs pa'i byung ma byung gi gzigs rtog dang bslab ston mdzad/ 'di skabs (177bsko65 'khor gling pa rnams kyisagayas sgar la rtsod rtsis kyis zur du don pa'i ngan gra bsgrigs par sde pa thugs rgyal bzhengs te dar khan nang so btang nas gur thab chas tshur phrod la phyir log song sogs rgyur sbyang gis tshar bcad song bas re zhig brlang spyod rnams zhi/ sde pas se chen dbon po can btang ba'i 'jam po'i bslab ston zhu 'bul lta bur byung tshul gra tshang rang gi gra rigs 'gas gleng ba ltar na yongs grags dang gsang ba'i —2yo

/tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i dbang zhig bskur/'bab (177na)rong du sdod mi'i ri khrod pa 'ga' 'dug par ma ṇi'i bzlas lung byas/ chu nag khar o rod g.yon ru a kha'i cho khur rang yul la 'degs par mngon du phyogs pa dang 'dzom pa'i der sog lugs kyi bsnyen bkur gya nom pa bstabs/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po er te ni'i gzhi ma rnams 'dug pa'i 'phrad mi mang ba byung / dpon mo shes rab sgrol mar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phab/gra tshang gnyis kyis byes lam du mkho ba'i bca' yig mdor bsdus dgos tshul byung ba ltar sprad/ chos 'khor gling pa rnams kyis gnas chung chos rgyal gyi mchod 'phrin ja mchod lta bu zhig dgos tshul byung ba'ang bris/ hor a mdo ba rnams kha zhu gting 'khyags su ma song ba'i sngar gyi sbyin bdag rnga ma nag po'i tshos can gyi stabs mtsho mo ra ba bkra shis sum mdor sde tshang ma dril 'dug / der bu dmar/ i big /skya ba ri/ btsan rgod dar/ dbang rgyal/ mgon tshe rnams kyis gtsos pas rta dngos gtsang nyisabargya drug cu tsam bdog pa bstar/ tshes dgu'i nyin lha ngar sgang du sa khri brtsigs pa'i steng nas hor a mdo ba'i khrom stong phrag gsum lhag par lha gcig bum gcig la brten pa'i grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang rgyas par bskur/ de skabs nam mkha' dwangs shing rlung bser bu tsam yang med pa la 'ja' sprin byung ba kho pa rnams dam tshig gtsang ba'i rten 'brel du mngon/ hor smad pa lha rgyal dar gyis mdzo mo be'u dang bcas pa brgya/ mdzo pho nyi shu rnams byin/ sde pas tho nang ltar sgar gral bsgrigs pa'i byung ma byung gi gzigs rtog dang bslab ston mdzad/ 'di skabs (177ba〉lo 'khor gling pa rnams kyisagayas sgar la rtsod rtsis kyis zur du don pa'i ngan gra bsgrigs par sde pa thugs rgyal bzhengs te dar khan nang so btang nas gur thab chas tshur phrod la phyir log song sogs rgyur sbyang gis tshar bcad song bas re zhig gnyis rnams bsu ba'i tshul du bstar bar gu yan tha su kha'i can sum brgya skor 'byor/ mkha' 'gro bar khams su phyir bteg /tshes bcu bzhi la na rings kha ra 'u su nas mgron gnyer ma ṇi ba gong du zhu rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()'bul bar btang / da la'i bā thur gyi gzhi ma/ mgon po tshe dbang / bkra shis/ da'i chin kho lo che rnams kyis khyon bsdoms rnga mong brgya skor/ me rgan ji nong gis rta dang rnga mong bsdoms pa brgya lhag rnams bsu ba'i tshul du skyel mi ched bstad kyis 'byor/ 'bri phu na ma mdor slebs thog tre bo hor tshang gi rta drel mdzo ja rnams so sor brgya phrag re/ dge rtse sku skyes kyang zang zing gi ster cha mang du bskrun/ dpon g.yog sum brgya tsam la yig drug gi bzlas lung byas/ bla ma khag gnyis nyung bsdus kyis 'bri phu rong nas mdo ba se leb bar nyi ma bzhi tsam gyi ring phyogs mthun du bgrod par tshe dbang lcags steng ma/rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar yod kun sel/ lhung bshags/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ sal ma/ gsar rtsom kha shas dang mkha' spyod dkar mo'i 'pho lung / las gshin dang dmag zor ma'i gtor chog dang bskang gso'i lung rnams bzhed pa dang sbyar/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu gsum dang dpon tshang chos rje'i gcung bstan 'dzin 'bras spungs su slob gnyer la (181ba/ri gro rgyu yin 'dug pas gtsos dge tshul sum cu lhag pa bsgrubs/dpon tshang chos rjes bskul ba ltar spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor brtsams/ ba yan ka rar sog po zhig btsan du skyes pa'i rta drel la gnod 'tshe che ba yod zer yang de res skyon chen ma byung / nyin char che bar char gcod kyi 'khor lo bskor bas 'grul la ma gnod/ sha la thur slebs thog thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar gsar rtsom gyi 'go btsugs/ nye skor du pad+ma sku skye 'byor ba'i rta rnga mong sum cu tsam byin / mtsho skya rengs kyi 'gram du mdzo dge ba bo sku skye zer ba'i sa lugs pa zhig sog khrod du zhwa ser po gyon nas dge lugs par brdzus te 'ongs par zhib tu dris pas sa lugs las dge lugs kyi skad cha bshad rgyu mi snang bas brdzu zhig ste gdan sa gong bar gyi lam yig dang 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang blo dang bstun pa byas/ slebs thog sa skyong gi mi bzang khon jin can dang mkha' 'gro'i bla ma me rgan dka' bcus rta lug gi bdog pa spel/ a mdo tsho lnga nas rta pa brgya re bsu ba la 'byor/ o rod dpon khag rnams kyi rta me tog gtor/ 'bul dpon chos rje dang chog thu ja'i sang la zhub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang byas/ mdo pa dbon po che chung gis gtsos pa'i bsnyen rdzogs bdun cu lhag bsgrubs/ se chen hung tha'i jis khri gsar du brtsigs pa'i steng du bos / rta stong phrag gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i khri 'bul/ bla ma btsan pos rta lnga brgyas gtsos pa'i stong 'bul/ tho yon bla mas dngul mdong lngas sna drangs pa'i brgya 'bul rgyas par bstar/ dgon lung sku 'bum gyi gra pa sogs skya ser khrir nye ba la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i nye brgyud kyi spyan ras gzigs (186ba)kyi rjes gnang byas/ 'di khrod nas 'ga' res gsang 'dus dang 'jigs byed kyi rjes gnang dgos tshul nan che tsam zer ba de 'dra'i srol med labs rung stong skor sprul sku rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs mdzad mkhan kha shas byung tshod nas bden par mi brtsi yang bdag bslus ni byed ma nus/sgrub thabs brgya rgyam du he ru ka /gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag sogs dang snar thang brgya rtsar mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes gnang 'dug pa ni paṇa grub khyad par can la yi dam lhas gnang ba'i dmigs bsal yin gyi de dag gis dpal 'dzin dang birnya pa'i gshed dmar/ rwa ba'i dgra nag /bya rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i mi 'brugs pa'i go ga la chod/ paṇa chen bzang bkras —277—

shri/ tha sor kha'i can la rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ zhing skyong nang sos bzhengs pa'i zhal thang gsar rnying dang bya khyung chos rjes dngul las grub po'i rjes gnang byas/ thang sngags rings kyi sku skye gra bcas sum brgya brgal ba 'byor gser srang bcu gsum/ rta brgya tsam dang sher dpal thas kyi tsha bos dngul srang lnga brgyas thog —278

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)khi ya gcig /jang gi dang bcas 'byor ba'i bka' shog mu tig gi 'phreng ba'i gnang skyes sprad/ de'i sang sog po rnams sgo bor 'bod pa rtsa chu med bzhi bcu bcad de nying zha'i cha chang lu'i srir 'bod pa'i grog gzhung 'dam gyi gang ba'i gseb la bya dang sprul dkar khra mang du yod pa zhig tu bsdad/ nom chi bla ma dang kho 31 sku skye la phyag tshigs sar cha khar tha yan chi/ cha gan tha yan chi/ ban+de tha yan chi gsum gyis rta rnga mong bzhi bcu lhag bsu ba'i tshul du skyel mi btang / nying zha mkhar gyi skya'o zer bas gnya' ba nas bteg pa'i shi gong zi zer ba'i mkhar gyi nye 'dabs su bsdad/ mi dpon phang shu'u sa rgya lugs kyi zas sna drangs/ de'i khad nyi shi gong zi'i gtsug lag khang mi gcig gis nyi ma bcu gcig la grub par grags gdugs/ ba dan/ bsil g.yab g.yas g.yon du bsgreng ba dang bcas pa 'chi med bdag po'i 'dun sa lta bu tshar du dngar ba byon/ bzhugs gral thog gong gi bka' shog dang mu tig gis spras pa'i snam sbyar gyis gtsos pa'i nyer (195ba)spyad kyi gnang sbyin rnams sprad/ dbang rang gi phyag rten du rgyal srid sna bdun yod pa'i gser gyi maṇ+ḍal zhig byung /der dbang byon pa'i stabs zhag gsum bcag mal byas/tshes lnga la u su thu rur 'byor skabs jo rig thub dbang gis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang ka to ra/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang gzheng pa / mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang gos dar rta sogs kyi khri 'bul bstar/ mi bzhi brgya tsam la byin rlabs byas/ jor de mur nas stag gzig gnas pa'i rong brgyud/ rdo'i tho zhes pa'i nags rong la zhugs te phyin/ de nyin nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga rma bya'i gdugs ltar phub 'dug par lnga la u su thu rur 'byor skabs jo rig thub dbang gis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang ka to ra/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang gzhed pa / mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang gos dar rta sogs kyi khri 'bul bstar/ mi bzhi brgya ba yod pa zhig mngon/ gong nas nged kyi sdod sar khi ri ta'i khar gsar du bskrun pa'i rgya khang rgya phibs lcags ri dang bcas pa der tshes drug gi nyin slebs/ byams gling no mon khan gyis bkras ji/ pho brang gi yig mkhan kha shas dang bcas par spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang byas/ bi lig thus mu tig gi zar tshags shig byin/nyer lnga la gong nas gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal rgyal srid sna bdun bkod pa/ dkar yol/ gser las grub pa'i dkar stegs/ bzed zhal/ spyi blugs/ sder ma 'brug 'phul ba'i khyad mtshar/ spos phor/dung chen/ rgya gling dang bcas pa/ 'phan/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ nyi yol sogs ti shri ra 'os pa'i chas rnams gnang bar nang blon ka pa las ma dang as khan a ma can kha shas byung / chos rje gun/ gtsang pa rab 'byams pa/ ārla khal/ bstan 'dzin chas rgyal gyi mi sna khon jin gzhan ma'i ldebs stir brgya —294—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)skor la spyan zir sa gags gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang byas/ ta'i kha nas mtsho sna sdong pa lo gsar 'bul bar 'byor/dgung lo so bdun par rgya nag tu mdzad 'phrin bskyangs lugs dang / bod du phyir log phebs pa'i lam bar gyi gnas tshul sogs kyi skor/lo 'jug dus rim dang rnam rgyal zhes pa (199na〉tsu mo sprul gyi lo tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i rim pa dang 'dod don gsol ba'i snyan dar phul/ bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston byes lam yin kyang gzhis su bsdad pa lta bu'i gra 'grig cing rten 'brel legs pa byung / tshes gsum gyi bar dbang / pa'i li/ be'i se/ gun/ am pa sogs ( drag rigs rnams kyis labs zhwa la bgos gzab 'chor dang bcas lo gsar dus ston gyi tshul du kha btags nyin bde mas mtshon dar zab kyi phyag rten bstar ba'i phrad mi mang bar byung / khor chin bing thu dbang / khi ya bla ma/ kho bo thu khu khu shog dge bshes can drug gis gtsos lnga bcu skor la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang / khe shing gi chin dbang gi phyag phyir dge slong blo bzang dang bcas par sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang dang de'i mngon rtogs gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/ bā thur ja'i sang dang pad+ma tha sor kha'i so sos dngul srang brgya skor/ ma cig dbang gi sring mo'i bsngo rten du gser srang zhe lnga las grub pa'i mchod kong / lus rgyan gyi rin po che dang gos dar gyis mtshon pa'i bdog pa rgya cher byung ba dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ dpon tshang byang ngos pa gnyan tshad du dogs pa'i nad kyis bro 'tshal bar sman bcos rim gro dang ngos kyis phyin pa'i rjes gnang gdon 'grol rgyal rdzongs byas rung dus babs dang glo bur ba ji ltar yang tshes brgyad la snga ma'i pho nyas zin par 'pho ba btab cing nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams —295

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ rta gos yug gis gtsos pa rnam grangs mang ba bteg /nyer dgu la ging ging dbang gis snga ma rnams dang 'dra ba'i gzhis len bzabs/ lha khang ser po'i bla ma a zhang gis 'dod mos (201ba)kyi dngos brgyud bla ma'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs smon lam bshags pa sogs rtsom pa kha yar dgos tshul byung ba bris/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par las rgya hor gyi yul grur rgyal ba myong kha pa'i thugs rje lhag par 'jug pa'i stabs kyis rim gro gzhan gang las kyang dmigs brtse ma 'di 'gyur che ba nas pho brang phyi nang gi rgya bod hor gsum gyi ban+de dang sgar pa skya ser kun 'dren du bcug pa'i so so'i grangs dang bstun pa'i yon la dngul srang khrir nye ba song / de mo sprul skus las gshin gyis gtor bzlog cig mdzad pa phyag len 'di yin rang mi 'dug kyang gsung bsnyen mang du song ba'i nyams kyis mtshan ltas legs rab snang / nub cig srod 'khor la sprin pa dang dud pa gang rung dbyibs khyab 'jug rā hu la'i rnam pa shin tu dod pa mdog dud kha skrag rngams yod pa zhig rgyu bzhin par lcags ri dkar po'i thad tsam nas yal ba bod sog 'ga' zhig gis mthong ba'i gleng gzhi byed 'dug pa nges par bden na rigs kyi srung mar song ba'i 'khor nyams yin 'dug pas legs pa 'dra/ nas ci tho yon gyis gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs bla med kyi lha'i mngon rtogs du ma pho mo kun la khyab gdal du bslabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sngar ma grags kyi rjes rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)pa'i rjes gnang /bsnyen rdzogs bco lnga/dge tshul 208bsum cu so gnyis/rab byung ma bcu bdun/dge bsnyen nyi shu tham pa rnams bsgrubs/hor zla lnga pa nye ba'i sar bsdad/ zhag lnga bcag mal byas pa'i ring thu med kyi tha'i ji gsum gyis thog drangs mkhar sngon phyogs kyi skya ser drag rigs la thugs rje chen po gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang bskur/ chu pha rir rin chen dbang dang paṇ+ḍi ta klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i skya ser lnga brgya tsam bsu bar 'byor (211na)dbang la jo bo lugs kyi sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang phul/ khal kha g.yon ru'i rgyal po bzlas lung byas/ dar khan chos rje/ gu lu gu/ tho bog jang gi gsum la mkhar sngon po'i zhig gsos thebs su gser zho lnga bcu dang rta nyis brgya sprad/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bsdoms pa sum cu skor bsgrubs/tshes bcu gnyis la zhor lam grub rgyal lha khang du phyin rma chu'i gru khar thu mad kyi tha'i ji gsum gyis gtsos pa'i brgya tsam la bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/ de nyin gru don nas le dbar lngar nye ba'i sar bsdad/ zhag lnga bcag mal byas pa'i ring thu med kyi tha'i ji gsum gyis thog drangs mkhar sngon phyogs kyi skya ser drag rigs la thugs rje chen po gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang bskur/ chu pha rir rin chen dbang dang paṇ+ḍi ta klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i skya ser lnga brgya tsam bsu bar 'byor (211na)dbang la jo bo lugs kyi sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang phul/ khal kha g.yon ru'i rgyal po yon mchod kyi mi sna brgya zin 'byor ba'i so so'i yig lan rnams 'tshems med du byas/ bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis ngor gnod sbyin beg ce'i spyan 'dren brtsams/ gong nas lung las sogs bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs pa thugs la btags ngos bod la bteg grub pa'i gnas tshul mchod yon gnyis la skyel bar dar khan nang so tshes bcu bdun la rdzong bda' byas/ zur kun mkhyen chen po dang khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba gnyis la'ang zhu 'phrin rten sbrags/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po'i rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin gyi lan/ jo bo shākya mu nir gos chen gyi snyan shal snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i kha byang dang bcas pa'i gong nas gnang ba'i gser tham gyi tham phud phul/ rin chen dbang gi lha khang dang ji nong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i jo bo'i —312

phyogs kyi nang so rnam pa/ mtsho kha'i dpon po mi bzang dmangs sogs khrom khri rwa can la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ ji nong chos skyid/ er te ni da'i chin / a mi dhar rnams la tshe rta/ a ga dge tshul/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ mgon po tshe dbang can la rta mgrin/ chin da mu ni la tshe mgon/ sku 'bum chos rje/ nang so khag /ri khrod pa kha shas la dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar gyi lung rnams byas/ de mo sprul pa'i skus bdog pa'i tshan grangs smon lam tshigs bcad thugs rtsom mdzad de ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i rgan tha'i ji la sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang rnams byas/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la bstan 'dzin chung bar mgon po'i rjes gnang bskur/ se chen khung tha'i ji dang ji nong sogs dpon khag skyel mi rags rim 'di nas log /ja'i sang gu gri'i sde dmangs la ma ṇi'i lung / gzhan yang lam bar du phrad mi stong phrag gnyis lhag la byin rlabs dang me tog 'thor ba byas/ tshes lnga la a rig gi rang byung rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)pa'i rnam pa zhig gis thugs tsho mi zin pa mtsho sngon por byon bstun gzhi med du gyur kyang tshes nyi shu la sog tu bar chad kyi rnam pas glo bur du gshegs/ zhugs 'bul gyi nyin nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la rlung bser bu tsam yang mi rgyu zhing 'ja' sprin gyi gur ngo mtshar ba byung / er te ni da la'i bā thur dpon g.yog sum brgya skor/ smad ta lha rgyal dar (217na skong so dngos grub/ tor bu dmar rnams rim gyis bsu ba la 'byor/ lha rgyal dar la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ bu dmar can sum brgya skor la skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin/ da la'i bā thur la sme brtsegs ljang sngon gyi rjes gnang rnams thugs dang bstun/ shag tu sgar dmangs kyis nyin gcig spyi rim byas/ chos skyong chen po phebs nasad cha khog 'di la mi zhugs pa dag sku chas spyan gzigs rnams lcog tu skyel ba'i bslab ston mdzad/mtsho mor bar da la'i bā thur gyi dpon mo can brgya skor dang hor a mdo ba stong phrag tsam la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang / 'tshong bar phyin pa la rin zhig los yong zer skad/ de dgongs bka' gdams kyi chu 'go rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas su dge 'dun rnams kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas 'byor/ mchod khang gsar rgyab kyi steng du gnas mal byas te zhag gsum bsdad/jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang sku 'dra dbu yon ma gdan drangs nas mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dmigs rim nan tan du bsgoms shing dbang blangs/ 'du khang du spyi sos gzhis len dang bdog pa'i skyes bzabs/ 'bri gung sku 'bring ba zhabs drung dkon mchog rin chen phebs/ bzhugs gdan/ ldang ba/ mjal dar sku gzhen par cha bzhag gi bkur gzos gang che phul/ ja yun gsum gyi bar sngags gsar rnying bka' brgyud kyi gsung 'phros phar dri ba zhu ma dgos par shin tu mang ba phebs sgo gnang gin 'dug rung dbu ma tshos pa'i rdza gcog kho na las phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas ser sbreng shin tu rgyas pa bstar/ zhabs drung dang bla ma rtags brgyad rnams kyi legs skyes kyi bdog pa bstar/—322

ngar ba'i gsung bshad ma rdzogs dogs pa lta bu'i rdzong dam drags pa'i skyon las mang du thos pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtser son pa zhig gda'/ sang nyin sde pa thon pa mgon po bkra shis kyis sgar ston dang ldan gyi gos yol sogs bkod legs phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas (220na〉nar ston gyi bzhugs gral thog gnas rnying zhabs drung khri thog pas chos kyi gsung gleng rgya cher mdzad/ sku yon che zhing thugs ngar ba'i gsung bshad ma rdzogs dogs pa lta bu'i rdzong dam drags pa'i skyon las mang du thos pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtser son pa zhig gda'/ sang nyin sde pa thon pa mgon po bkra shis kyis sgar ston dang legs skyes/ dmar khams go bo dbon pos ja rta khrab sogs kyi brgya 'bul/ mtshur phu drung pa rin po che/ sbyor ra sprul sku rdo rje snying pos gtsos phyogs 'dus kyi mchog dman mang po dang mjal phrad byas/ sde pa thon pa mgon po bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i skyon rin po che'i bstod pa/ sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi ngor zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khrungasarabs gsol 'debs/ dpon tshang bya mchu ba tshe dbang rdo rjes dgos tshul byung ba ltar gso rig gi che brjod rnams bris/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po la lcags sdong ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ dwa la'i bā thur la sme brtsegs ljang sngon dang phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/ sol thon tha'i shi/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ rdo rje/ bkra shis/ sde pa thon pa rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang sgrom mda' mkhan po mthu stobs dpal 'byor la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dang mi 'khrugs pa'i mngon dkyil gyi lung bklags/ gong da rka/ra rdzong sdod gzer chen pa rnam rgyal tshe ring —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gis gra bsgrigs pa'i rdzong 'og gi chos sde khag /drung 'khor rnams bsdebs mtshungs su legs skyes spel bar 'byor/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling slob dpon (220ba)brag sna chos rje gra bcas kyis tshan grangs spel te rnam rgyal ma dang 'brel ba'i tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dkon gnyer dpon dge steng bla ma nyin ltar gyis 'ongs nas mol mchid zhib par byung /tshes bcu gcig la gsar rgyag mdzad pa'i dga' ldan khang gsar du rgyal pos 3|ga gsung ba ltar phyin pa'i gung tshigs byas/ gzhis ka sngar gyi bkod legs de las cung zad gnas 'gyur zhid bsil khang byang du bton pas mtshon pa'i thugs rtog rtsing skyon du mngon/ gos chen gyi slog pas gtsos dngos po tshan grangs kyi ster sbyin mdzad cing skyos ma'i lugs kyi zang zing gi bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ de bzhin du bla ma/ dpon rigs/ chos sde khag /drung 'khor sogs mchog dman dang bstun par 'bul ster gang la gang 'tsham 'tshems med song phyi dro rkyang thang sgang du bro gzhas kyi rtsed sna mang zhing rin chen sgang du chos skyong chen po khog zhugs kyis phebs/ dan 'bag spyang ki chu kha nas chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi dge 'dun nyis stong bdun brgya tsam gyis ser sbreng rgyas pas bsus te dga' ldan pho brang du 'byor/ nyi ma gsum gyi bar rim bzhin spyi sos 'du khang phan bde legs bshad gling pa dang legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa so so'i gra khang du gzhis len bzabs/dwags la sgam po'i sprul sku phebs/ lha brag gter byon thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dgos tshul byung yang slebs 'phral du song ba'i ma thub pas shog bu nyi shu rtsa 'dren gyi lung dbu tshugs tsam phul/ brag dkar lha chu nas tshe bdag gi chos skor zhig bton rgyu'i khul mdzad 'dug kyang rjes su byas (221na)tshe zhu la re'i mgo skor gyi rnam pa yin snang / ljang dpon pos dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po che dang mgon khang / mal gro gzims khang shar gyi phyag bzhi pa/ sde pa bya pas yang rtse gza' khang du snyan dar/ 'o rlon pas phyag drug pa'i phyi rten 'bul ba dang snyan dar gyi zhal yig dgos tshul byung ba rlams bris/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgyad cu skor bsgrubs/ sde pa bya ba 'gyur med yab —326

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)sras bsdebs mtshungs glo bur du grongs par brten sde pa rgyal po bkra shis srid 'dzin du 'byon pa'i sgo shar te khyab 'jug gi dbang dgos gsungs par las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma'i dbang rgyas pa de phul/ dbus gtsang gi drung 'khor rgya nag tu phyin pa phal cher 'khor zhag tu song / rgya bod kyi chu brje mtshams la lus kyi 'tsho skyong gal che gshis re zhig 'gol mtshams su bsdad/ bkra shis chos sde nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po phebs par lam bsdus sogs chag med rnams gsos shing gzhan yang 'dod chos ci rigs zhus/ phar tshe dpag med lcags sdong brgya rtsa/ rat+na gling pa'i klong gsal snying thig gi tshe dbang / chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gter gsar mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi dbang rnams phul/ gter gsar kyi tshe dbang skabs mda' rtse sor phyed tsam 'phel 'dug pa sku tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i rten 'brel du mngon/gong gis bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por lung las gnang sbyin bzang po stsal ba'i tham phud jo bo shākya mu nir phul ba'i tshigs bcad brtsams/ gzims khang gong sprul pa'i sku spo bo chu mdo nas phebs (221ba)pa zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la phrad par byon te ja rta khrab kyi ster cha mdzad/stag lung zhabs drung ma chen khams ri bo cher bzhugs pa'i dbu ma lo tsā ba ja 'dren du ched bstad rdzong bda' gnang / de ga'i lan kyang snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa zhib par gsol/ lo mjug dus rim gyi rdo rje slob dpon la phyin/ 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i zor las rgyas par byas shing bkra rtags legs par byung /—327—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhal yig dang bcas bstar/ mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gnyis kyis phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang du gos chen gyi gnam rgyan yongs rdzogs phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul bzhin bris/ 'bras spungs 'du khang gsar bskyed kyi zhig gsos mdzad pa'i steng shod rnams kyi shing sa rtsa bzabs rgyas/ 'du khang ka ba brgya (223na)dang brgyad kyi ldebs bris la rten gtso thub dbang nyan thos gnyis/ sbyin bdag /chos skyong gi sku dang gtso bor rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing / gnam yangs la lam rim bla brgyud/ sgo khang lho la rgyal che bzhi/ shar la srid pa 'khor lo/ dngul gdung khang gi ldebs bris rnying pa'i 'phro 'thud la sangs rgyas sum rtsa lnga/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /de'i steng rab gsal la snar thang brgya rtsa dang 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ mchod khang gsar pa'i zhal ras lha khang la gnas bcu/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ gzims chud hor phibs la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar zhing bkod/ rdo gcal gyi khri rgyab la rgyal ba tsong kha pa yab sras/ bde yangs gra khang lo snga ma nas gsar du bsgrubs pa'i steng shod kyi shing rtsi/ ldebs bris la rgyal ba myong kha pa/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug /rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ dmag zor ma/ drag mo rgyal/ gnas chung ge chas rgyal rnams dang stag ru ba'i 'char ston bzhin dga' ldan pho brang gi rab gsal rnying par shing rtsi/ jo bo'i lam yig bkod pa'i gong gsal la sman thang pa'i dbu chen stag lung dpal mgon/ lha sa skal ldan/ 'brong rtse blo bzang / mkhyen brtse ba'i dbu mdzad gong dkar gsang sngags mkhar ba/ zho ra dgos dgos kyis gtsos sman mkhyen bsdoms pa drug cu re brgyad kyis zla ba drug la grub pa'i do dam stag ru ba nor bu dang rong dpal gling pas byas/rwa sgreng du sprul sku hor dar can mi grangs(223ba)bcu gcig gis mi g.yo ba/ mgon po dmar nag sogs 'bur sku kha yar bzhengs/ sne'u sdong rtse nas zhabs drung rin po che yab sras phebs/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang phul/ phyag phyir rin po che sman lung pa byon snang ba sgrol dkar la bka' babs kyi brgyud lugs mang po yod tshul dang da lam gyi 'di tshar chen chos kyi rgyal —330

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()zhal yig dang bcas bstar/ mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gnyis kyis phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i 'du khang du gos chen gyi gnam rgyan yongs rdzogs phul ba'i kha byang dgos tshul bzhin bris/ 'bras spungs 'du khang gsar bskyed kyi zhig gsos mdzad pa'i steng shod rnams kyi shing sa rtsa bzabs rgyas/ 'du khang ka ba brgya (223na)dang brgyad kyi ldebs bris la rten gtso thub dbang nyan thos gnyis/ sbyin bdag /chos skyong gi sku dang gtso bor rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing / gnam yangs la lam rim bla brgyud/ sgo khang lho la rgyal che bzhi/ shar la srid pa 'khor lo/ dngul gdung khang gi ldebs bris rnying pa'i 'phro 'thud la sangs rgyas sum rtsa lnga/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /de'i steng rab gsal la snar thang brgya rtsa dang 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ mchod khang gsar pa'i zhal ras lha khang la gnas bcu/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ gzims chud hor phibs la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar zhing bkod/ rdo gcal gyi khri rgyab la rgyal ba tsong kha pa yab sras/ bde yangs gra khang lo snga ma nas gsar du bsgrubs pa'i steng shod kyi shing rtsi/ ldebs bris la rgyal ba myong kha pa/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug /rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ dmag zor ma/ drag mo rgyal/ gnas chung chos rgyal rnams dang stag ru ba'i 'char ston bzhin dga' ldan pho brang gi rab gsal rnying par shing rtsi/ jo bo'i lam yig bkod pa'i gong gsal la sman thang pa'i dbu chen stag lung dpal mgon/ lha sa skal ldan/ 'brong rtse blo bzang / mkhyen brtse ba'i dbu mdzad gong dkar gsang sngags mkhar ba/ zho ra dgos dgos kyis gtsos sman mkhyen bsdoms pa drug cu re brgyad kyis zla ba drug la grub pa'i do dam stag ru ba nor bu dang rong dpal gling pas byas/rwa sgreng du sprul sku hor dar can mi grangs(223ba)bcu gcig gis mi g.yo ba/ mgon po dmar nag sogs 'bur sku kha yar bzhengs/ sne'u sdong rtse nas zhabs drung rin po che yab sras phebs/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang phul/ phyag phyir rin po che sman lung pa byon snang ba sgrol dkar la bka' babs kyi brgyud lugs mang po yod tshul dang da lam gyi 'di tshar chen chos kyi rgyal —330

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)po'i phyag len yin 'dug pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsan pa'i tshe ril tshe chang gnang rgyun yod pa zhig mthong ba deng sang rgyun yod med kyi dri mal zhib tu mdzad/ zang zing gi dngos po tshur gnang phar 'bul grub nas pho brang chen por phyir phebs/ snga thog gu ge chos rje snying stobs rgya mtshos sa bon rgyas pa bris te bskul yang brel ba gzhan gyis 'gyangs pa nye lam gsar bskul ba med rung dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i gsang ba'i rnam thar bris/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyis rim gro'i bskul ma'i lung bstan byung ba'i 'phrin lan gyi tshigs bcad snyan shal dang sbrags pa phul bla ma btsan po'i dgon pa dga' ldan dam chos gling dpal ldan dmag zor mar gnyer gtad kyi tshigs bcad/ rgyal gnyer pa rnying pa sger logs dbon dar gyis bskul ba'i rta rgod shel lcags kyi gsol mchod bris/zla mjug tu rje bla ma zur chen gung thang du phebs/ de skabs srung ma'i 'tshub kyi rnam pas zhabs la skrangs 'bur cung zad byung ba'i rkyen gyis zla lhag tsam bsnyun tshul bstan pa'i tshe brtan bzhugs dang bcas bar gcod kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'bul bar btang / ja'i sang (224na8 pas bskul nas sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i yi ge dang don gnyer can du ma'i ngor klu gtor bris shing ljang rams pa ngag dbang don grub sogs chos 'khor gling pa'i gra pa kha shas kyis nyin grangs mang bar btang char yang legs po babs pa de'i phan yon yin nam zer/ nged kyis zla ba bzhi pa nas lnga pa'i zla stod bar lha brag gter byon las khyung gi bsnyen mtshams mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byas/rgya nag gi sa chu ma 'phrod pas gsangs pa ma gtogs med 'dug ces phyogs mtha' mang por grags pas dga' sdug gi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan tshod du snang / mtshams snga ma'i mu 'thud nas gnam lcags drag po rdzas rgod kyi sgrub pa bdun gcig mun mtshams shin tu dam pa'i skabs gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags mtshan kyang legs pa byung / nyer gnyis la nang mtshams grol ba'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa'i mdos bskang gi rdo rje slob dpon du phyin rung nyer gcig gi nub mo glo bur du —33/—

thegs pa'i ring khyad kyis bskul ma tsha drag pas byang ngos nas kyi thugs dang mthun pa'i 'jam srongs kyi bcos ka byed long ma byung zhing gtar kha byas na nad gsar par song bas rjes su zhabrun chod tsam byung / mchod dpon pa gnas chung lcog tu rten mdos gnyis 'dzugs par btang /shangs bkra shis rtse ba mnga' ris su 'gro gdong tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ phyag drug pa dang las gshin gyi rjes gnang byas/ zhabs drung yid bzhin la'ang tshe dbang phul/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kha shas bsgrubs/ chos rje bco brgyad pa dang ngor pa shar pa gnyis phrad par byon/ phyogs kyi drung 'khor rnams kyang bsdus gnas chung lcog tu phyin/ de skabs dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che rin spungs su phebs pa'i sa bcad yod pa ltar chos skyong chen por gegs yod med dri ba zhus par rin chen spungs pa ma bsgral na bar chad mi yong ba sdug 'dres khag theg byed ces zhal gyis bzhes/sgang du shun pa'i drung 'khor rnams kyis bsnyen bkur/ de nub snye thang 'or du bsdad nas mnyam med jo bo chen po'i mchod sdong sogs mjal zhing smon lam btab/ dgon khag tshos ser sbreng yang bsgrigs —332

khyer ba'i rten 'brel shin tu lod pa byung / nyer drug la 'bras spungs su 'byor/ khal kha a kha'i da'i chin gyi bu cha gan bar dang phrad cing tshe mgon gyi rjes gnang phu'// dga' ldan gsang sngags gling par byang gter thugs sgrub rnam gsum gyi (232ba)chos skor dang tshe bdag lcags 'dra nas lung gi dbu tshugs tsam/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling par skyabs sems/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ sal ma gsum/ gsum pa/ gsar rtsom rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs rnams kyi lung phul/ spong rong dka' bcu grags pa can bsnyen rdzogs nyer gsum dang rab byung lnga bcu skor bsgrubs/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la khun 'du len o pa shi —343

brgya 'bul bteg cing grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / spyan ras gzigs dang phyag drug pa gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang / yang dgon spyan snga sha ra hor sku skye/ gzhi rtsa sde pa/ bstan 'dzin gsum la nyang lugs drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang bskur/ me'i spu gri dang las gshin rlung sgrub kyi sgrub pa btsugs shing g.yin gyi mnan gtad smin nas rgyal po sku mi 'tsho ba'i ltas kha yar byung snang /lo 'di'i dpyid ka phan chad sgrub khag phal cher gyi rdo rje slob dpon brag (233na sko chos rje phyon bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad cing / 'di nas bzung mtshams le tshan dang sa phag man gyi phur sgrub/khro rol/ tshe 'char sogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhal snga nas blo bzang dar rgyas/ bying pa sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub/ dge slong blo bzang rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ brag sna chosarje blo bzang ngag dbang / dge slong byams pa blo bzang / dge slong blo bzang don grub/ sngags rams pa dkon mchog rin r+pā/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje rkan bu ba zil gnon rdo rje/ rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dgung lo so dgu par pha bong khar gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams la bka' chos dang / gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin bstar ba sogs kyi skor/shing lug gnam lo gsar tshes kyi srid gsum dbang mor mchod gtor thog 'phrin las bcol ba'i snyan shal phul/ bzhugs gral gyi dus ston bstar/ gra tshang du rnam rgyal ma'i cho ga rgyud sde g.yin la (235ba)gzhogs drud kyi ha cang khungs mi btsun zhing mdzad byang yang med pa zhig 'dug pas lugs srol 'di ga'i rang skad dang mthun pa'i bdag mdun stong mchod kyi cho ga gsar du brtsams/tshes bzhi la spyi khang du slob dpon rnams dang lhan cig par gnyer pas bkur sti bzabs/ gtsang dus dbus gtsang gnyi gar bka' 'gyur rgyun sgrogs mdzad pa chag pa'i nyams gsos la 'di lo nas de tshab star chags 'gab tshul sde par zhus pa la dgon khag dgongs bcad kyis zhal bkod mdzad 'dug par/ zla ba dang por gong dkar thod ri bshad sgrub gling dang rin spungs dga' ldan byams pa gling / gnyis par chu shur thar pa gling pa dang dpal 'khor chos sde'i dge lugs gra tshang rnams nas bsdus pa/ gsum par dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa dang gangs can chos 'phel/ gnas cho me sde/lhun rtse chos sde/ sngo mo rdzong pa rnams tsho bsdus/ bzhi par thos bsam dar rgyas gling pa dang dga' ldan 'og min gling pa/ lnga par skyor lung / spe ser/ nyi thang tsho bsdus dang / shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/drug par chos 'khor yangs rtse ba dang gangs can pa/ rgyal chen rtse/ ri bo gdangs can pa rnams tsho bsdus/ bdun par 'ol dga' tsho bsdus/ gnas rnying / 'brong rtse/ gser sdings pa rnams tsho bsdus/brgyad par dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa dang dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling pa/ dgu par ri bo bde chen pa/ dga' ldan 'og min gling pa dang mang mkhar dar gling ba dril ba/ bcu par thos bsam dar —348

mtsho/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/—353

dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul/mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu ma/las gshin nang sgrub/rnam srasaser chen smad lugs/dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ba/rje bsod nams rgya mtsho la srong btsan sgam pos dag snang du gnang ba'i dpal lha/gur lha brgyad thun mong ba/zhal bsnyen dus kyi mgon po/gnod sbyin beg tse/gnubs lugs stag zhen rnams kyi rjes gnang /lung la/phur pa'i las byang /gtor 244 na ) bzlog/sgrub chen chog sgrigs/tshe bdag las byang /kha skong gter gzhung dang byang pa'i ljags sgrigs/mchod bstod gsal sgron/drag po rtsal dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul/mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu/gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu ma/las gshin nang sgrub/rnam srasaser chen smad lugs/dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ba/rje bsod nams rgya mtsho la srong btsan sgam pos dag snang du gnang ba'i dpal lha/gur lha brgyad thun mong ba/zhal bsnyen dus kyi mgon po/gnod sbyin beg tse/gnubs lugs stag zhen rnams kyi rjes gnang /lung la/phur pa'i las byang /gtor 244na ) bzlog/sgrub chen chog sgrigs/tshe bdag las byang /kha skong gter gzhung dang byang pa'i ljags sgrigs/mchod bstod gsal sgron/drag po rtsal dang thugs rje chen po'i las byang /gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa le lag dang bcas pa/sngags snab ma gtogos pa'i 'char ka nyang lugs kyi gter gzhung /'jigs byed za ma tog/rnam rgyal ma/phyag drug pa/las gshin/dmag zor ma/bstan gsol/gur zhal/stag zhen/thang lta/zhing skyong /khyab 'jug/pe har/tse'u dmar ba/rdor legs rnams kyi bskang gso gsol mchod/ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dang ja mchod le tshan sogs tshogs kyi zhal 'don phal cher gyi lung phul/tshes gsum la dbang yon gyi tshul du bdog pa dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/bsam blo yang dgon nang so dang chab mdo'i gnas po 'ga' zhig la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /dwags po gra tshang gi slob dpon zur pa 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang mkhas btsun/dmar khams go bo dbon po/spong rong dka' bcu grags pa sogs dbang cha gcig la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dge lugs 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur/thos pa che'ang ngag sgo dog pa'i bum nang gi mar me lta bu dang kha la rgyug kyang 6/ngas pa chung ba rnams dang mi 'dra bar dus thog

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)der zhal snga nas mkhas btsun de dge bshes 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig snang yang mkhas pa lag pa stong par 'gro ba'i dpe bzhin 'jig rten par grags pa'i 'phrin las ni shin tu (244ba〉spyang / me'i spu gri dang gshin rje rlung sgrub kyi rim gro btsugs/ tshes bdun nas gnam gang gi bar dge rtse dang a rig gi rta 'bul ba mang du slebs/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu dang dge tshul sum cu lhag bsgrubs te so so'i re ba bkang /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas bdun gyi bar byams pa sprul pa'i sku/ lcang ra 'un du su chos rje sogs gsar 'grul mang ba dang phrad/ mgon po tshe dbang dang mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu bdun/ rab byung nyi shu rtsa lnga skor bsgrubs/ tshesadagu la byams pa sprul pa'i skus brgya 'bul bstar/ nyer gsum la bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dgongs rdzogs su gsar bzhengs kyi smon grong mchod khang la rab gnas bgyid par 'byor/ sgong gseb nas bzung mchod khang par rta rmig 'jog sa med pa lta bu'i khrom dmar nag tu 'khyil 'dug /sang rmi ru ba tshor bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas shing skyid shod sde pa khag rnams byon pa dang phrad/nyer drug la 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgo nas rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga tshang ba byas/ de dang dus mtshungs dga' ldan khang gsar du dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa dkon cog chos bzang phebs te rgyal po'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul gnang / de'ang rten bzheng rnams nyi ldog gong la tshar res mtshan mo'ang sgron me spar te bal pos bzo byas shing 'jim sku tsho nam dus kyis 'khyags zhu langs par nye bas me bkongs kyis skem pa mdzad 'dug rung nyi ldog gi steng du dus tshes 'grig pa byung song /gnas rnying zhabs drung khri thog pa blo (245na)bzang kun dga' bde legs lcags bsnyen gyi rigs ma song bar rta mgrin gyi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i las kyi rnam pa'i bar chad cig gis glo bur du zhing khams 'phos pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor khong pa sku tshe mthar phyin na bstan pa la phan pa zhig yong ba 'dug kyang bstan pa'i sku chags kyi rnam pa lta bur mngon/ gcod pa bā thur can —361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()dang phrad/ nyer bdun la 'bras spungs su slebs/ dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa dang mjal/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i zla stod kyi ring phan bde sku skyer 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi bde mchog dkar po dang ba ri lugs kyi sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i rjes gnang / bla ma mchod pa dang lha sa'i dkar chag sogs gsar rtsom kha yar gyi lung byas/ g.yon ru dga' ldan pa yon mchod stong phrag tu nye bar gtsug lag khang chen mo'i khyams su grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur zhing brgya 'bul kyang bstar/byams pa sprul pa'i skur tshe rta/ thor god mgon po yel deng dang chog thu ja'i sang la tshe dbang / g.yon ru mchod yon la rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs/ no mon dge slong la spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/mkha' 'gro dge tshul mar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang byas/ g.yon ru dga' ldan sku skye dge bsnyen du bsgrubs pa'i ming ngag dbang 'jam dpal nor bur btags/ tshes bcu bzhi la phur sgrub dang nyer gsum la 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i zor las tshugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du phyin/ phur sgrub grol nas dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs bsdoms pa bcu skor bsgrubs/dgung lo bzhi bcu par rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas dang / dpung chen lho mon du drangs pa bcas kyi skor/me sprel hor zla (245ba)dang po nyis brtsegs kyi gnam lo'i thog mar dpal ldan re ma ti'i mchod gtor dang 'phrin 'chol spel ba'i snyan shal phul/ tshes bzhi'i bar lo gsar bzhugs gral kyi dga' ston/ lnga nas bcu'i bar mtshams shin tu dam par sgrol ljang gi bzlas brjod dang sbrags sgrol mdos btang / thun mtshams shig la bying pa bde legs kyis bskul ba'i tshigs bcad cig brtsams/legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa'i gra khang du gzhis len dang gra dmangs rnams kyis smon lam shis —362

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)brjod kyis mtha' brten pa mdzad/ tshes bcu gnyis la 'bras spungs spyi khang du lo gsar gyi dus ston bstar nas lam brkyangs te chos 'khor lha sar phyin/ smon lam chen mo sngar rgyun ltar tshugs pa'i thog dben sa sprul sku dang thor god mgon po yel deng sogs gsar 'grul rnams kyis bsnyen bkur zhing brgya 'bul stong 'bul kha yar blangs/ gsar 'grul tshor rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang / tshe rta zung 'brel gyi byin rlabs dang / nye lding tre bo sku skyer tshe mgon gyi byin rlabs byas/nyer drug la lha sa nas bteg lha gdong shan khar gur g.yabs phub pa'i sa skyong dga' ldan pa thog rgod rnam rgyal yab sras thab bsur byon/ tshal gung pa rnams kyi bsu ba dang bcas zur khang du gung gi dro bstabs/ sngags mkhar ba'i ser sbreng skye bo'i khrom chen po'i mdun bdar te bde chen rtser 'byor/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gsar bzhengs mdzad par nyer bdun gyi nyin gra tshang dang bcas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma la brten nas rab gnas 'bring po cha lag tshang ba shis pa (246na)brjod pa'i me tog sil ma phyogs kun tu bkram/ rab ston gyi bzhugs gral dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams dang drung 'khor drag rim tshor grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / nyang lugs kyi drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang / phyag rdor gos sngon can dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel rnams phul/nyer dgu la lam zhor sngags mkhar du khri rin po che mnga' ris pas yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar phyin pa'i gdan bzhes dang tshogs la dmigs brtse ma'i lung / ran dzab byams par smon lam btab cing zur khyab bdag bla mas shog gsung ba ltar gung tshigs la tshal chos khri bla brang du phyin/mchod khang rnams mjal zhing tshal yang dgon du bla ma dge dar bas dkar spro bshams/ chos skyong chen pos rgyal khang du me tog 'thor dgos tshul ltar bgrod/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la khrims ldan 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bsu ba dang bcas ser theg chen gling du slebs/ spyi so dang gra tshang khag gis gzhis len dang zang zing gi dngos po gya nom pa bstar/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad gsar —363—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzhengs la gra tshang dang bcas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa byas/ sog po kha shas la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang
