dge tshul sum cu bsgrubs/ sog po ri khrod pa zhig la 'jam dbyangs (246ba)chos skor nas khros nag gi byin rlabs dang mgon po yel deng dpon g.yog la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ seng ge sgra/ gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang rnams bskur/ de dang lhan du 'dul ba zur pa o rod chos rje 'dengs song bar rdzong ba bstabs hor zla gsum pa'i brgyad gtor sngar 'byud bzhin btang / g.yas ru g.yon ru'i don skor la se chen dbon po mtsho khar rdzong bda' byas/ chos 'khor rgyal du byams khang dang nub rgyud ma gtogs pa'i bla brang skor rnams kyi bshu 'bub dang gsar brgyab shing lug grub pa'i 'di lo sde pa'i thugs bzhed ltar 'du khang chen mo'i ldebs bris la cho 'phrul bkod pa/ rgyal chen bzhi/ seng g.yabs la rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs/ chos skyong skor gyi bla brgyud/ 'du khang thog mgon khang la nag po skor gsum/ gur zhal/ dmag zor ma/ beg tse/jo bo rgyal mtshan pa/ rta rgod shel lcags/ rgya la rigs bzang / rgyal mo phyug mo rnams bris pa'i ar po dang ri mo gnyis ga'i do dam stag ru ba nor bu/ ri ma'i do dam gyi sbrel zla ka bzhi smad pa/ ri mo pa dbu mdzad dpal mgon gyis gtsos pa'i drug cu re drug gis bsgrubs/ bzad du gang tshang nas pu ṣ+yobha dras do dam byas pa'i snye thon khul gyi bris pa byed nyis brgyas bka' 'gyur skya pod tshar gcig bzhengs pa'i phogs gla yon 'bru thog tu dril bar mkhar khal chig khri bdun stong brgyad brgya song /paṇa chen nags rin gyi dbu zhwa sna dkar rtse'i nang rten gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtshos ster sbyin mdzad/ dol gnas gsar bas seng ldeng las grub pa'i phur pa lha (247na〉nag gi phur cha yongasardzogs shin tu dngos gtsang ba brkos/ 'di mus nas las ka gzhan 'dra'ang byung ba dang bcas bskyil rtsis la sde pa nor bus lho dmag gi sgrogs bzo bar khrid pa dgra la nus pa med pa'i bzo bo mkhas pa —364—

gnas tshul la dpags na rten 'brel legs par mngon/ zhag gsum gyi bar mchod pa rgyas par bshams shing smon lam nan tan du btab/ de nas po ta la'i mchod khang du bzhugs/ de'ang rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i bstan pa spyi lung du/ skyid grong jo bo dbus g.yor phyogs su 'byon zhes pa'i dus la babs pas bzlog ma nus kyang so so'i bzhugs gnas bka' babs de las 'phos pa thams cad du shis pa zhig dka' bar 'dug /de'i mus las/ dge ba'i ming can byang chub sems dpa' zhig: dam sel grib kyis mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs zhes pa jo bo byon pa'i dus gang zag de 'dra zhig gzhan du gshegs par dogs (248na)pa byed mkhan 'dug rung byang sems de gshegs pa'i dus rtags/ sne yi sdong po star thogs gcod pa 'byung : zhes sogs la mar sbyor rgyu yin pas phag mo gru pa'i bstan pa nyams par nye ba'i dus snga thog yin/ byamasapa ngag dbang lhun grub la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs gyi tshul/ gling stod chos rje gso rig —366—

rgya gar gyi yul phal cher la dbang sgyur ba shākya rā dza'i sras 'bring po bha thi la'i rgyal srid kyi bdag po sha ha su dzas ma hā ma dha sha pi mngags te rgya gar dang stod zog gi skyes mang du bskur/ mi ched du 'ongs don rgyal po'i khri la shel gyi rgyan mang po dgos kyin yod 'dug pa shun gyi ltag na shel dkar brag khung zer ba'i phug stong yan pa phyon rin po che'i sgrub gnas su ri bong cal sgrog la brten gnas mjal mi mang bas shel gyi ka ba dang gdung ma yod ces rdzun lab byas pa gtam byi khung dang sa mtha'i dpe bzhin rgya gar du grags pas len 'dod yin 'dug /'gro ba rnams 'khor bar ba'i mus la/ zan de srog chags ltar 'gro ba dang yang rdzong gi rta lam du dmag gis 'tshangs pas ja'i sang sde pa dang lhan cig char —369

cal sgrog la brten gnas mjal mi mang bas shel gyi ka ba dang gdung ma yod ces rdzun lab byas pa gtam byi khung dang sa mtha'i dpe bzhin rgya gar du grags pas len 'dod yin 'dug /'gro ba rnams 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba 'brul snang bden 'dzin 'di rigs kho na'i rkyen du gda'/ chab mdo rnam sras sogs kyi 'phrul dang mkha' 'gro rang gi sgos dbang la brten pa'i gzer chen nas sdod ma bde bar 'ba'i rdzong sdod la dar khan dka' bcu rdzong bda' dang sbrags 'bar chos sde gsar du 'dzugs pa'i bslab ston mdzad/ chos skyong chen pos sprul pa'i sku'i pur bzhu'i dus nye skor du bsdad pa mi 'gab pas po ta pa'i skyon du snang bas chos skyong la log lta dgos rigs su mi gda'/ de'ang chos skyong rnams kyi lung bstan mo rtsis/ mi dmangs kyis brjod rigs gang la dpags kyang lho'i dpung 'jug de 'gro khyab che ba zhig yong rigs min 'dug rung dbus dpung dang khams kong rnams dgon dang bum thang du bcug tshe bum thang du man chad tshur chod pa tsam gyi mtha' brten pa'i rjes yong rigs la tshang ma spa gror dril ba sde ba nor bu'i che 'don la mi 'gro ba'i khar khong pas pho ma skyes pa'i dmag yun gyis be ge sogs nad rims dang lho tshad kyis mi gces mang du gron/ gad kha sa'i sger g.yog stag lung sman grong pas/ (256ba)rgyal rtser sde par phul ba'i zhu yig la da la'i bā thur dang ma gcig tha'i ji gnyis bstan pa'i lcags ri dang sde pa nor bu khar bzhes mdzad dgos pa'i gces 'phangs che bas dbyar gyi ring phag ri tsam la 'then/ gzhan su shi'ang mi la mi 'thogs pas lo sbrel 'jog dgos zhes bod gangs can pa thams cad sdebs su stongs kyang ji mi snyam pa'i rgyu mtshan phul snang ba dgos don ji ltar yang 'bras spungs su ched bstad sten par btang byung / tshur 'then rtsis mdzad 'dug rung sog po'i dpon po gnyis gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pas dpung chen 'then na nged gnyis yong ba gzhir bcas/ dmangs ma bzhag ste log pa'i gtam khur nas sog po'i khrod du gdong ston mi nus zhes 'byon ma nyan/ ma gcig tha'i ji glo bur du grongs pa mon tshad yin nam zer/ mgron gnyer drung pa can mang dag gis zab khog nas brjod rigs tha'i jis sde pa nor bur sdang zug ches par brten zas sbyor zhig byung 'dra gleng / khong gi bsngo byang 'byor don bzhin gnas —378

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)spar nan tan du bgyis shir pur sbyongs ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon byams pa rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rus pa bskyal byung bar sāts+tsha lag dar mang du btab/ gdan sa gong 'og gi zhabs drung rin po che gnyis kyis dbu mdzad/ bkra shis lhun po skyid shong ngor sogs kyi bar chings pa rnams kyis kyang dmag tshur 'then thub pa dang lo shas kyi chings las spros pa'i don mthong gang yang ma byung ba'i mchod yon lhan rgyas chibs kha sgyur ba'i nyer brgyad la 'bras spungs su phebs/ dgu gnam gang tshor (257na)phrad mi mang du byung /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nas zhag bdun gyi bar nyin ltar chu zhugs la phyin/ bsnyen rdzogs lnga bcu dang dge tshul brgyad cu skor bsgrubs/ ra ba stod bla ma zur pa brag sgo rab 'byams par bcu gcig zhal mkha' 'gro lnga'i byin rlabs dang nyi lding tre bo sku skye la snar thang brgya rtsa'i nang gi sgrol dkar/ phyag rdor/ mgon po gri gug gsum gyi rjes gnang byas/ nyi shu la blo gsal gling gi gra khang gsar par me tog gtor/ tshogs par chos spyod kha shas kyi lung phul/ nyer drug nas sgo mang slob dpon zur pa ga ru ba ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ rnam rgyal slob dpon blo bzang dar rgyas/ ri khrod dga' ldan bla ma byams pa rin cen/ gser khang 'og bla ma blo gros chos 'phel/ spyan g.yas dka' bcu blo bzang rnam rgyal sogs bcu gnyis la zla gcig lhag tsam gyi bar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams 'khrid smin rgyas dang hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas zla gcig bar phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i gra pa bco brgyad la yang tig gces sgron/ gsang ba rmad byung / 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma'i nyams 'khrid zhib par phab/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang du bsnyen rdzogs bzhi bcu dang dge tshul lnga bcu tsam bsgrubs/ hor sku skye/ pā ras/ co zhe/ ta 'on pa/ zung chus mtshon pa'i mdo stod smad kyi 'grul pa mang du byung bar spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa dang han sku skye sger du las gshin phyi sgrub/ 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' skal bzang la 'jam dbyangs nag po'i rjes gnang / byams (257ba)pas dam bcas pa dang sman bla'i gzungs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa'i lung rnams byas/—379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la 'khrid gnyis ka grol ba'i bkra shis ljongs chos rje byon te zang zing gi tshan grangs bstar nas ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs sku sger du grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs/ phyag drug pa/ sme brtsegs ljang sngon sogs kyi rjes gnang /phyogs 'dus kyi chos nyan pa lnga bcu skor dang lhan cig par lam rim chen mo/ bka' gdams thor bu/ sems dpa' chen po thogs med pa'i blo sbyong rnams kyi lung phul/ o rod nas du ri yal kho sho chi 'byor ba'i nyer gsum la gser srang lnga brgya/ dngul srang stong phrag drug /gos yug stong phrag phyed gnyis/ dar ras jas gtsos pa'i khri 'bul bstar/ byad 'grol dang rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang sogs rkyen sel gyi 'dod chos mang du byas/ thod pa zhal dbye'i skabs nye bar mkho ba'i 'chi bdag gshin rje'i las byang bris/ dus dgra'i dbang po la brten pa'i mtshams khag rnams kyang dkyu/sa bzhin btsugs/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas bdun phrag bzhi'i bar bsnyen mtshams dam du bcad/bcu gnyis pa'i nang du phur sgrub zin rjes du ri yal kho sho chi dpon g.yog rang yul du rdzong bda' byas/ zla mjug tu dus kyi dgra bo'i sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du phyin kyang gtor zor 'phen par 'gro bar mchod dpon pa khams ma bde ba nas de tshab dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis byed dgos shar zhing dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin skad chung skad po che 'ga' (258na)res dbyangs g.yas khyer g.yon khyer gyi spyan rnam bkra po rang mi 'dug pas 'gro ma thub/—380

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)dgung lo zhe gnyis par sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gshegs pa dang / bstan 'dzin da la'i han rgyal po'i khri la 'khod pa bcas kyi skor/sa khyi lo gsar gyi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mchod gtor rgyas pa dang 'di lo nas bzung 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan shal star chags su phul/ 31 gsar bzhugs gral 'bras spungs 'du khang du mdzad pa'i sog bod skya ser gyis bar mtshams med pa lta bur khyab/'di nas lo drug tsam gyi li tho mkhas dbang ldum po ba dang phu gu lung pa can gyis bzos grub nas snga sor mkhas pa mang por gtugs pa'i rtsis skor la mtha' gang chod byas pa yin rung gza' lnga'i mgyogs rtsis chen mo sogs phug lugs kyi man ngag kha shas blor ma chud pa rnams dpal mgon 'phrin las kyi rje dpal seng bar gnang / de'i rgyun bla mkhyen bkra shis mtshan can nas rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mkhas mchog don grub dbang rgyal la bzhugs 'dug pa zhib tu nyan/ gong gi gser yig pa shes rab bla ma/ bsam gtan dge slong / ba'i ri bdun gyis gtsos pa zhar byung du 'ongs pa'i 'grul pa mang ba dang bcas 'byor ba'i mi sna rnams kyis 'du khang du bzhugs gral thog gong ma'i bka' shog gnang sbyin sogs sprad/ sog po'i dpon khag gi khrod du khun 'du len gyi bu khong long du ma zad btsas pa'i dus nas rna bas mi thos shing smra mi shes pa'i ltas ngan gyi rigs shig 'dug cing bzhugs gral gyi dus kha ba'ang rdog rjes len tsam babs pa'i bkra rtags lod nges shig byung /tshes lnga la lha sar phyin/ rgyal sa bsko ba'i rten 'brel nas (258ba)rgyas rgyas shig dgos mdog kha rung 'di res rol cha skya dar tshang ma bzhag pa'i bsdus pa zhig mdzad song / cha gan no mon khan/dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ se chen dpon po can lugs de la mkhas pa mang po dang sde nga —381—

'dzin rdo rje rgyal po'i cho lo phul/ shal dkar dmar/ ja gos dar snam bu phung por spungs pa'i ster cha gtos che ba/ ser 'bras bkra shis lhun pos thog drangs pa'i rang phyogs 'gangs che rigs rags bsdus kyis legs skyes bstar/ sang nas bzung nyin gsum gyi bar gdan sa gong 'og /sne'u sdong rtse/ 'bri stag sogs bla chen rnams kyi sku tshab/ sprul sku gdung brgyud mkhan slob bla ma che phra'i rigs/ phul chog khul la la khar dpon pa drag rim thams cad la nad langs pa lta bus rgyal por 'khod pa dang ma 'khod pa tshang mar bgo bsha' brgyab pa'i 'bul dgos shar bar brten zar zir gyi bar nas spra lag can 'dras 'brong gsob kyi mun pa nag sar tshan grangs steng nas dbri ba sogs sna tshogs byung skad/ khri 'don gyi legs 'bul ba mang ba'i phrad mi nyin kha yar gyi bar rgyun mi chad pa lta bus g.yengs/ pa rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon yang dag byas/ phar mnyel cha yang rjes 'jug rnams tshems 'phreng gi ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i rgyas pa bstar song / gdan sa gong gi zhabs drung khri rin po che bsam yas chos rgyal dpon blon gyi sdig khrab sgrog par ched gnyer gdan drangs pa'i zhor lam lha sar phebs nyin mang po'i bar ngos mjal gyis gsung gleng zhib par byung / bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos bka' shog gnang ba'i sa skya dge bshes dang 'bras spungs dge bshes gnyis lung len res gyis gsung ba ltar tshur khro phu brgya rtsa zhig kyang dgos phebs byung zhing phar rnam sras kyi be'u bum sogs zhu 'dod rung sde pas khong dpon slob la dgon pa dang sa rigs kyi zhu don rnam grangs mang ba'i byed bstad kyi rgyur 'gro bas mi 'gab gsung bar brten zhu ma bde/ khro phu brgya rtsa thams cad mkhyen —382

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)pa bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig gi dbang du byas na dum bu bzhi'i gcig gi tshod tsam zhig thob pa'i lung phul/ brgyud pa rtsad gcod mdzad par med tshul zhus pas de 'dra'i chos zhes thugs khrel nyams gnang bar ngo gnong ba byung bas phebs lan 'bul tshod kyang ma zin/ rtse gdong zhabs drung khri chen phebs pa dang mjal/ gsung gleng ni gzhi nas mi smar ba zhig 'dug /sgam po sprul sku dang gdung brgyud/ sna dkar rtse sku mched/ sog po'i rgyal po dang dpon che chung / rgya nag gi mi sna sogs gsar 'grul rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sde pa (259ba)lha rgya ri bar tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang gzims shag par lo grangs mjug tu tshe rta zung 'brel dang bcas pa/ sde pa byang par tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma dang byang chub gling pa'i gter ma'i phyag rdor gyi dbang / sde pa lcang ra bar dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang las gshin phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / zug po nas dang glang bu nas la rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs rnams byas/ gnas rnying 'khas drung sku 'bring par rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gi lung phul/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skus slar 'gol mtshams shig la chos bka' mang tsam dgos gsung ba ltar khas len zhus/ bstan 'dzin rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal 'don du bzhed pa bzhi skyabs yul mang po khyon gcig par gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad dang de mo dbon po spun gyis bskul ba'i sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs bris/ de mo sprul skus spo bo bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gter chos sprul sku snying tig dbon por bskur nas khungs btsun mi btsun dri bar chos skor rnams kyang ha cang gi ya mtshan rgyu mi 'dug /lung bstan 'od drar/ yang gsang rtsa ba'i chos bdag 'di ltar 'byung ཿ mchog dbyangs rnam sprul gangs can mtshoḥ 'dzam gling lha mi kun gyi rgyan gyur paḥ dam nyams mthil phyin sde dgus rkyen byas nasaḥ ming snyan ga rma'i mtshan can rgyal khams myul: gangs can mgon po de la gtad rgya gyis: zhes ga mi pa chos dbyings rdo rje dang de mtshungs sa skya bdag chen mthu stobs dbang phyug /'brug pa gdung brgyud ngag dbang rnam rgyal gsum la bsngags brjod shin tu che zhing rje (260na)btsun tsong kha par/ thub dbang spyan sngar smon lam log pa yi: legs skar skye ba brod yul 'dir —383—

tshul zhus pas de 'dra'i chos zhes thugs khrel nyams gnang bar ngo gnong ba byung bas phebs lan 'bul tshod kyang ma zin/ rtse gdong zhabs drung khri chen phebs pa dang mjal/ gsung gleng ni gzhi nas mi smar ba zhig 'dug /sgam po sprul sku dang gdung brgyud/ sna dkar rtse sku mched/ sog po'i rgyal po dang dpon che chung / rgya nag gi mi sna sogs gsar 'grul rnams la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sde pa (259ba)lha rgya ri bar tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang gzims shag par lo grangs mjug tu tshe rta zung 'brel dang bcas pa/ sde pa byang par tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma dang byang chub gling pa'i gter ma'i phyag rdor gyi dbang / sde pa lcang ra bar dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang las gshin phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang / zug po nas dang glang bu nas la rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs rnams byas/ gnas rnying zhabs drung sku 'bring par rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i las byang gi lung phul/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skus slar 'gol mtshams shig la chos bka' mang tsam dgos gsung ba ltar khas len zhus/ bstan 'dzin rdo rje rgyal po'i zhal 'don du bzhed pa bzhi skyabs yul mang po khyon gcig par gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad dang de mo dbon po spun gyis bskul ba'i sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs bris/ de mo sprul skus spo bo bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gter chos sprul sku snying tig dbon por bskur nas khungs btsun mi btsun dri bar chos skor rnams kyang ha cang gi ya mtshan rgyu mi 'dug /lung bstan 'od drar/ yang gsang rtsa ba'i chos bdag 'di ltar 'byung ཿ mchog dbyangs rnam sprul gangs can mtshoḥ 'dzam gling lha mi kun gyi rgyan gyur paḥ dam nyams mthil phyin sde dgus rkyen byas nasaḥ ming snyan ga rma'i mtshan can rgyal khams myul: gangs can mgon po de la gtad rgya gyis: zhes ga mi pa chos dbyings rdo rje dang de mtshungs sa skya bdag chen mthu stobs dbang phyug /'brug pa gdung brgyud ngag dbang rnam rgyal gsum la bsngags brjod shin tu che zhing rje (260na)btsun tsong kha par/ thub dbang spyan sngar smon lam log pa yi: legs skar skye ba brod yul 'dir —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()blangs nas: dam sri bdud kyi sprul pa yis: byang sems tshul bzung skye 'gro bde mi steraḥ zhes lung bstan ngan pa zur tsam smos nas 'dir thems yod pa skad du dge lugs la ngan pa'i phyogs 'dug rung the tshom gyi gzhi las kha mtshon ma chod/ rjes su tshe yang phur gsum gyi po ti zhig nged la bskur nas chos bdag yin zer/ lung bstan bstan pa gsal byed du/ 'bras spungs mthil nas bzang po tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang : se rar dpal dang bzang po'i mtshan can byang sems 'byung : zhes sogs dge lugs la bsngags brjod/ bka' brgyud pa'i sdug zhor la lho brag mar pa la'ang smad/ khyad par 'brug pa gdung brgyud la bstan pa gsal byed du/ ri mthil phyogs nas byang sems tshul bzung ngag ming gis: lho mon skye 'gro sdug gi gnya' non byed pa 'byung : pad+ma bdag gi sgrub gnas rnams kyi dam nyams byed: lho mon yul dgon gtan brlag bod yul 'di ru 'tshe: mthar ni gnas srung khros pas srog dbugs sdud par byed: phung thabs nang 'byed de yi rigs chos gtan brlag 'gro: zhes dang / ga me'i ming can stod hor nyi grags dang : mchod yon bsgrigs nas mtha' yi dmag sna 'dren:zhes kurma pa dang bka' brgyud spyi la sgos lung kun khyab gser gdugs las/ bka' brgyud ming btags bdud sprul khyu gcig 'byung : la la bla ma chos rjer ming du 'bod: la la rnal (260ba)'byor grub chen ming du 'bod la la 'brul zhig sgom chen rtogs ldan zer log chos ston cing phyogs dbus kun tu myul pad 'byung bdag gi sgrub gnas thams cad du: dam nyams byed cing byi phrug nyal thag gcod: phyag chen ming btags 'gro rnams log lam bkod: blun sgom skal med bde 'gro'i sgra mi thos: zhes bka' brgyud pa spyi'i lung bstan 'di tshos sprul sku snying tig dang rgyab 'gal du song 'dug pas zog po gter rdzus mkhan du nges shes gting nas 'drongs te slar yang sprul pa'i skur rgyu mtshan mol/ bde chen chos 'khor bas lung las ka dang tham kha dmar po gzhan gyis ma shes par dgongs dpyad yin khul gyis dgos zhes se chen dbon po brgyud sde par zhus pa ltar si gru gu lha'i mtshan dang lung las 'ja' sa sprad/ smon lam chen mo'i chos rar bstan 'dzin rdo rje rgyal po/—384

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (cand la'i o pa shi/ dur bod tho yon/ mkha' 'gro tho yon gong gi gser yig pa/ dpal 'bor chos sde'i mkhan po/ dka' bcu dar rgyas sogs kyis nyi ma rim pa bzhin brgya 'bul bteg /bsnyen rdzogs drug cu dang dge tshul brgyad tsu tsam bsgrubs/gnam gang la chos sde chen po 'bras spungs su slebs/ bkras sgang tshe ring gis lho dmag skabs chos rje nam mkha' rin chen tshur ngo log rgyu'i yi ge sde pa nor bus snying gtam kho la bshad pa bla ma la sngon par bskyal bas nam mkha' rin chen gyi mi rtsa rtsa lag tu gtogs pa nyi shu skor bsad pa sogs tshul ldan ma byas tshul zhu mi byung bar brten khri 'don pa dmangs ma log (261na)dus phyag g.yog 'dra'i khyad kyis skor cig sdod gsung bskyil song ba 'gyangs med la chu sbyang mdzad par thag chod 'dug par nged rang gis gsang ba'i byed babs ci 'dra yod rung phyi 'char du sgrogs rar nyin star gyis ja mgron gtong ba'i thab skyongs dang gang cir khur bsam gyi grags pa che zhing me mdas rmog bcag nas mtshog sgang gis pags pa zhus par brten skra lo'ang bzhar dgos pa byung 'dug gshis thal song de rigs med pa dgos tshul zhus par gsan te skyar po mgon po rab brtan dang lhan du gro mo phyogs kyi kha mchu lab par rdzong bda' mdzad song /zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la spyi khang du ja mgron la phyin/ sang nas bzung zla 'phros bar phyi mtshams ngos snga dgongs dge sbyor dang nyin mo dpe lta 'dra byas/ mkhan chen lo tsā bas gtsos ngam ring khul gyi skya ser rnams khri 'bul ma zin par rjes su 'byor pa mtshams khog tu lo chen dang mjal/sde pa sku na bgres 'dug ces thugs khral cher mdzad cing brtan bzhugs smon lam zhig dgos tshul gsung / yar byon bstun dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher bskul nas brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad ma dbus su bskur byung / bsam yas gnod sbyin chen pos sku rim bskul ma dang spyan gzigs dgos tshul ltar gsung lan dang bcas phul/ bde chen chos 'khor bar lung las byung bar tham phud du bsnyad pa'i yi ge tshigs bcad ma bskur 'dug pa'i lan snyan ngag nas drangs par yang lan gyi lan —385

su tshangs pa dung thod can gyis bal yul dang nye bar 'khrungs tshul gsungs pa dang mthun par snang / sku rim la bsnyad de khyams rar ser 'bras kyi dge 'dun sum brgya lhag bsdus pa'i zla gcig bar bka' skabs sbyar lo bstud pa dang gnangs chag gzhes chag btang ba yas bsu mas skyel byas nas bya phan gnangs chag tsam song tshodi du 'dug /—387

gnod sbyin chen pos rgya ja dang gos chen sna lnga dgos tshul bzhin phul skabs las 'chol gyi 'phrin yig /kong yul nas gnam gong bla ma pad+ma legs grub kyi sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa nyams pa gso dgos pa'i snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig byung ba de lan bsrings/(266na) bdun gsum gyi bar bsnyen mtshams byas/ sde drug mkhan po sna mo shag pa rtsed thang lnga mchod kyi bla mar bskos pa'i legs sor rgyal gnod sbyin chen pos rgya ja dang gos chen sna lnga dgos tshul bzhin phul skabs las 'chol gyi 'phrin yig /kong yul nas gnam gong bla ma pad+ma legs grub kyi sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa nyams pa gso dgos pa'i snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig byung ba de lan bsrings/(266na) bdun gsum gyi bar bsnyen mtshams byas/ sde drug mkhan po sna mo shag pa rtsed thang lnga mchod kyi bla mar bskos pa'i legs sor rgyal ba thog rdugs pas thog gtums pa'i dus kyi sku gzan mthil gyi nang rten zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul skus yar stod zhabs drung la gnang ba sna mo shag grub chen pa'i lag tu 'byor ba byin/ mtshams grol nas rgyal po sku mched la 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ pā ras kyi 'grul pa 'byor pa'i rta nyis brgya tsam byung pā ras sog bod bsdoms pa'i bsnyen rdzogs phyed nyis brgya dang dge tshul nyis brgyar nye ba bsgrubs/tshes nyi shu nas zla ba phyed gnyis bar sgo mang khri gdan zur/ bde yangs/ 'dul ba/ sngags pa rnams kyi slob dpon/ pha bong kha dang dge 'phel gyi ri khrod pa/ dka' rab 'byams dge tshul slong bdun cu skor la lam rim gyi 'khrid zhib rgyas su phab/ sde pa lcang ra ba ming sring ngam ring mkhan chen gyi drung du sgra bslab par 'gro rgyu yin pas sne sbyor dgos tshul byung ba bzhin 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pur bsngags pa'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad du bsrings/ bde chen zhabs drung thog rgod rnam rgyal byon par tshe rta zung 'brel phul/ hor zla bcu pa snga ma'i tshes bdun nas bcu bzhi'i bar rdo rje brag rig 'dzin sprul sku dpon slob/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas dang bcas par byang gter phur pa drag sngags dang gnubs lugs 'char ka sgrom bu ma ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang / chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gter gsar 'chi med sku gsum rigs bsdus kyi dbang (266ba〉sna char ka nyang —392

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)lugs gter gzhung skor/ byang bdag po'i gsung 'bum thor bu/ gsar rtsom khrod nas rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi las byang gi lung rnams phul/ sku gsum rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi skabs tshe mda' rtse sor phyed lhag cig bri 'dug cing gzhan rnams kyi mar me dang mi 'dra ba'i phyag tu bzung ba de rlung pos gsod par nye ba tsam byung song bas nang par sku sger du mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dbang bskyar nas phul bas tshe mda' sngar bzhin tshad du lhogs/ dug khrag gi rdzas dbang dang sku gsum rigs bsdus kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs/ dmar nag gshin rje'i yang snying dang mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i dag snang tshe sgrub rnams kyi dmigs 'khrid dang lung man ngag phyag bzhes shin tu zhib par phul/ ma ga dha kha thun dang khun 'du len sogs kyis gos dar gser dngul ja ras cha'i stong 'bul bteg /lam rim gyi sems bskyed kyi nyin 'khrid dngos gzhir med pa'i bla ma gra pa'ang mang du byung / bsnyen rdzogs drug cu skor dang dge tshul brgyar nye ba bsgrubs/ don gnyer can drug cu tsam la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal mkha' 'gro lnga'i byin rlabs byas/zla ba bcu pa'i rting ma'i tshes bzhi la 'khrid grol nas rje bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig bdud rtsi gser gyi yang zhun dang gsar du brtsams pa'i 'khrid gnyis kyi lung bklags/tshes bdun gyi zhogs gra pa sum cu skor la smyung gnas kyi gso sbyong phab ste rkyang khug gi smyung gnas byed du bcug /srung bzlog bsad mnan (267na)gyi sgrub khag rnams kyang btsugs/ rin po che sman lung pas mkha' 'gro grib sel dang bsu bzlog yun du gnas pa'i thugs rtsom tshig don phun sum tshogs pa zhig mdzad cing bdog pa spel/ khun 'du len gyis gtsos bsnyen rdzogs pa lnga bcu tsam dang ma ga dhas thog drangs dge tshul ma bcu bskor bsgrubs/ de rnams dang gnyug mar gnas pa sogs brgya lhag la gsar rtsom gyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma brgya rtsa bsdus pa/ klu gtor/ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig la bla ma mchod pa dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor kha shas/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang —393—

chos skor yongs rdzogs/ dmar nag gshin rje'i yang snying dang mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i dag snang tshe sgrub rnams kyi dmigs 'khrid dang lung man ngag phyag bzhes ma'i tshes bzhi la 'khrid grol nas rje bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'khrid yig bdud rtsi gser gyi yang zhun dang gsar du brtsams pa'i 'khrid gnyis kyi lung bklags/tshes bdun gyi zhogs gra pa sum rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ rin po che sman lung pa dang gnas gzhi chos rje gnyis la byang pa'i gter gas rngo gyi dmi gu ru'i dbang lung phul/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la rgyal po sku mched/ khal kha dar khan no yon/ me rgan chos rje can dang phrad/ tshes bcu drug gi rgyal phur 'grub sbyor thog zhwa/ gon pa/ sag thag /ral gri sogs ster cha chan grangs dang bcas da la'i bā thur la da la'i hung tha'i ji'i cho lo byin/ bsnyen rdzogs bdun dang dar khan no yon dpon g.yog bcu lhag dge tshul du bsgrubs/ dwags po lcang ra bas rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar par la brkos pa'i par byang bris phur sgrub dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la phyin/ nyer dgu'i nub phyogs nges med nas langs pa'i rlung ltas 'tshub cing rwa zor ye mi 'gro ba/ hom gyi me lce phar tshur sna tshogs su ldog cing 'khor ba'i 'tshi lhongs shin tu che ba lo phyi mar gad sgo (267bskong tshan gnyis kyis bde gzar rgya cher slong ba'i ltas su mngon/dgung lo zhe gsum par ris med kyi 'dus sde rnams nas sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bsgrubs pa bcas kyi skor/sa phag lo gsar gyi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mchod gtor dang dga' ston sngar 'khyud bzhin byas/ tshes lnga la bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu lhag dang dge tshul sum cu tsam bsgrubs/ tshes bdun la bsam blo me rgan chos rjes tshogs chen du bos/ dngul gyi mdong mo bcu bdun/ tha phag bcu gsum/gos yug sum brgya/ dngul srang nyis brgya/ ja ko dra lnga bcu/ rta sga srab kyis spras pa dgus gtsos pa'i ster sbyin spams bstad/ dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che smon lam chen mor gra bskor gyi bstan pa'i rnam gzhag la phebs pa dang sbrags bsnyen rdzogs bzhes par —394

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ rin po che sman lung pa dang gnas gzhi chos rje gnyis la byang pa'i gter gas rngo gyi dmi gu ru'i dbang lung phul/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la rgyal po sku mched/ khal kha dar khan no yon/ me rgan chos rje can dang phrad/ tshes bcu drug gi rgyal phur 'grub sbyor thog zhwa/ gon pa/ sag thag /ral gri sogs ster cha chan grangs dang bcas da la'i bā thur la da la'i hung tha'i ji'i cho lo byin/ bsnyen rdzogs bdun dang dar khan no yon dpon g.yog bcu lhag dge tshul du bsgrubs/ dwags po lcang ra bas rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar par la brkos pa'i par byang bris phur sgrub dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la phyin/ nyer dgu'i nub phyogs nges med nas langs pa'i rlung ltas 'tshub cing rwa zor ye mi 'gro ba/ hom gyi me lce phar tshur sna tshogs su ldog cing 'khor ba'i 'tshi lhongs shin tu che ba lo phyi mar gad sgo (267bskong tshan gnyis kyis bde gzar rgya cher slong ba'i ltas su mngon/dgung lo zhe gsum par ris med kyi 'dus sde rnams nas sde srid bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bsgrubs pa bcas kyi skor/sa phag lo gsar gyi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mchod gtor dang dga' ston sngar 'khyud bzhin byas/ tshes lnga la bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu lhag dang dge tshul sum cu tsam bsgrubs/ tshes bdun la bsam blo me rgan chos rjes tshogs chen du bos/ dngul gyi mdong mo bcu bdun/ tha phag bcu gsum/gos yug sum brgya/ dngul srang nyis brgya/ ja ko dra lnga bcu/ rta sga srab kyis spras pa dgus gtsos pa'i ster sbyin spams bstad/ dge ba rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos/ 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che smon lam chen mor gra bskor gyi bstan pa'i rnam gzhag la phebs pa dang sbrags bsnyen rdzogs bzhes par —394

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chibs kha bskyod/ spyi khang du bzhugs mtsher gnang / de skabs bde chen chos 'khor ba'ang dpon slob sel med kyis tsho 'dzin la byon 'dug /tshes bcu la nged kyis mkhan po dang bde chen chos 'khor bas slob dpon mdzad nas yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs/ 'di lo sde pa'i gsang sgo'i stabs nged kyis ma phyin par dga' ldan khri rin po ches smon lam che chung sbrel te mdzad/ bcu gnyis la phan bde legs bshad gling pas 'chi med 'od snang gi sgo nas tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i sngon 'gror zang zing gi bdog pa spel/ dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa gnyis kyi ngor tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad brtsams/ rigs kun khyab bdag gnas gsar ba mgon po (268na)bsod nams mchog ldan phebs/ zhag bdun brgyad kyi bar stan chags te nyer mkho'i zab chos ci rigs zhus/ legs ldan rje'i shangs mtshal gyis brdzis pa'i zan la tshe dpag med kyi sku btab pa zhig dad rten du gnang / tshangs pa dung thod can gyis blang dor lung bstan ched du mdzad par slar yang dogs sel gyi dri smed gsol ba'i 'phrin yig tshigs bcad spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas 'bul bar nang so sangs rgyas ched gnyer du btang / dur bod dpon mos bla ma gsum gyi mtshan sgra yod pa'i bstod pa dgos tshul byung ba brtsams/ gsang sgo brtol nas skor cig dgongs rdzogs kyis rim gro 'gyangs dogs lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu bla mkhar rnams su gser chab 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan dar phul/ dbus gtsang gi chos sde rags rim la mang 'gyed/ bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs kha shas dang gdugs dkar 'bum ther btsugs/ nyer gcig yan la gra tshang gis nyin ltar gyis mkha' 'gro sde lnga la brten pa'i bsu bzlog dang nyer gnyis nas zla 'phros mtshams dam du bcad pa'i rdo rje gro lod kyi sgrub pa byas pas dam sri'i 'tshub lhongs kyi ltas rnams je 'jam du song /hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la bsam blo me rgan chos rjes sbyin bdag byas nas gra tshang gis —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog rgyas par btang / 'di lo gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos nged rang gi rim gror bzhengs nas gzims chung mgon khang du 'jog dgos pa'i bslab ston mdzad pa bzhin (268ba)dngos gzhi'i khur len ja'i sang sde pas byas/ blo gsal gling bla brang rnying par do dam kha rag mngon dga' ba ngag dbang tshe ring / bal po rdzu dha na/ sirnyi/ bkra shis/ dharma de bo/ dza'i shing / a mar dza ti/tshe ring / dze la khrang rnams kyis gser sku gra tshar dang de ga'i mu 'thud li gsar bzhengs pa lcags byi'i nang du sid+dhi/ dharma de bo/ dza'i shing / khra pa su tsa bzhis bzo byas pa'i gser sku slob dpon chen po dang gu ru mtshan brgyad/ thub dbang / tshe dpag med/ rje btsun myong kha pa/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag gcig /zhar byung du g.yin la ster sbyin byed rgyu'i 'dra 'bag lnga rnams bzhengs pa'i lugs brgyab pa'i do dam gra tshang gnyer pa dge bshes sbyin pas byas/ 'dra 'bag de la zangs kyi srog shing rang grub tu byung 'dug pa legs par mngon/ li gsar gyi rigs lnga sprul sku dang longs sku'i cha byad can tshar re/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ klu dbang gi rgyal po/ 'od dpag med/ mi zhabrugs pa/ thub dbang grong khyer ma/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ tshe dpag med longs sprul gyi cha byad can re/ tshe dpag med longs sku rigs lnga/ mnga' ris sku mched kyi gter ma'i tshe dpag med/ ye shes 'od mchog /rdo rje sems dpa'/ nye ba'i sras brgyad bzhugs sku me tog gis brgyan pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa gra tshar re/ de mtshungs nye sras ldem gra tshar re/ yum chen mo/ yi ge drug pa/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ spyan rasagazigs mgrin pa sngon po/ seng ge sgra/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ (269na tsher jam dbyangs dmar ser/'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po/ byams pa phyag gnyis pa/ byams pa phyag drug pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rnam rgyal 'joms gnyis/ ku ru kul+le dkar mo/ sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ sgrol ma dug sel ma/ dbyangs can ma/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can/ sher phyin ma dkar mo/ thogs med kyi sher phyin ma/ khro gnyer can ma/ sa la/nor rgyun ma ste dgu bcu tham pa gser sku bco brgyad dang bcas pa'i rgyur khams zangs/ bsha' —396

rang rnam du kū lu'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (ca)dkar/ ti tshwa rnams bsdoms par mkhar khal nyi shu rtsa bdun dang nyag dgu /rang byung zangs/ ti tshwa/bsha' dkar bsdoms pa khal lnga bcu nga bzhi dang spor phyed/ gser zho sum brgya dang gnyis song /de'ang rta lo mkha' ru steng du bsdad pa'i nub cig rmi lam du phung po ri bo che'i rtser gdugs lu hang ka bzhi'i sa tsam 'khor gyin 'dug pa zhig byung ba de skabs bod khams bde thabs dang khyad par lho mon phyogs kyi kha gnon du 'jam dpal gshin rje gtso bor byed pa'i sngags sde 'os 'tsham ri bo cher 'dzugs pa'i sa bcad yod pa de la dam sri dbur gnas rnying zhabs drung sku 'bring po rnams gdan drangs nyin gsum gyi bar bsnyen bkur zhing nyin star 'gyed btang / che gsum nas kyis bu ram rnams mtshan mo'ang ko nang la bzhag pa'i skyon gyis chud zos la song ste 'gyed gcig gra mi 'grig par nye ba sku mdun zug po bas bu ram chad pa tsho'i tshab nas steng nas brtsis pa'i 'gyed rnams mngon chung gi cha snyom thabs kyi 'phrul la brten nas shul ma byung bar snang / ser tshogs brgyad du bzlums ma thub pa'i rwa sgreng / 'bri gung / nyang long / kong stod smad/ rgyal dwags/gro lungs rong / gnyal byar/ lo ro dkar nag /mtsho sna/ gro shur/ mdo mkhar/ lho brag phyi nang / shel dkar/ gnya' nang / la phyi chu dbar/skyid grong / rdzong dkar sogs kyi dgon khag brgya dang drug cu re gnyis dge 'dun khri tsho gcig dang stong phrag bzhir nye bar tsha ra'i dod dang bcas pa'i 'gyed mang ja btang ba'i skam thog la rgya li chos li/ rgya nag ma/ bal lha dngos gtsang dang / bcas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan nyi shu/dus 'khor 'grel chen po ti gnyis/ pad spungs dang gser dngul gyi mchod rten nyer dgu /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i bris thang brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun/ rgya hor gyi sbug sil (272ba)bdun cu don gsum/ gan spos brgya bam nyis brgya brgyad cu/ rdor dril zhe bzhi/ ting shags bcu gcig /nya phyis dang rag gi ting bdun tshar gnyis/ gser sga 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag gnyis/ byu ru spos shel gyi shal pa gsum/ sog sna sag sgor/ phub sgor/ a tsar sba ril/ kong rna dung kha yod pa/ phud kyu/ g.yu ril/spyi bkab/ phrom rdzar sogs bsdoms pa brgya dang gcig /mu tig gi 'phreng ba bdun/mu tig lhug ma srang lnga bcu nga bdun/ mu men/ gzi/ bzhu shel gyi 'phreng ba gsum/ byu ru spos shel/ g.yu rdog 'khyar bsdoms pa nyis brgya dang gsum/ gser gyi phor pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ sder ma/ mdong mo sogs spyad pa sum cu/de dang gser sil ma bcas bsdoms par zho chig khri drug stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya bdun dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ tha phag /mdong mo/lhe ri/ dza rag /pad sder bsdoms pa spyad pa sum brgya don gnyis dang dngul —401—

dbur gnas rnying zhabs drung sku 'bring po rnams gdan drangs nyin gsum gyi bar bsnyen bkur zhing nyin star 'gyed btang / che gsum nas kyis bu ram rnams mtshan mo'ang ko nang la bzhag pa'i skyon gyis chud zos la song ste 'gyed gcig gra mi 'grig par nye ba sku mdun zug po bas bu ram chad pa tsho'i tshab nas steng nas brtsis pa'i 'gyed rnams mngon chung gi cha snyom thabs kyi 'phrul la brten nas shul ma byung bar snang / ser tshogs brgyad du bzlums ma thub pa'i rwa sgreng / 'bri gung / nyang long / kong stod smad/ rgyal dwags/gro lungs rong / gnyal byar/ lo ro dkar nag /mtsho sna/ gro shur/ mdo mkhar/ lho brag phyi nang / shel dkar/ gnya' nang / la phyi chu dbar/skyid grong / rdzong dkar sogs kyi dgon khag brgya dang drug cu re gnyis dge 'dun khri tsho gcig dang stong phrag bzhir nye bar tsha ra'i dod dang bcas pa'i 'gyed mang ja btang ba'i skam thog la rgya li chos li/ rgya nag ma/ bal lha dngos gtsang dang / bcas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan nyi shu/dus 'khor 'grel chen po ti gnyis/ pad spungs dang gser dngul gyi mchod rten nyer dgu /rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i bris thang brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun/ rgya hor gyi sbug sil (272ba)bdun cu don gsum/ gan spos brgya bam nyis brgya brgyad cu/ rdor dril zhe bzhi/ ting shags bcu gcig /nya phyis dang rag gi ting bdun tshar gnyis/ gser sga 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag gnyis/ byu ru spos shel gyi shal pa gsum/ sog sna sag sgor/ phub sgor/ a tsar sba ril/ kong rna dung kha yod pa/ phud kyu/ g.yu ril/spyi bkab/ phrom rdzar sogs bsdoms pa brgya dang gcig /mu tig gi 'phreng ba bdun/mu tig lhug ma srang lnga bcu nga bdun/ mu men/ gzi/ bzhu shel gyi 'phreng ba gsum/ byu ru spos shel/ g.yu rdog 'khyar bsdoms pa nyis brgya dang gsum/ gser gyi phor pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ sder ma/ mdong mo sogs spyad pa sum cu/de dang gser sil ma bcas bsdoms par zho chig khri drug stong brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya bdun dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ tha phag /mdong mo/lhe ri/ dza rag /pad sder bsdoms pa spyad pa sum brgya don gnyis dang dngul —401—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)hrug khyen brtsis srang chig khri bdun stong drug brgya bcu drug /ma na ho/ g.yang zhig shel dkar sngon sogs shel spyad kyi rigs zhe drug gan dkar rnying ma dang rgya dkar dkyus ma yu ring yu thung sder mas mtshon pa'i dkar spyad kyi rigs lnga bcu nga gcig /bum gdan ma/ jus sgril btags kyis gtsos pa'i bla bre/ rten khebs/ khri khebs/ mchod khebs bsdoms par bzhi brgya dang bdun/ gos chen/ kha btags/sman tse/ dar rigs kyi yol ba zhe brgyad/ ras yol nyer bdun/ gos ber/ snam sbyar/ chos gos/sham thabs/ gzan/ rtsi ma/ phod ka /rgya gos rnams/ gos chen/ ling / dar/ tshor tse las grub pa brgya gya drug /ras (273na)ber bzhi/ gos yug nyis stong zhe gsum/ yug bcad sum brgya zhe brgyad/kha 'khyar dgu stong lnga brgya re drug /ling dang dar tshos kha sna tshogs/ men/ ma ham chos tse sogs yug bzhi brgya go brgyad/ kha 'khyar chig khri dgu stong drug brgya zhe lnga/ kha btags mthing khra/ ja kha/ dkar po 'dom 'khor ma che 'bring chung gsum bsdoms pa drug khri lnga stong bzhi brgya zhe bdun/ ban chas skor cha tshang / gon phying rgya ma gcig /sbu la ga'i rtsag pa phyi gos chen gyis byas pa bdun dang thul pa gcig /khe re mu/ g.yi/ byi la dkar po'i rtsag pa re/ mu tig gi rgyan yod pa'i sog lham gcig dang med pa gnyis/ rgya lham gsum/ cha rog gcig /gos gdan cha tse bsdoms pa bcu gnyis/ mon dar/ lung gi /nam thang / lwa brgya go bdun/ rgya tshos khal chig stong lnga brgya so drug /grum tse go gsum/ sbyar zlam gnyis/ snam bu dkar po dang tshos ma bsdoms pa nyis brgya go drug /phying gur dang ras gur cha 'grig re/ gser sga/ dngul sga/ra ma lug /tshags sgra legs nges brgya dang zhe gsum gyis thog drangs dkyus sga dang bcas pa sga 'khor cha 'grig brgyad brgya zhe drug (273ba)rta brgya dang brgyad cu/ dre'u so lnga/ ral gri bcu gsum —402

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)rnams song zhing / bzhes thug /rtsam rgyar/ zas sna/ thud/ mar phyur/ tshwa snum sogs kyi grangs ma bkod pa'i gong gsal khyon bsdoms kyi dngos po rnams 'bru thog tu phab par khal bdun 'bum bdun khri lnga stong nga gnyis kyi zi gong du slebs pa dge 'dun tshig 'bum nyi khri lnga stong brgya gya gnyis la sri zhu bgyis/ lo snga ma gsang sgo'i ring sku rim la bsnyad pa'i dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ mnga' zhabs la 'bru 'gyed btang ba bsdoms pa'i dngos po 'brur phab na khal sum 'bum brgyad khri nyis stong tsam nges par song bas khyon bsdoms sa ya gcig chig 'bum lnga khri bdun stong lhag bcas su slebs par snang / sde pa de nyid dge lugs bstan don du 'o brgyal mang du byung bar ma zad rjes su mdzad pa khyab che ba kun la grags shing don la gnas pa yin pas 'di tsam yang dgongs rdzogs ches bsam pa med mod/ la la dag sngon chad 'di 'dra ma byung zer ba mnga' bdag khri ral gyis rab tu byung ba re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun re phul bar grags pa sprul pa'i gang zag gi mdzad pa la tshad gzung mi snang zhing sde dpon du grags pa tha mal pa'i rigs kyi dge ba mi rnams kyi zer ba don la gnas sam snyam/bla chen gyi phyag mdzod phal cher la 'jig rten dpe 'gre'i dge ba'ang lta ci/ thor bu tsam ma gtogs rgyab stong du song ba mang ngo / /'di skabs dngos gzhi stod smad skun tu gra ma 'grig pa ma byung rung gzhis rtse'i ser tshogs kyi mgon du dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che phebs thub la re'ang sku na ha cang smin ches pas nan zhus (274na)ci la nus/ gangs can mkhan po'i bsngo ba bkra shis lhun po ba rnams kyis nyan ma 'dod phyin khong dpon slob la skal ba 'tshems med dgon par bskyal/ de phyin gyi tshogs dbur khong pas mdzad na rta zi ngor pa sogs rwa che ba rnams kyis rtsod mi nus pas 'grig 'gro rgyur 'dug kyang snye thang drung chen can la dbang med cing sde pa nor bus go ma chod par snang / tshogs mkhan po'i bsngo ba ri bo bde chen pas ma nyan par rtsad gcos byas tshe 'phyong rgyas su zhabs drung de nyid kyi skabs zlos gzhi'i sri ngan dang bcas nged rang gis khur khur 'phral du song ba'i rnam rtog cig kyang shar bas khong rang —403

rgyug mtho bcu gcig re yod par sog rna/ sog sgor/ phub sgor/ phud kyu/ g.yu rdog /g.yu'i phra tshom/ mu tig /g.yu/ g.yang zhis byu ru spos shel gyi 'phreng ba/ sgyur shel sogs phra rgyan shin tu phyug pa bzhengs pa'i thig rtsa dang bzo bo'i do dam grong gsar pad+ma rab brtan gyis byas/ ser 'bras kyi mchod rten gyi bzo bkod kyis ha cang blo ma khengs pas da lam mgyogs chos su ma song ba'i gang legs dgos tshul (275ba tshe pabs pa ltar byon gtsang ba'i dper 'os pa byung /gsung gi rten du bka' 'gyur rin po che gser btso ma zho stong phrag gsum las grub pa'i zhal khebs gdong dar sku rags sogs 'gangs che ba dkar chag thang po cher bris pa'i deb nang der —405

yon/ gzungs 'bul rab gnas kyi dgos cha rnams 'bru thog tu dril bar mkha' ru'i khal nyi khri lnga stong lnga brgya skor song /bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi bang rim la gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mang du phul ba'i mjug tu sa stong lus par kha skong du 'dod gsol gyi smon lam slo ka gcig legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur te sdeb sbyor bsgrigs/ bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag dang smon lam tshigs bcad 'bri rgyu'ang brtsams/ gong nas gnang ba'i tham ga'i nang gi rgya yig rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i tham shu gsar pa zhig sa ris kyi gtan tshigs la rgyag par brkos pa'i tham phud tshigs bcad dang bcas 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra dang 'dod khams dbang phyug g.yul rgyal mar phul/ mjug gcod kyi rim gror dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa'i dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor gyis po ta lar gdugs dkar 'bum ther/ gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis gshin rje dmar po'i (276na)sri gnon/ lha sar se ra theg chen gling nas gra pa brgya skor gyis bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog /bkra shis chos sde ba grangs bcad kyis gdugs dkar mdos chen/ gra nang rtsis pa lhun grub can gyis nyes pa kun sel sa bdag g.yo 'khrugs/ dga' ldan khang gsar du dpal ri ba grangs bcad kyis khro rol/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa kha shas kyis 'char ga'i mdos chen rnams btang / bsnyen rdzogs bcu skor dang rab byung nyi shu rtsa gsum bsgrubs/ sde pa sa ta shegs pa yongs su grags pas nyer gcig la rgyal po sku mched gnyis sogs lugs kyi nye len dang bsngo ba zhu bar byon/ mched gnyis la tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang mi bzang rnams dang lhan du tshe rta zung 'brel bskur/ dpon g.yog drag rim dang dga' ldan pho brang gi snga phyi bar gsum gyi lo rgyus zhib par byung / khyad par sku mched gnyis dang gal che ba'i mol bsdur 'dra —406

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)byas/ zhag brgyad bzhugs pa'i nyer dgu la 'dam du byon/ zla mtshams su sde pa nor bu 'byor/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dpon po'i gzi brjid dang ldan zhing shun grong gsar ba lha chos dang lha rgyal sogs kyis phyi nang thams cad du mig mas 'gebs kyi dbang che byed pa'i nang rtags phyir shar/hor zla drug pa'i nang du ri bsgul mtsho skyoms bzhin byung ba yin nam ji ltar yang gtsang drung 'khor spyi so'i yi ge khyer nas rong 'a sras pa dang rta nag lhun grub rtse pa gnyis 'byor/ ci zer gyi tshod len dang bcas ngag ma zhib tu blangs kyang de gnyis ma las btsas nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs blangs pa zhig yin 'dra (276ba)bas lab rgyu cher mi 'dug /lab rgyu med pa gnyis gtong ba de 'dis 'di zer 'di'i sems la 'di 'dug sogs smra ba mang po rnams sangs rgyas gling pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi phyag len bzhin jo bo rin po cher brtan bzhugs 'bul bar btang ba de nyin nas chu rim gyis bri ba'i rten 'brel 'grig pa byung / ri bo rang 'jags/ de phyin gyi sa ris yas mas dang khang shag rnams rtsis blangs/ sog po byang du ldog mi kha shas la tshe dbang bskur/ ser tshogs —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)sbrags phyi mtshams byas/ gad kha sa po ta la dang thag nyes pa'i skyon gyis lho kha phyogs nas sa cha dod snyoms brje ba dang zla ba dkar bstun phyag 'bul 'grub pa'i sa bcad byas rung de skabs sgo sna shag sras po dang bkras sgang (278ba)tshe ring sogs tshang ma sa 'og dar 'thags grub tshod du 'dug /zla ba dgu ba'i nang du bsam yas su mchod dpon pa chos skyong chen por sku phebs thog spyan gzigs 'bul bar btang skabs bse 'bag smug chung la zhal yig yod pa'i snyan dar phul/ gnod sbyin chen pos sde pa nor bu la bca' ga ma byas na ra ra bar yod dus ma sgor tshe gla ba brag la song nas mi zin pa'i dpe dang bcas gsungs 'dug pa/ tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pas dbyar stod chu mi pus mo'i 'og nas rdol zhes lung bstan pa dang mthun par mchis shing / sgo sna shag pa'i nang tshang gzhi sgril ba'i chu tshan la bsnyad de gtsang du phyin chog pa dgos zer ba sras po'i bsam sbyor dang bcas yid dogs tsam byung rung mi dmangs 'di rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i mthong snang ngan pa zhig 'dug pas zhang tshan gnyis kyis rmugs pa'i rang mdog cig mi ston pa'i nges pa med pas bstan na thugs bad dwangs 'gro snyam khrol cha byas/ tshes brgyad la rdo rje brag rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs/ sngon nas thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi dbu rgyan gsar du bzhengs rnying pa der bzo skyor phran bu byas te khra 'brug gi jo mo sgrol mar phul na snyam pa yod rung dbu rgyan dang maṇ+ḍal gyi rigs 'di g.yu mu tig sogs dngos po 'gro tshan che zhing bong chung bas rten bzhengs gzhan ltar ngo so mi rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)sbrags phyi mtshams byas/ gad kha sa po ta la dang thag nyes pa'i skyon gyis lho kha phyogs nas sa cha dod snyoms brje ba dang zla ba dkar bstun phyag 'bul 'grub pa'i sa bcad byas rung de skabs sgo sna shag sras po dang bkras sgang (278ba)tshe ring sogs tshang ma sa 'og dar 'thags grub tshod du 'dug /zla ba dgu ba'i nang du bsam yas su mchod dpon pa chos skyong chen por sku phebs thog spyan gzigs 'bul bar btang skabs bse 'bag smug chung la zhal yig yod pa'i snyan dar phul/ gnod sbyin chen pos sde pa nor bu la bca' ga ma byas na ra ra bar yod dus ma sgor tshe gla ba brag la song nas mi zin pa'i dpe dang bcas gsungs 'dug pa/ tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pas dbyar stod chu mi pus mo'i 'og nas rdol zhes lung bstan pa dang mthun par mchis shing / sgo sna shag pa'i nang tshang gzhi sgril ba'i chu tshan la bsnyad de gtsang du phyin chog pa dgos zer ba sras po'i bsam sbyor dang bcas yid dogs tsam byung rung mi dmangs 'di rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i mthong snang ngan pa zhig 'dug pas zhang tshan gnyis kyis rmugs pa'i rang mdog cig mi ston pa'i nges pa med pas bstan na thugs bad dwangs 'gro snyam khrol cha byas/ tshes brgyad la rdo rje brag rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs/ sngon nas thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi dbu rgyan gsar du bzhengs rnying pa der bzo skyor phran yong ba zhig 'dug pas dge ba'i rigs tshor ngo so thon pa dgos tshul zhu mi mang ba thugs la zhen pa'i sde pa'i dgongs par ma babs gshis rim 'gyangs su lus (279na)pa tshes bcu nas las gra btsugs do dam dang bkod pa grong gsar bas byas pa'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs snyan rgyan rnams gser zho sum brgya lhag ljangs brdungs la g.yu grangs stong mu tig dgu bcu skor gyis spras shing smon lam gyi tshigs bcad gzong brkos brgyab pa lcags byi hor zla dang po'i tshes pa bcu gcig la legs par zin te rang byon lnga ldan la phul/ dge ba che ge mo byas so zhes pa'i snyan grags lhur —410

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)len pa deng sang tshang ma'i srol la 'dug kyang 'khor ba'i 'khor lo skor ba las thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur mi 'gro ba nas byas ma byas las rgyu 'bras kyis brtsis pa de gas 'thus par mngon/ cha gan no mon khan lo snga ma lam du bsnyung bas sku ma 'tsho ba'i dgongs rdzogs pa 'byor zhing 'od zer bla mas sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam dgos zer ba bris shing smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs dang 'byor lan zhib cha bskur/ rig 'dzin yol mo ba'i gcung sprul sku phyag rdor nor bus bka' 'gyur dang thugs rje chen po'i gser sku bzhengs/ ma ṇi dung nyi shu rtsa lnga btsugs/ lcags zam mang po'i zhig gsos sogs legs byas kyi phung po rgya cher spel bar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon lam/ bla ma lho pa'i sku skye 'phyos pa dkon mchog 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i smon lam/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po er te nis thub gsung glegs bam brgya phrag bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam gyi tshigs bcad/ byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs dgos tshul ltar sgrub rgya'i (279ba)nang gi slob dpon lhan skyes rol pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ sde pa bsam dar ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bskul ba'i tshigs bcad rnams bris/ 'bri gung nas zhabs drung rin po che chos kyi grags pa phebs par mtshams khog tu mjal ba'i nyer lnga drug gnyis la shin tu 'gol ba dang bcas nyin 'khyongs lta bur 'jam dpal gshin rje me'i spu gri'i skor gyi phyag len man ngag dmar khrid du rdzogs par zhus shing lhug par stsal/ gshin rje lcags sdig la'ang rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje'i zhal lung 'byul med thugs su mnga' ba'i shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas gsal byed kyi yi ge zhig gi bskul ma zhus pa'ang dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes shing gzhi len shangs len rgyas par bstar/ chog thu pā rang dang gu shri chos rje sogs gsar 'grul 'ga' zhig dang phrad/zla smad nas mchod khang du bdun gcig gi bar mtshams shin tu dam par bcad de 'chi med dpal ster gyi bsnyen pa zhig byas pa hor zla dgu pa'i zla 'go la grol/ bstan srid kyi la rgya dang bod —41/—

khyad kyis smin drug zla bar star chags su byas/ rgya nag gi mi sna'i khrod dang phyogs 'dus kyi rab byung bsnyen rdzogs brgya lhag bsgrubs/ u khe re'i tha'i —412

zhes gling gzhi sna tshogs lab mkhan snang yang sgo sna shag pa'i nang mi rnams gtsang du bsgril lugs dang bcas phyi lag nang 'brel byung ma byung cha mi things bsam pa shar/ gang ltar rjes zin la res 'phral du (281ba)mda' dpon 'or pa nye len la btang ba gong dkar du byang thang rgya le ba brgyud pa'i skad cha khungs btsun la brten nang so sangs rgyas yar 'ongs pa dang lam du phrad pa'i sangs 'or gnyis ka lhan du tshes bcu bzhi'i dgongs 'byor/ sde pa sras po rul bas gzhis ka rtse'i sdod res kyi gzims chung ba rnams bslu thabs kyis phyir bton/ gdong nas bkra shis lhun por 'bu shubs bton dang yong sdud pa tshor dam gcur byas pa'i zhang tshan gnyis kyis rdzong bzung ste bde gzar rgya cher bslang ba'i rgyu mtshan zhib par byung / chog thu pā rang gis 'byas things sam bkra shis lhun po phyogs kyi skad cha 'khyar ba bzhin tshor ba ji ltar kyang gdong kha nas la sras po 'di legs po med 'dug pas bca' ga gyis zer ba labs snang yang shes bzhin khyad gsod lta bu'i 'on gseng byung tshod min pa 'dra/ gnas skabs su g.yeng ba che ba ma gtogs sras pos mngon gyur ba de bzhin ma byas na dgra mkhar grog stong lta bu'i phugs lod po zhig yong rgyur dus gzings slong ba 'di ga dkon cog srung ma'i nus mthur 'dug /sang zhog ja'i sang sde pa/ mgron gnyer drung pa/ stag ru nas/ 'or sangs gnyis sogs dang gros bsdur par khe nyen gyi gnas tshul mang du byung rung da cha rgyal pham sngon gyi bskos tshad las med pas 'phral du dpung 'jug par thag bcad/ rgyal po sku mched kyi sar nya shur skya ril rgyu mtshan lab par btang / u khe ri'i tha'i ji la rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang bskur/tha'i jis khas blangs pa bzhin dmag brgya skor gyi sna khrid (282na)mgron gnyer drung pas byas nas sngon la brdzangs/ snye thang drung chen dang mda' dpon 'or pa gnyis dmag dpon du bskos pa'i dbus —414

'dra/ gnas skabs su g.yeng ba che ba ma gtogs sras pos mngon gyur ba de bzhin ma byas na dgra mkhar grog stong lta bu'i phugs lod po zhig yong rgyur dus gzings slong ba 'di ga dkon cog srung ma'i nus mthur 'dug /sang zhog ja'i sang sde pa/ mgron gnyer drung pa/ stag ru nas/ 'or sangs gnyis sogs dang gros bsdur par khe nyen gyi gnas tshul mang du byung rung da cha rgyal pham sngon gyi bskos tshad snyam pa shar/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyis rang phyogs dge bstan spyi bye brag gi la rgya'i sku rim dang (285na)khyad par hor sog gi yul grur 'tshub lhongs bzlog pa'i dge lugs chos sde sngags gra gzhi dgon rnams kyis gtor bzlog dang mtshan nyid kha gtsang gis sher snying bdud bzlog byung na legs pa'i lung bstan ltar dgon khag phyed sum brgya tsam gyi so so'i bla gnyer gyis khur khur spyi bsdus kyi nyin chog thog gzhung gis mang ja gsum re'i rgyu cha rtsis sprad pa'i rgyun 'di lo nas star chags su yod/ rdzogs chen pa lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis 'bras mo ljongs nas gdan drangs pa'i yid bzhin nor bu sa'i snying po dkar chag lung bstan dang bcas mag sog khang pa gnam lcags drag 'bebs kyis ched bstad skyel mi btang / gra tshang gi gra pa beg tse'i rjes gnang ma thob pa tshor bskur/tshes lnga la gra tshang du gnod sbyin beg tse'i gtor ma la brten pa'i las sbyor btsugs/ nub re bzhin btab pa zor gyi tshul du bskul/ 'di dus dang rlung 'khor btsugs grub bstun po ta la'i mchod khang thad nas btso yang yang rgyug pa dgongs mo se ra'i rdo gcal sku rim grol mtshams su gra pa mang pos gzigs pa dang zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gcig dang za lam nyi shur bskyal dus kyis mtshon pa 'gar btso spen bad la phog pa tsam rgyugs pa gzhis rtse'i phyi nang gi dmag mi rnams kyis kyang mthong zhes gleng / gnod sbyin chen po'i 'khor gyi gtor ma phyi la 'phar ba sogs rtags ya mtshan par byung bas las sbyor dngos gzhi ma 'gyangs par rdzogs par byas/ 'on kyang khong zhang tshan gnyis kyi chen pa ba rdzong zhol/ lha sa/ gra sa phan tshun tshor bag la nyal ba'i tshul (285ba)gyis mang ba yod tshod du 'dug pas zas 'brel byung ba bzhin yin nam gra tshang nang du'ang 'tshub lhongs cung zad che/ bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos gtsang nyang smad kyi phyogs su nged lha srin sde brgyad rnams dmag la 'gro dgos 'dug pas rten 'brel du go mtshon rol cha dgos tshul gsung ba ltar rgyas par bstar zhing / zhang tshan —419

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 6)bskul drag tu byas 'dug pa blo gsal gling pa dang ra ba stod pa'i slob dpon pa byes pa'i bla gra ci rigs kyi tshod na dad zhen che nges yin 'dra snyam pa shar/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyis rang phyogs dge bstan spyi bye brag gi la rgya'i sku rim dang (285na)khyad par hor sog gi yul grur 'tshub lhongs bzlog pa'i dge lugs chos sde sngags gra gzhi dgon rnams kyis gtor bzlog dang mtshan nyid kha gtsang gis sher snying bdud bzlog byung na legs pa'i lung bstan ltar dgon khag phyed sum brgya tsam gyi so so'i bla gnyer gyis khur khur spyi bsdus kyi nyin chog thog gzhung gis mang ja gsum re'i rgyu cha rtsis sprad pa'i rgyun 'di lo nas star chags su yod/ rdzogs chen pa lha btsun kun bzang rnam rgyal gyis 'bras mo ljongs nas gdan drangs pa'i yid bzhin nor bu sa'i snying po dkar chag lung bstan dang bcas mag sog khang pa gnam lcags drag 'bebs kyis ched bstad skyel mi btang / gra tshang gi gra pa beg tse'i rjes gnang ma thob pa tshor bskur/tshes lnga la gra tshang du gnod sbyin beg tse'i gtor ma la brten pa'i las sbyor btsugs/ nub re bzhin btab pa zor gyi tshul du bskul/ 'di dus dang rlung 'khor btsugs grub bstun po ta la'i pa 'gar btso spen bad la phog pa tsam rgyugs pa gzhis rtse'i phyi nang gi dmag mi rnams kyis kyang mthong zhes gleng / gnod sbyin chen po'i 'khor gyi gtor ma phyi la 'phar ba sogs rtags ya mtshan par byung bas las sbyor dngos gzhi ma 'gyangs par rdzogs par byas/ 'on kyang khong zhang tshan gnyis kyi chen pa ba rdzong zhol/ lha sa/ gra sa phan tshun tshor bag la nyal ba'i tshul (285ba)gyis mang ba yod chod du 'dug pas zas 'brel byung ba bzhin yin nam gra tshang nang du'ang 'tshub lhongs cung zad che/ bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos gtsang nyang smad kyi phyogs su nged lha srin sde brgyad rnams dmag la 'gro dgos 'dug pas rten 'brel du go mtshon rol cha dgos tshul gsung ba ltar rgyas par bstar zhing / zhang tshan —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā)gnyis bkras sgang pas gtsos pa'i bsam sbyor log sgrub mkhan rnams dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyi zas su dmar bstab kyi 'phrin las bcol zhing 'phrin yig tu'ang bkod/ ming yig rnams yum rdo rje phag mo'i ka pā lar bcug zer/ btsan rgod rta ra bas rim gro dmigs bsal dang spyan gzigs dgos tshul byung ba de lan gyi tshigs bcad dang bcas go mtshon snyan dar spel/ gnam lcags ur mo'i las sbyor gyi grabs yul byed skabs byang chub gling nas chos rje brag sna ba'i saṃ ṭa byung ba las sbyor ci 'dra byed dgos kyi rgyu mtshan yin yod snyam bltas pas khong zhang tshan gnyis bden tshul gyi sgyur sbyang kha thag ring bar lan med du bskyur bas bang chen de lto ma byung ba phyir log 'dug /rtse tshogs mkhan po blo bzang bstan 'phel/ mnga' ris gra tshang gi slob dpon rgyal sras sher 'phel ba'i sprul sku lnga pa no mon khan/ spyan g.yas spyi so/ bla ma dge dar ba/ e gzims shag byang pa sogs skya ser re mang gis lugs gnyis nas shed gang thon byed khul gyi yi ge byung ba'i khrod nas bla ma dge dar ba dang sde pa nor bu gnyis mi gnyis snying gcig lta bu yin zhing me sprel mchod gzhis zhu grogs bcol bar khur chen ma byung zer ba'i re (286na tshe shobang zhig ni 'dug /gang ltar 'bag mgo gnyis pa las tshad ldan zhig min yod kyang brag sna chos rje'i thad du snye phu nas chas ras rol 'dra dang bcas legs so'i dbugs dbyung byas/ sne'u sdong rtse dang sna dkar rtse sku gzhen pa gnyis kyis bar pa byas chog pa dgos tshul gsung ba thugs thugs tu ma tshad/ lar mi 'di bsam pa'i 'khyer so ma gtogs za che chung dang go yul la bltos pa zhig mi snang /tshes bcu gcig gi nyi ldog dang bstun bying pa sngags rams pa dang mchod dpon can bcu skor gyis gnam lcags ur mo'i las la sbyar ba zla ba bzhi lnga tsam nas rtags rnams mngon du gyur/ rlung dmar dang mig ce'i rlung 'khor gnyis gzhis ka shar a gur dang ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis ri mo ba byas nas zla smad la phyag len shin tu gtsang bar bzos/ gra tshang gi gra pa brag sna chos rjes gtsos grangs bcad kyis klu phug tu nyin kha yar bsgrubs te zla ba bcu gnyis pa snga ma'i tshes bdun la —420

skabs phying gur rlung tshub kyis 'jig la khad pa 'dzin dgos byung / stag lung phyag mdzod pa dang dpon tshang byang ngos pa gnyis kyi skad char gtsang du bde gzar ma grol bar nyin re (286ba)bzhin rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)sel/ 'chi blu rnams khamadzad/ tshes bcu bdun nas las 'go btsugs lcags byi zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gnyis la grub pa'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs snyan rgyan dang bcas pa gser zho lnga brgyar nye ba ljang brdungs la rin po che be+e ḍūrla ser po dpangs la rtse sor do zheng la sor phyed do yod pa gcig /g.yu grangs bdun brgya skor/ mu tig brgyar nye bas spras pa grong gsar bas do dam byas te chos rgyal kṛ gri'i mchod rten byams pa chos kyi 'khor lor smon lam tshigs bcad gzong ris su brkos te sgron/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad kyi nang tshan mar me mdzad la shing gi dbu rgyan zhig las mi 'dug pas byams pa'i rnying pa de la mdog 'don dang gso bran cung zad byas nas phul/ tshes bco brgyad la 'bri gung du rig 'dzin chen po chos kyis grags pa pad+ma 'od (288na)kyi zhing du sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs pa 'byor/ gdung 'bul la brten pa'i dgongs rdzogs mthun rkyen gyi dngos po gya nom pa'ang bstabs/ gong dkar chos sde pa la gzhan gyi zhu log gi 'phrul gyis mchod gzhis rnams bzhes te rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod chag par nye bar bla ma nam mkha' mdzod pa zhu don la yod pa bzhin sa 'byed la kha rag sgrub sde pa'i byed sgo log par brten sde pa gong mas bzhes pa'i mchod gzhis rta 'on bsam grub gling gzhis ka dud 'dzin gnyis/ lag 'bab bdun brgya/ snye mo rka stod dang zhur lag gi gzhis ka them 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab chig stong brgyad brgya skor dang ston tshab kyi gshor 'debs bstan rgyun la bsams nas sbyar/ sdings po che'i gra rigs bla ma rnam sras kyi rgyu mtshan la brten sa ris rnams shor bar dka' g.yeng yang ma nus pas phyir slog gi bab thob che ba rang mi 'dug rung 'thor dogs yod 'dra zer bas rtags tsam 'dzin pa la'ang dge 'dun dkon mchog tu mos par bshad pa'i dbang gis gra nang dud 'dzin sum cu/ lag 'bab nyis stong du nye ba phyir slog /'bras spungs bde yangs pa'i mchod gnyis kha ru gser khang gi tshab tu sde bzhi skor nas dgon pa gsar pa can them 'dzin brgyad/ lag 'bab phyed bdun brgya/ pha bong kha'i ja tshul thebs su gra bzhi khang gsar nas dgu brgya thon khungs kyi 'khyar/ dbu mdzad dang gnyer pa sbyin pa —423

bsgrubs/ mtshan zhabs drung chos kyi grags pas dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang por gsol ba gnang grub 'dug pa nged rang gi ming zur yang bzang po'i mtha' can du thon pas bsgyur bkod ma byas/ gu ru bde ba chen po'i sku/ slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra'i phyag phur chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi gter byon/ rje zur pa'i mgul ru rnams kyi zhu rten dang bcas dngul gdung gi mthun rkyen dgos tshul phyag mdzod dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis smed pa ltar gang legs sprad/ zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa rje zur pa'i yang srid nas slar gter kha bzhes pa'i lung bstan dus babs lta bu'i sprul sku 'byon na ma gtogs pha rnying tha snyad gang la'ang thos rgya che zhing khyad par gsang sngags rnying ma la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig 'dug pa dang gleng mo zhib tu mol/sprul pa'i sku dpon slob la bdag rkyen dang tsam phul 'dug /nyer lnga drang srong lha'i bla ma res gzar byon pa'i dus rigs kun khyab bdag ri sbug dbu mdzad sman khang pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi drung du rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis mdzad pa'i rnam sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga'i chog khrigs kyi ljags lung zhus/ sang gsung ngag 'khrid yig 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis reg zig mdzad pa'i lung phul/ sde pa de nyid kyi dgongs par legs bshad chos 'khor gling pa grangs nyungs nas 'phel rgyas chung zhing mang na spyi so'i phogs la'ang gnod pa dang gu yul dog pa gang spyi nas thog mar chos thog la bsnyad ngos thabs mkhas kyis rtag brtan rang du bzhugs 'jug rtsis snang ba de don thog tu khel na nang gi dgon pa dang phyi'i mchod gzhis gang sa nas gru bzhir 'gro ba 'dug rung sgye don phad zhugs la dga' ba 'di kun gyi srol lam yin gshis btson thon thon mdzad par sa rim gyi mthun rkyen btang bas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su 'byor ngos po ta lar dpon slob tsho dang (301na)phrad/ ge re lha pa yab sras dang g.yon ru dpon mo can brgya skor la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ ri bo dga' ldan gyi rten gsum rnams slar bsgrig bkod byas pa'i deb kyi 'go brjod bi warta can bris/ nyer brgyad nas phyi mtshams kyi bcad rgya byas/ dgu la khyab bdag sman khang par nyi ma mdung gang ma'i byin rlabs dang sang rig 'dzin chen po'i dag snang ma'i 'chi med grub pa'i zhal shes lung dang bcas pa zhib tu zhus shing zla gcig lhag gi bar dga' ldan khang gsar —441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)gyi zur lcog cig tu bsnyen mtshams mdzad/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas nyer gsum gyi bar mchod khang gsar pa'i gzungs bzhugs kyi byin rlabs rten gyi bca' bsgrig /gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa/ zhag lnga nas pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas lha sa rtse mor gzungs par 'debs pa dang bsgril ba'i phyag len mdzad/ nyer drug la lha sar phyin/ ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon byams pa rin chen dang gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis mi lag byas gnam gang gi bar nyin lnga'i ring gzungs bzhugs phul/tor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig gnyis la skyed tshal mkhan po zur pa 'bum rams pa rta nag thub bstan mkhan po/ ngor klu sdings pa/ chos rje zo lung pa sogs la stod phyogs kyi bla ma/ sngags pa/'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rjes gtsos pa'i drung 'khor gyi zhal dkar ba mang du 'byor pa dang phrad/tshes gsum (301ba)res gza' nyi ma/ skar ma chu stod la sta gon dang tshes bzhi zla ba chu smad kyi 'phrod dge bar rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa dang lhan du dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i ras bris gyi dkyil 'khor mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa la brten nas rab tu gnas pa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi rten brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa la rgyas par byas/ de'ang chos 'khor stod smad kyis gtsos pa'i gnas chen rnams su rab gnas bskyar na bod khams su bde thabs 'byung bar gsungs 'dug pa sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin tshang ba zhig la dgongs pas tshul ldan dka' yang rjod byed kyi tshig chad lhag med pa'i lugs yin/ nyi ma snga rting tshor nam mkha' g.ya' dag par rlung bser bu tsam yang mi ldang zhing 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa'i phyi'i gnam dpyad legs pa nang du bag dro nyams kyis ltas bzang ba byung / lha khang gsar pa rnams dang jo shāka rang byon lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor/ dung skyong rgyal mo bzhi la 'dod gsol gyi smon lam bris pa'i snyan dar phul/ bsam yas nas gnong sbyin chen pos rim gro'i bskul ma byung ba'i gsung lan gyi 'phrin yig tshigs bcad dang —442

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (canabacas spyan gzigs bzabs rgyas su bstar/ sang nas bzung nyin gsum gyi bar dur bod dpon po la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang byas shing dpon po'i ngor rgyal ba tsong kha pa la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang dpon mos bla ma gsum gyi mtshan tshang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos tshul byung ba bris/ srung bzlog mnan (302na)pa'i rim gro khag rnams btsugs/ rong pa rdzogs chen pa dang kong po rdzogs chen pa'i sku skye/ chos rje zo lung pa can kha shas la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/tshes brgyad la po ta lar slebs/ bla ma dung dkar ba'i sku skye rab byung du bsgrubs/ ming tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgrar btags/ lha sar phyin pas 'khrugs pa'i nyams kyis rkang pa cung zhig ma bde bar drung 'tsho ba ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis sman sbyar ba'i 'phrod bsten la tshes dgu nas nyer gnyis kyi bar bde mtshams byas/ nyer gsum la rgyal po 'dam nas phebs pa dang mjal/ gdan sa 'og gi btsun mo/ bya pa dpon sa/ gdan sa gong gi phyag mdzod kyis thog drangs zhal dkar 'degs mi dang khal kha g.yas ru rgyal khang rtse'i sprul sku'i mi sna/ stag lung phyag mdzod kyis mtshon pa'i phrad mi mang du byung / bya pa dbon sa la tshe dbang dang phyag drug pa/ ja'i sang gu shri la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel byas/ khams nas gar lugs kyi gra rigs gling dbon po dge lugs su 'gyur khul gyi pad las la mkha' 'gro 'brul bas sdings thang nang so rang phyogs rnga ma nag po'i tshos mdog can gyi bskul ma'i las sna phrogs te kho par sprad/ no po dge tshul sgrub par btang byung ba sa rul gyi chu thub bsam pa ma shar yang 'dod sbyar bzhin byas/ rjes su kho pas bslus nas mkha' 'gro'i mi bzang mang du bsad pas nyos pa'i chang skyur gyi dper song / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kha yar bsgrubs/nyer bzhi nas zla ba bcu (302ba)gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug gi bar 'gol mtshams ngos khyab bdag sman khang par nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs nyams 'khrid yang bskyar dang gzhan yang zab chos ci rigs zhus/ 'byung po'i 'tshub lhongs zhi ba'i ched du yang zab nang gi rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang —443

rnam rgyal smon lam gyi tsha ra gtong bar phebs zhor la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel rnams phul/ bcu drug la sa phag zla ba gnyis pa nas dbu gtsugs pa'i gser sku bco brgyad/ li ma gsar bzhengs dgu bcu tham pa rnams grub pa'i rtsis blangs/ rgyal po/ rtse tshogs mkhan zur pa/ gangs can mkhan po sogs che dgu mang dang mjal/ nyer gnyis la dga' ldan khri rin po che mnga' ris pa'i phyag phyir byams gling mkhan po bsam grub sgang pa dang bde chen chos 'khor bas gtsos bzhi bcu skor la lam rim gyi 'khrid gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bzo thab btsugs te jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bur gser zho drug cu re brgyad/ g.yu brgya dang bzhi bcu/ phub skor gsum rnams (304na)kyi zhal 'debs the ba'i gser zho stong brgyad brgya don gnyis/ phub skor bcu bdun/ a tsar sba ril gcig /sog rna sog sgor gcig /phrom rdzar gcig /gser spyi gcig /g.yu ril gcig /phud kyu bcu bzhi/ gtsug g.yu rdog kham rlon phyed gshags tsam nas g.yu spyang kham skam tsam 'dres pa lnga bcu nga lnga/ gri chung mgo shubs kyi g.yu phra spus legs pad 'dab bzhi ldang ba/ mu tig che ba byur kong nas chung ba rgya sran tsam gyi bar lnga brgya nyer bdun/ dngul srang zhe gcig skor las bskrun pa'i dbu rgyan grong gsar ba pad+ma rab brtan gyis bzo bkod dang 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis do dam byas te lcags glang zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lnga la legs par grub nas dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan g.yas g.yon la 'bri rgyur tshig bcad lhug brtsams pa gzong brkos brgyab ste phul/ dge ba bsngo ba'i smon lam bris pa rgyud stod pa dpon slob kyis zhal 'don du mdzad nas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ de'ang rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen pos phul ba'i dbu rgyan rnying pa brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel khyad kyis bsgyur bkod ma byas par dbyar chu nyen gyi ring sgron/ dgun dpyid mi tshogs che skabs rgyu dang bzo bkod —446

dga' ldan khri rin po che mnga' ris pa'i phyag phyir byams gling mkhan po bsam grub sgang pa dang bde chen chos 'khor bas gtsos bzhi bcu skor la lam rim gyi 'khrid gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bzo thab btsugs te jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bur gser zho drug cu re brgyad/ g.yu brgya dang bzhi bcu/ phub skor gsum rnams (304na)kyi zhal 'debs the ba'i gser zho stong brgyad brgya don gnyis/ phub skor bcu bdun/ a tsar sba ril gcig /sog rna sog sgor gcig /phrom rdzar gcig /gser spyi gcig /g.yu ril gcig /phud kyu bcu bzhi/ gtsug g.yu rdog kham rlon phyed gshags tsam nas g.yu spyang kham skam tsam 'dres pa lnga bcu nga lnga/ gri chung mgo shubs kyi g.yu phra spus legs pad 'dab bzhi ldang ba/ mu tig che ba byur kong nas chung ba rgya sran tsam gyi bar lnga brgya nyer bdun/ dngul srang zhe gcig skor las bskrun pa'i dbu rgyan grong gsar ba pad+ma rab brtan gyis bzo bkod dang 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis do dam byas te lcags glang zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lnga la legs par grub nas dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan g.yas g.yon la 'bri rgyur tshig bcad lhug brtsams pa gzong brkos brgyab ste phul/ dge ba bsngo ba'i smon lam bris pa rgyud stod pa dpon slob kyis zhal 'don du mdzad nas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ de'ang rgyal ba tsong kha ba chen pos phul ba'i dbu rgyan rnying pa brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel khyad kyis bsgyur bkod ma byas par dbyar chu nyen gyi ring sgron/ dgun dpyid mi tshogs che skabs rgyu dang bzo bkod —446

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)gnang ba chos rgyal gyis ka ba bum pa can du sbas pa rdo rje gling pas bton pa/ chos dbang la sne sngon brag phug tu mkha' 'gros dngos su gnang ba'i thod pa dpal ldan 'ja' tshon ma/ mon mo bkra shis khye 'dren dang bal 'bangs ka la sirnyi'i dbu thod/ bde chen gling pas dgos bstod srin bu brag nas bton pa'i pad+ma mthong grol dang tshe 'khrid kyi shog ser/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs dang me long rdo rje'i zhal 'gram/ klu sgrub kyi phyag bzo'i rdo nag gi thugs rje chen po/ rat+na gling pa'i tshems dang slong (310ba)chen pa'i phyag 'phreng sogs nang rten rnams mjal zhing smon lam btab/ sku rnams la dbang bzhi blangs/ sna mo shag mkhan po'i bsngo rten du grub chen pas mtshan ldan dbu thod thog mtha' bar gsum byung ba'i dang po rje sham po'i thugs gtsigs ma sne'u sdong rtse'i nang rten khyad 'phags/ dpon sa g.yang dpal byi bsngo rten du tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal thang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag bris ma/thon nas thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pa chen po'i snam sbyar dang rje mar pas rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyis thog drangs sras kyi nang rten 'ga' zhig stag lung phyag mdzod brgyud nas lag tu son/ sbyor ra sprul sku dang dpal ri sprul sku gnyis kyis yun du gnas pa'i tshigs bcad kyi rtsom pa mdzad/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis la rdzong sdod rnam sras gling pas gtsos gnyal skya ser yun 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrig par 'byor/ gser zho brgya skor dang bcas pa'i skyes bzabs/ bsnyen rdzogs lnga bcu dang rab byung brgya sum cu bsgrubs/ kong po rgyal skor pa pha bu/ rnam sras gling pa/ kra pa khro bo dkar po sogs la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/ kong po'i dpon khag rnams la phub sgor sogs ster cha gang legs byas/tshes bcu gcig la bye rdzing mkhan po sangs rgyas cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pa chen po'i snam sbyar dang rje mar pas rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten gyis thog drangs sras kyi nang rten 'ga' zhig stag lung phyag mdzod brgyud rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (5)dgung 'o1 zhe drug par 'bras spungs kun dga' ra ba'i ldebs bris gsar bzhengs dang / gsang sngags 2sto brang gi 'bur sku bzhengs bskrun bcas kyi skor/'jam dpal gshin rje'i dus rim/ chu stag gnam lo gsar pa'i srid gsum dbang mo mchod cing lo gsar gyi dga' ston sngar 'byud bzhin rgyas par byas/ rgod po rta ra bas blang dor bskul ba'i 'phrin lan tshigs bcad/ sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i sman bla'i mdo chog gi mjug tu 'dogs rgyu'i 'dod gsol/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang so sor gos 'phan (314na)snyan dar/ dkar me/ chos skyong chen por khrab gdan phul ba'i dus kyi snyan dar zhal byang rnams bris/ tshes brgyad la bsnyen rdzogs brgya lhag dang rab byung drug cu tsam bsgrubs/ spo 'bor bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyi shul 'dzin sngags rams pa can la tshe rta zung 'brel bskur/ gra tshang du phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba dang gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drag sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa bye ba re btsugs/ bcu drug la rgyal khang rtse sprul skur tshe rta zung 'brel phul/bod lugs la brten pa'i rdzong ba bzabs/ khri rin po che rtsed thang pa rdeg bzang rgyal mtshan smon lam chen mo'i mgon du chibs kha bskyod pa'i zhar la po ta lar phebs/ lam rim gyi 'khrid gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/ nyer gnyis dang gsum la sde pa ri bo che pa/ sgo mang slob dpon pa/ bde yangs slob dpon/spo 'bor sngags rams pas gtsos nyer lnga'i grangs su bcad par ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur/ sang nyin rgyal skor ba/ o rod/ sga chag /bcos mi/ stong shod/ spyang gi grong pa sogs kong po'i dpon khag dang mnga' ris kyi mi sna khyi gu sbrel por drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud byas/ nyer drug nas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes drug gi bar phyi mtshams byas te —460

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (5)dgung 61 zhe drug par 'bras spungs kun dga' ra ba'i ldebs bris gsar bzhengs dang / gsang sngags 2 1 brang gi 'bur sku bzhengs bskrun bcas kyi skor/'jam dpal gshin rje'i dus rim/ chu stag gnam lo gsar pa'i srid gsum dbang mo mchod cing lo gsar gyi dga' ston sngar 'khyud bzhin rgyas par byas/ rgod po rta ra bas blang dor bskul ba'i 'phrin lan tshigs bcad/ sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i sman bla'i mdo chog gi mjug tu 'dogs rgyu'i 'dod gsol/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang so sor gos 'phan (314na)snyan dar/ dkar me/ chos skyong chen por khrab gdan phul ba'i dus kyi snyan dar zhal byang rnams bris/ tshes brgyad la bsnyen rdzogs brgya lhag dang rab byung drug cu tsam bsgrubs/ spo 'bor bla ma 'jam dbyangs kyi shul 'dzin sngags rams pa can la tshe rta zung 'brel bskur/ gra tshang du phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba dang gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drag sngags bzlog pa dang bcas pa bye ba re btsugs/ bcu drug la rgyal khang rtse sprul skur tshe rta zung 'brel phul/bod lugs la brten pa'i rdzong ba bzabs/ khri rin po che rtsed thang pa rdeg bzang rgyal mtshan smon lam chen mo'i mgon du chibs kha bskyod pa'i zhar la po ta lar phebs/ lam rim gyi 'khrid gsar rtsom gyi lung phul/ nyer gnyis dang gsum la sde pa ri bo che pa/ sgo mang slob dpon pa/ bde yangs slob dpon/spo 'bor sngags rams pas gtsos nyer lnga'i grangs su bcad par ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur/ sang nyin rgyal skor ba/ o rod/ sga chag /bcos mi/ stong shod/ spyang gi grong pa sogs kong po'i dpon khag dang mnga' ris kyi mi sna khyi gu sbrel por drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud byas/ nyer drug nas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes drug gi bar phyi mtshams byas te —460

bdun la tshogs chen du mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ sgrol ma/ sher snying /bzang spyod/ byams smon/ ltung bshags/ bde ba can/ thog mtha' pa/ sa lam sogs chos spyod rags rim gyi lung phul/ dgu la pha bong pa'i rten rnams la me tog gtor/ dngul gdung rin po che mjal smon lam btab cing dbang bzhi blangs/ grong smad du gung tshigs byas nas po ta lar 'byor/ bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu dang rab byung sum cu lhag brgya nyi shu/ mtshan brjod 'bum ther drug /gdugs dkar 'bum ther gnyis/ sman bla dang sgrol ma/ sher snying 'bum ther gsum re/ badz+ra gu ru bye ba/ swa ts+tsha 'bum ther gnyis/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ yum zhar byung du phrad/ 'brug nang mtshams mdzo khal glang la 'do res kyis stong chen phyag rgya chen po'i rang tshugs 'jig par nye ba'i skabs su snang / paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung mgur du/ gnas 'di las dga' ldan lha yul skyid/ /ces zhal gyis 'ches pa —461—

mgyogs pa 'byor/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo byas te mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba rnams 'dren par mdzad pa'i bzhed pa lhun gyis 'grub pa'i smon lam nan tan du btab/ bsam yas nas chos skyong chen pos 'phral du yong dgos tshul dang sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis zhig gsos phal cher grub par rab gnas cis kyang byed dgos gsung bar gza' skar gyis gtugs pas brgyad gtor chen mo nyer gsum la snga bsnur/ sku gdung rin po cher smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan dar dang gdung 'bul dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i bkra shis lhun por mang 'gyed tsha ra gtong bar lha khang chos mdzad dang che gsum nas gzhan pa gnyis btang / sprul pa'i sku myur du phebs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad bris te ser 'bras kyi tshogs (315ba)chen du btsugs/ nyer dgu la po ta la nas bteg /lha gdong shan khar sa skyong thog rgod rnam rgyal dpon g.yog thab bsu la phebs/ tshal zur khang du bsnyen bkur bzabs/ yang dgon dbus gling gnyis nas 'cham gyi rim pa ci rigs brgyab/ de nub chos lung mdar bsdad/ gnam gang gi zhogs bde chen rtse sde dgon gyi rta rags dang yul mi'i khrom gyis bsus te mda' rang gung tshigs la 'byor/ sngags mkhar tshogs par blo sbyong don bdun ma'i rtsa ba'i lung bklags/ de nub rgyab yol thang du bsdad nang par mchod yon gnyis lha sar phyir thegs/ nged rnams kyis gser la brgyud mdo sngags gling pa'i ser sbreng gi sar btsan rgod kha che dmar po'ang khog tu zhugs 'dug par snyan dar phul yas phyin gyi lam tshor chos rje bde chen gling pa dang mthongs kha ru ba sogs phrad mi kha yar dang bro shon mang tsam snang / phun tshogs gling du zhag sdod byas/ gra tshang gis dkar spro bzabs/ 'di nas bzung bzhugs gral tshor glang bu ba dgra 'dul tshe ring dang lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu gnyis kyis chos kyi 'phros gleng mol/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis kyi zhags rta bsur sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal dpon g.yog brgya skor/—462
