tshes gnyis kyi zhogs rta bsur sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal dpon g.yog brgya skor/—462

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (canamanga' ris gra tshang dpon slob rgyal sras sher 'phel ba'i sprul sku/ dkar po zhabs drung thugs sras che ba/ dpal ri sprul sku/ rab byung pa'i bla ma/ mkhan tshang rab stims pas mtshon skya ser gyi bzhugs gral la gra tshang nas tsha bzhes kyis bsnyen bkur/ 'di phan chad bkra shis lhun po'i (316na)gnas gshis stabs kyis rgyas rgyas ma bde rung sngon nas gnod sbyin chen po dang gnas chung chos rgyal gnyis gas rdo mchod thang gi thad du chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dran thub pa'i spros pa che ba dgos tshul gsung ba rten 'brel gyi sgo nas gdugs rgyal mtshan gyis mtshon pa'i dar cha rnams bslangs/ rgya dkar nag gi rol mo dang bcas skya rags rnams dal 'gros kyis phyin pa'i tse dmar thang gi rten mkhar yod sar gser skyems rgyas par bsngos/ mnga' ris gra tshang / dpal ri sgrub sde/ rab byung pa gsum gya ser sbreng / rnga shon/ bro shon/ 'bag shon/ gzhas ma sogs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba dang bcas pas mdun bsus pho brang 'og tu 'byor/ tshoms chen du gung gi bzhugs gral rgyas par bshams/ phyi dro dbu rtse rigs gsum/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod/ g.yu'i thub pa rnams mjal/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ mthongs gzhi nag la gnas bcu'i si'u yod pa'i bla bre/ gos yug /'khor gyi lha kun la bkras btags kyi snyan shal bcas phul/ 'di nas bzung lha khang so sor phyin skabs bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa bris pa'i lha rdzas kyi mchod sprin spros byang chub chen po'i drung du yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ bsam pa lhun grub ma'i gsol 'debs byas/tshes gsum gyi snga dro pe har lcog tu gnod sbyin chen po sku phebs zhus/ (316ba〉sngog gi rdo gcal du khrab gdan dbu sdom dang bcas bsu bar byon/ gtsang khang gi mdo'i dkar phibs su sgam gshibs pa'i khri khru do tsam brgyab 'dug pa'i khar bsdad/ spyan gzigs mthun rdzas su bkras btags gsum/gser skyems zho sum cu/ dkar yol nyin mo bde legs dngul stegs dang bcas pa/ gan gos gser ma dmar po'i dbu sdom/ nya jus kyi khrab gdan/ gos dmar gyi zhabs dor/ rgya sbug legs pa/ bla bre/—463—

la nye ba/ gri mdzod pa'i bus sde pa sras po'i zi bun dus bya gdong khul byas par dam rtsi zhig kyang byung 'dug pas lho brag yug ba them 'dzin lnga/ lag yong nyis brgya skor rnams sbyor 'jags byas/ gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag 'di rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang gi ya gyal gcig yin par ma zad/ lus can kun la ris su ma chad pa'i spyi nor bla na med pa yin yang byang pa rigs ldan dang zur mkhar ba lugs tha dad pa'i nang nas smad lugs la gra thang gi par khungs btsun de 'phrin las ches skyon gyis mi gsal zhing (323na)sgam po sprul sku nor rgyan pas mchan bu logs su bkod de gsar brkos des kyang go dkar song / rtag brtan du gra thang gi bu dpe yin khul la byang pa rigs ldan chen po'i lugs dang bsres te don du phan tshun gnyis gar the ba'i sprul sku rang gi chos lugs dang mtshungs pa 'tsho byed lhun sdings pas do dam byas te rjes su brkos pa nor btub pa zhig mi 'dug par brten brko ba'i 'dun pa yod steng drang srong byang ngos pa nang so dar rgyas kyis bskul bas mtshams sbyar te hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du rgyud bzhi'i ma dpe bskur zin pa'i par byang che chung rnams bris/ tshes bcu drug nas hor zla lnga pa'i tshes brgyad kyi bar phyi mtshams khog tu gzhis ka shar pa a gur dang ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis shog khra'i ri mo ba byas te kun dga' ra ba'i nyi 'od ldebs ris la rgyal rabs dang mkhas grub lo paṇa gyi rnam par thar pa che long las btus pa'i gzhi mi —472—

(324na)drag pa 'dug pas dang spro ba'i khur len che ba mdzad/bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul so sor bzhi bcu/ dge bsnyen gnyis rnams bsgrubs/ khyab bdag sman —473—

tshon 'og tu 'gro rgyu'i gnas yig gzungs sngags khyad par chos skyong rnams kyi srog 'khor 'khrul med brgyud pa'i phyag bzhin bkod/ dam rdzas dang mthun rdzas sogs kyang man ngag bzhin tshang bas chen so'i brgyud pa'i bka' babs kyi dam rdzas dkar chag /sde tshan gang yin gyi thog ma'i rgyab tu 'dri ba'i tshig lhug thog mtha' —474

dang bla ma'i rigs la nang zhig yong ba sogs rnam grangs kha yar shar ba'ang rjes su mngon shes 'dra ba'i nges pa rnyed pa byung / lo snga ma mgron gnyer drung pa gnas chung lcog tu btang skabs shig yun du 'tsho ba'i smon lam btab/ nyer gcig la bsnyen rdzogs so gnyis dang dge tshul nyi shu skor bsgrubs/ khal kha g.yas ru'i rgyal po bi shi rel thu stong 'khor ba'i dgon par glo bur du grongs pa'i rgyal sa tsho pa bdun la gros med pa de ga'i gcung pos 'os med rig pa mdzad pa la bsnyad stong 'khor ba phyogs kyi g.yo 'phrul la brten san hung tha'i jis gzhung bshig pa'i gnas tshul no mon e jen mtsho kha 'byor thog byung bas dpon po rang yul la log pa'i me rgan chos rje dang dge tshul ma rgan pa yon mchod gnyis bod du dge rtsa byed par 'byor/ bsnyen rdzogs dgu bcu go gnyis dang dge tshul dkar chag bskul ba ltar bkod/tshes brgyad la me rgan chos rje nyang lugs drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud/ bram nag bshan pa drug skor/ rnam sras ser chen smad lugs rnams kyi rjes gnang byas/ gtor dngul srang stong phrag dang gos dar kha shas kyi bsngo rten byung ba dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ dngul srang nyis brgya'i yo byad la brten phan bde —481—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ 15)bstar/ bsnyen rdzogs dgu bcu go drug dang dge tshul gya bzhi bsgrubs/ rmi ru ba dang ne'u chung ri pa gnyis dril bas zang zing gi skyes dang bcas yun du 'tsho ba'i smon lam btab/ nyer gcig la bsnyen rdzogs so gnyis dang dge tshul nyi shu skor bsgrubs/ khal kha g.yas ru'i rgyal po bi shi rel thu stong 'khor ba'i dgon par glo bur du grongs pa'i rgyal sa tsho pa bdun la gros med pa de ga'i gcung pos 'os med rig pa mdzad pa la bsnyad stong 'khor ba phyogs kyi g.yo 'phrul la brten san hung tha'i jis gzhung bshig pa'i gnas tshul no mon e jen mtsho kha 'byor thog byung bas dpon po rang yul la log pa'i me rgan chos rje dang dge tshul ma rgan pa yon mchod gnyis bod du dge rtsa byed par 'byor/ bsnyen rdzogs dgu bcu go gnyis dang dge tshul bzhi bcu zhe dgu bsgrubs/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gsum la bsam blo me rgan chos rjes sbyin bdag byas te gra tshang gis 'chi med 'ong snang gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe chog btang / zhag gsum bcad rgya bgyis pa'i tshes drug la da la'i hung tha'i ji mtsho kha nas 'byor ba dang phrad/ (329ba)bsnyen rdzogs brgya bcu gcig dang dge tshul brgya bzhi bcu skor bsgrubs/ lha sa spyi tshogs kyis nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba bris/ mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis rigs lnga/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ thugs rje chen po rnams kyi gser thang gra tshar bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bskul ba ltar bkod/tshes brgyad la me rgan chos rje nyang lugs drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud/ bram nag bshan pa drug skor/ rnam sras ser chen smad lugs rnams kyi rjes gnang byas/ gtor grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang /skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po/ phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul rnams bskur/ se chen hung tha'i ji'i bu rdo rje pha'i dge rtsa gtong bar 'byor/ dngul srang stong phrag dang gos dar kha shas kyi bsngo rten byung ba dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ dngul srang nyis brgya'i yo byad la brten phan bde —481—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6)legs bshad gling pas phyag len tshad ldan gyi rus chog dang 'brel bas sāts+tsha btab/ skye rtags dgos tshul zer ba rang byung 'phags pa'i drung du 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas byang bu bzhu/ klu 'bum me rgan chos rjes gos yug brgya dang ja ko dra brgyas gtsos pa/ dpon mos gos dar ja dngul gyis sna drangs (330na)pa'i zang zing rgya cher byung / bsnyen rdzogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dge tshul bcu gsum bsgrubs/ gra tshang du gshin rje dmar po rlung gi sgrub pa btsugs/ spyi sgos kyi rim gror rdzong gzhis khag bcu drug bsdoms par bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang sum cu so lnga/ 'bum brgya/ brgyad stong pa stong rtsa gsum/ bskal bzang stong rtsa gnyis/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa stong rtsa/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ gser gzungs rnams brgya rtsa/ mtshan brjod 'bum ther lnga/ gdugs dkar 'bum ther gnyis/ sgrol ma 'bum ther gcig zhar snying 'bum ther gsum/ rnam rgyal 'joms gyi gzungs 'bum ther re/ gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i gzungs ring bye ba gsum/ ma ṇi dung phyur lnga/ sāts+tsha 'bum ther gcig /lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu bzhir brgya mchod zhal gser/ spyan 'byed/ phyugs lug brgya'i srog blus/ rgyud bzhi gsar du brkos pa'i par phud 'byor/ gsang sngags pho brang gi 'bur sku rnams grub bstun brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang can gra pa kha shas kyis ro gdan 'og tu mnan pa brgyab nas de steng snang brnyan rnams bsgrigs pa'i sngon 'gro brtan bzhugs kyi rab gnas dang kun dga' ra bar bgegs skrod kyi me tog 'thor bar mchod dpon pas rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin can gra pa bco lnga skor btang / sde pas don gal po cher mdzad de khur bzhes do dam lha rtse lhug pa/ bal po sid+dhi can lngas nyer lnga la 'go btsugs sa sprel zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi (330bsko1 la grub pa'i sangs rgyas stong sku'i rgyur zangs mkhar rgya'i khal sum brgya nyi shu/ ti tsha so gnyis/ bsha' dkar bcu/ gser btso ma zho sum brgya brgyad/ grang gser zho nyi shu/ dngul srang bcu gsum song ba'i phogs gla yon ston mo rnams kyi dgos cha 'bru thog tu dril bar mkhar khal chig khri dgu brgya song / nyer drug la bsnyen rdzogs bdun cu don gnyis dang —482

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)dge tshul zhe lnga bsgrubs/ er te ni tha yan chis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam go bde ba/mgon khang dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i ngor smon lam/ yangs pa can spyan snga ga rma nyi ma bsnyun pa'i dus bar chad sel ba'i tshigs bcad/ lha sa byams rgyab bzhi dga'i kha tan du smon lam rnams bris/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis la er te ni gu shri can gyis sbyin bdag byas gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i 'chi med tshe'i cho ga btang / rgyal po kong por dpung thog tu bzhugs pa'i stabs gong gi bka' shog gnang sbyin tshugs pa'i phur sgrub sngar rgyun bzhin dang bcu bdun nas bzung (332na〉ten gsum gyi bar jus rim la dmigs gra tshang nas gshin rje'i rang gshed 'bebs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ de mtshungs nged kyis ban bon gyi ngan sbyor gshed 'bebs dang re ma tī/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag rgyal po pe —484

gshags rgyud par gyi ma dpe bskur/ brgyad la legs ldan nag po gdong bzhi pa rgya cher mchod cing sang nas mu 'thud gra tshang gis bskang ba khri tshar bsags/ dgu la gong dkar nas chos rje dkon gnyer 'bar ba dang 'gong po ar la gtad pa so sor bye ba/dgon khag rnams kyi 'gyed kyang gser dngul gyi dngos po spams che ba sre bas thugs khur che bzhes kyis btang bas rim gros ngo blangs pa lta bu'i byang ngos nas kyis sman dpyad mdzad pa rnams kyang 'phrod lam che ba'i zla mtshams nas nad mjug phran bu tsam ma gtogs gzhi med du song / mda' dpon bsam dar bas bskul ba'i zhang blon gyi las byang dang nas gos chen gyi gur yol sgor dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi gser thog thebs su gser srang brgya/ dngul lnga bcu ma bdun/ gos yug dgu /la stod byang pa'i khyad nor gyi dung rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6) bu'i (356na)gzi brjid dang phug pa'i nang 'od du gsal zhing mkha' la 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa/rlung bser bu mi ldang bas sa la drod sos ga'i dus ltar phebs pa byung zhes gleng / de 'phral du dpal ri sprul sku can dge 'dun brgyad cu skor gyi spyan 'dren khrus gsol brtan bzhugs smon lam bkra shis tshigs su bcad de me tog gtor/ phyi dro gser 'bum mthil du tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par bshams te tshes bcu'i gar 'cham gyis rol/ gnas srung gtso mo rig 'dzin ma/ gnam lha byang chub/nor bu 'dzin pa/ ge gong chen po rnams khog tu zhugs thog chas phyag mtshan snyan shal phul zhing dmod nas gtor bas rig 'dzin mas sku 'di khyed gzugs can kho nas drangs pa min/ nged gzugs med tsho dang lhan cig pa'i mthu las byung / rten gnas su phebs pa'i tshe rtsi shing nags tshal rnams kyang mgo phyogs pa ma mthong ngam gsung / der 'khod kun kyang rnam rtog tu de 'dra ba zhig byung zer skad/ bod 'bangs bde ba'i rten 'brel 'grog tshul gsungs pa'i ram chos skyong g.yin tshos bteg pa'i legs tshogs kyi snyan pa dang bcas chang khyim pa 'khor zhing zhang mkhar pa tshe chog gi do dam la rjes su bsdad/brgyad kyi dgongs mo nas bzung dpal ri ba dpon slob kha shas kyis gsang phug tu bdun gcig gi ring 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i sgrub pa dang gra dmangs kyis zhag gsum gyi bar dri med bshags rgyud sgrogs/ tshes bcu gcig la sde pa bya ba yab yum sras bcas byon/ ras lcags khro btsong / gser rnga nyi shus thog drangs pa'i ster cha dpangs mtho bar mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams la 'chi med (356ba)dpal ster gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ bsnyen rdzogs nyis brgya don bdun dang / dge tshul nyis bsadrug bcas bsgrubs/ lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu dang khal kha sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis bskul ba'i smon lam/ dge 'phel dbon pa'i ngor brtan sdod/ 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku'i bzhed pa ltar bdag bstod/ gra dmangs kyis bskul nas sgo mang slob dpon 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs rnams bris/ 'phags pa lha'i sprul pa'i skur rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum nas lam rim chung ba/'dus pa dang bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog /'jigs byed za ma tog /sbyin sreg dngos grub —520

sos ga'i dus ltar phebs pa byung zhes gleng / de 'phral du dpal ri sprul sku can dge 'dun brgyad cu skor gyi spyan 'dren khrus gsol brtan bzhugs smon lam bkra shis tshigs su bcad de me tog gtor/ phyi dro gser 'bum mthil du tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par bshams te tshes bcu'i gar 'cham gyis rol/ gnas srung gtso mo rig 'dzin ma/ gnam lha byang chub/nor bu 'dzin pa/ ge gong chen po rnams khog tu zhugs thog chas phyag mtshan snyan shal phul zhing dmod nas gtor bas rig 'dzin mas sku 'di khyed gzugs can kho nas drangs pa min/ nged gzugs med tsho dang lhan cig pa'i mthu las byung / rten gnas su phebs pa'i tshe rtsi shing nags tshal rnams kyang mgo phyogs pa ma mthong ngam gsung / der 'khod kun kyang rnam rtog tu de 'dra ba zhig byung zer skad/ bod 'bangs bde ba'i rten 'brel 'grog tshul gsungs pa'i ram chos skyong g.yin tshos bteg pa'i legs tshogs kyi snyan pa dang bcas chang khyim pa 'khor zhing yid mkhar pa tshe chog gi do dam la rjes su bsdad/brgyad kyi dgongs mo nas bzung dpal ri ba dpon slob kha shas kyis gsang phug tu bdun gcig gi ring 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i sgrub pa dang gra dmangs kyis zhag gsum gyi bar dri med bshags rgyud sgrogs/ tshes bcu gcig la sde pa bya ba yab yum sras bcas byon/ ras lcags khro btsong / gser rnga nyi shus thog drangs pa'i ster cha dpangs mtho bar mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams la 'chi med (356ba)dpal ster gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ bsnyen rdzogs nyis brgya don bdun dang / dge tshul nyis bsadrug bcas bsgrubs/ lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu dang khal kha sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis bskul ba'i smon lam/ dge 'phel dbon pa'i ngor brtan sdod/ 'phags pa lha'i sprul sku'i bzhed pa ltar bdag bstod/ gra dmangs kyis bskul nas sgo mang slob dpon 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs rnams bris/ 'phags pa lha'i sprul pa'i skur rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum nas lam rim chung ba/'dus pa dang bcu gsum ma gsum gyi dkyil chog /'jigs byed za ma tog /sbyin sreg dngos grub —520

'brel ba brjod bya gang legs/ zhar byung deb kyi 'go brjod 'phral du bris pa'i dpon tshang phyir slog /nyer dgu la rgyal po dpon g.yog —521—

brag 11la sku gnyis la rdor 'bum chos grags kyi gter ma'i bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rje'i gter gsar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang lung cha gyis se thog lcags phur ba dang shug ra khang gsar gnyis gnang ba ma 'cham par brten sa cha 'or sbug par 'jags pa'i bdag po gnyis la sa tshab zhol nas sprad/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la dar mo ba blo bzang chos grags kyis phyi rol tu rgyud bzhi yongs rdzogs rgyugs phul na gnang sbyin zhus pa 'dra zhig yong 'dug pas skal ba bzang phyir nged rang gi 'khris su byed ces rtsa rgyud yongs rdzogs dang rgyud gzhan rnams shog bu kha yar kha yar skyur mtshams nas yig 'phreng gnyis gsum re'i rgyugs dang gzhung don sa bcad rtsed thang du 'di lo gra skor byed pa'i bshad phud byung / tshes gsum la ra ba stod pas tshan (362na)grangs dang bcas tsher gseb dgon pa ba lugs kyi rten 'byung mdzad song ba zhal 'don kyang chad grabs dang gtor ma sogs rnam dbye ye mi 'dug /rang la bab thob gang yod de ga gnad che bar snang / bkra shis lhun po nas gra tshang gsum gyi slob dpon/ bla brang gi sku tshab rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sde pa srad pa/ rtse nas/ jo mo rdzong pa/ lhun grub rtse ba sogs kyis sbyin bdag byas tshogs chas ster cha 'gyed spams bstod pa dang bcas gra tshang gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog btang / bkra shis lhun po ba tshor phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang byas/ bo dong me long dgon pa ba chos rje pad+ma gar dbang de mkha' 'gro seng gdong mas rjes su bzung zhing gdams pa gnang ba'i grags che/ de'i sku skye bstan 'dzin ngag dbang dpal bzang mkhyen dpyod yangs shing dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i gdams skor la mnga' brnyes pas 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar po dang khal kha a sa lang sogs la mngon spyod mdzad pa rtags thon byung bar snang /—529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6) khong pa me glang gshegs nas sku skye nged 'drongs ma byung 'dug rung g.yag sde nas po ta la'i ar por 'ongs pa'i 'u lag zhig rgyab 'ded pas rgyug rdeg btang ba'i rkyen gyis bros te chu shur phag gdong du btsun pa byas/ der rkun ma brkus pas dbyung ste sa skur phyin der yang lag mi gtsang ba byung bar brten sdod ma thub par hor la byon pa'i 'brog khri lcam gyi a drung rgad bu sdug chos byas pa zhig gi ga sku rdzog la phyin mtshams nas sems la 'byung po zhugs nyams kyis pad+ma gar dbang gi skye ba yin zhes gleng zhing mig 'phrul lta bu'i rtags mtshan 'dras mi mgo bskor ba'i zog po de 'ongs pa thog mar de 'dra'i rgyu mtshan ma (363na)nges pas phrad na'ang ja gral gyi sar dpal 'khor chos sde'i slob dpon pa 'ga' zhig yod pa la 'phros par g.yengs nas kho pa dang gtam ma 'dres pa rjes su bsam tshe bdud sprul de rigs la bag zon chud pa rang gnad du che bar mngon/ lha sa rdo khang du sprul sku dpal mgon can mkhas bsgrugs bcus gsol 'debs kyi rten mdo chog las ji ltar 'byung ba'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa gtso thang bzang po spyod pa las byung ba'i nyal sgom dang 'brel ba'i bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dang bcas tshon thang dgu deng sang sla chos kyi nag thang tshon thor re ba las med pa'i ri mo ba rnams kyi chang rin dang mi 'dra ba'i sman thang pa'i phyag srol gyi nag thang tshon thang las kyang bkrag che ba'i lugs ltar yi dam chos skyong gi sku brnyan nyer mkho bdun tshar zla ba phyed brgyad tsam gyi khongs su gegs med du grub pa'i skya ris spyan 'byed kyi rab gnas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas byas/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi gtso thang rgyab tu che brjod smon lam/gzhan brgyad po'i rgyab tu tshigs bcad blo ka re bi warta dang bcas pa/ gong dkar chos sde nas ri mo ba mkhas pa kha shas kyis brag sgo ga khri'i gnam rgyan la ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang dbus su tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rnams bris/ de mus nas 'bras spungs mtshams khang gsar par phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i zhal 'don dang mthun pa'i sngags sku 'bri ba dang shing rtsi gtong ba'i do dam 'dar gzhon (363ba)ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis byas/ sngar zur khyab 530

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam dang po/ (5)bdag bla ma'i drung du gsar ma rgyud 'bum gyi po ti lnga tsam cig las ma thob pas rgyud 'bum gyi lung rgyun ngor lugs khungs btsun pa'i gshis sngar thob pa rnams dang brgyud pa gcig khyad nas rigs kun bdag po khra tshang pa chen pos gong dkar rdo rje gdan du rab 'byams chos rje la rdzogs par gsan te tshes bco lnga nas rgyud 'bum ljags lung gi dbu btsugs/ stag ru ba nor bu spun gyis yig drug dung phyur btsugs skabs smon lam tshigs bcad dgos tshul bzhin brtsams/ bsnyen rdzogs don bzhi dang dge tshul so bdun bsgrubs/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la phan bde legs bshad gling pas spyi sger gyi tshogs chas zang zing gi skyes dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog btang zhing rten 'brel bsgrigs/ se chen dbon pos kho rang gi gon par bzos pa'i lha sa dang ra mo cher phye phur phul ba'i kha byang bkod/ rgya rag gi ya mgu ma mgu gtor cha lnga tshar legs pa zhig gra tshang gi nyer spyad du sprad/ tshes bcu bcu gcig skor la gra sa phan tshun gnyis so so nas dge 'dun nyis brgya lhag bcas phebs pa'i bdog pa gzengs stod de 'chi bdag gi g.yul las rgyal ba'i bden pa brjod/ rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs par khrus gsol mdzad pa'i phan yon gyis char dba' thon pa babs/ 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po dang dga' mgu ba bkra shis dbang phyug gnyis sdom gcod par bsdad/ lkog pa bas rgya bod kyi yig rigs (364na)dang rtsis sogs yon tan la brtson pa byas pas lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba byung / bsnyen rdzogs so bdun dang dge tshul nga drug bsgrubs/ gangs can chos 'phel gyi mkhan po skyong nga ba blo bzang phun tshogs bdog pa tshan grangs bcad ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa dang sbrags ngos 'phrad la byon/ nyer gsum la mkhas grub sman lung pa chen pos skyes dang bcas bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ 'chi blu'i rim gro mdzad nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgrub mchod la chu bo rir phebs/ rgyal po 'dam du 'byon khar tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ ri bo che nas stag lung zhabs drung ma chen gyi zhu lan tshig lhug gi bi warta/ glang bu ba dgra 'dul —531
